We then introduce annotation-conditioned reward modeling, which uses these annotations to score new responses during RL, and show that small open-weight agents trained with this reward better align with human privacy norms, with strong gains on PrivacyAlign and existing privacy benchmarks for agents.

AI.tldr: 提出PrivacyAlign数据集（1350样本，3516条标注），通过人类隐私规范对齐训练和评估LLM智能体，证明基于人类标注的条件化奖励建模能显著提升智能体的隐私对齐性能。
AI.motivation: AI智能体代表用户做决策时，隐私泄露是一个关键的对齐问题。现有工作使用不可靠的代理指标进行训练和评估，缺乏以人类判断为中心的隐私对齐方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建PrivacyAlign数据集，包含1350个样本和3516条详细标注；2) 提出条件化LLM评判器（conditioning on human annotations）；3) 提出标注条件化奖励建模（annotation-conditioned reward modeling），在RL训练中用人类标注对新响应进行评分。
AI.result: 条件化LLM评判器的判断更可靠；基于该奖励训练的小型开源智能体在PrivacyAlign和现有隐私基准测试上取得更优的隐私对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: 将人类隐私规范置于中心位置能够有效提升智能体的隐私对齐能力，人类标注不仅是评估标准，更是训练信号的核心组成部分。

title: Ramanujan Graph Rewiring with Non Negative Resistance Curvature
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning on graph-structured data by iteratively propagating and aggregating information across edges. However, conventional message passing schemes often suffer from over-squashing, whereby exponentially large neighborhoods are compressed into fixed-dimensional embeddings, impeding effective long-range dependency learning. In this work, we introduce Ramanujan Propagation, a graph rewiring strategy that leverages Ramanujan graphs to alleviate topological bottlenecks in GNNs. We first establish that suitably chosen Ramanujan graphs guarantee non-negative resistance curvature, which mitigates over-squashing and facilitates efficient information flow. We then propose an algorithmic framework to construct a Ramanujan rewired graph that preserves the local connectivity of the original graph. Our experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms nine state-of-the-art rewiring techniques. These results establish Ramanujan graphs as a rigorous structural prior for scalable, topology-aware message passing in GNNs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ramanujan Propagation，一种利用Ramanujan图进行图重连的策略，通过保证非负抵抗曲率来缓解GNN中的过挤压问题，从而促进高效的长距离信息传播，实验表明该方法优于九种最先进的图重连技术。
AI.motivation: 传统GNN的消息传递机制存在过挤压问题，即指数级增长的邻域信息被压缩到固定维度的嵌入中，阻碍了有效的长距离依赖学习。
AI.method: 提出Ramanujan Propagation框架，利用Ramanujan图进行图重连——首先证明合适的Ramanujan图能保证非负抵抗曲率以缓解过挤压，然后构建一个保持原始图局部连通性的Ramanujan重连图。
AI.result: 该方法在实验中超越了九种最先进的图重连技术，验证了Ramanujan图作为可扩展的、拓扑感知的消息传递结构先验的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Ramanujan图可作为GNN中缓解过挤压问题的严谨结构先验，为拓扑感知的消息传递提供了新范式。

title: Leveraging LaBSE with Progressive Curriculum Learning for Multicultural Polarization
summary: Detecting online polarization remains a critical challenge, particularly in multilingual and multicultural contexts where intergroup hostility is prevalent. The problem is particularly challenging due to the data scarcity for these tasks in the low-resource languages. Identifying such phenomena has become an active area of research and is addressed in SemEval-2026 Task 9: Multilingual, Multicultural Online Polarization Detection. To address this problem we propose an architecture that leverages LaBSE embeddings - an unconventional choice typically reserved for retrieval tasks, to obtain strong cross-lingual learning which enhances scores in low-resource language by a score up to 0.2 macro F1. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive ablation study evaluating the performance of diverse encoder models in the Qwen model family within a retrieval-based prompting framework. Our code will be soon available at https://github.com/carrycurious/PolarMind.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多语言、多文化环境下的在线极化现象检测问题，提出利用LaBSE嵌入（通常用于检索任务）进行跨语言学习，在低资源语言上提升了最高0.2 macro F1，并对Qwen系列编码器在检索式提示框架下的表现进行了消融研究。
AI.motivation: 多语言、多文化环境下的在线极化检测面临数据稀缺的挑战，尤其是低资源语言，因此需要有效的跨语言学习方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出结合LaBSE嵌入（非常规选择，通常用于检索任务）进行跨语言学习，并在Qwen模型系列中评估不同编码器在检索式提示框架下的表现，进行了全面的消融研究。
AI.result: 在低资源语言上提升了最高0.2 macro F1分数，验证了LaBSE嵌入用于跨语言极化检测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LaBSE嵌入作为跨语言特征提取器在极化检测任务中表现优异，是处理低资源语言数据稀缺问题的有效方案。

title: DataClaw0: Agentic Tailoring Multimodal Data from Raw Streams
summary: Massive unstructured multimodal streams suffer from high "data entropy," impeding both efficient human knowledge acquisition and high-quality AI post-training. Existing passive annotation paradigms, heavily reliant on heuristic rules or general VLMs, are costly, monotonous, and fail to unlock the deep procedural logic embedded in raw data. We elevate data processing to a learnable capability, proposing a paradigm shift towards Agentic Data Tailoring, which actively refining and structuring data to align with diverse user and downstream intents. To overcome the data scarcity bottleneck in training such high-order capabilities, we design a two-stage pipeline grounding generative semantic synthesis in deterministic Factual Anchors, yielding a large-scale dataset spanning five core physical and digital domains. Building upon this, $\text{DataClaw}_0$-9B model synergizes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), achieving robust alignment with complex refinement and tailoring intents. To systematically quantify this capability, we construct $\text{DataClaw}_0$-val, the first benchmark dedicated to data refinement. Crucially, we adopt downstream post-training as the ultimate validation touchstone. Evaluations on video generation, real-world VQA, and GUI navigation confirm that $\text{DataClaw}_0$ delivers high-information-density tailored data, facilitating efficient model adaptation to new tasks under limited training data regimes. Project page: https://czjdsg.github.io/MakeAnyData

AI.tldr: 本文提出DataClaw₀，一种基于Agentic Data Tailoring范式的数据精炼模型，通过将数据处理提升为可学习能力，结合SFT与GRPO实现主动数据精炼，在视频生成、VQA和GUI导航等下游任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 大规模非结构化多模态数据存在高“数据熵”，阻碍人类知识获取和AI后训练。现有被动标注范式依赖启发式规则或通用VLM，成本高、单调且无法挖掘数据中的深层程序逻辑。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Data Tailoring范式，将数据处理提升为可学习能力。设计两阶段流水线，基于确定性事实锚点（Factual Anchors）生成语义合成数据，覆盖五大物理与数字领域。DataClaw₀-9B模型融合监督微调（SFT）和群体相对策略优化（GRPO）进行训练。
AI.result: 构建首个数据精炼基准DataClaw₀-val。在视频生成、真实世界VQA和GUI导航等下游任务中，DataClaw₀生成的高信息密度精炼数据能有效促进模型在新任务上的高效适应。
AI.conclusion: 主动数据精炼范式优于被动标注方法，能够有效解锁原始数据中的深层逻辑，在有限训练数据下实现高效模型适配。

title: Denoising Iterative Self-Correction: Structured Verification Loops for Reliable LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models produce fluent but often incorrect multi-step reasoning, and naive correction methods risk degrading already-correct answers. We introduce Denoising Iterative Self-Correction (DISC), a test-time procedure that treats verification question outputs as noisy measurements of where a solution may be corrupted. Using these signals, DISC progressively reduces errors across multiple verify-judge-correct passes, analogous to traditional iterative denoising. A binary judgment gate controls correction precision by blocking rewrites that would damage already-correct answers while the verifier and corrector together repair errors. We evaluate this trade-off using two paired diagnostics: an improvement-to-degradation ratio (precision) and a repair rate (recall). Across three benchmarks (BIG-Bench Mistake, HotpotQA, GPQA Diamond) and four models, DISC dominates Chain-of-Verification and Self-Refine on the precision-recall trade-off, reaching 81.6% accuracy with 13x more improvements per degradation than Chain-of-Verification and 5x more than Self-Refine on BIG-Bench Mistake (Sonnet~4.5). On GPQA Diamond, we identify a capability floor below which judges acknowledge contradictions in evidence but cannot translate that recognition into a correction. We further show that cross-model role allocation -- assigning verification and judgment to a model different from the generator -- mitigates self-confirmation bias.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DISC（去噪迭代自我修正）的测试时方法，通过将验证问题输出视为解中可能被破坏位置的噪声测量，在多次验证-判断-修正的迭代中逐步减少推理错误。该方法使用二元判断门控制修正精度，在三个基准测试和四个模型上，相比Chain-of-Verification和Self-Refine，在精确率-召回率权衡上表现更优，同时发现跨模型角色分配可缓解自我确认偏差。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的多步推理流畅但常不正确，而简单的修正方法可能会破坏已经正确的答案，因此需要一种既能有效修正错误又不损害正确回答的方法。
AI.method: 将验证问题的输出视为解中可能错误位置的噪声测量，通过多次验证-判断-修正的迭代过程逐步减少错误，类似于传统的迭代去噪。引入二元判断门来控制修正精度，阻止可能破坏已正确答案的重写。同时探索跨模型角色分配——将验证和判断分配给与生成器不同的模型。
AI.result: 在BIG-Bench Mistake、HotpotQA、GPQA Diamond三个基准测试和四个模型上，DISC在精确率-召回率权衡上优于Chain-of-Verification和Self-Refine。在BIG-Bench Mistake上使用Sonnet 4.5达到81.6%准确率，每次改进与退化的比率分别是Chain-of-Verification的13倍和Self-Refine的5倍。在GPQA Diamond上发现了能力下限，即判断器能识别证据矛盾但无法转化为修正。
AI.conclusion: DISC方法通过迭代去噪机制和二元判断门实现了更精确的自我修正，跨模型角色分配可缓解自我确认偏差，但存在能力下限问题，即模型能识别矛盾却无法进行有效修正。

title: A Reward-Petri-Net Interpretation of Temporal Behavior Trees
summary: This paper introduces an interpretation of Temporal Behavior Trees (TBTs) as Reward-Petri-Nets (RPNs) for reinforcement learning (RL). Designing reward functions for complex, long-horizon robotic tasks is notoriously difficult, especially when tasks have hierarchical structure and temporal constraints. TBTs extend conventional behavior trees (BTs) used in robotic applications by incorporating temporal properties into their leaf nodes. This allows TBTs to represents not only the behavioral task structure defined by BT operators such as Sequence, Fallback, and Parallel, but also the task's temporal constraints. In this work, the constraints are specified in the leaf nodes using Linear Temporal Logic. In order to inform RL rewards using TBTs, we provide a translation from TBT into a Petri Net (PN) and show how rewards can be automatically assigned based on the TBT's structure, resulting in a RPN. In a series of increasingly challenging environments, we demonstrate how TBT-based rewards enable learning where vanilla RL fails, improve sample efficiency, and offer flexible, intuitive control over the learning progress. We showcase the learning impact by using different reward distribution schemes and TBT structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将时序行为树(TBT)解释为奖励Petri网(RPN)，用于强化学习中的奖励设计，通过在复杂、长时域机器人任务中自动分配奖励来提升学习效果和样本效率。
AI.motivation: 设计复杂、长时域机器人任务的奖励函数非常困难，尤其是当任务具有层次结构和时序约束时，传统方法难以有效处理。
AI.method: 将时序行为树(TBT)翻译为Petri网(PN)，并基于TBT的结构自动分配奖励，形成奖励Petri网(RPN)。TBT在叶节点中使用线性时序逻辑(LTL)指定时序约束，扩展了传统行为树的能力。
AI.result: 在多个难度递增的环境中，基于TBT的奖励方法使学习在普通RL失败的情况下仍能进行，提升了样本效率，并提供了灵活、直观的学习进度控制。
AI.conclusion: TBT作为RPN的解释框架能够有效指导RL奖励设计，不同奖励分配方案和TBT结构对学习效果有显著影响。

title: CalVerT: Augmenting Agents with Calibrated Verifier Telemetry Improves Action and Learning in Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
summary: LLM agents in knowledge intensive question answering take retrieval and reasoning actions with incomplete knowledge about whether their current answer is uncertain, unsupported, or already complete. This produces two failure modes: committing to confident but unsupported answers, which hurts accuracy, and over-retrieving when the evidence in hand already suffices, resulting in wasted compute. To give agents a more complete picture of the state space they are operating in, we introduce calibrated verifier telemetry (CalVerT), which augments the agent's state with additional telemetry: a calibrated self-confidence score and a grounding verifier score. We show that CalVerT can improve agents in both training-free and training-based settings. On four QA benchmarks, we find that CalVerT raises F1 by triggering retrieval in cases where agents over-rely on parametric knowledge, while cutting redundant retrieval in cases where agents have sufficient context to answer. We show that CalVerT can augment existing QA frameworks without training. Moreover, CalVerT also improves trained systems: by simply augmenting an agent's state with telemetry, we observe improvements after reinforcement learning, as compared to an agent with identical training but no CalVerT telemetry.

AI.tldr: CalVerT通过向LLM智能体状态中添加校准的自信心分数和 grounding 验证分数，在知识密集型问答中同时减少过早自信（提高准确率）和过度检索（节省计算资源），无需训练或结合强化学习均可提升性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在知识密集型问答中因无法判断当前答案是否不确定、缺乏支持或已经完整，导致两种失败模式：过早承诺自信但无支撑的答案（降低准确率），以及证据已足够却过度检索（浪费计算资源）。现有智能体对其操作的状态空间认知不完整，需要更全面的状态信息来指导决策。
AI.method: 提出CalVerT（calibrated verifier telemetry），在智能体状态中引入两种额外遥测信号：校准的自信心分数（calibrated self-confidence score）和 grounding 验证分数（grounding verifier score）。该方法可在无需训练的场景下直接增强现有QA框架，也可在强化学习训练中将遥测信息作为额外状态特征输入智能体。
AI.result: 在四个QA基准上，CalVerT提升了F1分数：一方面在智能体过度依赖参数化知识时触发检索，另一方面在上下文已足够时减少冗余检索。无需训练即可增强现有框架；在强化学习设置中，仅通过向智能体状态添加遥测信息，相比相同训练但无CalVerT的智能体也取得了改进。
AI.conclusion: CalVerT为LLM智能体提供了更完整的操作状态空间视图，有效缓解了知识密集型问答中的过早承诺和过度检索问题，在训练免费和训练驱动两种设置下均能提升性能，是一种轻量且通用的增强方法。

title: Urban Power Grid Topology and Hierarchy Identification from Open Data
summary: Understanding the complex topology and hierarchy of urban power grid is crucial for energy prognosis, power flow management, and system resilience analysis. However, detailed grid information remains largely proprietary. This creates significant barriers for research and innovation, especially when analyzing the last-mile distribution networks connecting individual buildings. This paper addresses this challenge by developing an open-data-driven framework for the complete identification of urban power grid topology, from high-voltage transmission down to individual building connections. Particularly, we fuse public infrastructure data (power-lines, substations, transformers, poles) to map the high and medium-voltage skeleton using graph-based algorithms. We then leverage geospatial machine learning on OpenStreetMap building data to group power demand clusters, and infer the physical topology of the final distribution lines linking the clustered buildings. We apply the developed framework to the district of Alna in Oslo, Norway, and we reconstruct the complete grid topology that connects 7,330 buildings and all major electricity infrastructure assets. With the research in this work, we provide a critical tool that facilitates power system analysis, e.g., power flow optimization, cascading failure simulation, and grid resilience against the penetration of distributed renewable generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于开放数据的框架，用于完整识别城市电网拓扑结构——从高压输电到单体建筑连接。通过融合公共基础设施数据（电力线、变电站、变压器、电杆）和图算法映射高中压骨架，再利用OpenStreetMap建筑数据的地理空间机器学习对电力需求聚类进行分组，推断最终配电线路的物理拓扑。在挪威奥斯陆Alna区应用该框架，成功重建了连接7,330栋建筑及所有主要电力基础设施资产的完整电网拓扑。
AI.motivation: 城市电网的复杂拓扑和层级结构对能源预测、潮流管理和系统韧性分析至关重要，但详细的电网信息大多属于专有数据，严重阻碍了研究和创新，尤其是在分析连接单体建筑的最后一级配电网时。
AI.method: 融合公共基础设施数据（电力线、变电站、变压器、电杆），使用图算法映射高中压骨架；再利用OpenStreetMap建筑数据的地理空间机器学习对电力需求聚类分组，推断最终配电线路的物理拓扑。
AI.result: 在挪威奥斯陆Alna区成功重建了连接7,330栋建筑及所有主要电力基础设施资产的完整电网拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成果为电力系统分析（如潮流优化、级联故障仿真、分布式可再生能源渗透下的电网韧性评估）提供了关键工具。

title: When to Plan, When to Polish: Noise Level as a Granularity Axis for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Standard tokenwise diffusion LMs keep training corruption and inference commitment at token granularity throughout denoising. At high noise, this leaves scattered local fragments rather than coherent evidence, making it hard to form early coarse structure, exactly what planning-sensitive generation requires. Hierarchical planning methods add coarse stages to separate planning from wording, but they need extra planners, block latents, or two stage designs. We propose Noise Dependent Granularity Control (NDGC), a single-level diffusion method that uses the noise level as a granularity cue. NDGC aligns training exposure and inference commitment with denoising progress. High noise steps use coherent token groups to support early meaning commitment, while low noise steps return to token level refinement. This creates planning like coarse to fine denoising without an explicit planner or hierarchical architecture. Across controlled tests, ablations, and WritingPrompts, NDGC shows earlier skeleton formation, better ordered recovery, and healthier outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出噪声依赖粒度控制（NDGC）方法，通过对不同噪声水平使用不同粒度的标记组（高噪声用连贯组、低噪声用单标记），实现单层扩散模型的粗到细生成规划，无需显式规划器或层次架构。
AI.motivation: 标准token级扩散语言模型在所有去噪步骤中都保持token级粒度的训练和推理，导致高噪声阶段产生局部碎片而非连贯证据，难以形成早期粗略结构，不利于需要规划敏感性的生成任务。
AI.method: NDGC利用噪声水平作为粒度线索：高噪声步骤使用连贯的token组支持早期意义承诺，低噪声步骤回到token级精细调整，从而在单层扩散模型中实现规划式的粗到细去噪。
AI.result: 在控制实验、消融研究和WritingPrompts数据集上，NDGC展示了更早的骨架形成、更好的有序恢复以及更健康的输出。
AI.conclusion: NDGC通过噪声依赖的粒度控制，在无需额外规划器或层次架构的情况下，实现了类似规划的粗到细去噪效果，提升了扩散语言模型生成的质量和结构合理性。

title: SOHET: Sequence Of Heterogeneous Events Transformer with Self-Supervised Pre-Training
summary: Many machine learning applications rely on heterogeneous event streams to make predictions, either causally as events arrive or bidirectionally over complete sequences. We propose SOHET (Sequence Of Heterogeneous Events Transformer), a hierarchical architecture combining event-type-specific tabular encoders with temporal and type embeddings, processed by a causal or bidirectional transformer. We introduce three self-supervised pre-training objectives for the causal setting. On a proprietary large-scale real-world Booking.com fraud detection task with 17 event types, SOHET outperforms FlexTPP, NAPPT, and CIPPT by 5.8%. Pre-training yields an additional 2.6% gain and 2.4% faster convergence. On the EBES benchmark, bidirectional SOHET matches or exceeds the published best on 6 out of 8 tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了SOHET，一种用于异构事件流的分层Transformer架构，结合事件类型特定的表格编码器与时间和类型嵌入，支持因果和双向两种模式。在欺诈检测任务上超越基线5.8%，预训练带来额外2.6%提升，在EBES基准上8个任务中6个达到或超过最佳水平。
AI.motivation: 许多机器学习应用依赖于异构事件流进行预测，现有方法未能充分利用事件类型的异构性和序列的时序特征，需要一种能够统一处理多种事件类型并支持因果（在线）和双向（离线）预测任务的架构。
AI.method: 提出SOHET分层架构：底层为事件类型特定的表格编码器，将每种事件类型的特征映射到共享表示空间；上层融合时间嵌入和类型嵌入，由Transformer（因果或双向）进行序列建模。针对因果设置提出了三种自监督预训练目标。
AI.result: 在Booking.com大规模欺诈检测任务（17种事件类型）上，SOHET比FlexTPP、NAPPT和CIPPT提升5.8%；预训练带来额外2.6%性能提升和2.4%更快的收敛速度。在EBES基准上，双向SOHET在8个任务中的6个达到或超过已发表最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: SOHET在异构事件流建模上有效，分层设计结合类型特定编码和Transformer序列建模能更好地处理多种事件类型的异构数据，预训练策略可进一步提升性能并加速收敛。

title: Test-Time Training with Next-Token Prediction
summary: Next-token prediction is the self-supervised signal that trains language models, and every observed prompt token provides the same signal at test time. We study whether this signal can define the inner-loop objective for test-time training (TTT) in pretrained long-context language models. Many TTT architectures require models to be trained with test-time adaptation in mind, limiting their direct applicability to released LLM checkpoints. While recent in-place TTT methods make fast-weight adaptation possible for pretrained LLMs without redesigning the backbone, they leave a central question unresolved: what should each test-time write store? Existing recipes train the fast weight to match a learned local value proxy but they are not directly tied to the self-supervised next-token prediction signal. We introduce Test-Time Training with Next-Token Prediction (TTT-NTP), a drop-in fast-weight adaptation method for pretrained LLMs that instead supervises updates using the model's own next contextual hidden state. This makes each local write follow the same causal computation that supports next-token prediction: the value target is a pointwise linear projection of a single next-position contextual state. On RULER Full-13 (averaged over 4k, 8k, 16k, and 32k context lengths), TTT-NTP is the only method that consistently improves the released backbone across four models spanning three families and a 0.6--8B size range: Llama-3.1-8B (+3.9), Mistral-7B-v0.3 (+3.0), and the Qwen3 series (Qwen3-4B +4.1, Qwen3-0.6B +2.9). On the real-world LongBench-v2 long-document QA benchmark, TTT-NTP improves over the base model on both Llama-3.1-8B (+5.6) and Mistral-7B-v0.3 (+3.7), while preserving commonsense and knowledge performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTT-NTP，一种即插即用的快速权重适应方法，利用预训练LLM自身的下一个上下文隐藏状态作为自监督信号进行测试时训练，在多个长上下文基准上显著提升Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3和Qwen3系列模型的性能，且不牺牲常识和知识能力。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时训练方法要么需要重新设计模型架构（不适用于已发布的LLM检查点），要么虽然支持在位快速权重适应但写入目标与模型自监督的下一个词预测信号脱节，缺乏理论一致性。本文旨在解决核心问题：测试时的每次写入应该存储什么？
AI.method: TTT-NTP使用模型自身的下一个位置上下文隐藏状态作为快速权重更新的监督信号。具体而言，值目标是通过对单个下一位置上下文状态进行逐点线性投影得到的，使得每次局部写入遵循与下一个词预测相同的因果计算逻辑。
AI.result: 在RULER Full-13（平均4k/8k/16k/32k上下文长度）上，TTT-NTP是唯一在所有四个模型（Llama-3.1-8B +3.9, Mistral-7B-v0.3 +3.0, Qwen3-4B +4.1, Qwen3-0.6B +2.9）上均持续改进基线的方;在LongBench-v2长文档QA上，Llama-3.1-8B提升+5.6，Mistral-7B-v0.3提升+3.7，同时保留常识和知识性能。
AI.conclusion: TTT-NTP作为一种即插即用的快速权重适应方法，通过将测试时训练目标与下一个词预测的自监督信号对齐，有效提升了预训练长上下文语言模型的性能，且具有跨模型家族和规模的良好泛化性。

title: Predictive Repair Management Using a Multi-Head Attention Transformer and Online Learning
summary: Accurate prediction of repair duration is an important challenge in product maintenance due to its implications for resource allocation, customer satisfaction, and operational performance. This study aims to develop a deep learning framework to help fleet repair shops accurately categorize repair time given product historical data. The study uses an automobile repair and maintenance dataset and creates an end-to-end predictive framework by employing a multi-head attention network designed for tabular data. The developed framework combines categorical information, transformed through embeddings and attention mechanisms, with numerical historical data to facilitate integration and learning from diverse data features. A weighted loss function is introduced to overcome class imbalance issues in large datasets. Moreover, an online learning strategy is used for continuous incremental model updates to maintain predictive accuracy in evolving operational environments. Our empirical findings demonstrate that the multi-head attention mechanism extracts meaningful interactions between vehicle identifiers and repair types compared to a feed-forward neural network and a random forest model. Also, combining historical maintenance data with an online learning strategy facilitates real-time adjustments to changing patterns and increases the model's predictive performance on new data. The model is tested on real-world repair data spanning 2013 to 2020 and achieves an accuracy of 78%, with attention weight analyses illustrating feature interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多头注意力网络的深度学习框架，结合嵌入、注意力机制、加权损失函数和在线学习策略，利用车辆历史维修数据对维修时长进行分类预测，在真实数据集上达到78%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 产品维修中准确预测维修时长对资源分配、客户满意度和运营绩效至关重要，而现有方法在处理大规模、类别不平衡且不断演化的维修数据时存在局限性。
AI.method: 采用多头注意力网络处理表格数据，通过嵌入和注意力机制融合类别特征与数值历史数据；引入加权损失函数解决类别不平衡问题；采用在线学习策略实现模型的持续增量更新。
AI.result: 在2013至2020年的真实汽车维修数据集上达到78%的准确率；多头注意力机制比前馈神经网络和随机森林更能提取车辆标识与维修类型之间的有意义交互；结合历史数据和在线学习策略提升了新数据上的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的深度学习框架能有效预测维修时长，注意力权重分析揭示了重要的特征交互关系，在线学习策略有助于模型适应不断变化的运营环境。

title: Fixed RAG Compression Collapses Measured Reader Scaling
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) compression papers often evaluate a compressor on one to three readers and treat the compressed evidence layer as evaluation-neutral. We show this assumption is false: fixed compression can raise average accuracy while hiding reader upgrades and reversing model rankings. Across 20 readers and ten domain-method settings over four QA benchmarks and one summarization benchmark, compression gain decreases with reader baseline (nine of ten settings significant, p < 0.05). Generic summarization flips 31% of pairwise model rankings on LongMemEval-S, and a fixed HotpotQA compressor hides 80% of the raw upgrade from Qwen 7B to GPT-4.1-mini. Two opposing forces explain this paradox: compression rescues weak readers by removing noise they cannot filter, and harms strong readers by dropping details they would have used. The pattern appears across structured compilation, generic summarization, three trained compressor families, query-focused summarization, and an external audit of nine published compression papers. We release ragscale, a toolkit built on 177,000 row-level compression transitions, so any compression paper can audit reader scaling with three readers in one day.

AI.tldr: RAG压缩评估中，固定压缩会掩盖读者能力差异并颠倒模型排名；压缩对弱读者有益（去噪）但对强读者有害（丢失细节），导致“压缩悖论”。基于177K行级压缩数据构建了ragscale工具包，可快速审计缩放效应。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG压缩评估通常仅用1-3个读者，并假设压缩后的证据层对评估是中性的。本文旨在证明这一假设是错误的，揭示压缩会掩盖读者升级效果并颠倒模型排名。
AI.method: 使用20个读者、10个领域-方法组合，在4个QA基准和1个摘要基准上进行系统实验。分析结构化编译、通用摘要、三种训练压缩器系列、查询聚焦摘要等压缩方法，并对9篇已发表压缩论文进行外部审计。
AI.result: 压缩增益随读者基线能力下降而增加（10个设置中9个显著，p<0.05）；通用摘要翻转31%的成对模型排名；固定压缩隐藏了80%的原始升级效果。压缩通过去噪帮助弱读者，但通过删除细节损害强读者。
AI.conclusion: 固定压缩不是评估中性的，会产生读者缩放悖论。ragscale工具包可使任何压缩论文在一天内用三个读者完成审计。

title: Enhancing Creativity in 3D Generative Design via a TRIZ-Inspired Text-to-CAD Framework
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in supporting engineering design tasks, including computer-aided design (CAD) automation. However, most existing LLM-based 3D CAD generation approaches primarily focus on geometric precision and instruction-following performance, often overlooking the fundamental aspect of creative design exploration. This study presents a TRIZ-inspired text-to-CAD framework that leverages LLMs to generate high-quality, editable CAD models while systematically exploring creative design alternatives. The framework integrates the Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ)-embedding deep human insights from extensive patent records-into LLM prompting strategies, enabling autonomous generation of innovative CAD variants that address technical contradictions. Through a comprehensive three-stage pipeline of design generation, enhancement, and optimization, the framework produces structurally diverse CAD models from well-crafted prompts. The present study implements and evaluates the first two stages, while positioning the design optimization stage as future work. A product design case study (chair) demonstrates that the TRIZ-inspired text-to-CAD framework generates multiple creative design alternatives by systematically applying TRIZ inventive principles such as segmentation, anti-weight, dynamics, and composite materials, achieving 4.0-14.7% mass reduction across all enhanced designs while maintaining structural integrity. The key findings suggest that integrating systematic innovation methodologies with LLM-based 3D CAD generation bridges the gap between precision-focused synthesis and creativity-focused exploration, advancing toward autonomous design systems where AI makes design decisions independently, supporting human decision-making in human-AI collaborative design for engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种TRIZ启发的文本到CAD框架，利用LLM生成高质量、可编辑的3D CAD模型，同时系统性地探索创造性设计替代方案。通过三阶段流水线（设计生成、增强、优化），该框架能够从提示词生成结构多样的CAD模型。以椅子设计案例验证，通过应用TRIZ发明原理（如分割、反重量、动力学、复合材料），所有增强设计实现了4.0%-14.7%的质量减轻，同时保持结构完整性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的3D CAD生成方法主要关注几何精度和指令遵循性能，忽视了创造性设计探索这一基本方面。作者希望将系统性创新方法论（TRIZ）与LLM结合，弥合精度导向合成与创造力导向探索之间的差距，推动自主设计系统的发展。
AI.method: 提出TRIZ启发的文本到CAD框架：(1) 将TRIZ（发明问题解决理论）嵌入LLM提示策略，从大量专利记录中提取深度人类洞察；(2) 三阶段流水线：设计生成、设计增强、设计优化；(3) 应用TRIZ发明原理（分割、反重量、动力学、复合材料）系统性地生成创造性CAD变体，解决技术矛盾。当前实现并评估了前两个阶段，优化阶段留作未来工作。
AI.result: 以椅子产品设计为案例，TRIZ启发的文本到CAD框架生成了多个创造性设计替代方案；所有增强设计实现了4.0%-14.7%的质量减轻，同时保持结构完整性。
AI.conclusion: 将系统性创新方法论（TRIZ）与基于LLM的3D CAD生成相结合，能够弥合精度导向合成与创造力导向探索之间的差距，推动实现AI独立做出设计决策的自主设计系统，支持人机协作设计中的决策过程。

title: Inverse Turing Bench: Evaluating Language Models as Judges of Human vs. AI Dialogue
summary: As AI systems integrate into online spaces, differentiating them from humans in conversations is increasingly important. We present Inverse Turing Bench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs and other models on their ability to differentiate humans and AI in multi-turn text. The benchmark provides a collection of paired dialogue transcripts, wherein one dialogue is between two humans and the other is between a human and an AI. The task is to correctly identify which dialogue is human-only vs. human-AI. We evaluated a preliminary set of models against this benchmark, and found that GPTZero, Claude Opus-4.6, and GPT-5.5 achieve the highest accuracy: 89.41%, 77.92%, and 75.94% respectively. Our results suggest that statistical approaches to detection have semantic blind spots, but semantic approaches are susceptible to persona-prompting. Our work speaks to the Inverse Turing Test as a probe of LLM theory of mind, and motivates human-AI differentiation as a critical capability for AI systems. Our live benchmark can be found at https://huggingface.co/spaces/roc-hci/Inverse-Turing-Bench-Leaderboard (anonymity preserved).

AI.tldr: 提出了Inverse Turing Bench基准，用于评估模型区分纯人类对话与人类-AI混合对话的能力。实验发现GPTZero、Claude Opus-4.6和GPT-5.5表现最佳，统计方法存在语义盲点，而语义方法易受角色提示攻击。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统融入在线空间，区分对话中的人类与AI变得越来越重要，现有基准缺乏针对多轮对话中人类-AI区分能力的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含配对对话转录的基准测试集（纯人类对话 vs. 人类-AI对话），要求模型正确识别哪段对话包含AI参与者，评估了多个模型的分类准确率。
AI.result: GPTZero（89.41%）、Claude Opus-4.6（77.92%）和GPT-5.5（75.94%）表现最佳；统计检测方法存在语义盲点，语义方法易受角色提示攻击。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可作为LLM心理理论能力的探测工具，人类-AI区分能力对AI系统至关重要，且不同方法各有局限。

title: Unsupervised Disentanglement Without Compromises : How Functional Orthogonality Enforces Identifiability
summary: This paper explores unsupervised disentangled representation learning from a functional perspective. We define latent concepts as factors that influence observations through locally orthogonal directions, formalized as an orthogonality constraint on the Jacobian of the generative mapping. We prove that this condition yields identifiability of general nonlinear generative models, without requiring statistical independence or causal assumptions, provided the latent domain admits all combinations of factor values. Experiments with orthogonality-regularized normalizing flows empirically confirm the theory, demonstrate reliable recovery of ground-truth factors, and shed light on the success of VAEs. These findings challenge the prevailing impossibility claims for unsupervised disentanglement and provide a principled alternative foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文从功能视角提出基于雅可比正交约束的无监督解耦表征学习方法，证明在潜在域包含所有因子值组合的条件下，该约束可使一般非线性生成模型可辨识，并通过正交正则化流实验验证了理论有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督解耦学习面临不可辨识性的理论困境，缺乏不依赖统计独立性或因果假设的理论基础。本文旨在提供一种新的可辨识性理论框架，挑战当前普遍认为无监督解耦不可能的主流观点。
AI.method: 将潜在概念定义为通过局部正交方向影响观测的因子，形式化为生成映射雅可比矩阵的正交性约束；在潜在域包含所有因子值组合的条件下，证明该约束可使非线性生成模型可辨识；采用正交正则化流进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论证明正交性约束条件下非线性生成模型是可辨识的；实验表明正交正则化流能可靠恢复真实因子；揭示了VAEs成功的部分原因。
AI.conclusion: 挑战了无监督解耦"不可能"的主流观点，为无监督解耦学习提供了原则性的替代理论基础。

title: Keyless Attention: Value-Space Routing and Value-Only Caching for Efficient Transformers
summary: We propose Keyless Attention, an attention mechanism that eliminates the key projection entirely, operating over queries and values only. This yields a Value-Only Cache that reduces KV cache memory and access overhead by exactly 50% over standard attention, while matching or exceeding standard attention's decode throughput. Beyond efficiency, we introduce Depth-$m$ Attention Factorization: standard attention computes a depth-2 factorization of the attention bilinear form, while Keyless Attention realizes a depth-$m$ instance of this family. At m=3, Keyless Attention matches the projection matrix count of standard attention via a value-space routing matrix that replaces the key projection and introduces a coupling between routing and retrieval. Experiments across five models and four architectures (GPT-2 280M, GPT-2 557M, Pythia 410M, Qwen2 1.5B, and Llama 3.2 1B) show that Keyless Attention matches or outperforms standard QKV attention on perplexity in 4 out of 5 models. On downstream zero-shot evaluation (GPT-2 557M), Keyless Attention outperforms on 4 out of 5 commonsense reasoning benchmarks, while achieving 50% KV cache reduction throughout.

AI.tldr: 提出Keyless Attention，消除键投影，仅使用查询和值，将KV缓存减少50%的同时在多数模型上匹配或超越标准注意力性能。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力机制中的键投影导致KV缓存内存和访问开销较大，作者希望消除键投影以降低存储开销，同时保持或提升模型性能。
AI.method: 提出Keyless Attention机制，完全消除键投影（Key Projection），仅保留查询（Query）和值（Value）投影，形成仅含值的缓存（Value-Only Cache）。引入深度m注意力分解（Depth-m Attention Factorization）的理论框架，将标准注意力视为深度2特例，Keyless Attention实现深度3实例，通过值空间路由矩阵替代键投影。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 280M、GPT-2 557M、Pythia 410M、Qwen2 1.5B、Llama 3.2 1B五种模型四个架构上，Keyless Attention在4/5的模型上匹配或超越标准注意力的困惑度。在GPT-2 557M的零样本评测中，Keyless Attention在5个常识推理基准中的4个上表现更优，同时实现50%的KV缓存缩减。
AI.conclusion: Keyless Attention通过消除键投影，在显著降低KV缓存开销的同时，能够在多数场景下匹配甚至超越标准QKV注意力的性能，为高效注意力机制设计提供了新方向。

title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs. However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. The second, action chunk consistency (ACC), exploits the temporal overlap induced by receding-horizon control and detects failures when consecutive action chunks become inconsistent. To capture the trade-off between detection accuracy and detection latency, we introduce AUCPDT, a threshold-independent metric that jointly evaluates precision, recall, and detection time. Through extensive real-world and simulation experiments, we demonstrate that LLMD and ACC capture complementary failure modes whose combination enables reliable and early failure detection across diverse tasks, frequently outperforming significantly more expensive baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLA-FAIL，一种轻量级、广泛适用的VLA故障检测框架，结合最后层马氏距离（LLMD）和动作块一致性（ACC）两种互补的检测器，无需故障数据即可实现早期可靠的故障检测，并引入新的评估指标AUCPDT。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在机器人操作任务中表现优异，但在分布外场景下行为不可预测，现有故障检测方法存在计算开销大、依赖架构假设或需要故障数据等问题，亟需一种轻量且广泛适用的故障检测方法。
AI.method: 提出VLA-FAIL框架，包含两种检测器：(1) LLMD，通过测量最后一层特征相对于训练数据的token级马氏距离检测分布外状态；(2) ACC，利用退火地平线控制中连续动作块的不一致性检测故障。同时引入AUCPDT指标综合评价精度、召回率和检测时间。
AI.result: 在真实世界和仿真实验中，LLMD和ACC捕捉互补的故障模式，二者组合在多种任务中实现了可靠且早期的故障检测，性能常优于显著更昂贵的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VLA-FAIL是一种轻量、通用且无需故障数据的VLA故障检测框架，通过互补检测器的组合实现了高效可靠的早期故障检测，适用于机器人的安全部署。

title: TALAS: Teacher-Anchored Layer Alignment with Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Embedding Distillation
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) has established itself as a pivotal technique for compressing large pre-trained language models. However, existing methods that force a student to strictly mimic the teacher's sentence embeddings or internal features often incur prohibitive computational costs and yield suboptimal performance due to the inherent capacity gap. To address these challenges, we propose TALAS (Teacher-Anchored Layer Alignment with Sharpness-aware minimization), a unified framework that synergizes hierarchical (multi-layer) alignment with robust optimization. First, we introduce a Teacher-Anchored mechanism that selectively distills final sentence embeddings only into the student's upper layers, thereby reducing overhead while respecting capacity constraints. Second, we bridge the semantic gap in lower layers via Layer-Aligned Self-Distillation, which propagates knowledge top-down using internal geometric relational constraints in the embedding space. Finally, to prevent the student from memorizing point-wise teacher noise, we integrate Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization (ASAM) into the training objective, guiding the model towards flat minima for enhanced generalization. Empirical results on standard sentence embedding benchmarks demonstrate that TALAS consistently outperforms strong distillation baselines while achieving superior training efficiency in terms of computational cost and memory footprint.

AI.tldr: TALAS提出了一种统一的知识蒸馏框架，通过教师锚定机制、层级对齐自蒸馏和自适应锐度感知最小化，在降低计算开销的同时提升了学生模型的句子嵌入性能和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法要求学生模型严格模仿教师模型的句子嵌入或内部特征，但存在两大问题：一是计算成本高昂，二是由于师生模型之间的能力差距（capacity gap）导致性能次优。
AI.method: （1）教师锚定机制（Teacher-Anchored）：仅将教师最终句子嵌入选择性蒸馏到学生上层，降低开销并尊重能力约束；（2）层级对齐自蒸馏（Layer-Aligned Self-Distillation）：利用嵌入空间的内部几何关系约束，从上到下传播知识，弥合低层语义差距；（3）自适应锐度感知最小化（ASAM）：集成到训练目标中，引导学生朝向平坦最小值，防止记忆教师逐点噪声，提升泛化能力。
AI.result: 在标准句子嵌入基准测试上，TALAS一致优于强蒸馏基线方法，同时在计算成本和内存占用方面实现了更优的训练效率。
AI.conclusion: TALAS通过层级对齐与鲁棒优化的统一框架，有效解决了知识蒸馏中能力差距和计算成本问题，为句子嵌入模型的压缩提供了更高效且性能更优的解决方案。

title: Atomistic Language Models Understand and Generate Materials
summary: Atomistic structure and natural language have long been modeled separately, with language models either calling atomistic models as tools or being fine-tuned on lossy textual encodings that discard atomistic information. We introduce Atomistic Language Models (ALMs) to pursue native multimodality, in which a single language backbone understands atomistic structures, generates materials from natural language, and optimizes crystal structures as instructed by text. By unifying a pretrained atomistic encoder, large language model, and denoising diffusion model through purely continuous projectors and staged training, ALMs achieve state-of-the-art results on crystal structure prediction and de novo generation. ALMs are enabled by a continuous bridge that maps language model embeddings directly into the steering space of atomistic diffusion, and are assisted by Text-to-Crystal Feynman-Kac (T2C-FK), a particle-based sampler that scores partial denoising trajectories to enforce stoichiometric targets at inference time. To evaluate the ability of ALMs to optimize and generate materials from natural-language prompts and 3D atom-coordinate inputs, we introduce ALM Bench, the first benchmark for text-conditioned crystal generation and optimization. Code, training data, and model weights will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出原子语言模型（ALMs），通过连续投影器和分阶段训练统一原子编码器、大语言模型和去噪扩散模型，实现从自然语言理解和生成晶体结构，并在晶体结构预测和从头生成任务上取得最优结果。同时引入Text-to-Crystal Feynman-Kac推理采样器和ALM Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将原子结构与自然语言分开建模，语言模型要么将原子模型作为工具调用，要么在有损的文本编码上微调，丢失了原子层面的信息。作者旨在追求原生多模态，让单一语言骨干同时理解原子结构、从自然语言生成材料、并根据文本指令优化晶体结构。
AI.method: 1) 统一预训练的原子编码器、大语言模型和去噪扩散模型，通过纯连续投影器连接；2) 采用分阶段训练策略；3) 构建连续桥梁将语言模型嵌入直接映射到原子扩散的操控空间；4) 提出Text-to-Crystal Feynman-Kac（T2C-FK）粒子采样器，在推理时对部分去噪轨迹进行评分以强制执行化学计量比目标。
AI.result: 在晶体结构预测和从头生成任务上取得最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: ALMs实现了文本与晶体结构之间的原生多模态理解与生成，并引入ALM Bench作为首个文本条件晶体生成与优化的基准测试。

title: The Language-Energy Divide: Measuring Energy Costs of Multilingual LLM Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multilingual settings, yet the energy costs of serving these models across different languages remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of inference energy consumption across languages with ML.Energy framework (Chung et al., 2026). We find striking disparities: energy consumption per output token varies by up to 8.3 times across languages, while total energy for a fixed set of requests varies by up to 179 times between the cheapest (English, 17.6 kJ) and the most expensive (Pashto, 3,147 kJ) languages. Our analysis shows that this disparity is driven by two compounding factors: (1) higher per-token energy costs for languages using complex or rare scripts, and (2) more tokens generated for low-resource languages. Moreover, we find a double cost + performance penalty: languages with the highest energy footprints also tend to achieve the lowest task accuracy. We reveal that the energy divide persists across models, hardware, and tasks, suggesting a systemic energy inequity in multilingual LLM deployment. Finally, we recommend that the community treat energy as a first-class evaluation axis, extend reporting checklists and model cards to include it, and adopt deployment-side mitigations for better energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: LLM在多语言部署中存在显著的能量不平等：不同语言间每token能耗差异高达8.3倍，完成相同请求的总能耗差异可达179倍（英语最低17.6 kJ，普什图语最高3,147 kJ），且高能耗语言往往伴随低任务准确率，存在"双重惩罚"。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM日益广泛地部署在多语言环境中，但不同语言在推理阶段的能源成本差异尚未得到系统性研究，作者希望揭示这一被忽视的能源不平等现象。
AI.method: 使用ML.Energy框架（Chung et al., 2026）对LLM推理过程中的能源消耗进行系统性测量，分析跨语言的每token能耗、总能耗差异，并探究其与脚本复杂度、语言资源丰富度、任务准确率之间的关系。
AI.result: 能源差异由两个复合因素驱动：(1) 使用复杂或稀有脚本的语言每token能耗更高；(2) 低资源语言需生成更多token。高能耗语言同时伴随低任务准确率（双重惩罚）。该能源鸿沟在不同模型、硬件和任务中均持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 建议将能源效率作为LLM评估的一级指标，扩展报告清单和模型卡以包含能源信息，并采用部署侧的缓解措施来提升多语言LLM服务的能源公平性。

title: One Size does not Fit All: Heterogeneous Latent Space Alignment for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
summary: Domain shift remains a major obstacle to the reliable deployment of machine learning models in high-stakes environments such as healthcare. While Domain adaptation aims to mitigate these effects, existing approaches suffer from limited expressiveness of latent representations and a reliance on handcrafted, static augmentations. In this work, we address these limitations by proposing a novel deep learning architecture for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA), specifically optimized for medical image segmentation. Our framework, ADualVUOT, integrates a dual-encoder Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs) to increase modeling flexibility and posterior expressiveness. To achieve domain alignment, we leverage Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) through the Gaussian-Gromov-Wasserstein (GGW) distance, which handles structural and topological discrepancies between domains. Furthermore, we incorporate an adversarial augmentation scheme to synthesize worst-case compositions, thus enhancing model robustness. Extensive experiments on medical imaging benchmarks show significant gains over prior OT-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出ADualVUOT框架，通过双编码器VAE结合连续归一化流增强表示能力，利用非平衡最优传输（高斯-格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦距离）进行域对齐，并引入对抗性增强策略，在医学图像分割的无监督域适应任务中取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 域偏移严重阻碍了机器学习模型在医疗等高风险场景的可靠部署；现有域适应方法存在潜表示表达能力有限以及依赖于手工设计的静态数据增强两大局限。
AI.method: 1) 双编码器变分自编码器（VAE）结合连续归一化流（CNFs）增强后验表达的灵活性和表达能力；2) 利用非平衡最优传输（UOT）中的高斯-格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦（GGW）距离实现域对齐，处理域间结构和拓扑差异；3) 引入对抗性增强机制合成最坏情况下的组成，提升模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在医学图像基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于此前基于最优传输的方法。
AI.conclusion: ADualVUOT通过增强表示能力、非平衡最优传输对齐和对抗性增强三者结合，有效解决了无监督域适应中潜表示局限和静态增强不足的问题，为医学图像分割提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: Scaling Performance and Low-Resource Annotation with Many-Shot In-Context Learning for Named Entity Recognition
summary: In-context learning (ICL) with large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a powerful alternative to fine-tuning for Named Entity Recognition (NER), achieving strong performance with minimal annotation and no additional training. However, prior work has shown that despite their adaptability, LLMs still lag behind fully supervised models such as fine-tuned BERT in structured tasks like NER. While existing studies on ICL for NER have mainly explored few-shot settings, the potential of scaling to hundreds of demonstrations has not been thoroughly investigated. To address this gap, we conduct a comprehensive investigation of many-shot ICL for NER and further explore its effectiveness in annotating and refining data for low-resource NER tasks. Specifically, we evaluate various LLMs across multiple domains using hundreds of ICL examples and then assess the feasibility of using many-shot ICL as a data annotation framework. Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) scaling to hundreds of in-context examples enables LLMs to match or even surpass the performance of fully supervised BERT models; and (2) using about one hundred human-labeled examples as demonstrations, many-shot in-context annotation can generate high-quality labeled data, leading to approximately 10% absolute F1 improvement over existing state-of-the-art approaches when used to fine-tune BERT on low-resource NER.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大规模上下文学习（many-shot ICL）在命名实体识别（NER）中的应用，发现使用数百个示例可使LLM匹配甚至超越全监督BERT的性能，并且基于约百个人工标注示例的大规模上下文标注可为低资源NER生成高质量数据，使BERT微调后的F1值提升约10%。
AI.motivation: 已有的ICL用于NER的研究主要集中在少样本设置，而扩展到数百个示例的潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在多个领域使用数百个上下文示例评估多种LLM，并将其作为数据标注框架用于低资源NER任务。
AI.result: (1) 扩展到数百个上下文示例使LLM匹配甚至超越全监督BERT；(2) 约百个人工标注示例的大规模上下文标注可生成高质量数据，使BERT微调后F1值比现有最优方法提升约10%。
AI.conclusion: 大规模上下文学习能有效缩小LLM与全监督模型在NER任务上的差距，并可作为低资源NER的高效数据标注框架。

title: Federated Temporal Attention Intelligence for Cyber-Resilient IoMT: Lightweight Digital Twins and PPO-Driven Honeypot Deception
summary: The rapid proliferation of Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices introduces critical cybersecurity vulnerabilities in healthcare environments where resource-constrained medical devices operate under strict latency requirements and stringent data-privacy regulations. To address these challenges, this paper presents the Lightweight Digital Twin and Federated Reinforcement Learning (LDT-FRL) framework, a privacy-preserving defense architecture integrating four complementary mechanisms: a Temporal Attention Encoder (TAE) built on a GRU backbone with learned temporal self-attention for flow-level threat classification; lightweight LSTM-based Digital Twins trained on normal-class traffic to generate per-device anomaly scores that gate the TAE classifier through a learned sigmoid coupling; a Federated Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent selecting among ALLOW, ISOLATE, and HONEYPOT_REDIRECT actions based on a seven-dimensional state; and an intelligent honeypot layer that converts redirected suspicious traffic into actionable threat intelligence. A federated aggregation strategy employing EMA-smoothed per-client validation losses as inverse-weighted FedAvg coefficients stabilizes global model updates under non-IID client distributions. Evaluated on CICDDoS 2019 and TON-IoT benchmarks, LDT-FRL achieves 99.66% and 99.95% test accuracy respectively, with macro-F1 scores of 0.9913 and 0.9995, converging 81% faster than the DTFL-CD baseline while attaining perfect F1=1.000 on the severely imbalanced MITM class. Explainability analysis via SHAP, LIME, Grad-CAM, and counterfactual methods confirms that the TAE focuses on semantically meaningful flow features, providing interpretable evidence for each defense decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LDT-FRL框架，结合轻量级数字孪生、联邦强化学习和时序注意力编码器，在资源受限的医疗物联网环境中实现隐私保护的威胁检测与防御，在多个基准测试上达到99.66%-99.95%的准确率，收敛速度提升81%。
AI.motivation: 医疗物联网设备资源受限、延迟要求严格且受数据隐私法规约束，现有安全方案难以兼顾轻量级、高准确率和隐私保护需求。
AI.method: 提出LDT-FRL框架，包含四个组件：1) 基于GRU和时序自注意力的TAE编码器进行流级威胁分类；2) 基于LSTM的轻量级数字孪生生成设备异常分数，通过sigmoid耦合门控TAE分类器；3) 联邦PPO智能体选择ALLOW/ISOLATE/HONEYPOT_REDIRECT三种动作；4) 智能蜜罐层将可疑流量转化为威胁情报。采用EMA平滑验证损失的逆加权FedAvg聚合策略应对非独立同分布客户端。
AI.result: 在CICDDoS 2019和TON-IoT数据集上分别达到99.66%和99.95%的测试准确率，宏F1分数分别为0.9913和0.9995，收敛速度比DTFL-CD基线快81%，在严重不平衡的MITM类别上F1=1.000。
AI.conclusion: 通过SHAP、LIME、Grad-CAM和反事实方法验证了模型关注语义上有意义的流量特征，为每个防御决策提供了可解释的证据。

title: Olfactory-Inspired Sparse Combinatorial Coding for Low-Resource Named Entity Recognition
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) in low-resource languages suffers from limited supervision and a lack of high-quality pretrained embeddings. Biological olfaction, which relies on sparse combinatorial coding through receptor and glomerular organization, offers a compelling paradigm for learning robust representations under uncertainty. In this paper, we introduce a receptor-glomerular bottleneck - a novel, biologically-inspired olfactory architecture - between standard token embeddings and a BiLSTM-CRF sequence model. We evaluate our architecture across six multilingual datasets trained entirely from scratch (without pre-trained embeddings) under varied data-scale conditions, including a strict 1k-sentence low-resource control. Our results demonstrate that introducing a representation bottleneck yields F1 score improvements under severe data scarcity, primarily by acting as a powerful regularizer. Under the 1k capped training condition, at least one olfactory-inspired configuration achieves the highest mean F1 score across all six datasets. While these improvements represent near-ties with generic bottleneck controls for most languages, the olfactory architecture provides a significant advantage in languages like Bangla (+6.23% F1 over standard baseline and +8.47% F1 over the best control baseline) where generic bottlenecks degrade performance. We also observe improvements in the ultra-low-resource Telugu setting (+4.43% F1) at full-scale, and find that sparse specialization naturally emerges within the receptor layer. Our findings suggest that structured sparse coding inspired by olfactory networks serves as an effective inductive bias and regularizer when representations must be learned from limited or noisy supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受生物嗅觉启发的受体-肾小球瓶颈架构，嵌入在标准Token嵌入与BiLSTM-CRF序列模型之间，用于低资源语言NER任务。实验表明，该架构在严格的低资源设定（1k句）下能提升F1分数，尤其在孟加拉语（+6.23%）和泰卢固语（+4.43%）上显著优于基线，其稀疏编码机制起到强正则化作用。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的NER面临标注数据稀缺和缺乏高质量预训练嵌入的挑战。生物嗅觉系统通过稀疏组合编码在不确定性下实现鲁棒表示，为设计高效的归纳偏置提供了生物学启发。
AI.method: 在标准Token嵌入与BiLSTM-CRF之间引入一个受体-肾小球瓶颈层，模拟嗅觉系统的稀疏组合编码机制，对表示进行压缩和稀疏化。
AI.result: 在六种多语言数据集上，均从零训练（无预训练嵌入），在1k句低资源控制下，至少一种嗅觉配置取得最高平均F1；孟加拉语提升6.23% F1，泰卢固语在全量训练下提升4.43% F1；受体层自然涌现稀疏专门化。
AI.conclusion: 嗅觉启发的结构化稀疏编码是一种有效的归纳偏置和正则化手段，尤其在表示需从有限或有噪声的监督中学习时，能显著提升低资源NER的性能。

title: Dual-Attention Convolution Experts for Sparse Tensor Completion
summary: Tensor factorization (TF) has been widely adopted for high-dimensional sparse data completion tasks. Despite significant progress, neural TF methods often struggle to capture complex cross-mode interactions and remain vulnerable to (extreme) data sparsity. To address these challenges, we propose a novel neural tensor factorization approach, termed Dual-Attention Convolution Expert Networks with Group-Level Contrastive Learning (DCGC). For the first problem, DCGC generates diverse non-linear alignment patterns of latent factors via a multi-channel convolution network, and leverages the gated dual-attention mechanism to drive the model to focus on more important output channels (i.e., convolution experts) and the aligned features. Furthermore, DCGC introduces a group-level contrastive learning strategy that aggregates positive samples with identical feedback levels while separating negative samples across different levels. This strategy injects high-quality self-supervised signals to mitigate data sparsity. Extensive experiments conducted on five datasets demonstrate that our DCGC outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in sparse tensor completion for traffic and recommendation applications. Code to reproduce the experimental results in the paper is available at https://github.com/ku1z/DCGC.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DCGC的神经张量分解方法，通过双注意力卷积专家网络和组级对比学习，有效解决了高维稀疏数据完成中复杂跨模态交互捕捉困难和数据稀疏性问题，在交通和推荐任务的五个数据集上取得了最优表现。
AI.motivation: 现有神经张量分解方法难以捕捉复杂的跨模态交互，且在极端数据稀疏场景下表现脆弱。
AI.method: 1) 多通道卷积网络生成潜因子的多样化非线性对齐模式；2) 门控双注意力机制聚焦重要输出通道和对齐特征；3) 组级对比学习策略聚合同反馈级别的正样本、分离不同级别的负样本，注入自监督信号缓解稀疏性。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上的实验表明，DCGC在交通和推荐应用的稀疏张量完成任务中优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DCGC通过双注意力卷积专家网络和组级对比学习有效解决了复杂跨模态交互和数据稀疏两大挑战，在稀疏张量完成任务中达到了SOTA性能。

title: Which Review Aspect Has a Greater Impact on the Duration of Open Peer Review in Multiple Rounds? -- Evidence from Nature Communications
summary:
Purpose: Peer review is essential to scientific publishing, but increasing submission volumes have placed growing pressure on reviewers and editors. This study examines the relationship between sentiment toward specific review aspects and peer review duration. It also investigates how this relationship varies across disciplines and review rounds, with the aim of supporting targeted manuscript revision and improving review efficiency.
  Design/methodology/approach: We adopt a two-stage approach. First, fine-grained aspects are extracted from peer review reports, and a sentiment classification model is used to determine the sentiment associated with each aspect. Second, correlations between aspect-level sentiment and peer review duration are analyzed. Sentiment scores are also calculated for different review rounds to determine whether these relationships change over successive rounds.
  Findings: Review sentiment has a weak but statistically significant negative correlation with peer review duration, indicating that more positive reviews tend to be associated with shorter review periods. Aspects concerning Evaluation and Results and Impact and Research Value show relatively stronger correlations with review duration. The relationships between aspect-level sentiment and review duration also differ significantly across review rounds.
  Originality/value: This study connects the textual content of peer review reports with the temporal characteristics of the review process. By identifying review aspects that are more closely associated with review duration, it provides evidence that may help authors prioritize revisions and assist reviewers and editors in improving review efficiency. The findings contribute to reducing the burden of peer review and accelerating scholarly communication and knowledge dissemination.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了同行评审报告中细粒度方面的情感与评审时长之间的关系，发现积极情感与较短评审周期弱相关，其中"评估与结果"和"影响与研究价值"方面的相关性更强，且这种关系在不同评审轮次中存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 同行评审是科学出版的关键环节，但日益增长的投稿量给审稿人和编辑带来了巨大压力。本研究旨在通过分析评审文本的情感倾向与评审时长之间的关系，为针对性修改稿件、提高评审效率提供支持。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：首先从同行评审报告中提取细粒度方面，并使用情感分类模型确定每个方面的情感；然后分析方面级情感与评审时长之间的相关性，并计算不同评审轮次的情感得分以考察关系变化。
AI.result: 评审情感与评审时长存在弱但统计显著的负相关；"评估与结果"以及"影响与研究价值"相关方面与评审时长的相关性较强；方面级情感与评审时长的关系在不同评审轮次间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将同行评审报告的文本内容与评审过程的时间特征联系起来，识别出与评审时长更密切相关的评审方面，为作者优先修改、审稿人和编辑提高评审效率提供了依据，有助于减轻同行评审负担并加速学术传播。

title: Universal Encoders for Modular Relational Deep Learning
comment: Accepted to ECML PKDD 2026 in Naples, Italy
summary:
Relational Deep Learning (RDL) models multi-tabular databases as temporal heterogeneous graphs for end-to-end representation learning. While RDL is evolving rapidly, existing approaches face significant generalization obstacles. They are either schema-specific, requiring training from scratch for every new database, or they rely on monolithic architectures that entangle feature encoding with graph message-passing. Analyzing these limitations, we establish four core pillars for building foundational relational models: semantic granularity, structural topology, temporal causality, and unified optimization.
  Addressing these pillars, we propose a modular approach that decouples row encoding from graph message-passing. We introduce the Universal Row Encoder, a transformer-based module that integrates raw cell data with schema metadata$-$including column semantics, table names, and global distribution statistics$-$to produce table-width invariant row embeddings. By explicitly feeding global statistics to an intra-row self-attention mechanism, the encoder natively contextualizes unseen features and handles sparse data. Serving as a flexible "backend" for any downstream graph architecture, our pretrained encoder enhances cross-database knowledge transfer on the established RelBench benchmarks while improving learning convergence and memory footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模块化的关系深度学习（RDL）框架，通过解耦行编码与图消息传递，引入通用行编码器（Universal Row Encoder）实现跨数据库迁移，在RelBench基准上提升收敛速度和内存效率。
AI.motivation: 现有RDL方法存在两大泛化瓶颈：要么是模式特定的（每个新数据库需从头训练），要么采用整体式架构将特征编码与图消息传递纠缠在一起，导致跨数据库迁移困难。
AI.method: 提出模块化方法，将行编码与图消息传递解耦。设计通用行编码器（Universal Row Encoder），基于Transformer架构，融合原始元胞数据与模式元数据（列语义、表名、全局分布统计），通过行内自注意力机制实现表宽不变的嵌入表示，可作为下游图架构的灵活"后端"。
AI.result: 在RelBench基准上，预训练编码器增强了跨数据库知识迁移，同时改进了学习收敛速度和内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 明确了构建基础关系模型的四大核心支柱：语义粒度、结构拓扑、时间因果性和统一优化，并验证了模块化解耦策略在跨数据库泛化中的有效性。

title: Deeper is Not Always Better: Mitigating the Alignment Tax via Confident Layer Decoding
summary: Autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) conventionally decodes from the final layer, assuming that deeper representations yield more reliable next-token predictions. We revisit this assumption by revealing a recurring Guess-Refine-Perturb dynamic: early layers form coarse guesses, intermediate layers refine reasoning-relevant semantics, and final layers can perturb these refined predictions toward generic or alignment-preferred tokens. We introduce Confident Decoding, a training-free decoding strategy that dynamically selects the most reliable near-final layer through entropy-guided conservative backward search. We further provide a theoretical formulation of layer selection as an optimal stopping problem, showing that under bounded projection noise and dominant late-stage alignment perturbation, our search rule filters perturbation while bounding the loss relative to the oracle refinement layer. Experiments across dense and Mixture-of-Experts LLMs demonstrate consistent gains on challenging reasoning benchmarks, including GPQA-Diamond, Omni-MATH, and HLE, with zero memory overhead and less than 2% latency increase. These results suggest dynamically bypassing final-layer perturbations can unlock stronger reasoning behavior from aligned LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型解码时存在“猜测-精炼-扰动”的动态：早期层形成粗略猜测，中间层精炼推理语义，最终层可能引入扰动。据此提出Confident Decoding，一种无需训练的解码策略，通过熵引导的保守反向搜索动态选择最可靠的近最终层，有效绕过最终层扰动，在多个推理基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 挑战传统假设——LLM解码必须从最终层进行，认为深层表示能提供更可靠的下一词预测。作者发现最终层实际上可能引入扰动（向通用或对齐偏好词偏移），从而损害推理能力。
AI.method: 提出Confident Decoding，一种训练无关的解码策略：(1) 通过熵引导的保守反向搜索，从最终层向前回溯，动态选择最可靠的近最终层；(2) 将层选择形式化为最优停止问题，理论证明在有界投影噪声和主导的后期对齐扰动下，该搜索规则能过滤扰动并保证损失有界。
AI.result: 在密集和MoE LLM上，GPQA-Diamond、Omni-MATH、HLE等推理基准测试中取得一致提升，零内存开销，延迟增加小于2%。
AI.conclusion: 动态绕过最终层扰动可以解锁对齐LLM更强的推理行为，表明最终层并非总是最优解码层。

title: Fusing Backdoors, Machine Learning, and Optimization for Large-Scale Parametric Mixed-Integer Programs
summary:
Large-scale optimization problems are often solved repeatedly under similar structural conditions, leading to substantial computational overhead. This occurs in applications such as power systems, transportation, and supply chain networks, where the underlying structure is fixed while parameters frequently vary under perturbations.
  This paper proposes a Learning to Optimize (LTO) framework that accelerates the solution of large-scale general mixed-integer problems by leveraging the concept of a backdoor, i.e., a subset of variables that drive most of the computational complexity. The proposed BIPC framework consists of three phases. Phase I is an identification procedure that discovers a backdoor for a set of instances in the distribution. Phase II uses supervised learning to develop machine learning models that, given an instance, predict values for bounded-domain backdoor variables and intervals for wide-domain backdoor variables. These predictions define a reduced optimization problem where the predictions constrain the backdoor variables, while the other variables remain free. Phase III optimizes this reduced problem and, if necessary, applies a correction step to restore feasibility or the optimality guarantees.
  Experiments on real-world, large-scale problems show substantial reductions in solution time with only a limited loss in solution quality. The framework enables organizations to solve large-scale optimization problems efficiently in the presence of frequent perturbations, such as unexpected events, demand fluctuations, or operational changes. Because these changes affect parameters rather than the problem structure, BIPC can quickly provide high-quality, feasible solutions, offering a practical approach to integrating machine learning into existing optimization pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BIPC框架，通过识别问题中的"后门"变量子集，利用机器学习预测其取值，从而将大规模混合整数规划问题简化为更易求解的子问题，在保持解质量的同时大幅降低求解时间。
AI.motivation: 大规模优化问题在固定结构、参数频繁变化的情况下（如电力系统、交通、供应链网络）需要重复求解，计算开销巨大，亟需一种能够利用历史求解经验加速当前求解的方法。
AI.method: BIPC框架包含三个阶段：（1）从实例分布中识别后门变量子集；（2）使用监督学习分别预测有界域后门变量的精确值和宽域后门变量的区间；（3）求解约束后的简化问题，必要时执行修正步骤以保证可行性和最优性。
AI.result: 在真实大规模问题上，该方法显著降低了求解时间，同时解质量损失有限。
AI.conclusion: BIPC框架能够有效应对参数扰动场景，为将机器学习集成到现有优化管线提供了一种实用方法，使组织能在频繁变化的环境中快速获得高质量可行解。

title: Pre-Generation Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Soft-Target Attention Probing
summary:
Detecting hallucination risk before generation enables abstention, retrieval augmentation, and routing decisions without incurring the cost of decoding.
  While prior work has shown that such risk can be estimated from a model's internal representations, existing approaches treat this as binary classification over a single decoded output. We instead formulate it as a risk-estimation problem. Under this formulation, we introduce soft-target supervision based on the empirical answer error rate over stochastically sampled outputs - an estimator we prove to be the unique unbiased minimum-variance estimator of the model's per-prompt error probability under its sampling distribution.
  We further adapt attention probing to the pre-generation setting, enabling the detector to selectively aggregate hallucination-relevant prompt representations. Across three question-answering benchmarks and five models, attention probing outperforms linear probing on short-answer tasks. Replacing binary labels with soft-target supervision further and consistently improves detection quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在生成前检测幻觉风险，通过软目标监督（基于随机采样输出的经验错误率）和注意力探测方法，在三个问答基准和五个模型上优于传统二元分类和线性探测方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将幻觉检测视为基于单个解码输出的二元分类问题，无法充分利用模型内部表示中的分布信息，且缺乏对生成前风险的精确估计。
AI.method: 1) 将幻觉检测重新定义为风险估计问题；2) 提出基于随机采样输出的经验答案错误率作为软目标监督信号，并证明该估计量是模型在采样分布下每个提示错误概率的唯一无偏最小方差估计量；3) 将注意力探测（attention probing）适配到生成前设置，选择性聚合与幻觉相关的提示表示。
AI.result: 在三个问答基准和五个模型上，注意力探测在短答案任务中优于线性探测；用软目标监督替代二元标签进一步且一致地提升了检测质量。
AI.conclusion: 生成前幻觉风险检测可通过软目标监督和注意力探测有效提升，避免了完整解码的计算开销，为拒答、检索增强和路由决策提供了更可靠的依据。

title: Fast-TurboQuant: A Multiplier-Free Online Vector Quantization Approach
summary: As large language models scale, memory bandwidth for key-value caches and retrieval-augmented generation systems becomes a critical bottleneck. While 1-bit quantization addresses this constraint, recent TurboQuant relies on dense random rotation matrices to condition the vector distribution before quantization. This projection demands millions of floating-point multiplications per embedding, making it difficult to deploy on constrained edge silicon. We introduce Fast-TurboQuant, a multiplier-free projection architecture that replaces the dense matrix with a structured fast Johnson-Lindenstrauss transform. By applying a Rademacher phase inversion followed by a fast Walsh-Hadamard transform (FWHT), the method leverages sub-Gaussian concentration to satisfy the prerequisites of scalar Lloyd-Max quantization without Gaussian projections. This substitution reduces the arithmetic complexity to only additions, eliminating hardware multipliers. Evaluation on DBpedia OpenAI-3 Large embeddings demonstrates a 19.7 times algorithmic speedup under sequential execution. Furthermore, the dimension expansion due to the FWHT zero-padding reduces the mean squared error and improves Recall@10.

AI.tldr: Fast-TurboQuant 提出了一种免乘法器投影架构，用快速沃尔什-哈达玛变换（FWHT）替代密集随机旋转矩阵，实现1-bit量化前的向量分布调节，在DBpedia OpenAI-3 Large嵌入上获得了19.7倍的算法加速，同时降低了均方误差并提升了Recall@10。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型扩展时，键值缓存和检索增强生成系统的内存带宽成为关键瓶颈。1-bit量化虽能缓解该约束，但TurboQuant依赖密集随机旋转矩阵进行投影，需要数百万次浮点乘法运算，难以部署在资源受限的边缘芯片上。
AI.method: 提出Fast-TurboQuant，用结构化快速Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换替代密集矩阵：先进行Rademacher相位反转，再执行快速沃尔什-哈达玛变换（FWHT）。该方法利用次高斯集中性满足标量Lloyd-Max量化的前提条件，无需高斯投影，将算术复杂度降至仅有加法运算，完全消除硬件乘法器。
AI.result: 在DBpedia OpenAI-3 Large嵌入上，顺序执行下实现19.7倍算法加速；FWHT零填充导致的维度扩展降低了均方误差，并提升了Recall@10。
AI.conclusion: Fast-TurboQuant通过结构化变换实现免乘法器的高效投影，显著降低了计算复杂度，同时保持甚至提升了量化性能，为边缘部署1-bit量化提供了可行方案。

title: MindTailor: Personalized Emotional Support via Post History-Grounded Case Formulation and Collaborative Refinement
summary: As mental health concerns continue to rise globally, social media has emerged as a vital space where individuals seek emotional support. While prior work on personalized emotional support has leveraged seekers' emotional states, personas, and situational context, these approaches primarily capture the seeker's current state, overlooking the formative experiences that shape present concerns. In this work, we propose MindTailor, a framework that generates personalized emotional support responses by constructing a case formulation from the seeker's post history and iteratively refining responses through collaborative critique among counselor agents grounded in distinct counseling strategies. To enable research on this history-aware task, we construct ReddiSupp, a dataset of 798 Reddit posts paired with seekers' prior post histories. Through LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, expert human evaluation, and a user study with seekers, we demonstrate that MindTailor outperforms baselines across these evaluations, improving empathy, personalization, understanding, and achieving the highest overall preference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MindTailor框架，通过分析用户在社交媒体上的历史发帖记录构建案例表述，并基于多种咨询策略的协作批评生成个性化情感支持回复。实验表明该方法在共情、个性化、理解力和整体偏好上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化情感支持方法主要关注用户当前状态（情绪、人格、情境），忽略了塑造当前问题的形成性经验（即用户的历史经历）。
AI.method: MindTailor框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 从用户历史发帖中构建案例表述（case formulation）；(2) 通过基于不同咨询策略的辅导员智能体进行协作批评（collaborative critique），迭代优化回复。同时构建了ReddiSupp数据集（798组Reddit帖子及历史记录）。
AI.result: 通过LLM评审、专家人工评估和用户实验三个维度的评价，MindTailor在共情、个性化、理解力和整体偏好上均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 引入用户历史信息作为案例表述，结合多策略协作批评机制，能显著提升情感支持回复的个性化和共情质量，验证了历史感知方法在心理支持任务中的有效性。

title: Post-Training Speech Enhancement Language Models with Perceptual Rewards
summary: Speech enhancement language models achieve strong results when trained on discrete audio tokens, but their optimization relies on token-level cross-entropy rather than the perceptual metrics used for evaluation. We introduce a post-training stage for autoregressive speech enhancement language models using Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) with multi-metric perceptual rewards. Our method directly optimizes non-differentiable quality metrics (DNSMOS, WER, and UTMOS) as reward signals, without learned surrogates or offline preference pairs. Applied to two autoregressive base models, UniSE and GenSE, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on the DNS2020 benchmark. A human evaluation ablation further shows that the composite multi-metric reward is preferred over any single-metric variant, confirming that multi-reward optimization avoids the reward hacking observed with single-metric training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于自回归语音增强语言模型的后训练方法，通过组序列策略优化（GSPO）结合多指标感知奖励（DNSMOS、WER、UTMOS）直接优化非可微质量指标，在DNS2020基准上达到SOTA，且人类评测证实多指标奖励优于单指标变体，避免了奖励破解问题。
AI.motivation: 语音增强语言模型在离散音频令牌上训练时，使用token级交叉熵损失优化，但评估时使用感知指标，存在优化目标与评估指标不一致的问题。
AI.method: 提出后训练阶段，应用组序列策略优化（GSPO），以多指标感知奖励（DNSMOS、WER、UTMOS）作为奖励信号直接优化，无需学习代理模型或离线偏好对。
AI.result: 在DNS2020基准上达到SOTA结果；人类消融实验表明复合多指标奖励优于任何单指标变体。
AI.conclusion: 多指标奖励优化能避免单指标训练中出现的奖励破解问题，是更优的后训练策略。

title: Beyond Value Benchmarks: Measuring Value-Structure Alignment in Large Language Models via Symmetric Q-Sorts
comment: 32 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables; accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring complex moral reasoning and value trade-offs. However, existing evaluations typically rely on item-level behavioral metrics, which fail to capture how models structurally prioritize competing values as a cohesive system. To address this, we propose a symmetric human-LLM evaluation framework, grounded in Q methodology, to measure value-structure alignment. Under our protocol, humans and models sort an identical 140-item moral statement set into a shared nine-column forced distribution; for LLMs, we elicit strict rankings and deterministically map them to Q-sort buckets. Using a human reference sample ($N=35$), we establish a stable three-factor reference geometry specific to this instrument and sample. We evaluate 12 LLMs across four model families via 240 replicated Q-sorts at two temperature settings, quantifying structural alignment via Procrustes similarity ($φ$) and RSA-based Spearman correlation ($ρ$). Our results reveal significant cross-family heterogeneity, model-specific sensitivity to generation stochasticity and localized misalignment, which demonstrate that favorable global scores can obscure underlying regional distortions. While rank- and bucket-based analyses remain highly consistent, prompt phrasing introduces notable variance. Ultimately, assessing value-structure alignment provides a crucial structural complement to traditional itemwise moral benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于Q方法论的对称人机评估框架，通过强制排序协议测量LLM与人类在道德价值结构上的对齐程度。实验发现不同模型家族间存在显著异质性，全局高分可能掩盖局部扭曲，提示需将结构性对齐作为传统逐项道德基准的重要补充。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM道德评估依赖逐项行为指标，无法捕捉模型如何在结构层面优先排序竞争性价值观。为弥补这一缺陷，需要一种能够测量价值结构对齐的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于Q方法论构建对称人机评估框架。人类和模型对140条道德陈述集在九列强制分布中进行排序；对LLM则通过严格排序确定性映射到Q分类桶。以35人人类样本建立三因子参考几何，对4个模型家族的12个LLM进行240次复制Q分类（两种温度设置），通过Procrustes相似度（φ）和RSA Spearman相关（ρ）量化结构对齐。
AI.result: 不同模型家族间存在显著异质性，模型对生成随机性具有特定敏感性，存在局部对齐偏差。全局高分可能掩盖区域扭曲。排名法和分桶法分析高度一致，但提示措辞引入了显著方差。
AI.conclusion: 评估价值结构对齐是对传统逐项道德基准的重要结构性补充。

title: Deep Learning for Soil Moisture Estimation: Fusing Satellite Data with Optimally-Lagged Meteorological Features
summary: Accurate soil moisture estimation in semi-arid agricultural regions requires integrating remote sensing and meteorological information while accounting for the delayed response of soil moisture to atmospheric forcing. This study introduces a Cross-Correlation Function (CCF) methodology to determine optimal temporal lags (0-30 days) between meteorological variables and soil moisture, as well as inter-depth lags (0-15 days) describing vertical moisture propagation from the surface (10 cm) to deeper layers (20-50 cm). The approach was validated across seven agricultural plots in southeastern Spain. Three deep learning architectures, each targeting a distinct prediction granularity, were evaluated under five feature configurations ranging from satellite-only to full satellite-meteorology-depth fusion: a CNN for per-pixel estimation within each plot, an LSTM for frame-level (daily plot-mean) prediction, and a CNN-LSTM hybrid operating on sliding windows with pooled multi-patch training. Models were assessed on held-out data to measure genuine generalisation. Meteorological variables improved performance over the satellite-only baseline, while subsurface depth information proved decisive across all architectures. The per-pixel CNN achieved the strongest single-patch result (R^2 = 0.877, RMSE = 2.28), with a seven-patch average R^2 of 0.535, representing an improvement of +1.00 over the satellite-only baseline. The pooled CNN-LSTM hybrid obtained the highest overall performance (R^2 = 0.930, CVRMSE = 8.0%). These results demonstrate that explicitly modelling atmospheric and vertical subsurface delays substantially improves soil moisture estimation for precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于交叉相关函数（CCF）的气象-土壤湿度最优时间滞后（0-30天）及层间滞后（0-15天）确定方法，在西班牙东南部七个农业地块验证。三种深度学习架构（CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM混合）在五种特征配置下评估，结果表明考虑大气和垂直地下延迟可显著提升土壤湿度估计精度，CNN-LSTM混合模型取得最优性能（R²=0.930, CVRMSE=8.0%）。
AI.motivation: 半干旱农业区精确估计土壤湿度需要融合遥感与气象信息，同时考虑土壤湿度对大气强迫的延迟响应。现有方法未充分建模这种时间滞后效应。
AI.method: 引入CCF确定最优时间滞后（0-30天）和层间滞后（0-15天）；评估三种深度学习架构（逐像素CNN、逐帧LSTM、滑动窗口CNN-LSTM混合）在五种特征配置（从仅卫星到卫星-气象-深度全融合）下的性能。
AI.result: 气象变量可提升仅卫星基线性能；地下深度信息对所有架构至关重要。逐像素CNN单块最优R²=0.877, RMSE=2.28，七块平均R²=0.535（较基线+1.00）；CNN-LSTM混合模型总体最优R²=0.930, CVRMSE=8.0%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模大气和垂直地下延迟可显著提升半干旱农业区土壤湿度估计精度，为精准农业提供有效支持。

title: Are Multilingual Models Actually Improving? Isolating True Cross-Lingual Transfer
summary: Cross-lingual transfer is a model's ability to generalize capabilities from well-represented source languages to under-represented target languages. Existing measures of a model's transfer strength conflate improvements in transfer with general improvements to accuracy in the source language. We advocate for an alternate metric that reliably captures transfer strength called Hardness Adjusted Transfer (HAT) Score, and use it to derive multiple insights on factors influencing transfer strength. Our analysis across twenty diverse language models and three popular mainstream multilingual benchmarks argues that 1) transfer in small models is not broken, 2) we are making slower than expected progress in cross-lingual transfer with model size, and 3) we have made clear progress over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种称为Hardness Adjusted Transfer (HAT) Score的新指标，用于更可靠地衡量跨语言迁移强度，并通过分析20个多语言模型和3个主流基准，得出三个关键发现：小模型的跨语言迁移并未失效、随模型规模增长的迁移进步慢于预期、以及跨语言能力随时间推移确有提升。
AI.motivation: 现有跨语言迁移强度指标将迁移提升与源语言准确率提升混为一谈，无法真实反映模型向目标语言泛化的能力，因此需要一种去除了源语言改进干扰的可靠度量方法。
AI.method: 提出Hardness Adjusted Transfer (HAT) Score，该指标通过调整源语言和目标语言之间的难度差异来分离迁移效果与源语言精度提升。在20个不同规模的多语言模型和3个主流多语言基准上进行分析。
AI.result: 1) 小模型中的跨语言迁移并未失效；2) 随模型规模增大，跨语言迁移的进步速度低于预期；3) 跨语言迁移能力随时间推移呈现出明确的进步趋势。
AI.conclusion: HAT Score作为去混杂的迁移强度指标，揭示了跨语言迁移研究中被传统指标掩盖的真实趋势，为多语言模型评估提供了更可靠的工具。

title: Robustness Cannot be Reduced to Regularization: Studying Adversarial Training Beyond the Linear Case
summary: The vulnerability of ML models to adversarial examples has recently emerged as a major concern. While adversarial training is one of the most effective countermeasures to this issue, its high computational cost remains an obstacle to practical deployment. Recent progress in reducing this cost has relied, in the case of linear models, on a formal equivalence between the adversarial risk and a simpler form of regularized risk. This enabled significantly more efficient training procedures, which naturally raises the question of whether such an equivalence can be extended beyond linear models. In this work, we formally show that no such equivalence is possible for two-layer networks. Our proofs proceed via a reduction to key properties that fundamentally separate the adversarial risk from any simple regularized risk which would only exhibit a weak form of data dependence. Beyond this setting, we provide empirical evidence on Wide-ResNets indicating that the same type of impossibility persists in deeper and more expressive architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对于两层神经网络，对抗风险与简单正则化风险之间不存在形式等价关系，并通过实验表明这种不可能性在更深层的架构中依然存在。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练计算成本高昂，近期在线性模型中发现了对抗风险与正则化风险的形式等价性，从而大幅降低了训练成本。本文探究这种等价性能否扩展到非线性模型。
AI.method: 通过归约方法，证明两层网络中对抗风险与仅具有弱数据依赖性的简单正则化风险之间存在根本性分离；同时在Wide-ResNet上进行实证验证。
AI.result: 严格证明了两层网络无法建立这种等价关系，并在更深层架构上提供了支持的实证证据。
AI.conclusion: 对抗风险与简单正则化风险之间的形式等价性无法推广到非线性模型（如两层网络及以上），因此需要寻找替代方案来降低对抗训练成本。

title: OpenBioRQ: Unsolved Biomedical Research Questions for Agents
summary: A working citation looks like proof -- but the fact that a link resolves does not mean the cited paper supports the claim. I find that current agentic models rarely fabricate citations (over $99\%$ resolve), yet roughly $15.9\%$ link to the wrong paper. Existing benchmarks miss this failure mode: when a question has a fixed answer key, a model can reproduce the expected source from that key rather than independently verifying that the source supports the claim. I introduce \textbf{\openbiorq{}}, a retrieval-grounded agentic benchmark of $12{,}553$ unsolved biomedical research questions across $12$ domains that treats open questions as a faithfulness-and-abstention probe. To my knowledge, this is the first biomedical benchmark to combine an agentic setting -- where the model must issue multiple tool calls -- with unsolved questions that have no answer key. Openness is verified against real follow-up evidence rather than a model's parametric knowledge. Difficulty is empirical: I anchor it on questions that three open-weight reference models fail to answer, rather than on subjective hardness labels. On this hardest subset, held-out models from the same lineage as the difficulty anchors solve only ~17%, while three independent frontier agents (Gemini-3-Pro, Opus-4.7, GPT-5.5) span a wide 29-60% range. The benchmark is thus hard, non-saturating (the best agent still leaves ~33-40\% unsolved), and discriminating across capability tiers. Beyond difficulty, I observe agentic collapse on the hardest questions, where agents stop using their tools. For the most collapse-prone model, blocking tool access entirely barely changes its score -- so tools stop paying off exactly where they are needed most. A frozen per-question checklist raises inter-judge agreement from Spearman 0.35 to 0.82.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenBioRQ，一个包含12,553个未解决生物医学研究问题的检索增强型智能体基准。研究发现现有模型虽极少伪造引用（>99%可解析），但约15.9%链接到错误论文。该基准通过开放式问题（无答案键）检测模型的忠实性与弃权能力。在最难子集上，前沿模型仅解决17-60%，且观察到智能体崩溃现象——模型在最难问题上停止使用工具。
AI.motivation: 现有基准存在两个缺陷：一是当问题有固定答案键时，模型可以复制预期来源而非独立验证来源是否支持主张；二是当前模型约15.9%的引文链接到错误论文，但现有基准未能捕捉这种失败模式。因此需要引入无答案键的开放式问题基准来测试模型的忠实性与弃权能力。
AI.method: 构建OpenBioRQ基准：包含12,553个跨12个生物医学领域的未解决问题，通过真实后续证据而非模型参数知识验证开放性。难度基于三个开源参考模型无法回答的问题确定，而非主观标签。采用代理设置要求模型多次工具调用，并使用冻结的每问题检查表来提高评估一致性。
AI.result: 与难度锚点同系列的保留模型仅解决约17%，三个独立前沿智能体（Gemini-3-Pro、Opus-4.7、GPT-5.5）覆盖29-60%范围。最优智能体仍留下约33-40%未解决。在最难问题上观察到智能体崩溃，模型停止使用工具。对最易崩溃的模型，完全阻止工具访问几乎不改变分数。冻结检查表将评估者间一致性从Spearman 0.35提升至0.82。
AI.conclusion: OpenBioRQ是一个困难、非饱和且具有区分度的基准，揭示了现有模型在生物医学推理中的关键失败模式：引文错误链接和智能体崩溃。工具在最需要的时候失效，表明需要更好的智能体推理机制。标准化评估流程可显著提高评估一致性。

title: Predicting High-Risk Colorectal Polyps in African Americans Using Pre-Colonoscopy Clinical Features: Machine Learning Model Development and Temporal Validation
summary:
Risk stratification for advanced colorectal polyps typically relies on colonoscopy and/or pathology findings. However, there is growing interest in whether non-invasive features available prior to colonoscopy can help identify patients at higher risk. Such approaches may enhance clinical decision-making by prioritizing surveillance for individuals most likely to harbor high-risk polyps, when colonoscopy resources are limited while potentially reducing unnecessary procedures in lower-risk patients. Importantly, the use of non-invasive, pre-procedural information may also help promote more equitable access to risk stratification, particularly in settings where colonoscopy resources are limited or unevenly distributed. We aimed to develop and externally validate machine learning models to predict high-risk colorectal polyps using only non-invasive, pre-colonoscopy demographic, clinical, and behavioral features in a diverse, predominantly African American, urban cohort.
  We conducted a retrospective cohort study using demographic, lifestyle, and comorbidity data from patients who underwent colonoscopy at Howard University Hospital to develop and validate several machine learning models, including neural networks, random forest, support vector machines (SVM), Naive Bayes, logistic regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors (KNN), and XGBoost, for predicting high-risk colorectal polyps. High-risk polyps (HRP) were defined as villous or tubullovillous adenomas, high-grade dysplasia, polyps >= 10 mm in size, and/or the presence of >= 3 polyps per procedure; all other cases were classified as low-risk polyps (LRP). The dataset included 4,681 patients from 2015-2022 used for internal validation and 1,562 patients from 2023-2024 used for external validation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用非侵入性（结肠镜前）的人口统计学、临床和行为特征，在主要由非洲裔美国人组成的城市队列中开发和外部验证机器学习模型，用于预测高危结直肠息肉，以在结肠镜资源有限的情况下优化风险分层和资源分配。
AI.motivation: 传统高危结直肠息肉的风险分层依赖结肠镜和病理结果，但研究者希望探索是否可以在结肠镜检查前利用非侵入性特征提前识别高风险患者。这种方法可优化临床决策，优先为高风险个体安排监测，同时减少低风险患者的不必要检查，特别是在结肠镜资源有限或不均衡分布的环境中促进更公平的风险分层。
AI.method: 采用回顾性队列研究设计，从霍华德大学医院接受结肠镜检查的患者中收集人口统计学、生活方式和合并症数据。开发并验证了多种机器学习模型（神经网络、随机森林、SVM、朴素贝叶斯、逻辑回归、决策树、KNN、XGBoost）。高危息肉定义为绒毛状/管状绒毛状腺瘤、高级别异型增生、息肉≥10mm和/或每次手术≥3个息肉。内部验证集包含4,681名患者（2015-2022年），外部验证集包含1,562名患者（2023-2024年）。
AI.result: 研究开发并外部验证了多种机器学习模型，利用结肠镜前的非侵入性特征在高危结直肠息肉预测中的表现。
AI.conclusion: 使用结肠镜前非侵入性特征的机器学习模型可能有助于在资源有限环境下识别高危结直肠息肉患者，改善风险分层公平性。

title: Can LLMs Control Readability? A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for CEFR-Controlled Arabic Generation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate fluent Arabic text, their ability to reliably control readability levels remains unclear. We propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework for Common European Framework of Reference for Language (CEFR)-controlled Arabic text generation, assessing whether instruction-following LLMs can serve as reliable generators for adaptive language learning. Our framework integrates controlled prompting, automatic readability prediction using a validated Taha-19 model, lexical constraint validation, and syntactic complexity profiling. Results show that structured prompting substantially improves CEFR alignment. In particular, CEFR-guided prompting with lexical constraints achieves the highest conformity to reference linguistic profiles (0.91 cosine similarity) and near-perfect agreement with predicted readability levels (0.99), while unconstrained prompting exhibits weak control. These findings establish an empirical foundation for integrating readability-aware Arabic text generation into adaptive educational systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个多维评估框架，用于评估指令跟随LLM在生成符合CEFR等级的可控阿拉伯语文本方面的能力。实验表明，结合CEFR引导提示和词汇约束的结构化提示方法能显著提升与参考语言轮廓的一致性（余弦相似度0.91）和可读性等级预测一致性（0.99），为自适应教育系统中可读性感知的阿拉伯语文本生成奠定了实证基础。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM能生成流利的阿拉伯语文本，但其能否可靠控制文本可读性等级尚不明确，需要建立系统的评估框架来验证。
AI.method: 提出了一个多维评估框架，包括：(1) 受控提示策略；(2) 使用经过验证的Taha-19模型进行自动可读性预测；(3) 词汇约束验证；(4) 句法复杂度分析。
