AI.result: 结构化提示显著提升了CEFR对齐效果：CEFR引导提示加词汇约束达到了与参考语言轮廓的最高一致性（余弦相似度0.91）和近乎完美的可读性等级预测一致性（0.99），而无约束提示的控制效果较弱。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为将可读性感知的阿拉伯语文本生成集成到自适应教育系统中提供了实证基础。

title: Breaking chains with trees: Deep learning with $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel time complexity
summary: Modern deep neural network architectures are trained via backpropagation, which requires errors to be sequentially propagated through all layers before parameters can be updated. This introduces two limitations: locking, where layer-wise updates are strictly interdependent and cannot proceed in parallel, and the weight transport problem, which requires symmetric forward and backward pathways for exact gradient computation. These constraints restrict parallelism, increase memory and communication overhead, and pose challenges for scalable learning. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Block-Local Learning (HBLL), a framework that decomposes deep neural networks into hierarchically linked blocks trained using local learning objectives derived from variational principles, eliminating the need for full end-to-end backpropagation while maintaining effective information propagation across the network. HBLL is the first algorithm that is able to train deep neural networks in $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ parallel time complexity, where $N$ is the number of network layers. We show that HBLL implicitly defines a family of subnetworks corresponding to different hierarchical paths, enabling flexible inference with different effective numbers of layers. We evaluate HBLL on a set of challenging vision and language modeling tasks, achieving competitive performance. We also extend HBLL to recurrent sequence architectures, applying to settings that otherwise rely on backpropagation through time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层块局部学习（HBLL）框架，通过变分原理驱动的局部学习目标将深度神经网络分解为层级链接的块，无需端到端反向传播即可实现O(log N)的并行训练复杂度，在视觉和语言建模任务上取得竞争性表现，并扩展至循环序列架构。
AI.motivation: 传统反向传播存在两大限制：锁定问题（层间更新严格串行依赖）和权重传输问题（需要对称的正向和反向路径）。这些约束限制了并行性、增加了内存和通信开销，给可扩展学习带来挑战。
AI.method: HBLL将深度神经网络分解为层级链接的块，每个块使用基于变分原理的局部学习目标独立训练，无需完整的端到端反向传播。通过层级结构设计，实现了O(log N)的并行时间复杂度，并隐式定义了对应不同层级路径的子网络族。
AI.result: HBLL是首个实现O(log N)并行训练复杂度的深度神经网络训练算法；在视觉和语言建模任务上取得竞争性表现；成功扩展至循环序列架构，应用于依赖时间反向传播的场景。
AI.conclusion: HBLL通过局部学习有效解决了反向传播的锁定和权重传输问题，显著提升了训练并行性，同时保持了网络性能，为大规模可扩展深度学习提供了新方向。

title: Adding Robust Code-Switching Capabilities to High Performance Multilingual ASR
summary: Code-switching (CSW) remains challenging for large multi-lingual ASR systems in real-world deployment. While fine-tuning on synthetic CSW data is possible, it generally degrades strong monolingual baselines. Our goal is to preserve these capabilities while extending models to handle complex code-switching, including morphological variations across languages. We propose Bayesian factorized adaptation, which learns to efficiently integrate switching-relevant knowledge into strong pretrained models without overwriting existing capabilities. Requiring only a small amount of synthetic data, our approach reduces transcription errors by 32.87% on code-switched words while improving overall WER by 5.31%, all while maintaining mono-lingual performance. Our results demonstrate that effective CSW adaptation depends more on knowledge integration than data complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯因子化适配方法，在保持单语性能的同时，通过少量合成数据将代码切换知识有效集成到预训练多语言ASR系统中，使代码切换词转录错误降低32.87%，整体WER改善5.31%。
AI.motivation: 现实部署中的多语言ASR系统面临代码切换难题，微调合成数据会降低单语基线性能，因此需要一种既能保持单语能力又能处理复杂代码切换（含跨语言形态变化）的适配方法。
AI.method: 贝叶斯因子化适配（Bayesian factorized adaptation）：通过贝叶斯框架学习将切换相关知识高效集成到预训练模型中，避免覆盖已有能力，仅需少量合成数据。
AI.result: 代码切换词转录错误降低32.87%，整体WER改善5.31%，单语性能得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 有效的代码切换适配更依赖于知识集成方式而非数据复杂度。

title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Temporal Graph Learning with Digital Twin--Guided Adaptive Deception for Cyber-Resilient IoMT
summary: The rapid proliferation of IoT and IoMT devices introduces critical cybersecurity vulnerabilities in healthcare and industrial environments where resource-constrained devices operate under strict latency and data-privacy regulations. This paper presents the Federated Temporal Graph Convolutional Network with Advantage Actor-Critic (Federated TGCN-A2C), a privacy-preserving defense architecture integrating four mechanisms: a PyG-based Temporal GCN using GCNConv layers with global mean pooling and a learned anomaly gate for flow-level threat classification; LSTM-based Digital Twins generating per-device anomaly scores gating the classifier via learned sigmoid coupling; a Federated A2C agent selecting among ALLOW, ISOLATE, and HONEYPOT-REDIRECT actions based on a seven-dimensional state capturing confidence, entropy, anomaly magnitude, and traffic composition; and an enhanced honeypot layer converting suspicious traffic into threat intelligence with adaptive thresholds. Federated aggregation employs EMA-smoothed per-client validation losses as inverse-weighted FedAvg coefficients to stabilize global model updates under non-IID distributions, with cosine-annealed learning rates per round. Evaluated on CICDDoS 2019 and TON-IoT benchmarks, the framework achieves 99.48% and 99.61% test accuracy with weighted-F1 scores of 0.9948 and 0.9961, converging within 25 and 10 federated rounds, outperforming Fed-Inforce-Fusion by 0.21 percentage points while covering three additional attack categories. All sixteen CICDDoS 2019 classes achieve F1 of at least 0.9237 and all ten TON-IoT classes achieve F1 of at least 0.9488, including the severely imbalanced MITM category. Post-hoc explainability via SHAP, LIME, Grad-CAM, and counterfactual analysis confirms decisions are grounded in semantically meaningful flow features, supporting regulatory accountability in clinical deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出联邦时序图卷积网络结合优势演员-评论家（Federated TGCN-A2C）的隐私保护防御架构，集成时序GCN、LSTM数字孪生、联邦A2C强化学习和增强蜜罐层，在CICDDoS 2019和TON-IoT基准上分别达到99.48%和99.61%的测试准确率，所有类别F1≥0.9237，并具备SHAP/LIME/Grad-CAM可解释性。
AI.motivation: IoT和IoMT设备在医疗和工业环境中资源受限且需满足严格的延迟和数据隐私法规，现有方案难以兼顾隐私保护、实时检测和多类别威胁分类，亟需一种隐私保护的分布式防御架构。
AI.method: 1) 基于PyG的时序GCN（GCNConv+全局均值池化+学习型异常门控）进行流级威胁分类；2) LSTM数字孪生生成每设备异常分数，通过sigmoid耦合门控分类器；3) 联邦A2C代理从7维状态空间中选取ALLOW/ISOLATE/HONEYPOT-REDIRECT动作；4) 增强蜜罐层将可疑流量转化为威胁情报；5) 使用EMA平滑的每客户端验证损失作为逆加权FedAvg系数，搭配余弦退火学习率进行联邦聚合。
AI.result: CICDDoS 2019准确率99.48%（加权F1 0.9948），25轮收敛；TON-IoT准确率99.61%（加权F1 0.9961），10轮收敛；相比Fed-Inforce-Fusion提升0.21个百分点且多覆盖3个攻击类别；16个CICDDoS类别F1≥0.9237，10个TON-IoT类别F1≥0.9488（含严重不平衡的MITM类别）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的联邦TGCN-A2C框架在隐私保护前提下实现了高精度多类别威胁检测与快速收敛，结合SHAP、LIME、Grad-CAM和反事实分析的可解释性验证了决策基于语义有意义的流特征，支持临床部署中的监管问责。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Grapheme-to-Phoneme Conversion: A Japanese Case Study
summary: Grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) conversion is essential for controllable and robust text-to-speech, and large language models (LLMs), with broad linguistic knowledge, offer a promising approach. We benchmarked over 30 LLMs on Japanese G2P, comparing them with conventional morphological analyzers on 3000 manually annotated sentences. We evaluated two prompting strategies: a parse mode, where the LLM performs morphological analysis followed by rule-based kana conversion, and a direct mode, where the LLM directly predicts kana readings. The results show that model size, version, and Japanese-specialized training are key factors, with the best LLMs achieving kana character error rate below 0.52\% vs. the best conventional tool (1.03\%). Parse mode outperforms direct mode for most models, as rule-based post-processing relieves the LLM of handling complex pronunciation rules. We also show that feeding LLM-predicted kana into a kana-input TTS yields better pronunciation than end-to-end TTS.

AI.tldr: 本文对30多种大语言模型在日语字素到音素转换任务上进行了基准测试，发现最佳模型在假名字符错误率上(0.52%)显著优于传统形态分析工具(1.03%)，并提出解析模式（先形态分析再规则转换）优于直接预测模式，且LLM预测的假名输入到基于假名的TTS系统可产生比端到端TTS更好的发音效果。
AI.motivation: G2P转换对可控且鲁棒的文本转语音至关重要，大语言模型具有广泛的 linguistic knowledge，提供了一种有前景的方法。作者旨在系统评估LLM在日语G2P任务上的能力，并与传统工具比较。
AI.method: 在3000条人工标注句子上，对30多种LLM进行了基准测试，对比了两种提示策略：解析模式（LLM进行形态分析+规则假名转换）和直接模式（LLM直接预测假名读音）。
AI.result: 模型规模、版本和日语专门训练是关键因素；最佳LLM的假名字符错误率低于0.52%，而传统最佳工具为1.03%；解析模式对大多数模型优于直接模式；LLM预测的假名输入到假名输入TTS比端到端TTS发音更好。
AI.conclusion: 基于规则的后期处理可以减轻LLM处理复杂发音规则的负担，从而获得更好的G2P转换效果；LLM在日语G2P任务上已超越传统形态分析工具。

title: Towards Understanding the Power and Limits of the Muon Optimizer: A River-Valley Perspective
summary: Recently, Muon has gained substantial attention as an appealing alternative to Adam-like optimizers, with many works highlighting its advantages through spectral normalization and improved conditioning. Yet this positive theoretical narrative contrasts with its empirical performance in large language model (LLM) training, where Muon's gains over Adam/AdamW are often mixed, schedule-sensitive, and not uniformly superior. To address this gap, we develop a trajectory-level theory characterizing both the strengths and limitations of Muon. We introduce a mixed-spiked matrix sensing model whose sensing operator decomposes into signal, spike, and bulk components, capturing a mixture of anisotropic structure and long-tail information reminiscent of LLM training. On top of it, we adopted a river-valley perspective in which we view the landscape as composed of a river direction flowing to the desired solution and hill directions encoding nuisance or task-irrelevant information. In the momentum-free setting, we show that Muon moves faster along the information-bearing river direction during early optimization, but can converge much more slowly near the river bottom than gradient descent. We then extend the river-valley perspective to general nonconvex objectives with momentum by studying points on the spectral river. There, while Muon converges faster early on, its orthogonalized update removes residual scale information, making it prone to overshooting and oscillation near the target solution. Together, these results suggest that our characterizations extend beyond spiked matrix sensing and motivate switching to GD-like refinement optimizers in the final phase, rather than relying only on a fixed learning-rate schedule for Muon. We also provide preliminary evidence supporting this two-stage approach in language model training experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过混合尖峰矩阵感知模型和“河谷”视角，从轨迹层面理论刻画了Muon优化器在LLM训练中的优势与局限：前期沿信息方向收敛快，但后期因正交化更新导致震荡缓慢，建议在最后阶段切换为GD类优化器。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器在理论（谱归一化、条件改进）与实证（LLM训练中性能不稳定、对调度敏感）之间存在矛盾，缺乏对其优势与局限的统一理论解释。
AI.method: 提出混合尖峰矩阵感知模型（信号、尖峰、体成分分解），采用“河谷”视角（河流方向通向解、山丘方向编码无关信息），在无动量和有动量两种设置下分析Muon的动力学行为。
AI.result: 无动量时Muon前期沿河流方向加速，但河底收敛慢于GD；有动量时Muon前期快但正交化更新消除残差尺度信息，导致后期过冲和震荡。
AI.conclusion: 理论结论不仅适用于尖峰矩阵感知，也适用于更广泛非凸目标；建议最终阶段从Muon切换为GD类精炼优化器，而非仅依赖固定学习率调度；语言模型实验初步支持两阶段策略。

title: NL2Scratch: An Executable Benchmark and Evaluation for Block-Based Programming
summary: Block-based programming environments such as Scratch are widely used in early programming education, yet natural-language-to-code (NL2Code) research has focused primarily on text-based languages. Scratch programs are event-driven, visually compositional, and distributed across concurrent scripts, making conventional NL2Code assumptions and evaluation insufficient. We introduce NL2Scratch, an executable benchmark for natural-language-to-Scratch generation comprising 311,648 parser-valid NL--program pairs, whose program side is extracted from real Scratch projects and paired with semantically aligned NL descriptions. For reliable evaluation beyond surface overlap, we propose Semantic Alignment Consistency (SAC), an interpretable slot-level metric for measuring semantic agreement between descriptions and programs. With SAC, we construct a semantically validated pool of 23,594 examples, and a slot-balanced 800 diagnostic benchmark. Experiments across instruction-tuned and fine-tuned LLMs reveal a notable gap between lexical similarity and semantic alignment: models achieving token-level F1 above 0.93 often fail to attain perfect SAC, particularly on longer examples. Errors concentrate on operational slots like actions, conditions, and numeric arguments, exposing failure modes largely invisible under conventional metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NL2Scratch基准数据集和SAC语义评估指标，用于自然语言到Scratch程序的生成任务，实验发现现有模型在词法相似度高的情况下语义对齐仍存在显著差距，尤其在操作槽位（动作、条件、数值参数）上错误集中。
AI.motivation: 现有的自然语言到代码（NL2Code）研究主要集中在文本编程语言上，而Scratch等基于块的编程环境具有事件驱动、视觉组合、并发脚本等特性，传统评估方法和假设不适用，因此需要专门针对Scratch的NL2Code基准和评估指标。
AI.method: 1）构建NL2Scratch基准：从真实Scratch项目中提取311,648个经解析器验证的自然语言-程序对；2）提出SAC（语义对齐一致性）指标：一种可解释的槽级度量，用于衡量描述与程序之间的语义一致性；3）基于SAC筛选出23,594个语义验证样本和800个槽平衡诊断基准；4）在多种指令微调和大模型微调设置下进行实验评估。
AI.result: 词元级F1超过0.93的模型往往无法达到完美的SAC，尤其在较长样本上表现更差；错误集中在操作槽位（动作、条件、数值参数）上，这些错误在传统指标下基本不可见。
AI.conclusion: 现有NL2Code模型在Scratch编程任务中存在词法相似度与语义对齐之间的显著差距，传统评估指标无法有效捕捉这些语义层面的失败模式，需要更细粒度的语义评估方法。

title: Backpropagating Through Simulation: Analytic Policy Gradients for Sample and Learning Efficient Differentiable Continuous Control
summary: Model-free reinforcement learning algorithms such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) treat the environment as a black box, estimating policy gradients from sampled rewards; this process demands millions of interactions and relies on high-variance advantage estimates. When environment dynamics are differentiable, the return is an end-to-end differentiable function of the policy parameters, enabling exact gradient computation via backpropagation through simulation. We term this approach Analytic Policy Gradients (APG) and evaluate it against PPO on four continuous control tasks of increasing dynamical complexity: a one-dimensional point-mass target-reaching task, a 2D point-mass navigation task with obstacle avoidance, a 2D rigid-body T-block pushing task, and a 7-DOF Franka FR3 end-effector reaching task. Both algorithms share identical model architectures, observation normalization, and optimizer settings. To decouple sample efficiency from compute efficiency, we design a multi-axis evaluation protocol that records performance against environment steps and gradient steps. We report a segmented backpropagation scheme with MC and critic-based bootstrap modes that mitigates gradient degradation on long-horizon tasks, and present ablations over segment length and bootstrap strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Analytic Policy Gradients (APG)，一种利用可微环境动力学通过反向传播精确计算策略梯度的方法，并在四个连续控制任务上与PPO进行对比，同时提出了多头评估协议和分段反向传播方案。
AI.motivation: 无模型强化学习算法（如PPO）需要大量环境交互且依赖高方差优势估计，当环境动力学可微时，回报是策略参数的可微函数，现有方法未能充分利用这一特性来获得精确梯度。
AI.method: 提出APG方法，通过反向传播穿过可微仿真器计算精确策略梯度；设计了多轴评估协议（区分环境步与梯度步）；提出分段反向传播方案，支持MC和基于critic的bootstrap两种模式以缓解长时域任务的梯度退化问题。
AI.result: 在四个连续控制任务（1D质点目标到达、2D质点避障导航、2D刚体T块推动、7-DOF Franka FR3末端执行器到达）上，APG与PPO在相同模型架构和优化器设置下进行了对比评估。
AI.conclusion: APG利用可微环境动力学实现精确梯度计算，有望在特定领域（如可微仿真器可用时）提升样本效率，分段反向传播和bootstrap策略对长时域任务至关重要。

title: Where Does the Signal Live? A Web Data Recipe for Medical Encoder Pretraining
summary: Web data curation has been widely studied for decoder Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining. Encoders for dense-terminology domains such as medicine, by contrast, are pretrained on small, manually-curated corpora that limit scalability and writing style diversity, a bottleneck even more severe in non-English clinical settings. Whether web-scale data curation also benefits encoder Masked Language Modeling (MLM) in a dense-terminology domain remains an open question. To address this, we introduce two complementary levers. Medical-term density filtering selects documents rich in medical terms. Signal-amplifying rephrasing uses an LLM to rewrite documents into denser variants with broader entity contexts. We instantiate the recipe on French medical NLP. The medical-term density filter outperforms the widely-used educational quality filter on downstream medical tasks, and the two complement each other. Signal-amplifying rephrasing alone improves on raw web data, and mixing it with filtered web data produces the largest gain. The recipe yields FineMed, a French medical pretraining corpus, and DoctoBERT, a state-of-the-art French medical encoder family evaluated on both the public benchmark DrBenchmark and a proprietary clinical Named Entity Recognition (NER) task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向密集术语领域（如医学）编码器MLM预训练的Web数据策展方法，包括医学术语密度过滤和信号增强改写两个互补杠杆，构建了FineMed语料库和DoctoBERT模型族，在法语医学NLP任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有医学编码器预训练依赖小规模人工策展语料，限制了可扩展性和写作风格多样性，这一问题在非英语临床场景中尤为严重。Web规模数据策展能否惠及密集术语领域的编码器MLM尚是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出两个互补杠杆：(1) 医学术语密度过滤——筛选富含医学术语的文档；(2) 信号增强改写——利用LLM将文档重写为密度更高、实体上下文更丰富的变体。在法语医学NLP场景中实现该方案。
AI.result: 医学术语密度过滤在下游任务上优于广泛使用的教育质量过滤，两者互补；信号增强改写单独使用即优于原始Web数据，与过滤后的Web数据混合使用提升最大。构建的DoctoBERT在DrBenchmark和专有临床NER任务上均达SOTA。
AI.conclusion: Web数据策展对密集术语领域的编码器MLM同样有效，所提方法可推广至其他密集术语领域和非英语场景。

title: Memory Is No Longer a Bottleneck: Memory-Efficient Graph Filtering for Scalable Collaborative Filtering
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables; IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering (to appear) (Please cite our journal version.)
summary: Graph convolutional networks (GCNs) have demonstrated significant success in capturing complex user-item relationships for collaborative filtering (CF). However, due to their reliance on extensive model training, training-free graph filtering (GF)-based CF methods have emerged as a promising alternative, offering computational efficiency by smoothing graph signals via matrix operations. In particular, polynomial GF-based approaches demonstrate improved accuracy through their ability to design more expressive and flexible filtering functions. Despite these advantages, existing GF methods suffer from a critical memory bottleneck: they necessitate storing the full item similarity graph, incurring prohibitive memory costs for large-scale datasets, which limits their practical applicability. To tackle this challenge, we propose Mem-GF (Memory-efficient GF), a new GF-based CF method that departs from conventional designs by principally leveraging the structure of Krylov subspaces as a core mechanism for approximating polynomial graph filters without explicitly storing the item similarity graph. We theoretically analyze the minimum Krylov subspace size that guarantees lossless approximation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that Mem-GF achieves up to 5.74$\times$ lower memory usage and 4.38$\times$ speedup in runtime, while consistently exceeding the recommendation accuracy of state-of-the-art GF and GCN-based methods. Mem-GF robustly scales to datasets with tens of millions of interactions, establishing itself as a practically viable and theoretically grounded solution for efficient CF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mem-GF，一种基于Krylov子空间的高效图滤波协同过滤方法，通过避免显式存储全量物品相似度图，在保持推荐精度的同时大幅降低内存占用（最高5.74倍）和运行时间（最高4.38倍），并理论分析了保证无损近似所需的最小Krylov子空间大小。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图滤波的协同过滤方法虽避免了GCN的模型训练开销，但需存储完整的物品相似度图，导致大规模数据集下的内存瓶颈，限制了实际应用。为此，本文旨在设计一种内存高效的图滤波方法，在不牺牲精度的前提下突破这一限制。
AI.method: 提出Mem-GF，核心思想是利用Krylov子空间结构来近似多项式图滤波器，避免显式存储物品相似度图。通过理论分析确定保证无损近似的最小Krylov子空间大小，并以此为基础构建高效的滤波计算流程。
AI.result: Mem-GF相比现有方法实现最高5.74倍内存降低和4.38倍运行加速，推荐精度持续超越最先进的GF和GCN方法，并能稳健扩展到千万级交互数据规模。
AI.conclusion: Mem-GF通过Krylov子空间机制解决了图滤波方法的内存瓶颈问题，在理论上具有无损近似的保证，在实践中实现了效率与精度的双赢，为大规模协同过滤提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Plurification in/of language technology -- The integration of culture in next-generation AI
summary: The paper explores how "culture" can be operationalised in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and what this reveals about the possibilities and limits of considering a plurality of cultural backgrounds in technological design. It proposes that cultural alignment cannot be achieved only by adding more examples of "other cultures", rather it requires plural epistemologies: allowing multiple, locally grounded ways of knowing. To analyze how this plurality of knowing can be addressed in NLP, the paper uses a socio-technical model of language technology (LT) design, the five layers of technological activity model, for collecting and systematizing approaches to culture in NLP. The analysis shows that while NLP research has made progress toward more culturally sensitive systems, many approaches remain partial, addressing "culture" primarily at the level of output or representation while leaving deeper questions of power, governance, and social context unresolved. The paper concludes that operationalising culture requires much more than technical adaptation; it suggests a reflexive and plural socio-technical approach that navigates potentials and limits of computational formalisation for accounting multiple linguistic and socio-cultural backgrounds.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何在NLP中操作化"文化"概念，提出文化对齐不能仅靠增加"其他文化"的例子，而需要多元认识论。通过五层技术活动模型分析发现，当前NLP研究在文化敏感性方面取得进展，但多数方法仍停留在输出或表征层面，未能解决权力、治理和社会语境等深层问题。结论指出，操作化文化需要超越技术适应，采取反思性、多元的社会技术方法。
AI.motivation: 现有NLP系统在文化适配方面存在局限，仅通过增加数据样本无法真正实现文化对齐，需要探索如何在技术设计中纳入多元文化背景和认识论。
AI.method: 采用社会技术模型（五层技术活动模型）对NLP中的文化研究方法进行系统化收集与分析，考察各层面如何处理文化维度。
AI.result: NLP研究在文化敏感性上有所进步，但多数方法仅在输出或表征层面处理"文化"，未能触及权力、治理和社会语境等深层结构性问题。
AI.conclusion: 操作化文化需要超越单纯的技术调整，应采取反思性和多元的社会技术路径，审慎处理计算形式化在容纳多种语言和社会文化背景方面的潜力与局限。

title: LIG: Layer-wise Integrated Gradients for Within-Layer Flow Analysis in Transformers
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. cs.LG. Experiments on BERT-base and PTB. Code: https://github.com/eightsuzuki/layer-wise-integrated-gradients
summary: Transformers achieve strong performance, but their internal computations remain opaque. We view each Transformer layer as a dynamic graph whose nodes are token representations and per-head attention outputs, with Multi-Head Attention (ATT) and MLP as module boundaries. On this graph we use LIG (Layer-wise Integrated Gradients), which applies set-to-set Integrated Gradients (IG) at nonlinear module boundaries. Set-to-set IG applies IG to a map from a set of input token representations to a set of output representations, evaluating token-to-token contributions, which is not standard in prior IG applications. This extends IG from the usual scalar-objective setting to set-to-set maps via an L2 scalarization, and composes within-layer contributions in the spirit of Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), with IG completeness playing the role of LRP-style conservation at each boundary. We use LIG to analyze (i) the agreement between module-wise composition and layer-whole attribution under an L2 criterion, and (ii) within-layer information flow by tracing separated ATT and MLP contributions. On BERT-base and PTB, configurations that best preserved within-layer consistency used the target token's embedding as the ATT baseline and either the ATT output at a=0 or Zero as the MLP baseline. We therefore present LIG as a diagnostic XAI tool at module-boundary granularity, without model-specific retraining or per-operation interpreter design. Code is available at https://github.com/eightsuzuki/layer-wise-integrated-gradients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIG（Layer-wise Integrated Gradients），将Integrated Gradients扩展到集合到集合的映射，在Transformer各层模块边界（ATT和MLP）上计算逐token贡献，实现模块级别的可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: Transformer内部计算过程不透明，现有可解释方法缺乏在模块边界（每个子层输出）粒度上的归因能力，标准IG只能处理标量目标。
AI.method: 将每个Transformer层视为动态图，节点为token表示和每头注意力输出。在非线性模块边界（ATT和MLP）上应用集合到集合的Integrated Gradients，通过L2标量化的方式将IG从标量目标扩展到集合到集合映射，并沿袭LRP的逐层传播思想，利用IG的完备性保持每层边界的守恒性。
AI.result: 在BERT-base和PTB上实验发现，保持层内一致性最佳的配置是：ATT基线使用目标token的嵌入，MLP基线使用ATT输出（a=0时）或零向量。
AI.conclusion: LIG是一种无需模型重训练或逐操作解释器设计的模块边界粒度诊断性XAI工具，可用于分析模块级组合与整层归因的一致性，以及层内ATT和MLP分离的信息流。

title: From Recognition to Understanding: Unlocking Cognitive Time Series Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Time series analysis has recently been coupled with Large Language Models (LLMs) to leverage their reasoning and world knowledge capabilities, yet gains remain limited. We attribute this to a fundamental mismatch between existing task formulations and LLM strengths: most settings reduce time series understanding to curve-fitting systems, focusing on low-level prediction while ignoring the semantic, contextual, and reasoning-intensive nature of real-world temporal decision-making.To address these limitations, we introduce TSCognition, a multimodal benchmark for multi-dimensional time series reasoning. It collects real-world time series and textual information from 15 public sources and constructs approximately 41K QA samples around five cognitive reasoning tasks: Decoding, Grounding, Inferring, Extrapolating, and Acting. Building on this, we further propose TSAlign, a unified framework that encodes time series into compact patch-level representations and aligns them with semantic directions in the LLM embedding space via gated residual injection and multivariate fusion.Experiments show that TSAlign outperforms existing LLM, VLM, and time series QA baselines on TSCognition and the publicly available TimerBed benchmark while substantially reducing computational cost.Code is available at: [https://github.com/EIT-NLP/CognitiveTSR](https://github.com/EIT-NLP/CognitiveTSR)

AI.tldr: 本文提出TSCognition多模态基准（含约41K问答样本）和TSAlign对齐框架，通过将时间序列编码为紧凑块级表征并与LLM语义方向对齐，解决现有时间序列分析中语义推理缺失问题，在降低计算成本的同时超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列与LLM结合的方法效果有限，根本原因在于任务范式与LLM能力不匹配：大多数设置将时间序列理解简化为曲线拟合，聚焦低层预测而忽略了真实世界时序决策所依赖的语义、上下文和推理需求。
AI.method: 1) TSCognition：从15个公开来源收集真实时间序列与文本信息，构建约41K QA样本，覆盖五项认知推理任务（解码、接地、推断、外推、行动）；2) TSAlign：统一框架，将时间序列编码为紧凑的块级（patch-level）表征，通过门控残差注入（gated residual injection）和多变量融合与LLM嵌入空间中的语义方向对齐。
AI.result: TSAlign在TSCognition和公开TimerBed基准上超越现有LLM、VLM和时间序列QA基线，同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义对齐的块级时间序列编码能有效弥补LLM在时间序列推理上的能力鸿沟，为未来时间序列认知推理研究提供了基准和框架。

title: The Cost Geometry of Belief: finite-resource inference under noisy observation
summary: We equip the space of beliefs with a cost geometry (what it costs to pass from one belief to another): optimal transport in Wasserstein space, reweighted conformally by Fisher information (the price of the precision at stake), distinct from the Fisher-Rao metric. In the setting we consider, a finite machine maintains a digital twin of a system; observing the territory through finite, noisy sensors, we model its coherent output as a belief: a probability density over states, the Bayes posterior. Certainty (the perfect twin) is denied twice, by observation and by physics, both read off the Fisher information. On the conformal class, essentially location-scale, three results emerge, all invariants of one change of cost unit. A wall: a well-posed inference rejects certainty to infinite distance as soon as the cost dominates the Fisher information (necessity conjectured beyond power laws). An honesty: an honest (eikonal) cost, each nat the same length everywhere, selects the geometries proportional to the Fisher information. A rigidity: these geometries are hyperbolic, and the Stam bound crowns the Gaussian, the most hyperbolic location-scale belief. Changing the unit dilates the geometry yet preserves the wall, the curvature ordering, and the extremality of the Gaussian: an absolute cost says nothing, only relative cost carries meaning, the value -1/4 being one of its images. The cost of reaching a given precision then has a geometric floor diverging at certainty. Thermodynamics fixes the cost unit and motivates this framework; the results are geometric, in nats.

AI.tldr: 本文在信念空间上引入了一种基于最优传输和Fisher信息共形加权的代价几何（不同于Fisher-Rao度量），并证明了三个不变结果：拒绝确定性的“墙”、诚实（eikonal）代价导致几何与Fisher信息成比例、以及这些几何是双曲的且高斯分布具有极值性（Stam界）。代价单位的改变仅缩放几何而不改变这些不变性，表明只有相对代价有意义。热力学为这一框架提供了动机。
AI.motivation: 在有限传感器和物理限制下，系统无法获得完美确定性（完美数字孪生被观测和物理双重否定）。作者希望在信念空间上建立一种代价几何，以量化从一种信念过渡到另一种信念的成本，并探索该几何的不变性质及其与Fisher信息、热力学的关系。
AI.method: 将最优传输（Wasserstein空间）与Fisher信息（精度代价）进行共形加权，构造不同于Fisher-Rao度量的代价几何。在位置-尺度族上分析该共形类，推导出三个不变结果（墙、诚实、刚性），并通过热力学固定代价单位。
AI.result: 三个主要结果：(1) 墙：当代价主导Fisher信息时，良好定义的推断将确定性（完美信念）推至无穷远距离；(2) 诚实：eikonal代价（每纳特等长）使几何与Fisher信息成比例；(3) 刚性：这些几何是双曲的，且高斯分布满足Stam界，是最极端的位置-尺度信念。代价单位变化仅缩放几何，不改变墙、曲率排序和高斯的极值性，只有相对代价有意义。
AI.conclusion: 信念空间的代价几何具有深刻的几何结构，其不变性表明绝对代价无意义而相对代价有意义。热力学固定了代价单位，为框架提供物理动机。结果以纳特为单位，是纯几何的。

title: BioMatrix: Towards a Comprehensive Biological Foundation Model Spanning the Modality Matrix of Sequences, Structures, and Language
summary: We present BioMatrix, the first multimodal foundation model that natively integrates sequences, structures, and natural language for both molecules and proteins within a single decoder-only architecture. Existing biological foundation models pursue native multimodality and broad entity coverage separately: those that fuse multiple modalities under a shared objective remain confined to a single entity type, while those spanning multiple entity types either omit explicit structural modeling or rely on adapter-based designs in which the model cannot natively generate the very modalities it can read. BioMatrix closes this gap by mapping molecular sequences (supporting both SMILES and SELFIES notations), molecular structures, protein sequences, protein structures, and natural language into a shared discrete token space through a unified tokenization scheme, so that all modalities are consumed and produced uniformly under a single next-token prediction objective -- without external encoders, projection adapters, or modality-specific output heads. Built upon the Qwen3 language model (1.7B and 4B), BioMatrix is continually pretrained on 304.4 billion tokens spanning general and domain-specific text, sequence and structure views of molecules and proteins, and cross-modal corpora that interleave biomolecular entities with scientific text and link distinct entities through molecule-protein and protein-protein interaction data. After tuning on a comprehensive suite of downstream applications covering 80 tasks across 6 categories -- encompassing single-entity and multi-entity understanding and generation tasks across and within modalities -- BioMatrix achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on 77 out of 80 tasks, demonstrating that a single, natively multimodal generalist model can effectively match or surpass specialized approaches across a wide range of biological tasks.

AI.tldr: BioMatrix 是首个原生支持序列、结构和自然语言的多模态基础模型，采用仅解码器架构，将分子序列、分子结构、蛋白质序列、蛋白质结构及自然语言统一映射到离散词元空间，在单一下一个词元预测目标下统一处理所有模态，无需外部编码器或适配器。基于 Qwen3（1.7B 和 4B），在 3044 亿词元上持续预训练，在 80 个下游任务中取得 77 个 SOTA 或竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有生物基础模型要么仅支持单实体类型的多模态融合，要么覆盖多实体类型但缺乏原生结构建模或依赖适配器设计，无法原生生成所有可读模态。BioMatrix 旨在弥合这一差距，实现真正的原生多模态通用模型。
AI.method: 采用统一标记化方案将分子序列（SMILES/SELFIES）、分子结构、蛋白质序列、蛋白质结构及自然语言映射到共享离散词元空间；基于 Qwen3 语言模型（1.7B 和 4B），在 3044 亿词元上持续预训练，涵盖通用和领域特定文本、分子/蛋白质的序列与结构视图、跨模态语料（穿插生物分子实体与科学文本、分子-蛋白质及蛋白质-蛋白质交互数据）。
AI.result: 在 6 类 80 个下游任务（涵盖单实体和多实体的跨模态及模态内理解与生成）中，BioMatrix 在 77/80 个任务上达到 SOTA 或竞争性水平。
AI.conclusion: 证明单一的原生多模态通用模型能够有效匹配甚至超越跨广泛生物学任务的专业方法。

title: FAST: A Framework for Aligned Sampling and Training in Parallel Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Deep reinforcement learning is pivotal for closed-loop autonomous driving yet remains constrained by severe bottlenecks in sampling efficiency. Standard parallel sampling mitigates this but suffers from the straggler effect, where the premature termination of a single environment necessitates a synchronized batch re-initialization, leading to suboptimal sample utilization and prohibitive re-initialization latency. To address this, we propose FAST, a synchronous parallel framework tailored for closed-loop simulation. Specifically, FAST employs Dynamic Parallel Sampling Alignment (DPSA) to maintain vectorization synchronization by extending terminated episodes via virtual continuation, thereby decoupling the sampling loop from individual terminations. By dynamically triggering global truncation based on the termination rate of parallel clips, FAST effectively eliminates the bottleneck of premature resets without sacrificing data diversity. Furthermore, to strictly preserve theoretical consistency, we incorporate a Scaled Mask-Padding Optimization (SMPO) that leverages validity masking and adaptive loss normalization to nullify the bias from auxiliary padding data. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that FAST achieves at least a 1.78 times wall-clock speedup over the single-clip baseline while preserving statistical unbiasedness.

AI.tldr: 针对闭环自动驾驶中同步并行采样因单环境提前终止导致的拖累效应问题，提出FAST框架，通过动态并行采样对齐（DPSA）虚拟延续已完成轨迹以维持向量化同步，并基于终止率动态触发全局截断，结合缩放掩码填充优化（SMPO）消除辅助填充数据的偏差，实现至少1.78倍加速且保持统计无偏性。
AI.motivation: 标准并行采样在闭环自动驾驶中面临拖累效应：单个环境的提前终止迫使整个批次同步重置，导致采样利用率低下和重置延迟过高，制约深度强化学习的采样效率。
AI.method: 提出FAST同步并行框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 动态并行采样对齐（DPSA），通过虚拟延续已终止的轨迹来保持向量化同步，并根据并行片段终止率动态触发全局截断；2) 缩放掩码填充优化（SMPO），利用有效性掩码和自适应损失归一化消除辅助填充数据引入的偏差。
AI.result: 在闭环自动驾驶仿真中，相比单clip基线，FAST实现了至少1.78倍的墙钟时间加速，同时保持了统计无偏性。
AI.conclusion: FAST通过解耦采样循环与个体终止事件，有效消除了过早重置的瓶颈，在不牺牲数据多样性的前提下大幅提升同步并行采样的效率，且理论一致性得到严格保证。

title: The Score Granularity Gap in Black-Box LLM Classification: A Comparative Study of Confidence Constructions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as black-box classifiers in pipelines that automate confident decisions and route uncertain ones to human review. Such selective prediction needs a confidence score that an operator can threshold at a chosen risk level. Prior work asks whether LLM confidence is well calibrated or well ranked; we ask a complementary, deployment-oriented question that has been largely overlooked: at what resolution can the score be thresholded? We call the answer the score granularity gap. Through a controlled comparison of seven ways to build a confidence score, from a single verbalized number, to token probabilities, to querying the model many times and combining the answers, across 25 model-dataset pairs (9 LLMs, 3 benchmarks), we find that single-shot verbalized confidence, once correctly converted to a class probability, ranks cases surprisingly well, yet takes only a handful of distinct values. It therefore offers an operator only a few coarse thresholds, no matter how well it ranks. We show which constructions widen this gap, at what inference cost, and with what effect on ranking, notably that multi-query aggregation helps weak models but can degrade already-strong ones. We translate these trade-offs into concrete deployment guidance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“分数粒度差距”（score granularity gap）概念，指LLM作为黑盒分类器进行选择性预测时，置信度分数可被阈值化的分辨率有限。通过对比7种置信度构建方法（25个模型-数据集组合），发现单次口头置信度虽排序性能良好但取值种类极少，导致操作者只能选择少数粗糙阈值；多查询聚合能帮助弱模型但可能降低强模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注LLM置信度的校准性和排序性，但忽略了实际部署中置信度分数能被阈值化的分辨率（即粒度）问题，这一缺失导致操作者无法在给定风险水平下精确选择阈值。
AI.method: 在9个LLM、3个基准测试、25个模型-数据集对上进行受控实验，比较7种置信度构建方法：从单次口头数值、token概率到多次查询并聚合答案等方式，评估其分数粒度和排序性能。
AI.result: 1）单次口头置信度（正确转换为类别概率后）排序性能良好，但仅取少量离散值，导致粒度极差；2）多查询聚合可提升弱模型的粒度，但会降低已强模型的性能；3）不同置信度构建方法在粒度和排序性能间存在明确权衡。
AI.conclusion: 为LLM选择性预测的实际部署提供具体指导：需根据模型强弱选择置信度构建方法，在分数粒度与排序性能之间做出权衡，单次口头置信度虽简单但粒度不足，多查询聚合需谨慎使用。

title: Geometric and Information Compression of Representations in Deep Learning
comment: Published at ECML PKDD 2026; Dataset: https://doi.org/10.17877/RCTRUST-2026-DWMJTZ. Code: https://github.com/link-er/information_geometric_compression
summary: Deep neural networks transform input data into latent representations that support a wide range of downstream tasks. These representations can be characterized along information-theoretic and geometric dimensions, but their relationship remains poorly understood. A central open question is whether low mutual information (MI) between inputs and representations necessarily implies geometrically compressed latent spaces and vice versa. We investigate this question using class-wise clustering as a measure of geometric compression and theoretically sound MI estimation in conditional entropy bottleneck (CEB) networks and continuous dropout networks. We evaluate the interplay between MI, geometric compression, and generalization on classification tasks under controlled noise injection schemes. Our findings show that low MI does not reliably correspond to geometric compression, and that the connection between the two is more nuanced than often assumed. Indeed, our experiments reveal a negative and nonlinear relationship that can reverse when varying training setup. Our results put forward a hypothesis that generalization acts as a potential confounder in this connection rather than being their direct consequence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了深度神经网络中互信息与几何压缩之间的关系，发现两者并非简单对应，而是存在负向非线性关系，且泛化能力可能是这种关系的混淆因素而非直接结果。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络将输入转换为潜在表示，这些表示可从信息论和几何维度刻画，但两者关系尚不明确。核心问题是低互信息是否必然意味着几何压缩，反之亦然。
AI.method: 使用条件熵瓶颈（CEB）网络和连续dropout网络，以类内聚类作为几何压缩度量，结合理论可靠的互信息估计，在分类任务中通过受控噪声注入方案评估互信息、几何压缩与泛化之间的相互作用。
AI.result: 低互信息并不可靠地对应几何压缩；两者关系呈负向非线性，且在不同训练设置下可能反转。
AI.conclusion: 互信息与几何压缩的关系比通常假设的更微妙，泛化能力在此关系中充当潜在混淆因素，而非两者的直接后果。

title: When Is Emergent Consensus Real? A Measured Coupling Gain and a Validity Diagnostic for LLM Agent Societies
comment: 13 pages (incl. appendix with proofs), 7 figures. Code and per-run logs released
summary: LLM "agent societies" are studied via demonstrations of emergent consensus or polarization -- with no measurable control parameter, no theory of when each regime appears, and no test of whether an outcome is a genuine social dynamic or a model artifact. We introduce the coupling gain gamma, measured per-agent by counterfactually perturbing a neighbour's stated opinion. (i) gamma is stable and model-distinguishing -- across five frontier models it spans 0.15-0.43 (n=20, 95% CIs <= 0.025), paraphrase-invariant; social-neighbour gamma roughly equals numeric-anchor gamma, so gamma is evidence-coupling, not uniquely social. (ii) Classical dynamics with measured (not assumed) coefficients organise the regime: Friedkin-Johnsen for consensus/pluralism, signed-Laplacian/structural-balance for polarization. (iii) Frontier LLMs do not spontaneously backfire (beta <= 0), so default societies do not self-polarize -- polarization is always induced; the beta>0 branch arises only in the FJ surrogate, never in the agents. (iv) A randomized-initial-condition diagnostic -- the (slope, bias) of final vs. initial opinion -- separates genuine averaging from model-prior artifacts (boundary-censoring ruled out by construction via interior-valued facts); applied to a published "emergent consensus" result (Chuang et al. 2023) it reveals a model-specific conflation: averaging on debatable claims, prior-artifact on settled facts. (v) Coupling is context-dependent: pairwise gamma does not predict multi-neighbour outcomes -- it can order them backwards -- whereas a modality-matched group coupling does (sixteen closed+open models, Pearson r=-0.70, permutation p=0.008). The regime laws take this matched coupling, not the single-neighbour gamma: emergent consensus must be read from coupling in the target interaction. We contribute a measurement protocol and a validity instrument, not new theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出耦合增益γ作为LLM agent社会动力学的可测量控制参数，通过反事实扰动法量化，发现γ能区分模型、稳定且与证据耦合相关；利用实测γ代入经典动力学模型（FJ、signed-Laplacian）可预测共识/极化涌现；揭示LLM不会自发极化，极化需外部诱导；提出随机初态诊断法区分真实平均与模型先验伪影；指出单邻域γ无法预测多邻域涌现，需使用匹配模态的群体耦合度量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM agent社会研究缺乏可测量的控制参数、缺乏涌现状态的理论预测、无法区分真实社会动态与模型伪影。
AI.method: 通过反事实扰动邻居观点计算每个agent的耦合增益γ；将实测γ代入Friedkin-Johnsen和signed-Laplacian/结构平衡理论预测涌现状态；设计随机初态诊断法（终态vs初态回归的斜率和偏置）区分真实平均与先验伪影。
AI.result: γ在五个前沿模型中区分性良好（0.15-0.43），与措辞无关；γ是证据耦合而非独特社会耦合；实测γ可准确预测FJ和结构平衡动力学；LLM不自发极化；单邻域γ无法预测多邻域涌现，需匹配模态的群体耦合（Pearson r=-0.70, p=0.008）。
AI.conclusion: 提供了测量协议和有效性检验工具而非新理论，强调涌现必须从目标交互中的耦合量读取。

title: Learning to Place Guards by Reinforcement: A Geo-Free Neural Policy for the Vertex-Guard Art Gallery Problem
summary: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has shown that policies trained by reinforcement can construct strong solutions to NP-hard problems directly from raw instances. What such a policy actually learns, as opposed to what its decoder expresses, remains much less clear. We study this distinction on the vertex-guard Art Gallery Problem, the NP-hard task of choosing polygon vertices from which to observe an entire region. A pointer-network policy is trained from a coverage-aware reward over its own rollouts under the constraint we call geo-free inference: at test time it sees only vertex coordinates, with no visibility computation and no geometric oracle. The policy places guards economically but leaves a tail of under-covered polygons that widens far beyond the training range. To locate the cause, we freeze the trained encoder and read its embeddings with a small single-shot classifier, still geo-free at inference. The classifier closes most of the feasibility gap, in and out of distribution and at up to roughly five times the training range, cutting under-covered polygons by about an order of magnitude at an explicitly reported cost in guard count. We read this as evidence that the reinforcement-trained representation already encodes the geometry required for feasibility, and that residual failures reflect decoder calibration rather than missing knowledge. Probing a frozen encoder thus offers a practical way to ask what a neural combinatorial solver has internalized.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经组合优化（NCO）在顶点守卫艺术画廊问题上的表现，发现强化学习训练的编码器已内化几何可行性知识，测试时的失败主要源于解码器校准而非知识缺失；通过冻结编码器并附加轻量分类器，可大幅缩小可行性差距。
AI.motivation: 探究神经组合优化策略在NP难问题上实际学到了什么，区分编码器内化知识与解码器表达能力的差异。
AI.method: 在顶点守卫艺术画廊问题上，使用基于覆盖奖励的强化学习训练指针网络策略，并施加"无几何推理"约束（测试时仅见顶点坐标，无可见性计算）。随后冻结训练好的编码器，附加单次分类器，仍保持无几何推理进行解码。
AI.result: 冻结编码器+轻量分类器大幅缩小可行性差距，在分布内/外及训练范围五倍内，将未覆盖多边形数量减少约一个数量级，但以守卫数量增加为代价。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习训练的表征已内化几何可行性所需的几何知识，残余失败反映的是解码器校准问题而非知识缺失。冻结编码器探测是理解神经组合求解器内化知识的实用方法。

title: Lexical Consensus: Grounded Word Learning and Shared Meaning in Artificial Agents
comment: 41 pages, 12 figures, 9 tables. Code and experiment artifacts available at https://github.com/patriciomvera/lexical-consensus
summary:
Artificial intelligence systems are commonly evaluated through task performance and behavioral imitation, but such evaluations leave open whether an artificial agent can acquire, stabilize, and use new lexical meanings from grounded experience. This paper introduces Lexical Consensus, an experimental framework for studying grounded word learning over a structured perceptual substrate. Using frozen DINOv2 visual embeddings, Carroll-style nonce words, and interpretable lexical learners plus linear baselines, we test whether agents can acquire artificial labels for visual concepts, generalize them bidirectionally, and stabilize them across controlled settings.
  The main result is a robust perceptual-coherence gradient: native categories are easiest to learn, coherent overextensions remain learnable, mid-range disjunctive concepts degrade, and far-disjunctive concepts approach chance. A pre-registered CIFAR-100 dissociation experiment confirms that this gradient is governed by perceptual distance rather than semantic relatedness: perceptual distance predicts acquisition accuracy (partial R^2 = 0.245, p < 1e-7), while semantic distance adds no significant explanatory power (partial R^2 = 0.002, p = 0.660).
  Bidirectional evaluation shows that naming and retrieval are distinct: exemplar-based mechanisms outperform centroid prototypes in label-to-image retrieval, exposing a memory-fidelity dimension separate from naming accuracy. Falsification controls, homogeneous candidate-pool evaluations, and null results on representational restructuring indicate that frozen perceptual geometry both enables lexical grounding and limits what can be acquired without representational adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lexical Consensus框架，通过冻结的DINOv2视觉嵌入和人工标注词，研究智能体在结构化感知基元上的词汇习得能力。主要发现是感知一致性梯度：天然类别最易习得，远析取概念接近随机水平。感知距离（而非语义距离）是习得准确率的核心预测因子。双向评估显示命名与检索机制分离，冻结的感知几何既支撑又限制词汇接地。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估体系主要关注任务表现和行为模仿，但无法判断智能体是否能从具身经验中获取、稳定并运用新的词汇意义。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出一个可控的实验框架来研究接地词汇学习问题。
AI.method: 使用冻结的DINOv2视觉嵌入作为感知基元，引入Carroll式无意义词作为人工标签，采用可解释的词汇学习器及线性基线模型。设置双向评估（命名和检索），并通过预注册的CIFAR-100分离实验解耦感知距离与语义距离的影响。
AI.result: 发现了稳健的感知一致性梯度：天然类别最易学习，连贯过度扩展仍然可学，中等范围的析取概念退化，远析取概念接近随机水平。感知距离预测习得准确率（partial R²=0.245, p<1e-7），语义距离无显著贡献（partial R²=0.002, p=0.660）。命名与检索表现分离，基于示例的机制优于质心原型。冻结的感知几何限制了无表征适应情况下的可习得范围。
AI.conclusion: 感知几何在词汇接地中起决定性作用，感知一致性梯度是词汇习得的基本约束条件。命名与检索是两种不同的认知过程，不能相互替代。冻结的感知表征既提供了词汇学习的可能性基础，也设定了学习上限——要实现更复杂的词汇习得，可能需要表征层面的适应。

title: The Two-Hump Problem: Bridging the Difficulty Gap in Mathematical Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 38 pages, 9 figures. Code and datasets: https://github.com/Math-AI-Caltech/ACSolverX
summary: Mathematical search problems present a unique challenge for Reinforcement Learning (RL) due to vast search spaces and sparse rewards. In previous works, the Andrews-Curtis (AC) conjecture was established as an illustrative example of such problems. In this work, we identify a critical structural barrier in the AC landscape: a "Two-Hump" distribution, where problem instances are either trivially solvable or effectively impossible, with a scarcity of intermediate "hard-but-solvable" instances required for effective learning. We tackle this challenge through two primary avenues: novel data generation techniques to populate the difficulty gap, and significant algorithmic enhancements including the introduction of supermoves and Transformer-based architectures. We demonstrate substantial performance improvements over previous baselines, and release new comprehensive benchmark datasets including AC-19 (125,192 AC-trivial presentations of varying difficulty with length at most 19) and AC-1M (1,136,154 hard AC-trivial presentations of length at most 30), the first large-scale, publicly available datasets of this kind.

AI.tldr: 本文针对数学搜索问题中奖励稀疏、搜索空间巨大的挑战，以Andrews-Curtis猜想为案例，识别了AC问题中的"双峰"分布障碍（问题要么极简单要么极难，缺乏中间难度的训练实例），通过新颖的数据生成技术填充难度缺口，以及引入超动作和Transformer架构等算法改进，显著提升了性能，并发布了两个大规模公开基准数据集AC-19和AC-1M。
AI.motivation: 数学搜索问题由于搜索空间巨大且奖励稀疏，对强化学习构成独特挑战。以Andrews-Curtis猜想为例，现有方法面临"双峰"分布问题：问题实例要么极易解决、要么几乎不可能，缺乏中间难度（困难但可解）的实例，导致有效学习受阻。
AI.method: 1) 新颖的数据生成技术，用于填充难度缺口，创造更多"困难但可解"的实例；2) 算法增强，包括引入超动作（supermoves）和基于Transformer的架构。
AI.result: 在性能上相比先前基线有显著提升，并发布了两个大规模公开数据集：AC-19（125,192个AC平凡呈现，长度≤19，难度各异）和AC-1M（1,136,154个困难AC平凡呈现，长度≤30）。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据生成和算法改进成功克服了AC问题的双峰分布障碍，大幅提升了强化学习在数学搜索问题上的表现，并提供了首个大规模公开基准数据集以推动后续研究。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Hausa and Fongbe Machine Translation: Benchmarks, Failures, and Metric Reliability
summary: We investigate the translation quality of current large language models (LLMs) for English-to-Hausa and English-to-Fongbe - two typologically distinct West African languages from the Afroasiatic and Niger-Congo families respectively - and evaluate whether standard automatic metrics reliably reflect human judgment for these low-resource languages. We evaluate four models (GPT-4o Mini, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Qwen2.5-7B) at progressive scales (500 to 10,000 sentences) using automatic metrics (BLEU, chrF++, TER, COMET, BERTScore) validated against native-speaker judgment. Our results reveal three key findings. First, translation quality varies substantially by language: Hausa achieves acceptable quality (human scores 4.0-4.5/5) while Fongbe achieves poor quality (1.0-2.2/5), with a consistent 3x BLEU gap across all systems. Second, model rankings differ by language - Gemini leads for Fongbe while GPT-4o leads for Hausa by human evaluation - indicating that performance on one low-resource African language does not predict performance on another. Third, metric-human correlation varies dramatically: perfect rank correlation for Fongbe (rho=1.0) but weak correlation for Hausa (rho=0.5), where human evaluators preferred GPT-4o despite all automatic metrics ranking Claude first. We further show that neural metrics like BERTScore exhibit embedding collapse (within-language similarity >0.99) for both languages, limiting their ability to differentiate translation quality. Based on these findings, we recommend multi-metric evaluation for low-resource African languages, with particular caution when interpreting neural metrics. We establish that minimum sample sizes of n=2,500 sentences are required for stable system rankings, as smaller samples produced artifact findings that reversed at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型在英语→豪萨语和英语→丰贝语两种西非低资源语言上的翻译质量，发现：豪萨语翻译质量可接受（4.0-4.5/5），丰贝语质量很差（1.0-2.2/5）；模型排名因语言而异（Gemini领先丰贝语，GPT-4o领先豪萨语）；自动指标与人工判断的相关性差异巨大（丰贝语rho=1.0，豪萨语rho=0.5）；神经指标存在嵌入坍塌问题（相似度>0.99）。建议采用多指标评估，且最小样本量需达到2,500句才能获得稳定排名。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型在低资源非洲语言上的翻译质量缺乏系统评估，现有自动指标在这些语言上的可靠性尚未验证，且不同低资源语言之间的模型表现差异未被充分研究。
AI.method: 选取豪萨语（亚非语系）和丰贝语（尼日尔-刚果语系）两种类型学差异显著的西非低资源语言，评估GPT-4o Mini、Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Flash和Qwen2.5-7B四个模型在500到10,000句递增规模下的翻译质量，使用BLEU、chrF++、TER、COMET、BERTScore等自动指标，并以母语者人工评分作为验证标准。
AI.result: 豪萨语人工评分4.0-4.5/5，丰贝语仅1.0-2.2/5，BLEU差距达3倍；Gemini在丰贝语上最优，GPT-4o在豪萨语上最优；自动指标与人工判断的秩相关在丰贝语上完美（rho=1.0），在豪萨语上较弱（rho=0.5）；BERTScore等神经指标在两种语言上均出现嵌入坍塌（同语言相似度>0.99）；小样本（<2,500句）会导致排名结果反转的伪像。
AI.conclusion: 低资源非洲语言的翻译评估应采用多指标综合评估，对神经指标需谨慎解读；系统排名对比的最小样本量应不低于2,500句；不同低资源语言之间模型性能不可互相预测。

title: HERALD: High-Throughput Block Diffusion LLM Serving via CPU-GPU Cooperative KV Cache Retrieval
summary: Diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) improve GPU utilization over autoregressive decoding by generating multiple tokens per forward pass, but their KV cache still grows linearly with context, limiting throughput at long contexts. KV cache offloading to host DRAM alleviates this memory pressure, but the limited PCIe bandwidth necessitates recalling only a sparse subset of KV entries. In block dLLMs, the relevant KV entries remain consistent across denoising steps within a block, enabling high-accuracy selection by identifying the top-k entries once and reusing them throughout all denoising steps. This property appears attractive for offloading as it amortizes the selection overhead across the entire block, but it requires exact attention over the full KV cache, which is too expensive under offloading. We present HERALD, a KV offloading system for block dLLMs that resolves this through two opportunities that reduce the required selection compute by a factor of the block size and enable selection to be overlapped with denoising. Across three block dLLMs and five long context tasks, HERALD achieves near-lossless accuracy at 5-10% KV budget and up to 1.59x lower per block latency and 2.47x higher throughput over GPU-only inference, with speedups growing with context length.

AI.tldr: HERALD 是一种针对块级扩散 LLM 的 KV 缓存卸载系统，通过利用块内去噪步骤间 KV 条目一致性，在 5-10% KV 预算下实现近无损精度，相较纯 GPU 推理最多降低 1.59 倍块延迟并提升 2.47 倍吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 扩散 LLM 虽能通过每前向步生成多个 token 来改善 GPU 利用率，但其 KV 缓存随上下文线性增长，限制了长上下文场景的吞吐量。将 KV 缓存卸载到主机 DRAM 虽能缓解内存压力，但 PCIe 带宽有限，只能召回稀疏的 KV 子集。块级扩散 LLM 中相关 KV 条目在块内保持一致的特性虽有利于卸载，但需要昂贵的全量 KV 注意力计算。
AI.method: HERALD 利用块级扩散 LLM 的两个机会：(1) 将选择计算量减少一个块大小因子；(2) 使选择过程与去噪过程重叠。具体通过识别 top-k 条目并在整个块的所有去噪步骤中复用，从而分摊选择开销。
AI.result: 在三种块级扩散 LLM 和五个长上下文任务上，HERALD 在 5-10% KV 预算下实现近无损精度，每块延迟最高降低 1.59 倍，吞吐量最高提升 2.47 倍，且加速比随上下文长度增长而增加。
AI.conclusion: HERALD 有效解决了块级扩散 LLM 中 KV 缓存卸载的稀疏选择效率问题，实现了显著的长上下文推理加速，且性能优势随上下文长度扩展而增强。

title: MixedPEFT: Combining Multiple PEFT Methods with Mixed Objectives for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
comment: 6 pages, 5 tables. Builds upon our preliminary work presented at UBMK 2024
summary: Pre-trained language models struggle when applied to new domains, as full fine-tuning is computationally expensive and prone to catastrophic forgetting. This study addresses this challenge by presenting a novel parameter-efficient strategy for unsupervised domain adaptation that combines custom PEFT architectures with mixed-objective training. Our approach simultaneously optimizes classification performance on labeled source domain data and masked language modeling (MLM) on unlabeled target domain data, preserving target domain knowledge while adapting to source domain tasks. Our method employs a custom union of invertible adapters and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) within a unified parameter-efficient framework. Through comprehensive evaluation on the Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI) dataset across 20 domain shifts, our approach achieves significant improvements over existing methods: 1.41 percentage points over the current parameter-efficient state-of-the-art UDapter, 1.26 percentage points over the fully-tuned DANN baseline, and 0.86 percentage points over DSN, while utilizing only 7% of the model's trainable parameters. These results establish new benchmarks for parameter-efficient unsupervised domain adaptation and demonstrate that carefully designed PEFT combinations with concurrent optimization can outperform both existing parameter-efficient methods and traditional fully-tuned approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合定制PEFT架构与混合目标训练的参数高效无监督域自适应策略，在MNLI数据集跨20个域迁移任务上，仅用7%可训练参数即超越了现有参数高效方法和全微调方法，分别比UDapter、DANN、DSN提升1.41、1.26、0.86个百分点。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型在迁移到新领域时面临全微调计算成本高且易灾难性遗忘的问题，现有参数高效方法在无监督域自适应场景下性能仍不足。
AI.method: 提出一种参数高效的域自适应策略，结合定制PEFT架构（可逆适配器与LoRA的联合）和混合目标训练，同时优化源域标注数据的分类目标和目标域无标注数据的掩码语言建模目标。
AI.result: 在MNLI数据集20个域迁移任务上，所提方法以仅7%的可训练参数取得了显著提升：比UDapter高1.41个百分点，比全微调DANN高1.26个百分点，比DSN高0.86个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的PEFT组合与并发优化策略不仅优于现有参数高效方法，甚至能超越传统的全微调方法，为参数高效的无监督域自适应设立了新的基准。

title: A new classification method based on Minimum Spanning Trees
summary: Minimum Spanning Trees have been used in unsupervised learning, particularly in clustering tasks, due to their ability to recognize clusters by removing edges that are considered inconsistent in defining those clusters. This paper aims to study the use of Minimum Spanning Trees in supervised learning. Specifically, we propose a classification algorithm based on Minimum Spanning Trees. To improve its performance, we introduce a robust version of the method that is also computationally more efficient. We evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method through an extensive simulation study. We also apply the proposed methodology to a real-world case study involving aircraft trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最小生成树的监督学习分类算法，并引入了鲁棒且计算高效的改进版本，通过模拟研究和飞机轨迹真实案例验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 最小生成树在无监督学习（如聚类）中已得到广泛应用，但将其用于监督学习的研究较少。本文旨在探索MST在监督学习分类任务中的潜力。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于最小生成树的分类算法，并进一步设计了鲁棒性更强且计算效率更高的改进版本。
AI.result: 通过广泛的模拟研究验证了方法的有效性，并在飞机轨迹的真实案例中展示了实际应用效果。
AI.conclusion: 最小生成树可以有效应用于监督学习分类任务，所提出的鲁棒版本在性能和计算效率上均有提升。

title: From Speech to Text Corpora: Evaluating ASR-Based Data Acquisition for Low-Resource Fongbe and Hausa
summary: Low-resource African languages lack text corpora needed for language model training. We investigate whether ASR pipelines can extend text resources for two typologically distinct West African languages: Fongbe (tonal, diacritic-rich) and Hausa (non-tonal). We fine-tune MMS-300M on a curated 12.3-hour Fongbe dataset, achieving 9.48% WER on the ALFFA benchmark - a 78% relative reduction from the prior 44.04% baseline - while preserving tonal diacritics critical to the language. For Hausa, we apply an existing fine-tuned Whisper-Small model. We catalog 1,553 YouTube videos (236 hours) and process a subset of 424 videos (45.49 hours) selected to balance domain diversity with available computational resources, producing 6,770 transcribed segments. Human evaluation on 50 randomly sampled segments per language shows mean quality scores of 57.4/100 for Hausa and 36.5/100 for Fongbe, indicating that while Hausa transcriptions approach acceptable quality for corpus construction, Fongbe transcriptions require post-processing or improved models for production use. We release the curated dataset, fine-tuned model, transcribed corpus, and full video catalog following platform terms and ethical guidelines.

AI.tldr: 探索利用ASR流水线为两种西非低资源语言（丰贝语和豪萨语）扩展文本语料库，微调MMS-300M模型在丰贝语上实现9.48% WER（相对降低78%），处理424个YouTube视频（45.49小时）生成6,770条转录片段，人工评估显示豪萨语转录质量接近可用水平（57.4/100），丰贝语（36.5/100）需后处理改进。
AI.motivation: 低资源非洲语言缺乏训练语言模型所需的文本语料库，亟需探索利用ASR技术从语音数据中自动生成文本资源的可行方案。
AI.method: 1) 在12.3小时人工标注的丰贝语数据集上微调MMS-300M模型，保留声调变音符号；2) 对豪萨语应用已有的微调Whisper-Small模型；3) 编录1,553个YouTube视频（236小时），筛选424个视频（45.49小时）进行转录；4) 人工评估每语言50个随机样本的转录质量。
AI.result: 丰贝语WER从44.04%降至9.48%（相对降低78%）；豪萨语转录质量评分57.4/100，丰贝语36.5/100；共生成6,770条转录片段。
AI.conclusion: ASR流水线可有效扩展低资源语言文本资源，但效果因语言类型特征而异：豪萨语（非声调语言）转录已接近可接受质量，而丰贝语（声调、变音符号丰富的语言）需进一步后处理或改进模型才能用于生产环境。

title: When Is an LLM Worth It for Hyperparameter Optimization? A Budget-Matched Study on Tabular Data Finds the Warm-Start Is a Default Configuration, Not the Model
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as hyperparameter-optimization (HPO) advisors that "warm-start" search from prior knowledge, proposing strong configurations in very few evaluations. We test that claim under a budget-matched, multi-seed protocol on eight PMLB tabular benchmarks, comparing an LLM advisor (LLM-OptFlow) against four classical baselines (random search, Optuna-TPE, Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization, and successive halving) over one shared search space, with paired tests and bootstrap 95% CIs across 8 x 5 = 40 (task, seed) units. The finding is cautionary. The advisor's strong first point is not an LLM output at all: like prior LLM-HPO systems the loop is seeded with a fixed default configuration, evaluated before any model call, which alone reaches 88.7% mean best-CV, identical to within 0.01 pp across all seven advisor models tested. The LLM's own proposals add only +0.40 pp of cross-validation accuracy over that seed and nothing on held-out test (LLM-Default = -0.01 pp, p = 0.92). When the same seed is granted to classical search, the apparent lead collapses: against seeded random search it leads by +0.20 pp at 2 evaluations, is tied by 5, and is behind by 12 (-0.37 pp). Without the seed, classical search ties the advisor by 12 evaluations and beats it by 40 (+0.6 to +0.8 pp, p <= 1e-4). Two LLM-specific behaviors survive: a single-task exploration failure (vehicle), and a rule-based confidence filter that removes ~33% of wasted compute without changing accuracy. The recommendation is deflationary: on tabular HPO, seed classical search with a sensible default; an LLM advisor adds no measurable generalization benefit and is overtaken within a handful of evaluations. We release the harness and a script that reproduces every statistic.

AI.tldr: 本文通过严格实验发现，LLM作为超参数优化顾问并没有带来显著的泛化收益。LLM顾问的强势表现主要源于一个固定默认配置的预置种子，而非LLM自身的输出。在与经典方法公平对比时，LLM的贡献微乎其微（交叉验证准确率仅提升+0.40 pp，测试集无提升），经典搜索方法在几次评估内即可赶超甚至超越LLM顾问。
AI.motivation: 检验LLM作为超参数优化（HPO）顾问的声称——即能从先验知识中"热启动"搜索，在极少量评估中提出强配置——是否在预算匹配、多随机种子的严格实验协议下成立。
AI.method: 在8个PMLB表格基准上，采用预算匹配、多随机种子（8×5=40个任务×种子单元）协议，将LLM顾问（LLM-OptFlow）与四种经典基线（随机搜索、Optuna-TPE、高斯过程贝叶斯优化、Successive Halving）进行对比，使用配对检验和bootstrap 95%置信区间，共享同一搜索空间。
AI.result: LLM顾问的强第一点并非LLM输出，而是固定的默认配置种子，该种子独自达到88.7%的平均最佳CV；LLM自身提案仅增加+0.40 pp CV准确率，测试集无提升（LLM-Default = -0.01 pp, p=0.92）；给经典搜索相同种子后，LLM优势消失：2次评估领先+0.20 pp，5次打平，12次落后-0.37 pp；无种子时，经典搜索12次评估打平，40次超越（+0.6~+0.8 pp, p≤1e-4）。
AI.conclusion: 在表格HPO任务上，LLM顾问未带来可测量的泛化收益，经典搜索方法在几次评估内即可赶超。建议用合理默认配置种子化经典搜索，无需使用LLM顾问。

title: Learning at the Right Pace: Adaptive Data Scheduling Improves LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve remarkable reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. However, existing RL post-training commonly relies on uniform data sampling, which ignores the semantic structure of the training data and the changing capability of the training policy. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Data Scheduling (ADS), a dual-level data scheduling framework for pacing RL post-training that replaces uniform sampling with an adaptive distribution over semantic clusters and policy-boundary sample selection. At the cluster level, ADS organizes samples according to semantic patterns and maintains an adaptive inter-cluster distribution to solidify current training progress. At the sample level, ADS performs intra-cluster scheduling to continuously sample policy-boundary samples, which provides informative relative advantages. Experimental results across three LLMs and seven reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ADS improves average accuracy by 5.2% over Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Notably, ADS consistently improves RL methods with different objective designs, highlighting its potential as a general data scheduling strategy for LLM RL post-training. The source code is available at: https://github.com/Richard-zrx/ADS.

AI.tldr: ADS（自适应数据调度）是一个用于LLM强化学习后训练的双层数据调度框架，通过语义聚类级自适应分布和策略边界样本级选择替代均匀采样，在三个LLM和七个推理基准上平均提升5.2%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM的RL后训练普遍采用均匀数据采样，忽略了训练数据的语义结构和训练策略能力的变化，导致训练效率低下。
AI.method: 提出ADS双层数据调度框架：1）聚类级：根据语义模式组织样本，维护自适应聚类间分布以巩固当前训练进度；2）样本级：在聚类内持续采样策略边界样本，提供信息量丰富的相对优势信号。
AI.result: 在三个LLM和七个推理基准上，ADS相比GRPO平均提升5.2%准确率，且能一致改进不同目标设计的RL方法。
AI.conclusion: ADS是一种通用且有效的数据调度策略，能显著提升LLM强化学习后训练的性能，有望替代现有的均匀采样方法。

title: A Framework for Directed Acyclic Hypergraph Learning
comment: 3 pages. Accepted and presented as an oral presentation at the 9th Graph Signal Processing Workshop (GSP 2026), June 8-10, 2026, Madrid, Spain
summary: Continuous optimization methods for learning Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) operate on weighted adjacency matrices and are therefore limited to pairwise causal relationships. We propose a framework for learning Directed Acyclic Hypergraphs (DAHGs) from observational data, capturing joint parental influences that pairwise models cannot represent. Our approach rests on three components: (i) a generalized linear structural equation model (SEM) with multiplicative interaction terms whose non-zero weights correspond one-to-one with directed hyperedges; (ii) a weighted adjacency tensor representation whose acyclicity is characterized via nilpotency under the tensor t-product; and (iii) a differentiable acyclicity constraint derived through the Fourier decomposition of the t-product, which reduces tensor nilpotency to slice-wise matrix nilpotency and enables least-squares learning via the augmented Lagrangian method.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种从观测数据中学习有向无环超图（DAHG）的框架，通过张量t-积的幂零性刻画无环性，并利用傅里叶分解将无环约束转化为可微的切片级矩阵约束，从而支持基于增广拉格朗日方法的最小二乘学习。
AI.motivation: 传统有向无环图（DAG）学习方法受限于加权邻接矩阵，只能建模成对因果关系，无法捕捉多个变量共同作用（联合父节点影响）的复杂因果结构。
AI.method: (i) 广义线性结构方程模型，引入乘性交互项，非零权重与有向超边一一对应；(ii) 加权邻接张量表示，利用张量t-积的幂零性刻画无环性；(iii) 通过傅里叶分解将张量幂零约束转化为切片级矩阵幂零约束，得到可微的无环约束，再通过增广拉格朗日方法进行最小二乘学习。
AI.result: 成功将DAG学习方法扩展至DAHG，能够建模联合父节点影响，且学习过程可微、可优化。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架突破了成对因果关系的局限，使得从观测数据中学习包含多变量联合影响的超图结构成为可能，为因果发现提供了更丰富的表达能力。

title: BabelJudge: Measuring LLM-as-a-Judge Reliability Across Languages and Agent Trajectories
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Source code, benchmark toolkit, and reproduction scripts at https://github.com/Shreyaskc/BabelJudge
summary: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant approach to scalable evaluation in NLP pipelines, yet judges themselves carry systematic biases that raw accuracy hides: they favor responses placed in slot A (position bias), they prefer longer responses regardless of quality (verbosity bias), and their reliability degrades sharply in lower-resource languages. We introduce BabelJudge, an open-source benchmark and reliability audit framework that measures all four failure modes -- position bias, verbosity bias, order inconsistency, and cross-lingual degradation -- on any judge model, without requiring human preference labels. The key insight is gold-labelling by degradation: starting from a high-quality reference response and applying a controlled perturbation yields a pairwise item whose gold label is known by construction, eliminating annotation cost. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit across English, Hindi, Arabic, and Swahili and find that our composite bias-penalised reliability score drops from 0.714 in Hindi to 0.550 in Swahili, a gap that raw accuracy (0.835 vs. 0.660) understates. Swahili order consistency collapses to 0.480, meaning judge verdicts are near-random under slot-order swaps -- a failure mode invisible to accuracy alone. We further extend the framework to agentic evaluation via nine trajectory-level perturbations (argument corruption, tool swaps, hallucinated calls, missing steps) and three new metrics: tool accuracy, hallucination detection rate, and trajectory-length bias. BabelJudge is released as a Python package supporting 11 judge backends. Code: https://github.com/Shreyaskc/BabelJudge

AI.tldr: BabelJudge 是一个开源基准测试和可靠性审计框架，通过受控扰动生成已知标签的成对样本，无需人工标注即可衡量裁判模型的四种失败模式（位置偏差、冗长偏差、顺序不一致性和跨语言退化）。实验发现，原始准确率掩盖了严重的可靠性问题，如在斯瓦希里语中顺序一致性仅为 0.480（接近随机）。该框架还扩展至智能体评估，支持9种轨迹级扰动和3种新指标。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 在 NLP 评估中广泛应用，但裁判模型本身存在系统性的偏差（位置偏差、冗长偏差等），且原始准确率指标掩盖了这些失败模式。现有方法依赖人工偏好标签，成本高昂且难以扩展，尤其对低资源语言的可靠性评估严重不足。
AI.method: 核心思路是通过"退化式金标签"：从高质量参考响应出发，施加受控扰动（如交换位置、增减长度等），构造出金标签已知的成对比较项，无需人工标注。框架支持四类偏差度量（位置偏差、冗长偏差、顺序不一致性、跨语言退化），并扩展至智能体评估的9种轨迹级扰动（参数损坏、工具交换、幻觉调用、缺失步骤等）及3项新指标（工具准确率、幻觉检测率、轨迹长度偏差）。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit 上的评估显示：合成偏差惩罚可靠性评分从印地语的0.714下降到斯瓦希里语的0.550，而原始准确率仅从0.835降至0.660；斯瓦希里语的顺序一致性仅为0.480，意味着交换选项位置后裁判判决近乎随机。
AI.conclusion: BabelJudge 揭示了原始准确率严重低估了裁判模型在低资源语言中的可靠性问题，为 LLM-as-a-judge 的可信评估提供了无需人工标注的系统性审计框架，并首次将偏差审计扩展至智能体评估场景。

title: Decodable but Not Faithful: Coupling Natural-Language Rationales to Programmatic Verifiers
comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 AI4Math Workshop as a poster
summary: Language models can generate plausible rationales for their predictions, but these explanations may not faithfully represent the model's internal reasoning. We propose verifier-coupled reasoning, a framework that inserts inline claims into reasoning traces and trains an auxiliary consistency head to predict programmatic verifier outputs from rationale-span hidden states. The central finding is a gap between decodability and faithfulness: consistency training reliably makes verifier information decodable from rationale representations, but decodability does not guarantee faithful generation. In LeanCheck (formal theorem proving), rationale-only and proof-only pooling achieve perfect directional separation under counterfactual conflict. In KataGo (Go engine), commentary spans encode 10-way win-rate buckets at 81% accuracy. Yet in a code setting, the model achieves 98.6% coupling while its generated explanations remain unfaithful: fluent prose with correct structured claims, but describing unrelated algorithms; a controlled pretrained-vs-from-scratch comparison shows the gap is not capacity-driven. Synthetic activation patching confirms causal influence (73-89% vs. 31% baseline), FEVER reveals that evidence-only pooling isolates genuine evidence sensitivity at the cost of raw accuracy, and per-claim analysis shows that consistency loss disproportionately benefits fine-grained claims over binary ones. These results establish that consistency losses are effective diagnostics and representation-shaping tools, but not sufficient conditions for faithful reasoning.

AI.tldr: 一致性训练可使验证器信息从推理表征中解码，但可解码性并不保证生成忠实解释；在LeanCheck、KataGo和代码设置中均观察到可解码性与忠实性之间存在显著差距，表明一致性损失是有效的诊断工具而非忠实推理的充分条件。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可以生成看似合理的推理链，但这些解释可能无法忠实反映模型内部推理过程，存在解释与真实推理的脱节问题。
AI.method: 提出验证器耦合推理框架，在推理轨迹中插入内联声明，并训练辅助一致性头从隐状态预测程序化验证器输出。通过多种评估方法（句法对抗、合成激活补丁、FEVER、逐声明分析）系统性地检验可解码性与忠实性之间的关系。
AI.result: 一致性训练使验证器信息可解码（KataGo中81%准确率，代码设定中98.6%耦合度），但生成解释仍不忠实（如代码设定中描述无关算法）；合成激活补丁显示73-89%因果影响；FEVER表明证据池化可隔离证据敏感性但牺牲准确性。
AI.conclusion: 一致性损失是有效的诊断工具和表征塑造方法，但不能保证生成忠实推理，可解码性与忠实性之间存在根本性差距。

title: How Does Research Evolve? Tracing Cross-Domain Trajectories in NLP, ML, and CV with Claim-Grounded Typed Citations
summary: How does research evolve, and what substrate would let us forecast where it goes next? Scientific progress is not simply a uniform accumulation of facts: ideas extend prior methods, address known limitations, realize proposed future directions, and sometimes dispute earlier claims. Existing citation graphs usually collapse these roles into a single homogeneous edge type, limiting how we can analyze scientific progress. We address this gap by proposing the SciTraj corpus, the first claim-grounded typed citation graph in which each edge is linked to the specific claim sentence that motivates it. Claim-bearing sentences are extracted from paper sections; four claim-driven relations are verified by NLI entailment against in-paper context, while two similarity-only relations are gated by abstract cosine and year-gap rules. SciTraj contains 32,559 papers from NLP, ML, and Vision (2015--2024), connected by 573,126 directed edges across six relation types, with NLI-verified claim seeds. Using SciTraj, we identify disciplinary siloing in typed citation flow and topic emergence concentrated in Vision and LLM-related work. The corpus also contains 287M typed trajectories of length $\geq 3$, covering 72.8% of papers, and supports a temporally split typed link-prediction benchmark. A year-shuffle falsifiability test separates temporal structure from year-correlated content, and a 3-annotator pilot reports $κ= 0.74$ with 79.9% precision.

AI.tldr: 提出了SciTraj语料库，首个基于主张的带类型引文图，每条边关联到具体的主张句子，包含32,559篇论文和573,126条有向边，支持6种关系类型，用于分析科学研究的演化。
AI.motivation: 现有引文图将所有引用关系视为单一同质边类型，无法区分研究演化中的不同角色（如扩展、解决局限性、实现未来方向、质疑先前主张等），限制了科学进步的分析能力。
AI.method: 从论文章节中抽取带主张的句子，通过NLI蕴含验证四种主张驱动的关系（扩展、改进、对比、使用），通过摘要余弦相似度和年份间隔过滤两种相似性关系（相似、相关），构建了NLP、ML和Vision领域2015-2024年间的引文图。
AI.result: 构建了32,559篇论文、573,126条有向边的引文图，识别出学科孤岛现象和主题集中在Vision及LLM相关工作的趋势，生成了2.87亿条长度≥3的带类型轨迹覆盖72.8%的论文，通过时间分割的链接预测基准和年份打乱可证伪性测试验证了时间结构的有效性，注释者间一致性κ=0.74，精度79.9%。
AI.conclusion: SciTraj通过细粒度的带类型引文图，能够更准确地分析科学进步的演化模式，包括学科隔离、新兴主题识别和跨领域知识流动，为预测科学发展方向提供了新的数据基础。

title: Expressivity Saturation: Reduced Affine Region Usage Under Increasing Task Complexity
summary: Piecewise-affine neural networks (e.g., with ReLU or LeakyReLU activations) implement continuous piecewise-affine maps, and the number of affine regions provides a natural proxy for expressive capacity. However, the gap between theoretical region capacity and the affine regions realized after training remains insufficiently understood. We study this gap from two complementary perspectives. First, we give a rigorous, architecture-dependent theorem for affine line-segment probes: for multilayer perceptrons with piecewise-affine activations, the number of affine pieces realized along an affine line-segment probe is upper bounded by an explicit product of layer-wise width terms (and activation breakpoint factors). This yields a neuron-threshold lower bound for representing target functions with prescribed one-dimensional piece complexity, formalizing the minimal region budget required for complex signals. Second, we exactly enumerate affine regions realized within bounded 2D and higher-dimensional domains under controlled task complexity. Under fixed architectures and training protocols, increasing input--label complexity yields trained solutions with markedly fewer realized regions in the evaluation domain, even though worst-case architectural capacity is unchanged; we call this reduced region usage expressivity saturation. Moreover, in the most challenging regimes, 2D visualizations show that region-usage collapse often coincides with degraded decision boundaries. Finally, we visualize the training dynamics of affine-region partitions and decision boundaries, revealing a consistent refinement process during optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分段仿射神经网络（如ReLU/LeakyReLU网络）在理论上可达的仿射区域数量与实际训练后实现的仿射区域数量之间的差距。从两个角度分析：1）给出沿仿射线段的仿射片段数的严格上界定理；2）通过实验发现，随着输入-标签复杂度增加，训练后网络在评估域内实现的仿射区域显著减少（即表达饱和度），且区域坍塌常伴随决策边界退化。此外，可视化展示了训练过程中区域划分和决策边界的细化过程。
AI.motivation: 分段仿射神经网络的表达能力常用仿射区域数量衡量，但理论上的最大区域容量与实际训练后实现的区域数量之间存在尚未被充分理解的鸿沟，本文旨在弥合这一认知差距。
AI.method: 1）理论推导：针对沿仿射线段的探针，给出仿射片段数的严格上界（依赖网络架构的乘积形式）。2）实验枚举：在受控任务复杂度下精确枚举有界二维及更高维域中实现的仿射区域，分析输入-标签复杂度与区域数量的关系。
AI.result: 1）提出神经元阈值下界，形式化了表征复杂一维信号所需的最小区域预算。2）发现表达饱和度现象：固定架构下，增加任务复杂度导致训练解在评估域中实现的区域数量显著减少。3）高复杂度下区域使用坍塌常伴随决策边界退化。
AI.conclusion: 理论容量与实际表达能力之间存在显著差距，任务复杂度会导致区域使用饱和甚至坍塌，这为理解神经网络泛化和表达能力的局限性提供了新视角。

title: Curiosity as Linguistic Intervention: Using LLM Tutoring Dialogues to Influence Exploratory Learning Behavior
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a new opportunity to study how language shapes exploratory cognition because conversational strategies can be systematically manipulated at inference time. We introduce CURIOBOT, a framework that operationalizes Berlyne's collative variables, novelty, complexity, conflict, and uncertainty, as adaptive linguistic interventions for conversational tutoring. Across 270 tutoring conversations spanning multiple model families, domains, and topic complexity levels, curiosity-oriented interventions consistently increased exploratory learner behaviors, producing up to 2.4x more conversational turns under fixed time budgets. To measure these effects, we further introduce a learner-centered evaluation framework capturing exploratory questioning, conversational agency, productive struggle, and observable curiosity. Learner-side gains persisted even when tutor-side instructional quality remained unchanged, suggesting that curiosity functions as a partially independent interaction-level mechanism. More broadly, our results demonstrate that LLM-mediated dialogue can serve as a scalable experimental framework for studying how language shapes exploratory learning behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CURIOBOT框架，通过将Berlyne的好奇心变量（新颖性、复杂性、冲突、不确定性）转化为自适应语言干预策略，在LLM驱动的对话式辅导中显著提升学习者的探索行为（最多2.4倍对话轮次），并引入以学习者为中心的评价框架，证明好奇心作为部分独立的交互层面机制，为研究语言如何塑造探索性认知提供了可扩展的实验框架。
AI.motivation: 探索语言如何塑造探索性认知，利用LLM在推理阶段可系统性操纵对话策略的新机会，验证Berlyne的好奇心理论在LLM对话辅导中的有效性。
AI.method: 将Berlyne的四个好奇心变量（新颖性、复杂性、冲突、不确定性）操作化为自适应语言干预策略，构建CURIOBOT框架；在270个对话、多个模型家族、领域和主题复杂度级别上进行实验；提出以学习者为中心的评价框架，涵盖探索性提问、对话能动性、生产性挣扎和可观察好奇心四个维度。
AI.result: 好奇心导向的干预一致性地增加了学习者的探索行为，在固定时间预算下对话轮次最多增加2.4倍；学习者端的收益在辅导端教学质量不变的情况下依然持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心是部分独立的交互层面机制；LLM中介的对话可作为研究语言如何塑造探索性学习行为的可扩展实验框架。

title: Embedding Linear Equality Constraints in Probabilistic Neural Networks for Dynamic Modelling
summary: Machine learning models are increasingly used to model chemical process systems, yet they often lack principled uncertainty quantification and mechanisms to enforce physical constraints. We propose a probabilistic neural network framework that guarantees satisfaction of linear equality constraints within a given tolerance, while capturing aleatoric uncertainty. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our formulation demonstrates improved predictive accuracy, uncertainty calibration, and adherence to constraints on reduced data. It also demonstrates competitive performance, but with significantly faster training times when evaluated on large data regimes. We evaluated this on two batch reactor case studies, enforcing mass balances.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个概率神经网络框架，能够在给定容差内保证线性等式约束的满足，同时捕捉偶然不确定性。在批量反应器案例中验证了质量平衡约束的强制执行，相比现有方法在预测精度、不确定性校准和约束遵守方面表现更优，且在大数据 regime 下训练速度更快。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在化工过程系统中应用日益广泛，但缺乏原理性的不确定性量化和物理约束强制执行机制，这限制了其在关键化工场景中的可靠应用。
AI.method: 提出一个概率神经网络框架，通过设计特定的网络结构或损失函数，在给定容差内保证线性等式约束（如质量平衡）的满足，同时建模偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）。
AI.result: 在减少数据场景下，该方法在预测精度、不确定性校准和约束遵守方面优于现有方法；在大数据场景下，实现了具有竞争力的性能，同时训练时间显著缩短。在两个批量反应器案例研究中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架能有效平衡物理约束满足、不确定性量化与计算效率，为化工过程建模提供了更可靠且高效的方案。

title: ORBIT: Training-Free Multi-Attribute Behavioral Steering via Orthogonal Subspace Rotation
summary: Language models are widely used in assistant settings, where controlling behavioral attributes is often essential. Activation steering modifies hidden-state representations at inference time, providing a lightweight, training-free mechanism that can be toggled at runtime. Existing methods, however, have focused primarily on steering a single attribute at a time. When multiple attributes must be controlled simultaneously, naive summation of per-attribute steering vectors suffers from norm imbalance and directional cancellation, while classifier-based approaches require retraining whenever the attribute set changes. We introduce ORBIT (Orthogonal Rotation-Based Intervention Technique), a training-free extension of rotation-based steering to the multi-attribute setting. Our method constructs a joint subspace from per-attribute steering planes via singular value decomposition and applies a single norm-preserving rotation within that subspace toward a combined target direction. Adaptive per-token gating identifies which attributes need correction at each position, and an optional additive boost strengthens attributes with weak initial projection. We also introduce TraitFactory, a new multi-attribute benchmark that focuses on behavioral tendencies rather than surface-level style. We evaluate ORBIT on TraitFactory and ToneBank across three models (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B) while steering multiple attributes simultaneously, showing that it achieves stronger and more balanced multi-attribute steering than existing training-free baselines while better preserving output coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ORBIT方法，通过正交旋转实现在推理时对语言模型进行多属性联合控制，解决现有方法在多属性叠加时存在的范数不平衡和方向抵消问题，在TraitFactory和ToneBank基准上取得更优的多属性操控效果。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法主要针对单一属性控制，当需要同时控制多个属性时，简单叠加每属性的引导向量会导致范数不平衡和方向抵消问题；而基于分类器的方法在属性集合变化时需要重新训练，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: ORBIT方法通过以下步骤实现多属性引导：(1) 利用SVD从各属性的引导平面构建联合子空间；(2) 在该子空间内向组合目标方向施加单一保范旋转；(3) 使用自适应逐token门控机制识别每个位置需要修正的属性；(4) 可选的加法增强机制加强初始投影较弱的属性。
AI.result: 在TraitFactory和ToneBank基准上，使用Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B三个模型进行多属性同时引导实验，ORBIT相比现有无训练基线方法实现了更强且更均衡的多属性引导效果，同时更好地保持了输出连贯性。
AI.conclusion: ORBIT是一种训练免费、运行时可切换的多属性激活引导方法，有效克服了多属性叠加时的技术难题，为语言模型在辅助场景中的行为属性控制提供了轻量级解决方案。

title: AdaPrivate-TS: Private Thompson Sampling for Contextual Bandits with Privacy Amplification
comment: Accepted at the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence (Canadian AI 2026) as a long paper; selected for oral presentation. 12 pages, 6 tables
summary: We present AdaPrivate-TS, a differentially private contextual bandit algorithm that combines Thompson Sampling with batched zCDP composition. Our key insight is that differential privacy noise inflates the posterior covariance in a structured way: adding Gaussian noise $N(0,σ^2 I)$ to $b$ yields sampling covariance $v^2 A^{-1} + σ^2 A^{-2}$, which Thompson Sampling interprets as increased uncertainty rather than pure corruption. Under event-level privacy (protecting individual interactions) with stochastic contexts, we prove that the privacy cost is only $O(\sqrt{d}\,\log T/\sqrtρ)$, logarithmic in $T$, because parallel composition amortizes noise across batches. Additionally, we explore privacy amplification via Poisson subsampling, which can reduce effective noise at stringent privacy budgets. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate: (1) AdaPrivate-TS achieves 93-99% of non-private performance at $\varepsilon \in [0.5, 5]$, outperforming UCB by 0.5-3.7% and up to 18% with tuned adaptive exploration at extreme $\varepsilon$; (2) privacy amplification provides additional 2-5% gains at low $\varepsilon$; (3) on MovieLens and Jester, AdaPrivate-TS achieves the best overall performance among event-level baselines, dominating at $\varepsilon \geq 2$; (4) under DP-SVD private features, TS's advantage over UCB grows to +11%, confirming noise-as-uncertainty is not limited to reward privacy. We provide rigorous proofs for privacy guarantees under interactive zCDP composition and comprehensive evaluation including convergence curves, 12-seed CIs, and DP-SVD feature ablation.

AI.tldr: AdaPrivate-TS 是一种结合 Thompson 采样与批量 zCDP 组合的差分隐私上下文赌博机算法。核心发现是差分隐私噪声会以结构化的方式膨胀后验协方差（$v^2 A^{-1} + σ^2 A^{-2}$），Thompson 采样将其解释为不确定性而非纯噪声。在事件级隐私和随机上下文下，隐私成本仅需 $O(\sqrt{d}\,\log T/\sqrtρ)$。实验表明在 $\varepsilon \in [0.5, 5]$ 时达到非私有性能的93-99%，优于 UCB 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有差分隐私上下文赌博机算法（如 DP-UCB）通常将噪声视为纯粹的干扰，导致探索策略过于保守或次优。作者试图利用 Thompson 采样天然具有的不确定性建模能力，将差分隐私噪声转化为有益的结构化不确定性，从而在不牺牲隐私的前提下提升算法性能。
AI.method: 提出 AdaPrivate-TS 算法，结合 Thompson 采样与批量 zCDP（零集中差分隐私）组合。关键创新包括：(1) 证明添加高斯噪声 $N(0,σ^2 I)$ 到 $b$ 后，后验协方差变为 $v^2 A^{-1} + σ^2 A^{-2}$，TS 将其解读为增加的不确定性；(2) 利用并行组合在批处理中摊销噪声，实现 $O(\sqrt{d}\,\log T/\sqrtρ)$ 的隐私成本；(3) 探索通过泊松子采样进行隐私放大的策略。
AI.result: (1) 在 $\varepsilon \in [0.5, 5]$ 时达到非私有性能的93-99%，优于 UCB 0.5-3.7%，在极端 $\varepsilon$ 下通过自适应探索提升高达18%；(2) 隐私放大在低 $\varepsilon$ 下额外带来2-5%收益；(3) 在 MovieLens 和 Jester 数据集上，事件级基线中总体最优，$\varepsilon \geq 2$ 时显著占优；(4) DP-SVD 私有特征下，TS 相对 UCB 的优势扩大至 +11%。
AI.conclusion: AdaPrivate-TS 成功证明了差分隐私噪声在 Thompson 采样框架下可以被重新解释为有益的不确定性信号，而非纯粹的信息损失。这种"噪声即不确定性"的视角不仅适用于奖励隐私，在特征隐私（DP-SVD）场景下同样成立。算法在多种隐私预算下均能接近非私有性能，为差分隐私在线学习提供了一种新的设计范式。

title: First-Token Broadcasters: Mechanistic Origins of Language Identity and Distributed Robustness in Transformers
summary: Why do multilingual language models sometimes generate in the wrong language, and why is this so hard to fix? We introduce Language Identity Head Ablation (LIHA), a causal intervention that zeros each attention head individually and measures the resulting language switch rate across a parallel dataset of 2,700 prompt-language pairs spanning seven languages.
