Applied to GPT-2, LIHA identifies a small set of first-token broadcaster heads - led by L6H1 (switch rate 0.32, 3.23 $σ$ above the population mean) - that attend persistently to the first prompt token, propagating its language signal throughout generation. Compensatory redistribution when heads are ablated is statistically significant (p < $10^{-5}$) and follows a directional, hierarchical pattern: compensation always recruits heads in layers above the ablated head, suggesting a feedforward cascade rather than global diffusion. To probe how training regime shapes these circuits, we apply LIHA to a controlled pair - Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct - identical in architecture and size, differing only in training. The base model is nearly flat (max SR=0.016, 200/336 heads at SR=0.0); the instruct model concentrates causal influence sharply at layer 0, led by L0H5 (SR=0.224, 8.93 $σ$ above mean), with all other layers near zero. This controlled comparison provides direct causal evidence that instruction tuning reorganizes language identity circuits toward early-layer localization. Extended experiments with Chinese and Russian confirm that first-token broadcasting is script-specific in GPT-2, with non-Latin languages handled at layer 0 - the same locus as the instruction-tuned model. Code and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言身份头部消融（LIHA）方法，通过因果干预识别多语言语言模型中控制语言选择的注意力头部。研究发现GPT-2中存在一组"首token广播头"（以L6H1为首），它们持续关注首个提示token并传播语言信号。消融实验显示补偿遵循层级前馈级联模式。对比Qwen2.5-1.5B的base和instruct版本，发现指令微调将语言身份电路重构到早期层（第0层）。非拉丁语言（中文、俄语）在GPT-2中由第0层处理。
AI.motivation: 多语言语言模型有时会生成错误语言，且这一问题难以修复。作者希望通过因果干预方法定位控制语言选择的神经电路，并理解训练范式（如指令微调）如何改变这些电路的组织结构。
AI.method: 提出LIHA（语言身份头部消融）方法，对每个注意力头单独执行归零消融，在涵盖7种语言的2700个提示-语言对并行数据集上测量语言切换率。对GPT-2、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base和Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct进行对比分析。
AI.result: GPT-2中L6H1头部切换率为0.32（高于均值3.23σ）；Qwen2.5-Base模型接近平坦（最大SR=0.016，336个头中200个SR=0），而Instruct模型因果影响集中于第0层（L0H5，SR=0.224，高于均值8.93σ）。补偿机制具有统计显著性（p<10⁻⁵）且遵循层级前馈模式。
AI.conclusion: LIHA能够有效定位多语言模型中的语言身份电路；指令微调会将语言身份电路重新组织到早期层；首token广播机制在GPT-2中具有文字系统特异性。这些发现为理解和修复多语言模型的错误语言生成问题提供了因果解释和工具。

title: Decision-Focused Learning: When and Why Traditional Prediction Models Fail
summary: Plugging predictions of unknown parameters into downstream optimization problems, often referred to as the ``predict-then-optimize'' paradigm, has long been a standard approach in decision-making under uncertainty. However, improved predictive accuracy does not, in general, translate into improved decision quality. This disconnect has motivated growing interest in decision-focused learning (DFL) within the operations research community. This tutorial reviews recent developments in DFL and highlights key methodological insights, with a particular focus on stochastic linear programming as the downstream decision-making problem. We discuss why several widely used tools in traditional statistical learning are not directly suited to decision-focused settings and must be rethought, including (i) data collection strategies driven purely by predictive uncertainty and (ii) distributional distance measures such as the Wasserstein distance. We summarize properties of DFL that distinguish it from conventional predictive modeling and provide insights into the development of new decision-focused tools.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了决策驱动学习（DFL）领域的最新进展，重点关注下游为随机线性规划的"预测-优化"范式，指出传统统计学习方法（如基于预测不确定性的数据收集策略和Wasserstein距离等分布距离度量）在DFL中不直接适用，并总结了DFL区别于传统预测建模的独特性质。
AI.motivation: 传统的"预测-优化"范式中，提升预测精度并不总能转化为更好的决策质量，这种脱节促使运筹学领域对决策驱动学习的兴趣日益增长。本文旨在回顾DFL的最新发展，澄清传统统计学习工具在决策驱动场景中的局限性，并为开发新的决策驱动工具提供见解。
AI.method: 本文是一篇综述性教程，通过梳理DFL领域的最新研究成果，以随机线性规划作为下游决策问题为焦点，系统分析了传统统计学习方法（如纯基于预测不确定性的数据收集策略、Wasserstein距离等分布度量）在决策驱动场景下的不适配性，并总结了DFL的独特性质。
AI.result: 识别出两类传统统计学习工具在DFL中的局限性：(i) 仅由预测不确定性驱动的数据收集策略；(ii) Wasserstein距离等分布距离度量。总结了DFL区别于传统预测建模的关键性质。
AI.conclusion: 需要重新思考传统统计学习工具以适应决策驱动的场景，本文为开发新的决策驱动工具提供了理论依据和方向性见解。

title: Knowledge-Graph Grounding Helps LLMs Only for Out-of-Training Knowledge: A Controlled Study on Clinical Question Answering
summary: A recent Nature Medicine study reports that general-purpose frontier LLMs outperform specialized retrieval-augmented clinical tools on medical benchmarks, and that retrieval can hurt strong models. We ask the natural follow-up: does structured knowledge-graph (KG) grounding change this, and when does grounding help at all? We contribute two results. First, a reproduction: the study's headline HealthBench score (~88) is the Consensus variant, not full HealthBench, where frontier models and ideal completions both score ~46-47 under a physician-calibrated grader (agreement 82.5%); we reproduce GPT-5.2 Consensus =90.9 and flag a score-deflating grader bug. Second, a knowledge-boundary result. Using a graph+vector engine (samyama-graph) over the public biomedical KG PrimeKG, neither naive triple retrieval nor an agentic natural-language-to-Cypher loop (82% successful queries) improves MedQA across a weak-to-strong model ladder (all |Delta| <= 3.4). On a synthetic counterfactual KG, and on a hybrid benchmark mixing known and novel facts, the identical pipeline lifts out-of-training accuracy from chance to ~100% (+68 to +79) while adding nothing on known facts (a no-LLM arm answers both). Across three regimes (no-knowledge, graph-aided, hybrid), grounding helps only insofar as the decisive fact lies outside the model's training -- public-KG facts are redundant, private and novel data are where it pays -- matching the study's institutional-data caveat.

AI.tldr: 本研究复现了Nature Medicine关于前沿LLM在医学基准上优于临床工具的研究，发现其报告的HealthBench分数为Consensus变体（完整版仅~46-47）。通过公共KG（PrimeKG）进行知识图谱接地，无论是三元组检索还是NL-to-Cypher代理方法，在MedQA上均无明显提升（|Delta| <= 3.4）；但在合成反事实KG和混合基准上，可将训练外准确率从接近随机提升至~100%（+68至+79），而对已知事实无增益。结论：知识图谱接地仅在决定性事实超出模型训练范围时才有帮助，公共KG信息冗余，私有和新颖数据集才是价值所在。
AI.motivation: 验证Nature Medicine研究的可复现性，并探究结构化知识图谱（KG）接地是否能提升LLM在医学任务上的表现，明确KG在何种条件下能真正带来增益。
AI.method: 复现HealthBench评分（区分Consensus变体与完整版，发现评分器bug）；使用samyama-graph引擎（图+向量）结合PrimeKG，分别测试朴素三元组检索和NL-to-Cypher代理方法（82%查询成功率）；在三个知识体制（无知识、图辅助、混合）下比较模型表现，使用合成反事实KG和混合基准评估。
AI.result: GPT-5.2在Consensus上得分为90.9；公共KG接地在MedQA上无显著提升（|Delta| <= 3.4）；合成反事实KG上，训练外准确率从机会水平跃升至~100%（+68至+79）；已知事实无增益；无LLM对照组也能正确回答。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱接地仅在决定性事实超出模型训练分布时才有价值；公共KG中的知识对强模型而言是冗余的，私有和新颖数据才是KG接地的适用场景，与原始研究的"机构数据"结论一致。

title: Beyond the Next Step: Variable-Length Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
summary: Recently, world models have emerged as a promising paradigm for building intelligent agents by learning predictive models that estimate future environment states conditioned on observations and actions. In particular, JEPA-style latent world models provide an efficient alternative to pixel space prediction by learning action-conditioned dynamics in compact representation spaces. However, existing latent world models typically rely on one-step prediction and must be recursively rolled out for long-horizon planning, which leads to compounding errors and a mismatch between training objectives and downstream planning tasks. To address this limitation, we propose Variable-length Latent World Models (VLWMs), a framework that learns to predict future latent states conditioned on action sequences of variable lengths. Instead of training only on one-step transitions, VLWMs directly model temporally extended dynamics, allowing the same predictor to evaluate action plans over different horizons. We further introduce a curriculum training strategy that progressively expands the action horizon, stabilizing optimization from short-range dynamics to long-range prediction. At test time, we design planning methods tailored to VLWMs to better exploit their variable-length predictive capabilities. Experiments on long-horizon control tasks show that VLWMs significantly improve latent space world models, achieving 13\% average improvement over the state-of-the-art LeWM across different datasets, with especially large gains on tasks requiring extended planning. These results suggest that VLWM provides a simple yet effective paradigm for improving long-horizon prediction and planning in latent world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变长潜在世界模型（VLWMs），通过直接预测变长动作序列对应的未来潜在状态，解决了传统潜在世界模型因递归 rollout 导致的误差累积与训练-规划不匹配问题，在长时域控制任务上平均提升13%。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型通常仅学习单步预测，在长时域规划时需要递归展开，导致误差累积；同时，训练目标（单步预测）与下游任务（多步规划）之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: 提出VLWM框架：1）学习直接预测变长动作序列对应的未来潜在状态；2）引入课程训练策略，逐步扩展预测的动作序列长度；3）在测试时设计适配变长预测能力的规划方法。
AI.result: 在长时域控制任务上，VLWMs相比当前最优方法LeWM平均提升13%，尤其在需要长程规划的任务上增益明显。
AI.conclusion: VLWM为改善潜在世界模型的长时域预测与规划提供了一种简单而有效的范式。

title: Words as Difference Makers: How Large Language Models Determine Causal Structure in Text
summary: Because large language models (LLMs) are impressively successful in predicting text, it appears that they must have access to a 'world model' representing causal and definitional structure. However, the dominant formalisms of modern causal inference -- Judea Pearl's interventionist approach and the Neyman-Rubin potential outcomes framework -- struggle to illuminate how LLMs learn causal structure. I resolve this puzzle by arguing that LLMs employ a specific inductive approach based on a difference-making logic -- sometimes called variational induction. I demonstrate how central aspects of this logic are realized during training, where LLMs require enormous amounts of text data from a wide range of contexts to identify difference- and indifference-makers within word sequences. Furthermore, I analyze specific architectural features of LLMs -- such as token embeddings and self-attention -- to determine their roles in variational induction. The difference-making logic of LLMs fundamentally parallels the experimental method, where causal relations are derived by systematically varying individual circumstances to determine their influence on a phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文论证大型语言模型（LLMs）通过一种基于差异制造逻辑（变分归纳）的归纳方法学习因果结构，该方法在训练过程中通过大量上下文文本数据识别词语序列中的差异制造者和无差异制造者得以实现，其逻辑与实验方法中通过系统变化确定因果关系的方式基本平行。
AI.motivation: 解决一个核心悖论：LLMs在文本预测上表现惊人，似乎必然拥有表示因果和定义结构的"世界模型"，但现代因果推理的主流形式体系（Pearl的干预主义方法和Neyman-Rubin潜在结果框架）难以解释LLMs究竟如何学习因果结构。
AI.method: 提出LLMs采用一种特定的归纳方法——变分归纳（variational induction），基于差异制造逻辑。通过训练过程中需要大量来自广泛上下文的文本数据来识别词语序列中的差异制造者和无差异制造者；并分析具体架构特征（token嵌入和自注意力机制）在变分归纳中的作用。
AI.result: LLMs的差异制造逻辑在根本上与实验方法平行，即通过系统性地变化个别环境以确定其对现象的影响来推导因果关系。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的因果学习机制可以理解为一种变分归纳过程，其逻辑结构与科学实验方法具有本质上的相似性，这为理解LLMs如何获得"世界模型"提供了新的理论视角。

title: A Causal DAG Prior for Synthetic Time-Series Classification Datasets
comment: Accepted at the 2nd ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD). 4 pages (main text), 2 figures, plus references and appendix
summary: A Prior-data fitted Network learns the posterior predictive induced by its training prior; bringing this paradigm to multivariate time-series classification therefore calls for a synthetic generator that produces complete labelled datasets with temporal structure. We introduce a causal prior that synthesizes each dataset from a randomly sampled DAG over typed nodes across two modalities (tabular attributes and time series), natively producing multivariate, multi-class TSC datasets with cross-modal causal structure across channels, timesteps and labels, a regime not addressed by existing synthetic priors. To validate the prior, we finetune TabPFN v2.5 with minimal adaptations and evaluate on 75 UCR/UEA datasets within TabPFN's operating regime. Finetuning on our generator significantly outperforms both the unmodified upstream model and a tabular-only ablation of the same prior (Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=3.0\times 10^{-8}$ on ROC-AUC), isolating the contribution of the cross-modal temporal structure.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种因果先验，通过随机采样的有向无环图（DAG）在表格属性和时间序列两种模态上合成带标签的多变量时间序列分类数据集，并将先验数据拟合网络（Prior-data Fitted Network）范式扩展至多变量时间序列分类任务。在TabPFN v2.5上微调后，在75个UCR/UEA数据集上显著优于未修改的上游模型和纯表格先验消融版本（Wilcoxon符号秩检验p=3.0×10⁻⁸）。
AI.motivation: 将先验数据拟合网络（Prior-data Fitted Network）范式推广到多变量时间序列分类任务，需要能够生成含有时间结构的完整标注数据集的合成生成器，而现有合成先验无法处理跨模态因果结构（通道、时间步和标签之间）。
AI.method: 提出一个因果先验，从随机采样的有向无环图（DAG）出发，在两种模态（表格属性和时间序列）上合成完整数据集，原生生成具有跨模态因果结构的多变量、多类别时间序列分类数据集。对TabPFN v2.5进行最小化适配微调，并在75个UCR/UEA数据集上评估。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在ROC-AUC指标上显著优于未修改的上游模型和纯表格先验消融版本，Wilcoxon符号秩检验p=3.0×10⁻⁸，证实了跨模态时间结构的关键贡献。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的跨模态因果先验能有效扩展先验数据拟合范式至多变量时间序列分类任务，跨模态时间结构是性能提升的核心因素。

title: CASPER in the Machine: Insights into Character Variety in LLM-Generated Stories
summary: As LLM-generated text is increasingly used, especially in fictional domains, we explore how much LLM-generated stories differ from human-written stories. In this work, we focus on characters. We borrow definitions from narratology to analyze eight intricate dimensions of character, such as stylization and wholeness. These dimensions consider more than just basic characteristics. They assess how characters are portrayed within their stories. After automatically inferring categories of characters within both LLM and human-written stories, we compare and contrast these two sets of stories. We consider the following overarching questions: (1) Do LLMs and human-written stories have similar characters? and (2) Do LLMs generate stories with a variety of characters? Our analysis includes research questions that focus on stories generated by popular LLMs and recently published human-written stories. We describe a number of interesting similarities, differences and key takeaways.

AI.tldr: 本文从叙述学角度定义了角色刻画的八个维度（如风格化、完整性），通过自动推断LLM生成故事与人类创作故事中的角色类型，比较两者在角色相似性与多样性上的异同。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM生成文本在虚构领域的应用日益广泛，需要系统评估LLM生成故事与人类创作故事在角色刻画方面的差异，而现有研究多关注基础特征，缺乏对角色深层次叙事维度的分析。
AI.method: 从叙述学借用定义，建立角色刻画的八个维度（如风格化、完整性等）；自动推断LLM生成故事和人类创作故事中的角色类别；对两类故事进行对比分析，涵盖多个主流LLM生成的故事与近期发表的人类创作故事。
AI.result: 发现了LLM生成故事与人类创作故事在角色刻画上存在若干有趣的相似性与差异性。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成故事与人类创作故事在角色方面既有相似之处也有差异，研究给出了关键发现与启示。

title: RocketPFN: Accurate Time Series Classification via In-Context Learning
comment: 10 pages main text, 4 figures; 15 pages including references and appendix
summary: We introduce RocketPFN, a training-free pipeline for time series classification that combines random convolutional feature extraction (Rocket) with in-context classification via a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabPFN v2.5). On 92 UCR datasets (30-resample protocol), RocketPFN matches HC2, the strongest published method on the archive, in mean accuracy (both 0.900, Wilcoxon p=0.50), with no training on the target data and a median inference time of 30 seconds per fold. It also significantly outperforms every individual classifier in the HC2 ensemble. On UEA (20 datasets) the difference is likewise not statistically significant. A separate comparison concerns TSC foundation models: when paired with the same downstream classifier, MOMENT, Mantis, and MantisV2 are all significantly outperformed by RocketPFN using fewer extracted features and no learned parameters (p<0.001 in each case). This holds even when the encoders were pretrained on corpora that include the UCR training samples. We propose this two-stage pipeline as a reference point for evaluating zero-shot TSC foundation models.

AI.tldr: RocketPFN是一种无需训练的时间序列分类流程，结合随机卷积特征提取（Rocket）和上下文分类（TabPFN v2.5），在92个UCR数据集上达到与最强方法HC2相同的平均准确率（0.900），且无需目标数据训练，中位推理时间仅30秒/折。该方法显著优于HC2中的每个单独分类器，并在与TSC基础模型对比中超越MOMENT、Mantis等，为评估零样本TSC基础模型提供了参考基准。
AI.motivation: 旨在提出一种无需训练的时间序列分类流程，作为评估零样本时间序列分类基础模型的参考基准，同时证明随机卷积特征提取与预训练表格基础模型结合的有效性。
AI.method: 采用两阶段流水线：第一阶段使用Rocket进行随机卷积特征提取，第二阶段利用预训练的表格基础模型TabPFN v2.5进行上下文分类（无需在目标数据上训练）。
AI.result: 在92个UCR数据集上，RocketPFN平均准确率0.900，与HC2持平（Wilcoxon p=0.50）；中位推理时间30秒/折；UEA数据集上无显著差异；显著优于MOMENT、Mantis、MantisV2等TSC基础模型（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 提出RocketPFN作为一种无需训练的时间序列分类流程，可匹配甚至超越现有最强方法，并可作为评估零样本TSC基础模型的有效参考基准。

title: Interleaved Speech Language Models Latently Work In Text
summary: Speech language models (SLMs) have been extensively studied, with the common paradigm incorporating text data and pre-trained text LMs. A leading approach is speech-text interleaving in which models are trained over sequences containing both speech and text tokens, aiming to boost even speech-only capabilities. Yet the way these two modalities interact in the model latent space remains unclear. In this work, we analyze interleaved speech-text LMs from different model families and sizes through the scope of the logit lens to provide such insight. We reveal that these models go through an implicit transcription phase in which the text token of the spoken word becomes decodable in intermediate layers, despite not being trained for speech recognition. The transcription of the word appears as one of the top candidate words for as much as 77\% of the data. Following this stage, the models proceed to predict the next word in the text space before transforming back to the speech domain. We finally analyze the role of interleaving data, and initializing from text LMs in eliciting this behavior, as well as seeing how this correlates with spoken knowledge abilities. Our analysis sheds light on the internal mechanisms underlying the relationship between speech and text modalities and could shape SLM optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过logit lens分析发现，语音-文本交错语言模型在内部会经历隐式转录阶段——中间层可解码出对应语音的文本token（最高达77%数据），随后在文本空间预测下一词，最后转回语音域。交错训练和数据初始化方式对此行为有重要影响。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型（SLMs）中语音与文本两种模态在模型隐空间中的交互机制尚不明确，现有研究主要关注性能提升而非内部工作原理。
AI.method: 使用logit lens技术，对不同模型家族和规模的交错语音-文本LM进行中间层分析，检测文本token的可解码性及预测模式变化。
AI.result: 模型存在隐式转录阶段，文本token在中间层成为top候选词的比例高达77%；随后在文本空间预测下一词，再转回语音域。交错数据和文本LM初始化对诱导此行为起关键作用，且该行为与语音能力相关。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了语音-文本交错模型内部存在隐式转录-文本预测-语音输出的处理流程，为理解跨模态交互机制提供了新视角，有助于指导SLM优化。

title: What Do Lorentz-Equivariant Jet Taggers Learn?
comment: Accepted at the AI4Physics Workshop, ICML 2026. 21 pages, 15 figures
summary: We study what Lorentz-equivariant jet taggers learn internally, using equivariance tests, linear probes and grade ablations across five models including L-GATr, L-GATr-slim and LLoCa-T. Linear probes show that equivariant models suppress frame-dependent pseudorapidity to zero while encoding jet mass and N-subjettiness strongly. Grade ablations on L-GATr reveal that bivector channels are negligible for top-quark tagging while vector-like channels are dominant but seed variable, consistent with the network exploiting multiple representational pathways. These results characterize which physical features and algebraic grade structures carry discriminative information in equivariant taggers and may inform future development of such models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Lorentz等变喷注标记器（包括L-GATr、L-GATr-slim和LLoCa-T）的内部表征机制，通过等变性测试、线性探针和分级消融实验发现：等变模型会将依赖参考系的赝快度压制为零，同时编码喷注重量和N-subjettiness；在L-GATr中，双向量通道对顶夸克标记贡献可忽略，而矢量类通道占主导地位但依赖种子变量，表明网络利用了多重表征路径。
AI.motivation: 理解Lorentz等变喷注标记器的内部工作机制，揭示模型学习了哪些物理特征以及代数分级结构中的哪些成分携带判别信息，从而为未来等变模型的发展提供指导。
AI.method: 采用等变性测试、线性探针和分级消融实验，对L-GATr、L-GATr-slim和LLoCa-T五种模型进行分析。
AI.result: 等变模型抑制了依赖参考系的赝快度，有效编码了喷注重量和N-subjettiness；L-GATr中双向量通道对顶夸克标记贡献可忽略，矢量类通道占主导但依赖种子变量。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了等变喷注标记器中哪些物理特征和代数分级结构承载判别信息，为未来等变模型的设计与优化提供了参考。

title: Not All Claims Are Equally Risky: FACTOR for Adaptive Verification in Factual Long-Form Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate fluent long-form text, however, often add unsupported factual claims. Existing verification techniques improve factuality by grounding generation in external evidence. However, the same verification policy usually applies to all claims despite being differences in hallucination risks. We propose \textit{FACTOR} (\textit{FACTuality-Oriented Risk-aware Verification}), an inference-time model that adapts verification criteria according to claim-level uncertainty. FACTOR combines uncertainty estimation, adaptive language inference verification, and candidate re-ranking to allocate verification effort where it is most needed. We evaluate \textit{FACTOR} on FactScore benchmark showing that adaptive verification improves factuality while reducing verification cost simultaneously. We further perform different ablation studies to identify the primary driver of these gains. Our results show the effective and model-agnostic performance of \textit{FACTOR} for improving factuality in long-form generation.

AI.tldr: FACTOR是一种基于不确定性感知的自适应验证方法，能根据句子级幻觉风险动态调整验证策略，在提升长文本生成事实性的同时降低验证成本。
AI.motivation: 现有验证技术对所有事实性声明采用统一的验证策略，忽略了不同声明在幻觉风险上的差异，导致验证效率低下。
AI.method: FACTOR结合了不确定性估计（量化声明级不确定性）、自适应语言推理验证（根据不确定性动态调整验证标准）和候选重排序（优化输出质量），实现验证资源的按需分配。
AI.result: 在FactScore基准上，自适应验证在提升事实性的同时降低了验证成本；消融实验进一步识别了性能提升的主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: FACTOR是一种有效且模型无关的方法，能够改善长文本生成的事实性。

title: Discretizing Reward Models
summary: Despite their widespread use, the role of reward models in shaping reinforcement learning is poorly understood. Reward models offer a tempting promise: they automatically estimate response quality in the absence of verifiers or human judges. Unlike "verifiable rewards" which typically produce binary scores, reward models typically produce continuous scores, allowing them to be sensitive to fine-grained differences in responses. However, we show this apparent strength is a serious weakness: many popular reward models are oversensitive, assigning different scores to equally good responses. Theoretically, we show that seemingly perfect reward models can be highly oversensitive; empirically, this oversensitivity can lead to bad policies. In place of existing notions of "reward model accuracy," we propose evaluating reward models using distinct measures of "discriminative ability" and "specificity" (the complement of oversensitivity). As a solution, we describe a training-free algorithm that uses Monte Carlo dropout on any neural reward model to produce discrete reward clusters. Theoretically, we prove there exist discretizations that reduce oversensitivity at minimal expense of discriminative ability; empirically we show, in both controlled and natural RL settings, that discretizing rewards leads to less reward hacking and better policies than training on the original rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文发现奖励模型普遍存在过度敏感性问题（对同等质量的回答给出不同分数），并提出使用离散化奖励（基于蒙特卡洛dropout）来降低过度敏感性，从而减少奖励黑客行为并改进策略。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型在强化学习中广泛应用，但其作用机制尚不清晰。现有对奖励模型准确性的评估标准未能捕捉其关键缺陷，需要更合理的评估方法。
AI.method: 理论分析了完美奖励模型仍可能过度敏感；提出使用"判别能力"和"特异性"（过度敏感性的互补指标）来评估奖励模型；设计了一种无需训练的算法，通过对神经网络奖励模型应用蒙特卡洛dropout来生成离散奖励簇。
AI.result: 理论上证明了存在既能降低过度敏感性又能最小化判别能力损失的离散化方案；实验上在受控和自然RL环境中验证了离散化奖励可减少奖励黑客行为并得到更优策略。
AI.conclusion: 奖励模型的过度敏感性是严重缺陷，离散化奖励是一种有效且无需训练的解决方案，应使用判别能力和特异性替代传统准确率指标来评估奖励模型。

title: ROMEVA: Geometry-Preserving Vocabulary Expansion for Roman Urdu Language Models
summary: Multilingual Language Models like mBERT are widely used for low-resource NLP, yet their adaptation to morphologically inconsistent languages such as Roman Urdu remains underexplored. Roman Urdu spelling variation causes severe sub-word fragmentation, averaging 1.50 sub-words per token. We propose \textit{ROMEVA} (Roman Urdu Embedding-preserving Vocabulary Adaptation), which combines sub-word-average initialization and a PCA-guided anchor loss to stabilize embeddings during vocabulary expansion. Using a 36,130-comment Roman Urdu corpus, we add 500 highly fragmented tokens to mBERT and compare naive fine-tuning, sub-word-aware fine-tuning, and \textit{ROMEVA}. While \textit{ROMEVA} most effectively preserves the pretrained embedding space, naive fine-tuning achieves the strongest downstream sentiment classification performance. These findings reveal a disconnect between embedding stability and downstream performance, suggesting that stronger adaptation may be preferable to strict embedding preservation in morphologically inconsistent languages.

AI.tldr: 针对罗马乌尔都语拼写不一致导致的子词碎片化问题，提出ROMEVA方法进行词汇自适应扩展，发现嵌入空间保持与下游性能存在脱节，强适应优于严格保持。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型（如mBERT）在形态不一致语言（如罗马乌尔都语）上的适应性问题尚未充分探索，尤其是拼写变异导致的子词碎片化严重影响模型性能。
AI.method: 提出ROMEVA方法，结合子词平均初始化与PCA引导的锚定损失，在36,130条评论的罗马乌尔都语语料上，向mBERT添加500个高频碎片化token，并与朴素微调、子词感知微调进行对比。
AI.result: ROMEVA最有效地保持了预训练嵌入空间，但朴素微调在下游情感分类任务上取得了最强性能。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间稳定性与下游性能之间存在脱节，在形态不一致语言中，更强的适应（而非严格的嵌入保持）可能更优。

title: Causal Variational Deep Embedding: A Family of Interventional Generators for Confounded Images
summary: Deep generative models reproduce the observational distribution of their training data, inheriting any spurious associations it contains. A common source is an unobserved confounder that shapes both an attribute the user wants to control at sampling time and an attribute expected to vary in response. Existing causal generative approaches resolve the resulting ambiguity by imposing structural assumptions strong enough to single out one interventional distribution; in image domains, such assumptions are rarely warranted, and the data is generally consistent with a set of distinct causal mechanisms -- a feasible region of interventional distributions. We propose CauVaDE (Causal Variational Deep Embedding), built on a canonical augmented SCM in which the unobserved confounder collapses, without loss of generality, into a discrete latent cluster of bounded support while continuous variation is absorbed into independent noises. We prove that this canonical class is dense, in both observational and interventional Wasserstein distance, in the class of augmented SCMs compatible with a given causal diagram, and instantiate it as a mixture variational autoencoder whose cluster variable plays the role of the canonical confounder. An entropy regularizer with weight $γ$ on the cluster posterior then traces a family of candidate causal effects that fit the observational data to comparable likelihood while spanning the feasible region. Experiments on image data benchmarks show that CauVaDE produces diverse interventional samples and improves FID against an unconfounded reference.

AI.tldr: CauVaDE提出了一种基于规范增广SCM的因果变分深度嵌入方法，通过离散潜聚类变量吸收未观测混杂因子，利用熵正则化器在可行因果效应区域中采样，在图像数据上生成多样化干预样本并改善FID。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型会继承训练数据中的虚假关联，其中常见来源是未观测混杂因子同时影响用户希望在采样时控制的属性和期望变化的属性。现有因果生成方法需要强结构假设来唯一确定干预分布，但在图像领域中这些假设难以成立，数据通常与一组不同的因果机制一致。
AI.method: 提出CauVaDE，基于规范增广SCM，将未观测混杂因子无损地坍缩为具有有界支撑的离散潜聚类变量，连续变化吸收为独立噪声。证明该规范类在观测和干预Wasserstein距离下稠密。实例化为混合变分自编码器，聚类变量扮演规范混杂因子角色，在聚类后验上使用γ权重的熵正则化器，在可行区域中追踪一系列候选因果效应。
AI.result: 在图像数据基准上，CauVaDE生成了多样化的干预样本，并相对于未混杂参照改善了FID指标。
AI.conclusion: CauVaDE能够在无需强结构假设的情况下，有效处理图像数据中的未观测混杂问题，生成可行的干预分布，为因果生成建模提供了理论保证和实用方法。

title: Breaking the Likelihood Trap: Variance-Calibrated Modulation for Large Language Model Decoding
summary: In open-ended generation, LLMs frequently fall into the "likelihood trap", marked by repetitive degeneration and vocabulary dullness, creating a discrepancy between machine-generated and human-written text. While post-hoc tail truncation (e.g., Top-$p$, Min-$p$) avoids sampling from the unreliable tail, it can over-sample from the uncalibrated head and misalign generation with human lexical preferences; fixed scalar repetition penalties likewise ignore variation in logit scale across inference steps, potentially disrupting semantic coherence. To address both limitations, we propose Variance-Calibrated Modulation (VCM), a training-free pre-decoding intervention that reshapes the probability distribution before truncation through two dynamic mechanisms: (1) Contextual Searchlight via PMI, which suppresses global stopwords while elevating context-evoked tokens, and (2) Adaptive Self-Debiasing, which uses real-time logit standard deviation for scale-invariant penalization. Across open-ended generation, factual QA, and mathematical reasoning, VCM consistently mitigates the likelihood trap. With negligible computational overhead, VCM integrates with existing decoding strategies, improving diversity, coherence, and, particularly at higher decoding temperatures, reasoning accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出VCM（方差校准调制），一种无需训练的解码前干预方法，通过两类动态机制（基于PMI的上下文聚光灯和自适应自去偏）重塑概率分布，缓解大模型在开放生成中的"似然陷阱"问题，提升生成多样性、连贯性和推理准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM在开放生成中常陷入"似然陷阱"，表现为重复退化和词汇贫乏，导致机器生成文本与人类写作存在差异。现有后验截断方法（如Top-p、Min-p）会过度采样未校准的头部概率分布，与人类词汇偏好不一致；固定标量的重复惩罚则忽略推理步间logit尺度的变化，可能破坏语义连贯性。
AI.method: 提出VCM，一种无需训练的解码前干预方法，在截断前通过两种动态机制重塑概率分布：(1) 基于PMI的上下文聚光灯，抑制全局停用词同时提升上下文诱发词；(2) 自适应自去偏，利用实时logit标准差实现尺度不变的惩罚。
AI.result: 在开放生成、事实性QA和数学推理任务上，VCM持续缓解了似然陷阱。计算开销可忽略，能集成到现有解码策略中，提升多样性、连贯性，尤其在高温解码时提高推理准确性。
AI.conclusion: VCM通过动态、尺度感知的概率分布校正，有效解决了后验截断和固定惩罚的局限性，是一种轻量而有效的解码增强方法。

title: Causal Gaussian Processes for Robust Treatment Effect Evaluation with Unobserved Confounding
summary: The presence of confounding bias poses a key challenge in policy evaluation, as the target causal effects of actions are not identifiable (i.e., underdetermined) from observational data. On the other hand, existing confounding-robust evaluation strategies require detailed prior knowledge about the environment or apply only to discrete treatments and outcomes. This paper investigates causal effect evaluation over the continuous domain from confounded observations, while requiring only basic temporal ordering between the treatment and the outcome. We introduce a universal discretization of the exogenous domains that approximates the observational and interventional distributions of any causal model with arbitrary accuracy using a finite number of latent states. Building on this newfound universal approximation property, we develop a novel family of Causal Gaussian process (CGP) models that effectively approximate the observational and interventional distributions of any causal model with confounded observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的因果高斯过程（CGP）模型族，通过对外生域进行通用离散化，在仅需治疗与结果间基本时间顺序的条件下，实现对连续域上混杂观测数据的因果效应评估，且能以任意精度逼近任何因果模型中的观测分布和干预分布。
AI.motivation: 现有的混杂鲁棒评估策略要么需要详细的先验环境知识，要么仅适用于离散治疗和结果，而连续域上的因果效应评估受混杂偏差影响难以识别。本文旨在克服这些限制，在无需详细先验知识的前提下实现连续域的因果效应评估。
AI.method: 提出一种外生域的通用离散化方法，利用有限数量的潜在状态以任意精度逼近任何因果模型的观测分布和干预分布；在此基础上，开发了一种新的因果高斯过程（CGP）模型族，有效逼近混杂观测下的因果模型。
AI.result: 所提出的离散化方案具有通用逼近性质，CGP模型族能够在仅需治疗与结果间基本时间顺序的条件下，有效逼近混杂观测数据下的观测分布和干预分布。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为连续域上的混杂因果效应评估提供了一种新的通用框架，降低了对先验知识的依赖，拓展了混杂鲁棒策略的适用范围。

title: Look Light, Think Heavy: What Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Can and Cannot Do
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has become a standard method for improving reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) by eliciting step-by-step thinking, but its effectiveness in multimodal tasks remains unclear. In this paper, we aim to systematically investigate the key question: What can multimodal Chain-of-Thought reasoning do, and where and why does it fall short? To this end, we evaluate 12 multimodal tasks across perception and reasoning categories using both 14 non-reasoning models and 8 reasoning models. Our analysis reveals several important findings: (1) CoT is not a free lunch and should be used selectively depending on the specific requirements of each task. For perception tasks, CoT can lead to undesirable side effects, such as reduced performance in visual grounding and object counting. In contrast, it proves effective for reasoning tasks involving mathematical, scientific, and multi-image reasoning; (2) Compared to original models, existing open-source multimodal reasoning models often yield only marginal overall improvements, possibly due to an overemphasis on mathematical reasoning at the expense of broader capabilities; (3) Visual reasoning remains a key bottleneck for current multimodal CoT, as models exhibit a Look Light, Think Heavy pattern where verbal reflection rises and falls during reasoning, whereas visual reflection consistently diminishes. These findings suggest that while multimodal CoT handles verbal reflection relatively well, it lacks the ability to maintain deep visual introspection throughout the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态思维链（CoT）推理的能力边界与局限性，发现CoT在感知任务中会产生负面效果，而在数学、科学和多图像推理等复杂推理任务中有效；现有开源多模态推理模型提升有限且过度偏重数学推理；视觉推理是当前多模态CoT的主要瓶颈，存在"看浅想深"模式，即语言反思能力保持但视觉反思能力持续下降。
AI.motivation: CoT在纯文本推理中已成为标准方法，但在多模态任务中的有效性尚不清楚。本文旨在系统探究多模态CoT推理能做什么、在哪些场景失效及其根本原因。
AI.method: 在12个涵盖感知和推理类别的多模态任务上，使用14个非推理模型和8个推理模型进行系统评估与对比分析。
AI.result: (1) CoT在感知任务中会降低性能（如视觉定位、物体计数），但在数学、科学、多图像推理任务中有效；(2) 现有开源多模态推理模型相比原始模型提升有限，过度偏重数学推理导致其他能力受损；(3) 视觉推理是核心瓶颈，模型呈现"看浅想深"模式，语言反思能力保持而视觉反思能力持续下降。
AI.conclusion: 多模态CoT应选择性使用，不能一概而论；当前多模态CoT虽能较好处理语言反思，但缺乏在整个推理过程中维持深度视觉内省的能力，视觉推理是亟需突破的方向。

title: Local Causal Attribution of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
comment: Camera-ready version for the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026. 37 pages, 18 figures
summary: Understanding the causal structure of a language model's thought process is a problem of significant importance for both transparency and safety. In this work, we take a local approach toward this goal by analyzing the causal relationships among individual components, termed units, of a given, specific chain-of-thought trace. We construct a structural causal model on these units and relate each unit to the log probability of generating (subsequent) output units. Our algorithm, termed AttriCoT, is a black-box method that performs attribution by estimating importance parameters in the structural causal model using $O(U)$ forward passes through the model, where $U$ is the number of units. Evaluation of perturbation curves across 5 datasets and 4 reasoning models shows that AttriCoT produces attributions that are more faithful to the model's behavior than alternative methods. The attribution results also reveal notable differences in thought structure between models and domains.

AI.tldr: 提出AttriCoT方法，通过构建结构因果模型对思维链中各单元进行因果归因，仅需O(U)次前向传播即可得到比现有方法更忠实的归因结果，并揭示不同模型和领域在思维结构上的差异。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型思维过程的因果结构对透明度和安全性至关重要，现有方法缺乏对思维链中细粒度组件的因果归因分析。
AI.method: 将思维链各组件（单元）构建为结构因果模型，将每个单元与生成后续输出单元的log概率相关联，通过O(U)次前向传播估计因果模型中的重要性参数，实现黑盒归因。
AI.result: 在5个数据集和4个推理模型上的评估表明，AttriCoT产生的归因结果比替代方法更忠实于模型行为，且归因结果揭示了模型和领域间显著的思维结构差异。
AI.conclusion: AttriCoT能有效归因思维链中各单元对模型输出的因果贡献，为理解语言模型的内部推理机制提供了新工具。

title: What are Key Factors for Updates in RL for LLM Reasoning?
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising framework for enhancing the reasoning ability of large language models. However, much of the existing work is guided by heuristic intuition, leading to divergent algorithmic choices, even contradictory ones that nevertheless report empirical gains. To better understand this phenomenon, we conduct a theoretical analysis of RLVR updates. Our study reveals that differences in off-policy degree, determined by the number of gradient steps per rollout, substantially affect the distribution of importance sampling ratios and their clipping behavior, thereby altering which tokens dominate the update. Building on this insight, we characterize gradient expectation as the central quantity governing update dynamics and analyze the roles of token probability, advantage, and importance sampling ratio. Motivated by these findings, we propose Adaptive Clip Policy Optimization (ACPO), which adjusts clipping boundaries across token groups according to the empirical variance of their importance sampling ratios. Experiments on 3B and 7B models across diverse reasoning benchmarks, spanning mathematical problem solving, tabular QA, and logic puzzles, demonstrate that ACPO outperforms strong baselines such as DAPO and CISPO. These results demonstrate that principled, analysis-driven approaches yield more robust and effective RLVR methods. Code is available in: https://github.com/Control-derek/ACPO

AI.tldr: 本文对基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行了理论分析，揭示了离策略程度（每轮梯度步数）通过影响重要性采样比分布及裁剪行为来改变更新主导令牌。据此提出自适应裁剪策略优化（ACPO），根据令牌组间重要性采样比的经验方差调整裁剪边界，在3B和7B模型的数学推理、表格问答和逻辑谜题等基准上超越DAPO和CISPO等强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法多依赖启发式直觉，导致算法选择分歧甚至相互矛盾却能取得经验增益，缺乏统一的理论理解。本文旨在通过理论分析揭示RLVR更新的内在机制，解释不同算法选择为何有效，并据此设计更稳健的方法。
AI.method: 首先从理论上分析RLVR更新，发现离策略程度（每轮梯度步数）影响重要性采样比分布和裁剪行为，进而改变主导更新的令牌。将梯度期望作为核心量，分析令牌概率、优势函数和重要性采样比的作用。基于此提出ACPO，根据令牌组间重要性采样比的经验方差自适应调整裁剪边界。
AI.result: 在3B和7B模型上，针对数学问题求解、表格QA和逻辑谜题等多样化推理基准，ACPO优于DAPO和CISPO等强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于原理的分析驱动方法能够产生更鲁棒且有效的RLVR方法，为强化学习提升大模型推理能力提供了理论指导。

title: Mat-Pref: Verifiable-Reward Training Improves Compositional Reasoning in Inorganic Materials
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, Accepted at ICML AI4Physics 2026 Workshop
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven rapid progress in mathematical and code reasoning, but when extended to science, existing benchmarks do not decompose what generalizes: do gains reflect structural transfer, property transfer, or memorization? We introduce Mat-Pref, a benchmark of 10,837 ionic-substitution questions across 11 inorganic structure families, grounded in density functional theory calculations from the Materials Project, with three evaluation splits that isolate in-distribution performance, generalization to entirely held-out structure families, and cross-property transfer: applying band-gap reasoning to hosts seen during training only through formation-energy supervision. Four zero-shot frontier models (70-671B parameters) remain in the 33-54% range on every split, confirming that scale alone does not resolve the compositional chemical reasoning this task demands. A two-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) lifts Qwen3-8B to 65.2% in-distribution and 71.6% on held-out families, exceeding zero-shot Qwen3-235B by over 20 percentage points on both structural-generalization splits. Self-consistency sampling shows that the SFT policy can already produce correct answers but cannot reliably surface them as the modal response; GRPO reshapes the distribution so that correct answers become modal rather than merely reachable, and this sharper commitment is visible mechanistically: logit lens analysis reveals a ${\sim}$20pp advantage in answer crystallization at the critical decision layer. We formalize this observation as a distractor-permutation consistency metric under which GRPO narrows the gap between lenient scoring (at least one permutation correct) and strict scoring (all permutations correct) from 24.0 to 14.3 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mat-Pref基准（10,837个离子替换问题，11种无机结构家族），系统评估RLVR在科学推理中的泛化能力。实验表明，零样本大模型（70-671B参数）在所有分片上仅达33-54%；两阶段pipeline（SFT+GRPO）将Qwen3-8B提升至65.2%（分布内）和71.6%（留出结构家族），超越零样本Qwen3-235B超20个百分点。机制分析发现GRPO通过重塑输出分布使正确答案从"可达"变为"模态"，在关键决策层带来约20pp的答案结晶优势，并通过干扰项排列一致性指标（从24.0pp降至14.3pp）形式化此观察。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR在数学和代码推理上取得进展，但扩展到科学领域时，现有基准无法分解增益来源——究竟是结构迁移、属性迁移还是记忆化？缺乏一个能够系统隔离这三种泛化类型的科学推理基准。
AI.method: 构建Mat-Pref基准（10,837个离子替换问题×11种结构家族，基于Materials Project的DFT计算数据），设计三种评估分片：分布内、留出结构家族（结构迁移）、跨属性迁移（带隙推理→仅见过形成能监督的主机）。采用两阶段pipeline：SFT + GRPO，并利用logit lens和干扰项排列一致性指标进行机制分析。
AI.result: 零样本模型（70-671B参数）仅33-54%；SFT+GRPO将Qwen3-8B提升至65.2%（分布内）和71.6%（留出家族），超越零样本Qwen3-235B超20pp。GRPO使正确答案从"可达"变为"模态"，在关键决策层产生约20pp答案结晶优势，干扰项排列一致性从24.0pp降至14.3pp。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠模型规模无法解决组合化学推理；SFT+GRPO两阶段pipeline在科学推理中有效；GRPO的核心机制在于重塑输出分布使正确答案成为模态响应，而非仅使其可达；干扰项排列一致性指标可形式化这种分布收紧效应。

title: Context-Aware Distillation and Ablation for Text2DSL
summary: We extend our prior work on Text2DSL automatic generation of domain-specific language (DSL) code from natural language descriptions along two complementary axes. First, we replace prompt-only synthetic generation with context-aware distillation, in which a teacher large language model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) operates under an explicitly defined structured context comprising a BNF grammar, an API specification, and a closed identifier vocabulary; the resulting corpus is verified by a two-tier pipeline combining AST validation through esprima and runtime acceptance through the production polkitd daemon and the pkcheck client. This scales the verified PolkitBench corpus from 4,204 to 10,073 natural-language-to-Polkit-rule pairs at 100.0% AST validity and 99.7% runtime pass rate. Second, we conduct the per-component factorial ablation of structured context that was identified as future work in the precursor study: eight conditions C0-C7 are evaluated on GigaChat-10B-A1.8B with the new corpus. Three findings emerge. (i) The new harder corpus collapses the baseline mode (Syntax Valid 97.6% -> 58.5%, Combined Score 0.482 -> 0.252), whereas the context-enhanced mode degrades only marginally (Syntax 98.6% -> 97.4%, Combined 0.801 -> 0.750), confirming that structured context is not a cosmetic improvement but a load-bearing mechanism. (ii) The best absolute condition is the full context C7 across all metrics, while the strongest partial conditions (C5 = BNF + Vocabulary, C6 = API + Vocabulary) both contain the vocabulary. (iii) A Shapley-style decomposition assigns the largest semantic-quality effect to the vocabulary (Combined +0.198), the largest structural-validity effects to API (+24.7 pp) and BNF (+22.3 pp).

AI.tldr: 本文在Text2DSL方向上将提示词合成升级为上下文感知蒸馏，构建了包含BNF语法、API规范和封闭词汇表的结构化上下文，将PolkitBench语料库从4,204扩展到10,073条，并进行了八种结构化上下文组件的消融实验。结果表明：结构化上下文是承载性能的关键机制而非锦上添花；完整上下文C7在所有指标上最优，词汇表对语义质量贡献最大（Combined +0.198），API和BNF分别对结构有效性贡献+24.7pp和+22.3pp。
AI.motivation: 在Text2DSL领域，现有基于纯提示词合成的方法缺乏结构化指导，生成质量受限；前序工作遗留了结构化上下文各组件的消融分析作为未来工作，本文旨在填补这一空白，系统评估BNF语法、API规范和封闭词汇表各自及组合对DSL代码生成的影响。
AI.method: 提出上下文感知蒸馏框架：使用教师大模型DeepSeek-V4-Flash，在显式定义的结构化上下文（BNF语法+API规范+封闭词汇表）指导下生成自然语言到Polkit规则对的语料；两级验证流水线（esprima AST验证+pkcheck运行时验证）确保质量；在GigaChat-10B-A1.8B上对八种条件（C0-C7）进行逐组件因子消融实验，并采用Shapley值分解量化各组件贡献。
AI.result: 语料库规模从4,204扩展到10,073条，AST有效性100.0%，运行时通过率99.7%。消融实验显示：基线模式在新语料上Syntax Valid从97.6%降至58.5%，Combined Score从0.482降至0.252；而上下文增强模式仅从98.6%降至97.4%，Combined从0.801降至0.750。最佳条件为完整上下文C7，词汇表对语义质量贡献最大（Combined +0.198），API对结构有效性贡献+24.7pp，BNF贡献+22.3pp。
AI.conclusion: 结构化上下文不是微调性改进而是关键承载机制；词汇表是语义质量的核心组件，API和BNF是结构有效性的主要贡献者；完整上下文（语法+API+词汇表）是最优配置，为Text2DSL的上下文设计提供了定量指导。

title: UniRank: Unified Rank Allocation for Low-Rank LLM Compression
summary: Low-rank decomposition serves as a promising compression paradigm for large language models, however, rank allocation remains challenging: manual rules lack generalizability, and learning-based approaches incur heavy computational overhead. To address these issues, we formulate global low-rank allocation as a sorting-and-truncation pipeline, and score each singular component via dual criteria: \textbf{Local} singular energy ratio that quantifies the intrinsic importance within the decomposed parameter matrix and \textbf{Global} functional importance (measured by input-output cosine similarity) that evaluates the functional significance of decomposed modules. We verify the strong correlation between high input-output cosine similarity and low effective rank through geometric interpretation and experimental validation. Furthermore, we propose rank-preserving fine-tuning, which performs direct LoRA tuning on decomposed weights and avoids extra information loss caused by re-truncation in conventional merging pipelines. Empirical results confirm that our method delivers sustained performance enhancements when combined with models featuring distinct decomposition schemes, model sizes and architectural designs, e.g. in one-shot compression without further fine-tuning, our method reduces perplexity by up to 50\% compared with uniform and heuristic allocation baselines. Code will be available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双重重要性评分（局部奇异能量比和全局输入-输出余弦相似度）的低秩分解全局秩分配方法，通过排序-截断流水线实现LLM压缩，并设计了保秩微调策略避免信息损失，在多种模型上均取得显著困惑度下降。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩分解中秩分配存在两难：手工规则缺乏泛化性，学习方法计算开销大。需要一种既高效又具有泛化能力的全局秩分配方法。
AI.method: 1) 将全局低秩分配建模为排序-截断流水线；2) 提出双重评分标准：局部奇异能量比（衡量参数矩阵内重要性）+ 全局功能重要性（输入-输出余弦相似度，衡量模块功能重要性）；3) 通过几何解释和实验验证高余弦相似度与低有效秩的强相关性；4) 提出保秩微调，在分解权重上直接进行LoRA调优，避免传统合并流水线中重截断导致的信息损失。
AI.result: 在无需进一步微调的一次压缩下，与均匀分配和启发式基线相比，困惑度降低高达50%；与具有不同分解方案、模型规模和架构设计的模型结合时，均能持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 双重评分标准有效指导了低秩分解中的全局秩分配，保秩微调进一步提升了压缩后模型性能，方法具有良好的泛化性和实用性。

title: Sub-Billion, Super-Frontier: Small Language Models Rival Zero-Shot Frontier LLMs on General and Literary Relation Extraction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong relation extraction (RE), but their computational demands and reliance on proprietary APIs limit deployment in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive settings. We investigate how far small language models (SLMs) can close this gap across general-domain and literary text. We evaluate five models from 360M to 3B parameters under three domain-composition regimes and two prompt-conditioned tuning styles (30 configurations), comparing them with zero-shot frontier LLMs and a discriminative RoBERTa baseline. Across nine benchmarks, the best sub-billion model, Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned on pooled general-domain data, achieves a general-domain positive-class micro-F1 of 0.83, versus 0.69 for GPT-5.4 and 0.66 for Claude Sonnet 4.6 evaluated zero-shot. This does not imply that SLMs are intrinsically stronger; rather, targeted task adaptation enables 4-bit models deployable on a single consumer GPU to outperform general-purpose frontier systems under this protocol. An in-domain RoBERTa baseline also exceeds both frontier models, indicating that the gain stems from task adaptation rather than generative decoding. On literary RE, tuned SLMs reach 0.92 on the human-annotated Biographical benchmark versus 0.83 for GPT-5.4, and 0.833 versus 0.578 on the two-benchmark literary average. A targeted domain-adaptive pretraining case study yields no practically meaningful gain over supervised fine-tuning, while the cleanest within-family scale comparison shows only marginal improvement. These results show that, when task-specific data are available, compact task-adapted models can provide accurate, private, and hardware-efficient RE.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了小语言模型（SLMs，参数范围360M到3B）在关系抽取任务中的表现，发现经过领域特定微调的子十亿参数模型（Qwen2.5-0.5B）在通用领域和文学文本的关系抽取中均能超越零样本的前沿大语言模型（如GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6），并论证了任务自适应带来的增益主要源于监督微调而非生成式解码或规模扩展。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在关系抽取中表现强劲，但其计算开销和对专有API的依赖限制了在资源受限或隐私敏感场景中的部署。本文旨在探究小语言模型能否通过任务自适应缩小这一差距，从而实现准确、隐私且硬件高效的关系抽取。
AI.method: 在通用领域和文学文本两种场景下，评估5个参数从360M到3B的SLMs，设置3种领域组合方式和2种提示条件微调风格（共30种配置），与零样本的前沿LLMs及判别式RoBERTa基线对比，并在领域自适应预训练和同族模型规模比较上做消融研究。
AI.result: 最佳子十亿模型Qwen2.5-0.5B在通用领域正类微F1达0.83，远超GPT-5.4（0.69）和Claude Sonnet 4.6（0.66）；文学RE上达0.92（Biographical基准）和0.833（两基准文学平均），优于GPT-5.4的0.83和0.578。领域自适应预训练无明显增益，同族规模比较仅边际改进。
AI.conclusion: 当任务特定数据可用时，经过任务自适应微调的紧凑型模型能够在保持高精度的同时满足隐私保护和硬件效率需求，SLMs的性能优势来源于任务自适应而非模型规模或生成式解码。

title: WiSP: A Working-Set View of Mixture-of-Experts Serving on Extremely Low-Resource Hardware
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Preprint, work in progress
summary: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models place most of their parameters in expert layers, yet only a small fraction of those experts are used for any token. The unused weights must still be stored where the GPU can reach them. On commodity GPUs the common fix is layer-level CPU offloading, which keeps memory low but streams all of a layer's experts across PCIe on every forward pass, losing much of MoE's sparsity benefit. We cast low-resource MoE serving as a working-set management problem on the GPU: routed expert weights and the key-value (KV) cache are two streams of memory demand competing for limited VRAM. We realize this in WiSP (Working-Set Paging), a routing-aware expert pager that plugs into an unmodified serving engine with byte-identical outputs. Keeping resident only the experts a workload reuses, WiSP reaches up to 1.95x the decode throughput of static offload at the same memory budget when the model does not fit. We also find that prefetching experts from predicted routing helps little in single-stream decode: the bottleneck is PCIe bandwidth, not prediction accuracy. This shifts the question from prefetching to allocation: how should VRAM be split between experts and the KV cache? We answer with MV-WSA (Marginal-Value Working-Set Allocation), which equalizes marginal latency benefit per byte subject to a KV admission floor. MV-WSA runs either as an offline configurator or as an online controller that resizes both pools while serving. In real serving the offline configurator is the only policy we test that does well on both prefill and decode; in trace-driven simulation it stays within a few percent of a per-workflow oracle while fixed splits are about 20% worse. The online controller adds a further 1.20x without changing model outputs.

AI.tldr: WiSP是一种路由感知的专家分页系统，通过将MoE模型中的专家权重和KV缓存视为两个竞争GPU显存的工作集，实现了低资源下的高效服务。它引入MV-WSA分配策略，在离线配置和在线控制下均能显著提升吞吐量，最高可达1.95倍。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE模型虽然参数多存储在专家层，但每个token只使用少量专家，而未被使用的权重仍需存储在GPU可达的位置。常用的层级CPU卸载方案虽然内存占用低，但每次前向传播都要将所有专家通过PCIe传输，丧失了MoE的稀疏性优势。如何在不牺牲稀疏性收益的前提下，在有限显存中高效管理专家权重和KV缓存之间的竞争，是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 将低资源MoE服务建模为GPU上的工作集管理问题，提出WiSP（Working-Set Paging）——一种路由感知的专家分页器，可直接插入未修改的服务引擎，保持输出字节一致。仅保留工作负载重复使用的专家驻留显存。同时提出MV-WSA（边际价值工作集分配），通过均衡专家和KV缓存的边际延迟收益每字节，在KV准入下限约束下进行显存分配。MV-WSA可作为离线配置器或在线控制器运行。
AI.result: 在相同内存预算下，WiSP的decode吞吐量可达静态卸载的1.95倍。在真实服务中，离线配置器是唯一在prefill和decode上均表现良好的策略；在轨迹驱动模拟中，其性能与每个工作流的oracle相差仅几个百分点，而固定分割方案差约20%。在线控制器额外带来1.20倍提升，且不改变模型输出。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明低资源MoE服务的瓶颈在于PCIe带宽而非路由预测精度，因此问题从专家预取转向显存分配。WiSP和MV-WSA通过工作集管理与边际价值分配，有效解决了专家与KV缓存间的显存竞争问题，无需修改模型或服务引擎即可显著提升吞吐量。

title: Orthogonal Representation Editing: Decoupling Semantic Entanglement in Batch Knowledge Editing of LLMs
summary: Knowledge editing aims to efficiently update factual information in Large Language Models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, existing methods still suffer from performance degradation in batch knowledge editing. We identify that semantic representation entanglement, such as overlapping concepts and shared syntactic patterns, accumulates interference in the representation space and reduces editing precision. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we propose Orthogonal Representation Editing (ORE), which performs edits in the hidden representation space of LLMs by constructing a general semantic subspace and enforcing orthogonal constraints on edit vectors, effectively decoupling semantic entanglement. Furthermore, we introduce a gated non-linear representation head to enable adaptive learning of editing locations and precise control over knowledge injection. Extensive experiments show that ORE outperforms existing methods and achieves superior performance in cross-lingual knowledge editing scenarios. We release our code at https://github.com/YVVH/ORE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正交表示编辑（ORE）方法，通过构建通用语义子空间并对编辑向量施加正交约束，解决大语言模型批量知识编辑中语义表示纠缠导致的性能下降问题；同时引入门控非线性表示头实现编辑位置的自适应学习与知识注入的精确控制，在跨语言知识编辑场景中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法在批量编辑时性能严重下降，根源在于语义表示纠缠（如概念重叠和共享句法模式）在表示空间中累积干扰，降低了编辑精度。
AI.method: 提出正交表示编辑（ORE）：1）在LLM隐藏表示空间中构建通用语义子空间；2）对编辑向量施加正交约束以解耦语义纠缠；3）引入门控非线性表示头，自适应学习编辑位置并精确控制知识注入。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ORE在批量知识编辑和跨语言知识编辑场景中均优于现有方法，达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过正交约束解耦语义纠缠是提升批量知识编辑精度的有效途径，门控机制能进一步实现编辑位置的自适应选择与精确知识注入。

title: Protein contacts are already in the attention: a single-forward-pass alternative to the Categorical Jacobian
summary: The Categorical Jacobian (CJ) of Zhang et al. (2024) reads protein contacts from a language model by perturbing every residue with every alternative amino acid, about 19L forward passes. We show the signal it reconstructs is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads: averaging the top-K contact-relevant heads, selected on as few as 10 labeled proteins, recovers contacts in one forward pass and beats CJ on leakage-clean data for every bidirectional model where CJ is defined, and matches or beats it in-distribution (the exceptions being the smallest 8M model and a statistical tie on ESM Cambrian). Ablations localize the gain to labeled head selection, not averaging: at a matched label budget the unweighted mean ties a supervised L1 logistic regression on the same heads, so the parameter-free mean is selection's minimal form, not the source of the advantage. Our primary test is leakage-clean: on a CAMEO split where neither selection nor evaluation touches data the models have plausibly memorized, the head readout beats CJ on ESM-2-650M by +9 pp (N=29, p<0.001), with the within-model margin reproducing across architectures on a wider pretraining-aware set. Both methods fall 30-36 percentage points from their in-distribution Zhang numbers to the leakage-clean numbers, consistent with substantial pretraining overlap inflating prior numbers (a CAMEO-vs-Zhang difficulty shift contributes too, so we read it as an upper bound on the leakage component). We additionally introduce representation-CJ, a hidden-state generalization of the Jacobian for architectures without a masked-LM head; show that the optimal K tracks how diffusely a model spreads its contact heads; and find that both methods lose the contact signal on both causal LMs we test (ProGen2), suggesting attention-encoded pair structure may depend on bidirectional pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Categorical Jacobian方法从蛋白质语言模型中读取接触信息的信号主要集中在一小部分注意力头上。通过在有标签的少量蛋白质上选择Top-K接触相关头并取平均，可在一次前向传播中恢复接触信息，在无泄漏数据上超越CJ方法。最优K值反映了模型扩散接触头的程度，且两种方法在单向因果LM（ProGen2）上均失效，表明注意力编码的配对结构可能依赖双向预训练。
AI.motivation: Zhang等人(2024)的CJ方法需要约19L次前向传播来读取蛋白质接触信息，计算成本高。本文旨在验证该信号是否集中在少量注意力头上，从而开发更高效的方法。
AI.method: 选取Top-K接触相关注意力头（仅需10个标签蛋白），取均值即可在一次前向传播中恢复接触信息。在无泄漏的CAMEO数据集上评估，并与CJ方法对比。此外引入representation-CJ作为无掩码LM头架构的隐状态泛化版本。
AI.result: 头部读取方法在ESM-2-650M上以+9pp超越CJ（N=29, p<0.001），且在不同架构上复现。两种方法从分布内到无泄漏设置均下降30-36个百分点，表明预训练重叠显著夸大了先前结果。两种方法在ProGen2（单向因果LM）上均丢失接触信号。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头选择而非平均化是优势来源；无参数均值是选择的最小形式。最优K值反映模型接触头的扩散程度。注意力编码的配对结构可能依赖双向预训练。

title: Only Ask What You Don't Know: Grounded Delta Planning for Efficient Multi-step RAG
summary: Multi-hop question answering remains challenging for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) because existing approaches either propagate errors across iterative retrieval rounds or over-generate reasoning steps, increasing cost without improving accuracy. We propose Grounded Delta Planning RAG (GDP-RAG), a plan-based framework that targets only the information delta based on three simple design choices: (1) preliminary retrieval to ground planning before execution, (2) a gap-conditioned planning prompt that asks only for missing information, and (3) a skeletal trajectory that pairs each subquery with a Thought capturing evidence from preliminary retrieval and carrying it through to the final answer. GDP-RAG focuses computation on unresolved gaps, yielding concise, reliable reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue show that GDP-RAG achieves the highest accuracy (60.63%) among all compared systems while maintaining a cost-of-pass of 0.51, 22% lower than PAR-RAG (0.65) and 68% lower than KnowTrace (1.57), with no method achieving both higher accuracy and lower cost.

AI.tldr: GDP-RAG是一个基于规划的检索增强生成框架，通过三个关键设计（初步检索锚定规划、缺口条件提示、骨架轨迹）聚焦信息增量，在多跳问答中以最低成本实现最高准确率（60.63%），成本效益比显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在多跳问答中面临两难：迭代检索会传播错误，而过度生成推理步骤则增加成本却不提升准确率。需要一种既能减少错误传播又能控制成本的方法。
AI.method: 提出GDP-RAG，基于三个设计选择：(1)初步检索在执行规划前先锚定已知信息；(2)缺口条件规划提示只询问缺失信息；(3)骨架轨迹将每个子查询与Thought配对，携带初步检索证据直达最终答案。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上，GDP-RAG达到最高准确率60.63%，同时保持0.51的cost-of-pass，比PAR-RAG低22%，比KnowTrace低68%。
AI.conclusion: GDP-RAG通过聚焦未解决的信息缺口，生成简洁可靠的推理轨迹，在准确率和成本之间取得了最优平衡，没有其他方法能同时实现更高的准确率和更低的成本。

title: A Verifiable Search Is Not a Learnable Chain-of-Thought
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables; Interactive walkthrough: https://nemotron.harshpatel.live ; Code, solvers, and per-row eval data: https://github.com/harshpatel1692/search-not-learnable
summary: It is tempting to assume any task solvable by a short program can be taught to a model as its chain-of-thought: write the steps out, fine-tune, and the model follows. This paper shows the assumption fails for an identifiable class of procedures. The testbed is nine reasoning tasks, each from a deterministic generator; public and hidden splits share generators, so held-out data proxies test accuracy. I reverse-engineer the generators into Python solvers, render them as chain-of-thought, and distill into a rank-<= 32 LoRA over a 30B (3.5B-active) Nemotron model. Forward-computable tasks install readily: lookup/arithmetic and an 8-bit boolean task transfer (>= 0.99 and 0.68). Cryptarithm does not: distilling its backtracking search holds at 0.01-0.07 across eleven chain-of-thought designs, RL from verifiable rewards, and self-training, even though a search solver answers 71% of instances. This is not a capability gap. The model does the arithmetic on 97-100% of lines and ranks the correct cipher in its top eight on 71%; it cannot carry the search forward as a left-to-right derivation. Fine-tuning learns the shape of a verifiable elimination step while its verdicts become unconditional templates, correct only 16-57% of the time ("verdict-as-token"). The ceiling holds across backbones from 3B to 671B and across fine-tuning and prompting; a controlled intervention isolates the cause: revealing the cipher key, which turns the derivation forward, lifts the same instances from 0.03 to 0.57. When a procedure's only solution is search over information-free structure, no faithful forward chain-of-thought exists to imitate. The task becomes learnable only by removing the search, precomputing its combinatorial core into a catalog and reducing the trace to recall plus verification; the 1st-place solution reaches Private LB 0.92 this way. What distills is memorization and verification, not search.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，对于需要搜索信息自由结构的程序（如解密码算术题），前向链式思维无法被蒸馏学习；模型可以学会记忆和验证，但无法学会搜索。即使模型在每一步子任务上表现良好，也无法将搜索过程作为从左到右的推导连续执行。只有通过预计算将搜索核心转化为目录并缩减为记忆+验证，才能获得高准确率。
AI.motivation: 挑战一个常见假设：任何可由短程序解决的任务都能通过链式思维蒸馏教会模型。作者识别出一类可证明无法通过前向链式思维学习的过程。
AI.method: 设计9个确定性生成器的推理任务，含公开/隐藏数据划分。将生成器逆向为Python求解器，渲染为链式思维，用LoRA（秩≤32）蒸馏到Nemotron模型（30B参数，3.5B活跃）。测试前向可计算任务、回溯搜索任务（密码算术），并尝试RL、自训练等多种方法。
AI.result: 前向可计算任务（查表/算术/8位布尔任务）转移成功（≥0.99和0.68）。密码算术任务在所有链式思维设计下仅0.01-0.07，即使搜索求解器可答对71%。模型能完成97-100%的算术行，正确排名密码71%，但无法维持搜索推导。跨模型规模（3B-671B）和方法均存在天花板。揭示密码键可将同一实例从0.03提升至0.57。
AI.conclusion: 当过程的唯一解法是在信息自由结构上搜索时，不存在可供模仿的忠实前向链式思维。蒸馏学到的只是记忆和验证，而非搜索。要使任务可学习，必须移除搜索，将组合核心预计算为目录，将轨迹缩减为回忆+验证。

title: moBERTo: A Modern Encoder for Portuguese via Continued Pretraining of ModernBERT
summary: Encoder-only transformer models remain essential for production NLP pipelines. We introduce moBERTo, a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT obtained through continued pretraining of the ModernBERT-base checkpoint on 60 billion tokens (5 epochs over a 12-billion-token corpus curated from FineWeb2 and filtered with educational and STEM classifiers). We preserve the original architecture, including rotary positional embeddings, alternating local-global attention, flash attention, and unpadding. We evaluate moBERTo across information retrieval (including long-context retrieval at up to 8,192 tokens), document classification, named entity recognition, and natural language understanding. Our best variant, which combines a Portuguese tokenizer with subword-matching embedding transfer and long-context post-training, achieves the highest average reranking nDCG@10 across three Portuguese retrieval benchmarks and the best results on PLUE-PT. Through ablation studies, we show that (i) continued pretraining is strongly preferable to training from scratch, particularly for preserving long-context capabilities; (ii) tokenizer adaptation improves token-level tasks but degrades long-context retrieval; (iii) a dedicated long-context post-training phase at 8,192 tokens further improves reranking and NER; and (iv) encoder-only architectures remain competitive with larger decoder-only alternatives for discriminative tasks. We publicly release the model weights at https://huggingface.co/Tropic-AI/moBERTo and training data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tropic-AI/moberto-pretraining-dataset-c4-compatible on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: moBERTo 是基于 ModernBERT-base 在 600 亿 token 上继续预训练的葡萄牙语编码器模型，通过葡萄牙语分词器、子词匹配嵌入迁移和长上下文后训练，在信息检索、文档分类、命名实体识别和自然语言理解任务上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 编码器-only Transformer 模型在生产 NLP 管线中仍然至关重要，但面向葡萄牙语的现代编码器模型（基于 ModernBERT 架构）尚属空白，需要针对该语言进行适配和优化。
AI.method: 对 ModernBERT-base 检查点在 120 亿 token 的葡语语料（源自 FineWeb2，经教育和 STEM 分类器过滤）上继续预训练 5 个 epoch（共 600 亿 token），保留原始架构（RoPE、交替局部-全局注意力、flash attention、unpadding）。探索三个变体：基础继续预训练、引入葡语分词器+子词匹配嵌入迁移、进一步添加 8,192 token 长上下文后训练。
AI.result: 最佳变体（葡语分词器+嵌入迁移+长上下文后训练）在三个葡语检索基准上取得最高的重排序 nDCG@10，在 PLUE-PT 上获得最佳结果。消融实验表明：(i) 继续预训练优于从头训练；(ii) 分词器适配提升 token 级任务但损害长上下文检索；(iii) 长上下文后训练进一步提升重排序和 NER；(iv) 编码器架构在判别式任务上仍与大解码器模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: moBERTo 证明了继续预训练 ModernBERT 是高效适配低资源语言的有效策略，编码器-only 架构在判别式 NLP 任务中仍保持竞争力，模型和训练数据已在 Hugging Face 上开源发布。

title: Cohort-Anchored Foundation Models for Electronic Health Records: From Risk Scores to Auditable Peer Cohorts
summary: Foundation models have achieved remarkable performance across medical question answering, imaging, and electronic health record (EHR) tasks, yet reliable clinical deployment remains challenging due to limited interpretability, vulnerability to distribution shift, and weak alignment with clinician reasoning. We argue that these limitations arise because existing approaches prioritize representation learning while treating patient comparison as an emergent property rather than a primary source of clinical evidence. To address this gap, we propose CAFM, a Cohort-Anchored Foundation Model framework that elevates patient cohorts to a first-class object throughout the learning pipeline. The framework consists of four stages: deviation-aware data curation, cohort-conditioned pretraining, multimodal cohort alignment, and clinician-in-the-loop refinement. Together, these stages improve data quality, organize representations around clinically meaningful cohort structure, preserve modality-specific relationships, and support auditable clinical decision-making. The framework is compositional and can augment existing EHR foundation models without modifying their underlying encoders. We illustrate CAFM through four clinical case studies spanning acute kidney injury prediction, cardiovascular risk stratification from electrocardiograms, optic neuropathy triage from orbital imaging, and electroretinogram-grounded report generation. We further present five empirically testable hypotheses and identify open challenges in data quality, irregular temporality, multimodal learning, distribution shift, and evaluation beyond predictive accuracy. We argue that explicitly anchoring foundation models to patient cohorts provides a principled path toward trustworthy clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAFM（队列锚定基础模型框架），将患者队列作为一等对象贯穿学习流程，通过四个阶段（数据筛选、队列条件预训练、多模态对齐、临床医生反馈）提升基础模型在临床部署中的可解释性、鲁棒性和与临床推理的一致性，并通过四个临床案例和五个可检验假设论证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型在医学任务中表现优异，但存在可解释性差、易受分布偏移影响、与临床推理对齐弱的问题。作者认为这些局限源于现有方法将患者比较视为表征学习的附属属性，而非主要证据来源。
AI.method: CAFM框架包含四个阶段：(1) 偏差感知数据筛选提升数据质量；(2) 队列条件预训练使表征围绕临床有意义的队列结构组织；(3) 多模态队列对齐保留模态特定关系；(4) 临床医生在环优化支持可审计的临床决策。框架具有组合性，可增强现有EHR基础模型而无需修改其编码器。
AI.result: 通过急性肾损伤预测、心电图心血管风险分层、眼眶影像视神经病变分诊、视网膜电图报告生成四个临床案例进行了说明，并提出了五个可检验假设。
AI.conclusion: 将基础模型显式锚定到患者队列是走向可信临床AI的原则性路径，但仍面临数据质量、不规则时序、多模态学习、分布偏移和超越预测精度的评估等开放挑战。

title: BLUEX v2: Benchmarking LLMs on Open-Ended Questions from Brazilian University Entrance Exams
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in many tasks, their assessment in Portuguese has received less attention, particularly for open-ended, discursive tasks that demand deeper reasoning and generation capabilities. While the original BLUEX benchmark addressed the scarcity of Portuguese evaluation datasets through multiple-choice questions from Brazilian university entrance exams, it did not cover the more challenging second-phase examinations, which require free-form written responses. In this work, we introduce BLUEX v2, a benchmark derived from the second-phase entrance exams of Brazil's two leading universities: UNICAMP (Comvest) and USP (Fuvest), spanning exam years 2022-2025. Our dataset comprises 395 questions unfolding into 919 graded subquestions, with 55.7% of questions containing associated images. Each question is annotated with subject area, official reference answers, LLM-generated rubric criteria, and six cognitive capability tags. We evaluate 21 state-of-the-art LLMs using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol. Results reveal a 4.92-point performance spread across models (4.18-9.10 on a 0-10 scale), with Mathematical Reasoning and Image Understanding emerging as the hardest capability dimensions. The dataset, evaluation code, and model outputs are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BLUEXv2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BLUEX v2，一个基于巴西两所顶尖大学（UNICAMP和USP）第二阶段入学考试（2022-2025年）的葡萄牙语开放题基准数据集，包含395道题（919个子题），并使用LLM-as-a-judge协议评估了21个最新的大语言模型，结果显示模型间得分差距为4.92分（满分10分），数学推理和图像理解是最困难的能力维度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在葡萄牙语评估方面关注不足，尤其是在需要深度推理和生成能力的开放型论述任务上。原有的BLUEX基准仅覆盖了巴西大学入学考试的多选题部分，未涉及更具挑战性的第二阶段笔试（自由回答题），因此需要构建一个新的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 收集了巴西两所顶尖大学（UNICAMP和USP）2022-2025年第二阶段入学考试的395道题（919个评分子题），其中55.7%的题目包含图片。每道题标注了学科领域、官方参考答案、LLM生成的评分标准以及六种认知能力标签。采用LLM-as-a-judge协议评估21个最新LLM的性能。
AI.result: 21个模型在0-10分制上的得分范围为4.18-9.10，差距达4.92分。数学推理和图像理解是最困难的能力维度。
AI.conclusion: BLUEX v2作为首个覆盖巴西大学第二阶段入学考试开放题的大规模葡萄牙语基准，揭示了当前LLM在葡萄牙语开放型任务上的能力差距，特别是数学推理和图像理解方面的挑战，为未来模型改进提供了方向。

title: Ranking-and-Selection with Multiple Correct Answers and Non-Answerable Estimates
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 Winter Simulation Conference
summary: We study fixed-precision ranking-and-selection in structured settings where the answer may be non-unique and where noisy estimates may temporarily admit no valid answer at all. This phenomenon arises naturally in problems such as multi-fidelity ranking-and-selection and identifying a Condorcet winner from pairwise comparisons. To address this, we propose a unified framework based on answer-wise acceptance sets, restricted generalized likelihood ratio stopping, and an answer-pitfall decomposition that yields a max-max-min characteristic value and a common sampling principle. We introduce ENDS, a general procedure that combines estimation, nomination, pitfall detection, and cost-aware information-directed selection. We instantiate ENDS for various problems by deriving explicit formulas. Extensive numerical experiments show that this unified recipe performs well across a broad range of pure-exploration problems and offers a practical framework and proof-of-concept algorithmic recipe.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非唯一解且噪声估计可能导致暂无可接受解的固定精度排序与选择问题，提出了基于答案接受集、受限广义似然比停止规则和答案-陷阱分解的统一框架，并设计了ENDS算法，在多种纯探索问题上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 在结构化排序与选择问题中，解可能不唯一，且噪声估计可能导致暂时不存在有效解（如多保真度排序与选择、从成对比较中识别Condorcet胜者），现有方法缺乏统一处理框架。
AI.method: 提出基于答案接受集的统一框架，引入受限广义似然比停止规则和答案-陷阱分解，导出最大-最大-最小特征值和通用采样原则；设计了ENDS算法，融合估计、提名、陷阱检测和成本感知的信息导向选择。针对多种问题推导显式公式进行实例化。
AI.result: 通过大量数值实验验证，该统一方法在广泛的纯探索问题中表现良好，提供了实用的框架和概念验证的算法方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文为结构化非唯一解场景下的固定精度排序与选择提供了统一的理论框架和实用算法ENDS，具有良好的泛化能力和实际应用价值。

title: When Confidence Takes the Wrong Path: Diagnosing Retrieval-State Lock-In in RAG
summary: The trustworthiness of a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system depends on more than the answer it returns, yet many black-box uncertainty methods still read agreement among sampled answers as confidence. That inference fails when repeated samples condition on the same defective retrieval state. The state may be empty, with the model falling back on parametric memory, or populated by a coherent but wrong neighbourhood. In either case, the answers agree because the error is stable. The problem is recognised in deployed RAG, but it has lacked a name, a measurable signature, and a prevalence bound. We supply all three. We name the failure retrieval-state lock-in and diagnose it by separating the three objects a single confidence score conflates: the answer surface, the retrieved evidence, and the retrieval state itself. In an inspectable, ontology-guided knowledge-graph RAG (KG-RAG) system across six question-answering snapshots, we measure the agreement blind spot directly: at five samples per question, 42% of KG-RAG errors and 59% of dense-retrieval errors carry zero answer dispersion, so agreement has nothing to rank, while evidence- and retrieval-state checks still flag most of them. The decomposition supports an auditable decision rule: accepting an answer only when answer, evidence, and retrieval checks all agree that it is low-risk reaches 91.9% pooled precision against a 69.7% accept-all rate. The cost is coverage: it certifies only 7.7% of answers as low-risk. On the clinical calibration domain it reaches 100% precision under an automated judge; this is an in-domain automated-label upper bound, not a clinical safety claim, and still needs human validation. Confidence in RAG is object-specific: when answers agree, the useful question is which part of the pipeline to distrust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAG系统中存在"检索状态锁定"问题——当检索状态有缺陷时，模型采样答案会呈现虚假一致性从而导致置信度误判。通过在知识图谱RAG系统中分解答案、证据和检索状态三个置信度对象，发现42%的KG-RAG错误和59%的稠密检索错误具有零答案离散度，而证据和检索状态检查仍能识别多数错误。该方法在7.7%的覆盖率下达到91.9%的精确度。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统的黑盒不确定性方法仅通过采样答案的一致性来判断置信度，但忽视了当检索状态存在缺陷（如检索为空或错误但自洽的邻域）时，一致性反而掩盖了错误。该问题在部署中已知但缺乏正式命名、可测量特征和普遍性上界。
AI.method: 将传统单一置信度分数解耦为三个对象：答案表面(answer surface)、检索证据(retrieved evidence)和检索状态(retrieval state)。在可检查的、本体引导的知识图谱RAG系统中，跨六个问答快照测量这三个维度的不一致性，并构建可审计的决策规则。
AI.result: 在5个采样/问题的设置下，42%的KG-RAG错误和59%的稠密检索错误呈现零答案离散度（即一致性盲区）。提出的三检查决策规则在69.7%的全接受率基准上达到91.9%的合并精确度，但覆盖率仅为7.7%。在临床校准域中达到100%精确度。
AI.conclusion: RAG系统的置信度是对象特定的：当答案一致时，有用的问题是应该不信任管道中的哪个部分。需要将检索状态检查纳入不确定性量化方法中。

title: AgroSense 2.0: Cross-Modal Transformer Fusion with Geospatial Raster Integration and Interpretable Multi-Task Learning for Precision Crop Recommendation
summary: Crop recommendation systems in precision agriculture have long suffered from a fundamental modality gap: visual soil characterization and chemical nutrient profiling are typically treated as independent inference problems, with fusion often reduced to late-stage feature concatenation. AgroSense~2.0 addresses this limitation through three architectural advances. First, we introduce continental-scale geospatial integration via a seven-band soil raster (\texttt{india\_soil\_7bands.tif}) spanning India, encoding Nitrogen, pH, SOC, Clay, Sand, Silt, and Bulk Density as $32\times32$ spatial patches, a modality entirely absent from prior work. Second, we replace naive feature concatenation with a cross-modal Transformer fusion module, where tabular nutrient features attend over image representations via multi-head attention, enabling richer inter-modal dependency modeling than shallow fusion. Third, we adopt a multi-task objective jointly optimizing soil classification and crop recommendation through a shared backbone, improving generalization via complementary cross-task signal. To enhance interpretability, we apply TreeSHAP to the tabular branch, revealing crop-conditioned nutrient sensitivity: humidity and rainfall emerge as the most influential features globally, while crop-specific profiles diverge meaningfully rainfall dominates rice, nitrogen and potassium dominate maize, and humidity and nitrogen dominate coffee. These explanations provide transparency into model decisions and surface both agronomically consistent patterns and dataset-specific divergences worth further study. Together, these contributions establish AgroSense~2.0 as a more principled, interpretable, and geospatially grounded framework for precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: AgroSense 2.0 提出三项架构改进：引入全印度七波段土壤栅格数据、用跨模态Transformer融合代替简单的特征拼接、采用多任务联合优化。通过TreeSHAP分析发现湿度和降雨是全局最关键特征，不同作物有特异的营养敏感性模式。
AI.motivation: 传统农作物推荐系统中，视觉土壤表征与化学养分特征通常被独立处理，融合方式仅停留在浅层特征拼接，存在严重的模态鸿沟。
AI.method: (1) 引入覆盖全印度的七波段土壤栅格数据（氮、pH、有机碳、黏粒、砂粒、粉粒、容重），以32×32空间块编码；(2) 用跨模态Transformer融合模块替代特征拼接，表格养分特征通过多头注意力机制关注图像表征；(3) 采用多任务学习目标，共享骨干网络同时优化土壤分类和作物推荐。
AI.result: TreeSHAP分析显示：湿度和降雨是全局最具影响力的特征；水稻主要受降雨影响，玉米受氮和钾影响，咖啡受湿度和氮影响。
AI.conclusion: AgroSense 2.0 构建了一个更合理、可解释且具有地理空间基础的精准农业框架。

title: Language-Specific Sentiment Polarity Biases in Encoder and Large Language Model Classification of Product Reviews
summary: This study investigates sentiment polarity biases, specifically, differences in how accurately AI models classify positive versus negative reviews across languages and model architectures. Large language models show a negative bias in French and are more accurate on negative reviews, while encoder models exhibit positive bias in Japanese, missing negative reviews that use indirect criticism. These language-specific polarity biases have implications in both social and business domains deploying multilingual sentiment analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了AI模型在不同语言和架构下对正面与负面评论分类准确率的差异，发现LLM在法语中存在负面偏见（对负面评论更准确），而编码器模型在日语中存在正面偏见（漏检使用间接批评的负面评论）。
AI.motivation: 探究多语言情感分析系统中，AI模型在不同语言和架构下是否存在情感极性偏差，以及这些偏差对实际应用的影响。
AI.method: 对比分析大型语言模型（LLMs）和编码器模型（encoder models）在法语和日语等语言中对正面与负面评论的分类准确率差异。
AI.result: LLM在法语中表现出负面偏见，对负面评论分类更准确；编码器模型在日语中表现出正面偏见，容易漏检使用间接批评的负面评论。
AI.conclusion: 语言特定的情感极性偏差会影响部署多语言情感分析系统的社会和商业领域，需要针对不同语言和模型架构采取相应措施。

title: Data Pruning: Redundant, Problematic, and Interdependent Samples
comment: This work is a preprint of a published paper by the same name
summary: The performance of deep learning models is affected by not only data quantity but also data quality. Data pruning is a process by which practitioners can reduce the size of a dataset by only keeping the most important training data points, thereby achieving similar test set performance. We empirically investigate two popular data pruning methods under noisy and noiseless conditions and show that these methods fail in the presence of significant label noise. We highlight that the success of data pruning is distinctly affected by three factors: redundancy in the dataset, the presence of problematic samples, and interdependence between samples. We perform a detailed investigation on commonly used benchmark classification datasets and neural network architectures. We find that our observations are consistent across data distributions and training protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了两种主流数据剪枝方法在噪声和无噪声条件下的表现，发现这些方法在存在显著标签噪声时失效。研究指出数据剪枝的成功受三个因素影响：数据集冗余、问题样本的存在以及样本间的相互依赖。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型性能不仅受数据量影响，也受数据质量影响。数据剪枝旨在通过保留最重要的训练数据点来缩减数据集规模，同时保持相似的测试集性能。本文旨在探究现有数据剪枝方法在标签噪声条件下的有效性及其影响因素。
AI.method: 在噪声和无噪声条件下实证研究两种流行的数据剪枝方法，在常用基准分类数据集和神经网络架构上进行详细调查，分析数据集冗余、问题样本和样本间相互依赖三个因素对剪枝效果的影响。
AI.result: 两种主流数据剪枝方法在存在显著标签噪声时失效；数据剪枝的成功受数据集冗余、问题样本的存在以及样本间相互依赖三个因素的显著影响；这些观察结果在不同数据分布和训练协议下保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 数据剪枝方法的有效性在标签噪声条件下显著下降，其成功取决于数据集的冗余程度、问题样本的排除以及样本间依赖关系的处理，这些发现对实际应用中的数据预处理策略具有指导意义。

title: AI Fiction in the Wild
comment: Presented at the MFS Cultural AI Conference, Purdue University, September 19, 2025. This essay is provisionally forthcoming in MFS: Modern Fiction Studies
summary: Some professional authors are beginning to use AI tools to help produce their fiction writing. Are readers using AI to generate fiction, too? This paper examines how large language models are reshaping the production and consumption of fiction by enabling new forms of participation in narrative generation. Drawing on over 500,000 anonymized, English-language ChatGPT-user conversations (arXiv:2405.01470), we find that more than one third of the conversations involve some form of fiction generation -- including original stories, roleplay, fanfiction, and erotica. This AI-generated fiction is notably dominated by power users. We identify common fiction generation patterns and profiles among these users, including what we call "infinite story demanders," who repeatedly request and revise variations of the same or similar narratives over extended periods of time. We show that users especially gravitate toward fanfiction and erotica, and that they are broadly drawn to generic forms, repetition, immediacy, and niche combinations of story elements. Our findings motivate two theoretical provocations. First, we argue that AI technologies may lead to a shift in the conventional relationship between the author and reader, potentially producing what we call a "solipsistic reader-writer," who both generates and consumes fiction within a closed conversational loop, interacting with a machine rather than a human other. Second, we note that LLMs enable interactivity, play, and permutation in ways that are seemingly pleasurable for users, raising questions about where AI will fit into contemporary storytelling and entertainment ecosystems. We situate these developments within broader transformations in literature and media, including self-publishing, fanfiction, and pornography, and suggest that AI-generated fiction shares structural affinities with on-demand, personalized, and repetitive cultural forms.

AI.tldr: 基于50万条ChatGPT对话数据，研究发现超过三分之一的对话涉及AI生成小说，包括原创故事、角色扮演、同人小说和色情文学。用户以重度使用者为主，表现出对重复、即时性和小众组合的偏好。论文提出"唯我论读者-作者"概念，认为AI技术正在改变传统作者与读者的关系。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型如何重塑小说的生产与消费模式，以及普通读者（而非专业作者）如何利用AI工具进行小说创作，并理解这一现象对作者-读者关系和叙事生态的深远影响。
AI.method: 分析超过50万条匿名英语ChatGPT用户对话数据，识别小说生成模式，并通过聚类分析发现用户类型（如"无限故事需求者"）及其行为特征。
AI.result: 超过三分之一的对话涉及AI小说生成；重度使用者主导；用户偏好同人小说和色情文学，倾向重复、即时性和小众元素组合；识别出"无限故事需求者"等典型用户类型。
AI.conclusion: AI技术可能导致"唯我论读者-作者"的出现——用户在封闭对话循环中同时生产和消费小说，与机器而非他者互动；AI生成小说与按需、个性化、重复性的文化形态具有结构相似性，对当代故事讲述和娱乐生态提出新问题。

title: Selective Ensemble Based on Preference-Directed Multi-Objective Bandits
summary: Selective ensemble for modern machine learning systems requires choosing promising model candidates under limited evaluation budgets, while downstream tasks often specify only partial preferences over capabilities such as accuracy, robustness, and reasoning. This setting naturally gives rise to a sequential decision problem under partially specified linear preferences. We formalize it as preference-directed multi-objective bandits (PDMOB), where admissible trade-offs are represented by a polyhedral preference cone. Based on this formulation, we introduce Pareto $C$-optimality, which recovers standard Pareto optimality and single-weight scalarization as special cases. We then propose the preference-directed upper confidence bound (PrefUCB) algorithm, which maintains directional confidence intervals to guide exploration. We analyze both indicator-based and gap-weighted regret, and establish instance-dependent logarithmic bounds for both criteria, recovering the optimal logarithmic dependence on the horizon $T$ in classical special cases. Experiments on large pre-trained model selective ensemble tasks and online asset allocation under institutional mandates validate the efficacy of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出偏好导向多目标老虎机（PDMOB）框架，用于解决有限评估预算下基于部分偏好（如准确率、鲁棒性等）的模型选择性集成问题，并提出PrefUCB算法，通过方向性置信区间引导探索，在指示器遗憾和间隙加权遗憾上均达到实例相关的对数界。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习系统中的选择性集成需要在有限评估预算下选择有潜力的模型候选，而下游任务通常只指定对准确率、鲁棒性、推理等能力的部分偏好，这自然形成了一个具有部分指定线性偏好的序贯决策问题，现有方法未能很好地形式化解决。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为偏好导向多目标老虎机（PDMOB），用多面体偏好锥表示可接受的折衷；提出Pareto C-最优性（恢复标准Pareto最优和单权重标量化为特例）；设计PrefUCB算法，维护方向性置信区间引导探索。
AI.result: 在指示器遗憾和间隙加权遗憾两个准则上均建立了实例相关的对数界，在经典特例中恢复了关于时间T的最优对数依赖性。在大型预训练模型选择性集成任务和机构授权下的在线资产配置实验中验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: PrefUCB算法能够有效处理部分指定线性偏好下的多目标序贯决策问题，具有理论保证和良好的实证表现。

title: Learning Moral Diversity: Modelling Individual Perspectives in Moral Classification of Texts
comment: Accepted at the Seventh Workshop on NLP and Computational Social Science. 12 pages, 7 figures
summary: Understanding moral values in social media text offers insight into moral judgement formation, and supervised NLP models trained on crowdsourced data have achieved strong classification performance. However, most approaches simplify the problem by aggregating multiple annotators' labels into a single "ground truth", overlooking the inherent subjectivity of the task. In practice, there are disagreements between annotators caused by personal viewpoint or inherent ambiguities, particularly for short tweets. Here, we extend a pretrained language model with a layer that learns annotator-specific features. Our model improves predictions of individual annotations and yields representations that reveal meaningful insights into annotators' moral perspectives. We show that models trained on aggregated labels may hide variation and give a misleading impression of performance. Overall, we demonstrate that disagreement reflects the inherent subjectivity of the task and that modelling individual perspectives creates benefits for moral classification of texts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在预训练语言模型中增加学习标注者特定特征的层，以建模道德文本分类中的主观性分歧，证明聚合标签会掩盖变异并误导性能评估，而建模个体视角能带来分类收益。
AI.motivation: 现有监督NLP模型在道德价值分类中通常将多个标注者的标签聚合成单一"真实标签"，忽略了标注者间因个人观点或文本歧义导致的分歧，尤其对于短推文而言，这种主观性被严重低估。
AI.method: 在预训练语言模型基础上扩展一个学习标注者特定特征的层，使模型能够预测个体标注而非聚合标签，从而捕捉标注者之间的分歧和个性化道德视角。
AI.result: 所提模型在预测个体标注方面表现更优；聚合标签训练的模型会隐藏标注者间的变异，并给出误导性的性能印象；分歧实际上反映了任务固有的主观性。
AI.conclusion: 建模个体标注者视角比聚合标签方法更准确地反映了道德文本分类中的主观性，为理解道德判断的形成提供了更有意义的表征。

title: DevoTG: Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Modeling C. elegans Developmental Connectomics
