AI.tldr: 本文研究了多轮交互智能体中决策密度ρ对轨迹级信用分配的影响，发现低决策密度会导致信号稀释，使轨迹级方法（如GRPO）的信噪比按ρ^{-1/2}衰减，而高决策密度下轨迹级方法无需评论家即可保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将复杂信用分配的困难归因于长视界，但本文旨在证明真正的决定因素是决策密度ρ——即影响回报的动作在全序列中的占比。需要厘清低决策密度下信号稀释的量化影响。
AI.method: 通过理论分析推导轨迹级估计器（如GRPO）的信噪比随ρ的缩放关系；在可精确调节ρ的受控环境中进行实验验证，测量训练步数差距随ρ→0的变化。
AI.result: 理论预测的ρ^{-1/2}缩放关系在实验中得到R²=0.999的精确拟合；当ρ趋近于0时，轨迹级方法与评论家方法的训练步数差距显著扩大。
AI.conclusion: 决策密度ρ是比视界长度更根本的困难度量；低ρ时评论家方法更具优势，高ρ时轨迹级方法可避免评论家开销而保持竞争力。

title: Scaling LLM Knowledge Boundaries via Distribution-Optimized Synthesis
summary: Knowledge injection via synthetic data is crucial for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). However, current synthesis methods simply stop at preset token counts or fixed data ratios, lacking awareness of knowledge distribution. This results in some domains being sparse while others are redundant, limiting LLM knowledge boundaries. We revisit knowledge injection from a distribution perspective and hypothesize that an optimal knowledge distribution exists to maximize knowledge boundary expansion. We propose KDoS (Knowledge Distribution-optimized Synthesis), a framework that introduces knowledge density to drive synthesis through a three-stage feedback mechanism, shifting from blind generation to distribution-optimized synthesis. We construct Wikipedia-based synthetic data with varying knowledge distributions and conduct experiments on models from 0.6B to 16B (Qwen, Ling, LLaMA) and data scales from 1B to 5B tokens. Our key findings are: (1) an optimal knowledge distribution consistently maximizes boundary expansion; (2) this distribution is stable across backbones and scales; (3) KDoS outperforms baselines across six knowledge benchmarks. Our work offers a new perspective and practical framework for synthetic data-driven knowledge injection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KDoS框架，从知识分布角度优化合成数据生成，发现存在最优知识分布可最大化LLM知识边界扩展，实验验证该分布在多种模型和规模下稳定有效。
AI.motivation: 现有合成数据方法仅关注预设token数量或固定数据比例，忽略知识分布，导致某些领域稀疏而其他领域冗余，限制了LLM知识边界的扩展。
AI.method: 提出KDoS框架，引入知识密度概念，通过三阶段反馈机制驱动合成，从盲目生成转向分布优化的合成。构建基于Wikipedia的不同知识分布合成数据，在0.6B-16B参数模型和1B-5B tokens数据规模上实验。
AI.result: (1)存在最优知识分布一致地最大化知识边界扩展；(2)该分布在不同的骨干网络和规模下保持稳定；(3)KDoS在六个知识基准测试中优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为合成数据驱动的知识注入提供了新的分布视角和实用框架KDoS。

title: Early-Exit Graph Neural Networks for Link Prediction
summary: Graph Neural Networks are great for link prediction in various network-like structures; however, the question of their speed/quality tradeoff has been barely studied. While in practice the time it takes to do inference matters little for small benchmarks, the latency does limit applicability in large-scale domains. In this work, we explore early-exiting strategies that can be applied to Graph Neural Networks to solve the problem of link-prediction faster. We use no auxiliary losses to enforce early exiting, allowing it to emerge as an implicit property of the architecture. We show that our method enables early exiting in several setups, moving the Pareto frontier on the HeaRT benchmark for GCN and SAS-GNN backbones. Our findings show that inference speed of GNNs on many link-prediction problems can be improved, while losing little, or even winning in terms of prediction quality. The code is available in our repository: https://github.com/knyazer/link_prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需辅助损失的早期退出策略，用于加速图神经网络在链接预测任务中的推理，在不牺牲预测质量甚至有所提升的情况下改善了速度/质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前图神经网络在链接预测任务中速度与质量的权衡研究不足，推理延迟限制了在大规模场景中的应用。
AI.method: 采用无辅助损失的早期退出策略，使早期退出作为架构的隐式属性自然涌现，应用于GCN和SAS-GNN等骨干网络。
AI.result: 在HeaRT基准测试上，该方法推动了GCN和SAS-GNN的帕累托前沿，在提升推理速度的同时几乎不损失甚至提升了预测质量。
AI.conclusion: 早期退出策略能有效提升GNN在链接预测任务中的推理速度，且无需牺牲预测性能，适用于多种骨干网络架构。

title: Towards Root Memories: Benchmarking and Enhancing Implicit Logical Memory Retrieval for Personalized LLMs
summary: Memory systems are essential for personalized Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing retrieval methods in these systems primarily rely on semantic similarity, potentially missing logically critical memories with limited semantic overlap. Current benchmarks remain inadequate for evaluating this problem. To address this gap, we construct IMLogic, the first high-quality benchmark targeting implicit logical memory retrieval in long-dialogue scenarios. Motivated by this challenge, we introduce root memory, a structured, decision-preserving representation that distills reusable personalized logic from long-term user histories. We then propose RootMem, a plug-and-play framework that first distills raw histories into structured root memories and then uses an LLM-based router to activate logically relevant ones, complementing semantic retrieval with personalized decision logic. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RootMem significantly outperforms the strongest retrieval baselines and consistently boosts the accuracy of existing memory agents. Our benchmark and codes will be available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/IMLogic-DBB3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IMLogic基准和RootMem框架，解决现有LLM记忆系统仅依赖语义相似性检索而忽略隐式逻辑记忆的问题。RootMem通过将用户历史转化为结构化"根记忆"并用LLM路由器激活逻辑相关记忆，显著提升了检索准确率和记忆代理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM记忆系统的检索方法主要依赖语义相似性，可能遗漏语义重叠少但逻辑关键的记忆，而当前基准不足以评估这一问题。
AI.method: 构建首个面向长对话场景的隐式逻辑记忆检索基准IMLogic；提出RootMem框架，先将原始对话历史蒸馏为结构化、保留决策信息的"根记忆"，再通过基于LLM的路由器激活逻辑相关的根记忆，与语义检索互补。
AI.result: RootMem显著优于最强检索基线，并能稳定提升现有记忆代理的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 引入结构化根记忆和逻辑路由可以有效弥补纯语义检索在隐式逻辑记忆检索上的不足，提升个性化LLM记忆系统的性能。

title: Beyond Time Series: Spatial Reasoning for Epidemic Forecasting via Multimodal Learning
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026), AI for Science Track
summary: Epidemic forecasting models typically rely on surveillance data reported over administrative regions, treating them as atomic units, thereby obscuring sub-regional spatial structure that shapes disease dynamics. We introduce a spatially structured multimodal epidemic forecasting setting that integrates region-level temporal surveillance data with spatially localized auxiliary signals that are misaligned in resolution and structure, reflecting realistic public health reporting constraints. Building on this formulation, we propose M-SPICE (Multimodal SPatIal Context for Epidemic Forecasting), a structure-aware spatiotemporal forecasting framework that performs joint reasoning over temporal disease dynamics and spatial context via attention-based multimodal fusion, allowing spatial signals to selectively condition temporal representations across forecast horizons. We evaluate our approach on real-world COVID-19, influenza, and influenza-like illness (ILI) forecasting tasks under realistic real-time evaluation protocols. Across all forecasting settings, our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multivariate time-series, multimodal, and epidemiological forecasting baselines while maintaining strong probabilistic forecasting performance. Finally, interpretability analyses reveal when, where, and how spatial signals are leveraged, highlighting settings in which purely temporal, region-aggregated models are most likely to fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M-SPICE框架，通过多模态融合将区域级时间序列数据与空间上不匹配的辅助信号结合，在COVID-19、流感和ILI预测任务上优于现有基线方法，并揭示了空间信号在流行病预测中的作用机制。
AI.motivation: 传统流行病预测模型将行政区域视为原子单元，忽略了区域内空间结构对疾病传播的影响，且难以融合分辨率不一致的多模态空间信号。
AI.method: 提出M-SPICE框架，采用基于注意力的多模态融合机制，对时间动态与空间上下文进行联合推理，使空间信号可选择性地调节不同预测时间范围内的时序表示。
AI.result: 在COVID-19、流感和ILI真实预测任务中，M-SPICE持续优于最先进的多元时间序列、多模态和流行病学预测基线，并保持强概率预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 空间信号能有效提升预测精度；可解释性分析揭示了纯时间区域聚合模型最可能失效的场景。

title: On the Effect of Segmentation Width and Cluster Size on Speech Resynthesis and Continuation in Generative Spoken Language Models
summary: Generative Spoken Language Modeling (GSLM) enables text-free speech modeling by training language models (LMs) using discrete speech representations instead of textual transcription. In this paper, we investigate the performance of GSLM on speech synthesis and continuation using discrete speech representations with varying bitrates. We segment speech representations with fixed widths and train K-means models in multiple cluster sizes, resulting in various bitrate settings. We demonstrate that intelligible and natural speech can be synthesized at lower bitrate settings than the baseline. Furthermore, speech continuation quality remains stable at lower bitrates across multiple metrics, suggesting that the conventional GSLM setting may be redundant for effective speech generation. Although LLM-based metrics show higher correlation with human subjective score than conventional metrics, it remains low, highlighting the need for more stable automatic evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生成式口语语言建模（GSLM）在不同比特率离散语音表示下的语音合成与续接性能，发现较低比特率下仍能生成可理解且自然的语音，且续接质量保持稳定，表明传统GSLM设置可能冗余；同时LLM基指标与人类主观评分相关性虽优于传统指标但仍较低，亟需更稳定的自动评估方法。
AI.motivation: 探究GSLM在使用不同比特率离散语音表示时的语音合成与续接性能，验证传统高比特率设置是否必要，并评估现有自动评估指标的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用固定宽度分割语音表示，训练不同聚类数量的K-means模型以生成多种比特率设置，在此基础上训练语言模型并进行语音合成与续接实验。
AI.result: 较低比特率下仍能合成可理解且自然的语音；语音续接质量在多个指标上保持稳定；LLM基指标与人类主观评分相关性高于传统指标，但整体相关性仍然较低。
AI.conclusion: 传统GSLM的高比特率设置对有效语音生成可能冗余；现有自动评估方法（包括LLM基指标）尚不足以稳定可靠地评估生成语音质量，需进一步发展。

title: Gated MLPs as Symmetry-Broken Rank-1 Bilinear Attention
summary: We show that the conventional gated MLP can be viewed as a rank-1 approximation to a bilinear attention mechanism with two distinct factors corresponding to the query and the key. We further show that moving the nonlinearity onto one factor breaks the exchange symmetry between the two factors and, for non-homogeneous activations, the inverse-scaling symmetry as well. This perspective may help explain why gated MLPs are effective in practice and inform the design of future architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了门控MLP可以视为双线性注意力机制的秩1近似，其中两个因子分别对应查询和键，并分析了非线性激活函数对因子交换对称性和逆缩放对称性的破坏作用。
AI.motivation: 理解门控MLP在实践中有效的内在原因，并为未来架构设计提供理论指导。
AI.method: 将门控MLP形式化为双线性注意力机制的秩1近似，通过数学分析研究非线性激活函数置于其中一个因子上时对对称性的影响。
AI.result: 门控MLP等价于注意力机制的秩1特例；非线性放在一个因子上会破坏两个因子间的交换对称性，对于非齐次激活函数还会破坏逆缩放对称性。
AI.conclusion: 这一视角为门控MLP的有效性提供了理论解释，并有望启发现代神经网络架构的创新设计。

title: The Anatomy of the CTC Oracle Gap: Acoustic Exhaustion and Linguistic Recovery
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/Melodiz/RBPO
summary:
We study the limits of CTC-internal scoring for N-best hypothesis selection and locate the information bottleneck separating acoustic confidence from linguistic plausibility. Eleven CTC-internal and acoustic-feature scoring strategies produce no statistically significant WER improvement over greedy decoding on LibriSpeech dev-other at G=16 (all p > 0.05). The exhaustion is systematic: CTC's Spearman $ρ$ between hypothesis score and per-utterance WER degrades from -0.574 at G=4 to -0.270 at G=128, a 53% loss driven by blank-path proliferation. This establishes that the discriminative capacity of CTC-internal representations is saturated: no recombination of acoustic signals can close the oracle gap.
  Confirming that the bottleneck is linguistic, not acoustic, external linguistic information introduced via MBR decoding breaks through it. MBR-CER decoding with a RoBERTa pseudo-log-likelihood (PLL) posterior ($τ$=10, G=128) achieves 5.42% WER on held-out LibriSpeech test-other (greedy 5.96%, $Δ$=-0.535 pp, p<0.0001, 9.0% relative). RoBERTa PLL $ρ$ degrades only 21% over the same range, retaining discriminating power where CTC loses it. Applied without retuning across two Zipformer architectures, three domains (LibriSpeech, TED-LIUM 3, VoxPopuli), and four MUSAN noise levels, the recipe gives significant gains in 11 of 13 conditions.
  On the training side, standard MWER training via the CTC forward-backward algorithm implements Rao-Blackwellized REINFORCE at the output projection (variance about 3x below Viterbi). Yet sequence-level fine-tuning fails at near-converged checkpoints: all four MWER configurations on CR-CTC collapse (+6.18 to +8.90 pp WER), as a training oracle gap of 0.007 pp provides no usable reward signal.

AI.tldr: 本文系统证明了CTC内部表征的区分能力已饱和，无法通过重排声学特征来缩小oracle差距；而通过MBR解码引入外部语言信息（RoBERTa PLL）可突破瓶颈，在多个架构和领域上取得显著WER改善；同时发现标准MWER训练在接近收敛的检查点上失效，因为训练oracle间隙过小无法提供有效奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 探究CTC内部评分用于N-best假设选择的极限，定位声学置信度与语言合理性之间的信息瓶颈，并验证外部语言信息能否突破该瓶颈。
AI.method: 系统评估11种CTC内部及声学特征评分策略在N-best重排中的效果；引入MBR解码结合RoBERTa伪对数似然（PLL）后验进行外部语言信息注入；分析标准MWER训练（CTC前向后向算法实现Rao-Blackwellized REINFORCE）在近收敛检查点上的失效原因。
AI.result: CTC内部评分在G=16时无显著WER改善；CTC的Spearman ρ从G=4的-0.574降至G=128的-0.270（衰减53%）；MBR-CER解码（RoBERTa PLL, τ=10, G=128）在LibriSpeech test-other上达到5.42% WER（greedy 5.96%, 相对改善9.0%），RoBERTa PLL ρ仅衰减21%；在13个条件中11个获得显著增益；四种MWER配置在CR-CTC上均失效（+6.18至+8.90 pp WER）。
AI.conclusion: CTC内部表征的区分能力已饱和，瓶颈在于语言信息而非声学信息；外部语言模型可通过MBR解码有效突破该瓶颈；标准MWER训练在近收敛时因oracle间隙过小（0.007 pp）而失效。

title: Residue-Level Attributions in Protein Language Models Do Not Recover Allergen Epitopes
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop (peer-reviewed)
summary: Deep allergenicity classifiers are increasingly used in safety screening of novel foods, and recent protein language models have substantially improved protein-level allergenicity prediction. However, whether their explanations capture biologically meaningful information remains unclear. We introduce an epitope-grounded residue-level benchmark for quantitatively evaluating attribution faithfulness in protein allergenicity models. Across frozen ESM-2, multi-task ESM-2, and DeepPlantAllergy, protein-level classification was robust, yet classification-head explanation signals did not significantly exceed random in their residue-level alignment with annotated epitopes across AUROC, AUPRC, and Precision@k. Integrated Gradients identified residues that were functionally important to the model, but not overlapping annotated epitopes. Saturation mutagenesis further suggested classifiers may rely on physicochemical and compositional sequence features rather than epitope-specific mechanisms. Residue-level importance signals should therefore not be interpreted as immunological explanations for safety screening or hypoallergen design without quantitative validation. Code available: https://github.com/Jeffateth/XAllergen2.0-paper

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于表位锚定的残基级基准，用于定量评估蛋白质过敏原性预测模型中归因解释的忠实性。研究发现，尽管蛋白级分类性能鲁棒，但分类头的解释信号与注释表位的残基级对齐程度并不显著优于随机，表明模型可能依赖物理化学和组成序列特征而非表位特异性机制。
AI.motivation: 深度过敏原分类器越来越多地用于新型食品的安全性筛查，但现有解释是否捕捉到生物学上有意义的信息尚不清楚。因此需要一种定量基准来评估模型归因的忠实性。
AI.method: 引入表位锚定的残基级基准，在冻结ESM-2、多任务ESM-2和DeepPlantAllergy模型上，使用AUROC、AUPRC和Precision@k等指标定量评估归因信号与注释表位的残基级对齐程度，并采用饱和诱变实验进一步分析模型依赖的特征。
AI.result: 蛋白级分类性能鲁棒，但分类头解释信号与注释表位的残基级对齐在AUROC、AUPRC和Precision@k上未显著优于随机。Integrated Gradients识别出的残基在功能上对模型重要但与注释表位不重叠。饱和诱变表明分类器可能依赖物理化学和组成序列特征而非表位特异性机制。
AI.conclusion: 残基级重要性信号不应被解释为安全性筛选或低过敏原设计的免疫学解释，除非经过定量验证。

title: Tmax: A simple recipe for terminal agents
summary: Terminal-using agents have quickly become the most popular downstream application of language models (LMs). Despite their prevalence, relatively little academic work has examined RL-based training of these models, likely due to difficult benchmarks, a lack of data, and a lack of simple baseline recipes. We present Tmax, the strongest open RL recipe for terminal agents to date, bringing open data recipes closer to the frontier. While simple, our recipe achieves 27\% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 with only 9B parameters, outperforming much larger models from prior work. Concretely, we generate data using a novel taxonomy, combining difficulty control, personas, and verifier diversification, which allows us to cheaply generate large amounts of terminal environments for RL and SFT training. We open-source our terminal dataset, which is over 2.5x larger than previously released terminal-agent datasets. We then train open-weight models using RL with our data, using a simple, outcome-only recipe. We release our data, models, and code as a strong baseline for future open academic work on terminal agents at https://github.com/hamishivi/tmax.

AI.tldr: Tmax 是一个面向终端智能体的开源强化学习方案，通过新颖的数据生成分类法（结合难度控制、角色设定和验证器多样化）生成了大规模终端环境数据集，采用仅基于结果的简单 RL 训练，以 9B 参数在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 27% 的性能，超越此前更大的模型。数据集规模是此前开源终端智能体数据集的 2.5 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于终端交互的智能体已成为语言模型最流行的下游应用，但学术界对基于 RL 训练这类模型的研究相对较少，主要受限于基准测试难度大、数据匮乏以及缺乏简单可复现的基线方案。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一个强开源基线方案。
AI.method: 提出 Tmax 方案：(1) 设计新颖的数据生成分类法，结合难度控制、角色设定（personas）和验证器多样化（verifier diversification），低成本生成大规模终端环境数据；(2) 构建开源终端数据集，规模是此前最大数据集的 2.5 倍以上；(3) 使用仅基于结果（outcome-only）的简单 RL 训练流程训练开放权重模型。
AI.result: 仅用 9B 参数模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 27% 的准确率，超越此前工作中使用的更大规模模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: Tmax 证明了简单、可复现的 RL 训练方案结合大规模多样化数据可以显著提升终端智能体的性能，为未来开源学术研究提供了强基线。数据、模型和代码均已开源。

title: Bayesian Adaptation Gym: A Benchmark for the Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation of Multi-Modal Language Models
summary: Large multi-modal language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, making well-calibrated uncertainty essential. Traditional Bayesian methods approximate posteriors over all model weights, which becomes intractable for modern large models. For this reason, recent work instead considers Bayesian low-rank adaptation to enable tractable posterior approximation. Due to a lack of a standardized benchmark to evaluate these approaches, it remains unclear where these methods provide meaningful benefits. To fill this gap, we introduce Bayesian Adaptation Gym (BAG), a benchmark for the Bayesian adaptation of multi-modal language models. BAG provides reference implementations of classic Bayesian baselines and state-of-the-art adaptation methods, along with a multi-modal dataset and task suite designed to probe calibration, robustness under distribution shift, and decision-making under uncertainty via active learning. Using BAG, we conduct and report extensive experiments across model sizes, datasets, and tasks to highlight the successes and failures of current Bayesian adaptation approaches. To enable further research, BAG is fully open source: https://github.com/SRI-CSL/BayesAdapt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Bayesian Adaptation Gym (BAG)，一个用于评估多模态语言模型贝叶斯适应方法的标准化基准测试平台，包含参考实现、多模态数据集和任务套件，并进行了大量实验以揭示当前方法的成功与失败之处。
AI.motivation: 当前大型多模态语言模型在高风险场景中部署需要良好校准的不确定性估计，但传统贝叶斯方法因计算复杂度过高而难以应用于现代大模型。虽然近期工作提出了贝叶斯低秩适应方法，但由于缺乏标准化基准来评估这些方法，其实际效果尚不明确。因此需要构建一个统一的评估框架来填补这一空白。
AI.method: BAG提供了经典贝叶斯基线和最新适应方法的参考实现，构建了多模态数据集和任务套件，用于评估校准能力、分布偏移下的鲁棒性以及通过主动学习实现的决策不确定性。在不同模型规模、数据集和任务上进行了广泛的实验分析。
AI.result: 通过大规模实验揭示了当前贝叶斯适应方法在多模态语言模型上的成功案例与失败场景，为研究者提供了系统的性能对比结果。
AI.conclusion: BAG作为开源基准测试平台，能够有效评估贝叶斯适应方法在多模态语言模型上的不确定性量化能力，为未来研究提供了标准化工具和实验基础。

title: WaveDetect: Robust Framework for Machine-Generated Text Detection via Wavelet Transform
summary: As Large Language Models asymptotically approach human-level fluency in natural language generation, solely relying on surface-level semantic artifacts for detecting LLM-generated texts has become increasingly precarious. Existing detectors often falter when facing three critical challenges: adversarial perturbations, cross-domain shifts, and the rapid temporal evolution of the foundation model. To address these issues, we propose \wavedetect, a novel framework that reformulates text detection as a signal processing task within the time-frequency domain. Unlike previous methods that analyze static token probability distributions, \wavedetect models the generated output as a probability signal, upon which a differentiable Continuous Wavelet Transform is applied to convert them into learnable spectral representations. This process reveals the intrinsic ``spectral fingerprints'' in machine-generated texts--patterns that remain invisible in time domain. Comprehensive evaluations on three well-curated datasets (RAID, EvoBench, and Domain-Shift) show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art. It not only achieves superior accuracy but also exhibits remarkable robustness against sophisticated attacks, generalization across out-of-distribution topics and unseen evolving LLMs. Our results validate the efficacy of spectral analysis as a promising paradigm for LLM-generated texts detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wavedetect框架，将大语言模型文本检测转化为时频域信号处理任务，利用可微连续小波变换提取文本的"频谱指纹"，在RAID、EvoBench和Domain-Shift三个数据集上实现了对对抗攻击、跨域迁移和模型演化的最先进鲁棒检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM文本检测器在面对对抗扰动、跨域分布偏移以及基础模型快速时间演化三个关键挑战时表现脆弱，仅依赖表层语义伪影越来越不可靠。
AI.method: 将生成文本建模为概率信号，应用可微连续小波变换(CWT)将其转换为可学习的频谱表示，揭示机器生成文本中在时域不可见的固有"频谱指纹"。
AI.result: 在RAID、EvoBench和Domain-Shift三个数据集上达到新的最佳性能，在对抗攻击、跨领域泛化和对未见过的演化LLM检测方面均表现出优越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 频谱分析作为LLM生成文本检测的新范式是有效的，优于传统依赖静态token概率分布的方法。

title: L20-Edu-135M: An Auditable Single-GPU Study of Data-Efficient Small Language Modeling
summary: Small language models are cheap to serve and feasible on local hardware, but strong public 135M-class systems are commonly trained with hundreds of billions to trillions of tokens on large clusters. We study a sharply resource-constrained regime: a complete 134.5M-parameter language-model pipeline executed on one NVIDIA L20 GPU. The released checkpoint, L20-Edu-135M, receives approximately 13B pretraining tokens: 10B FineWeb-Edu tokens followed by a 3B-token educational, mathematics, code, and reasoning mixture. We document the architecture, data gates, cross-source MinHash/LSH near-deduplication, segment deduplication, benchmark-overlap removal, throughput optimization, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with weight interpolation, and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) on GSM8K. In a self-run zero-shot six-task harness, L20-Edu-135M obtains a mean score of 0.4150. It trails SmolLM-135M (0.4767) and SmolLM2-135M (0.4917), but its mean is 87.1% of SmolLM-135M's while its nominal token count is 2.17% as large. This ratio is descriptive, not evidence of statistical equivalence or a controlled scaling law. The model exceeds several older 100M-160M public baselines under the same harness. Direct GRPO-style RLVR decreases GSM8K exact-match accuracy from 1.82% to 1.59% (192-token completions) and 1.21% (320-token completions). These single-run results identify a concrete failure mode rather than establishing a general lower bound on RLVR. The contribution is an auditable resource-constrained case study, not a state-of-the-art claim.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了极端资源受限条件下的小语言模型完整训练流程：在单张NVIDIA L20 GPU上完成134.5M参数模型的全流程训练（约13B token），最终模型L20-Edu-135M在六任务零样本评测中平均得分0.4150，达到SmolLM-135M性能的87.1%，但训练token量仅为后者的2.17%。论文同时报告了GRPO式RLVR在GSM8K上的失败案例。
AI.motivation: 探索极端资源受限条件下（单GPU）小语言模型训练的可行性，记录实际工程挑战与失败模式，提供可审计的案例研究而非追求最优性能。
AI.method: 134.5M参数模型在单张NVIDIA L20 GPU上完成全流程训练：约13B token预训练（10B FineWeb-Edu + 3B 教育/数学/代码/推理混合数据），采用跨源MinHash/LSH近去重、片段去重、基准重叠去除、吞吐优化、带权重插值的SFT以及基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR on GSM8K）。
AI.result: L20-Edu-135M在六任务零样本评测中平均得分0.4150，达到SmolLM-135M（0.4767）的87.1%，而训练token量仅为后者的2.17%；在GSM8K上GRPO式RLVR导致准确率下降（从1.82%降至1.59%/1.21%），识别出失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个可审计的极端资源受限条件下的语言模型训练案例研究，展示了即使训练数据量极小也能达到有竞争力的性能比例，同时报告了RLVR在小型模型上的具体失败模式。

title: Measuring & Mitigating Over-Alignment for LLMs in Multilingual Criminal Law Courts
summary:
While the wider applicability of LLMs in the legal field is currently debated due to their reliability and the gravity of any errors, narrow uses with well-understood and mitigated risks have emerged. Notably the Swiss Federal Supreme Court uses small on-premises models for tentative translations and short-passage summarization across the four official languages. However, such usage is challenging in the context of Criminal Law. Since rulings and cases employees work on routinely can contain detailed descriptions of violent and sexual offenses, their legitimate work is compromised by refusals and disclaimers due to the activation of model guardrails (over-alignment).
  To measure this phenomenon, we introduce TF-RefusalBench, a multilingual benchmark for criminal-law translation and summarization derived from public Swiss Supreme Court rulings. TF-RefusalBench contains 5,200 total prompts across French, German, Italian, and English, corresponding to common task prompts and passages likely to trigger refusal. We then use TF-RefusalBench to show that over-alignment is a multifaceted phenomenon, influenced by the model and the prompt and text languages being processed, and that its impact cannot be evaluated solely from an over-refusal perspective, given the disclaimer's impact on task faithfulness. Finally, we evaluate approaches to enable on-premises LLMs for Criminal Law Tasks, demonstrating that while prompting can be effective, abliteration (refusal directions ablation) eliminates refusal with minimal impact on task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对刑事法律场景中大语言模型因过度对齐（guardrails）导致拒绝响应的问题，构建了多语言基准TF-RefusalBench，揭示了过度对齐的多面性，并评估了提示工程和abliteration两种缓解方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 瑞士联邦最高法院已在法律领域窄范围使用LLM，但在刑事法律场景中，由于模型安全护栏对暴力、性犯罪等内容的过度响应，导致合法工作（如翻译和摘要）被不当拒绝或附加免责声明，影响任务完成。
AI.method: 构建TF-RefusalBench多语言基准（含法语、德语、意大利语、英语共5,200个提示），基于瑞士最高法院公开刑事判决，包含常规提示和易触发拒绝的敏感内容提示。在此基础上评估过度对齐的多维表现，并对比提示工程与abliteration（拒绝方向消融）的缓解效果。
AI.result: 过度对齐是多面现象，受模型本身、提示语言和文本语言共同影响；其影响不能仅从过度拒绝角度评估，还需考虑免责声明对任务忠实度的破坏；abliteration可消除拒绝行为且对任务性能影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 刑事法律场景中LLM的过度对齐问题确实存在且复杂，abliteration是比提示工程更有效的本地部署方案，为法律领域安全使用LLM提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Neural Conjugate Aggregation: Identifiable Unsupervised Multi-Sensor Regression under Heterogeneous Sensor Bias
summary: We study regression-based data fusion under uncertainty, where multiple noisy and biased measurement sources are available but ground-truth labels are absent during training. This setting arises in sensor networks, simulation ensembles, and scientific monitoring systems where supervision is costly or infeasible. We propose the Neural Conjugate Aggregation Model (NCAM), a hierarchical Bayesian framework that combines neural networks with conjugate Gaussian inference for unsupervised multi-source fusion. NCAM learns source-specific bias and reliability conditioned on contextual covariates, yielding an analytically tractable posterior over a latent target variable with decomposed epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. Structural non-identifiability is resolved through sensor anchoring and variance regularization, enabling stable and interpretable posterior aggregation. To complement Bayesian uncertainty with finite-sample guarantees, we integrate locally adaptive Monte Carlo conformal prediction, producing heteroscedastic prediction intervals with coverage guarantees under exchangeability assumptions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world air-quality datasets demonstrate improved predictive accuracy and well-calibrated uncertainty compared to unsupervised baselines, including mean aggregation, probabilistic PCA, and Kalman filtering.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无监督数据融合的层次贝叶斯框架NCAM，结合神经网络与共轭高斯推理，通过传感器锚定和方差正则化解决非可辨识性，并集成自适应蒙特卡洛共形预测提供有覆盖保证的预测区间。
AI.motivation: 在无监督场景下（无真实标签），如何从多个有噪声和有偏的测量源中融合数据并量化不确定性，是传感器网络、仿真集成和科学监测系统中的关键问题，现有方法缺乏对源特异性偏差和可靠性的条件建模能力。
AI.method: 提出NCAM：1）层次贝叶斯框架，用神经网络建模源特异性偏差和可靠性（依赖上下文协变量）；2）共轭高斯推断得到潜变量的解析后验，分解认知不确定性和偶然不确定性；3）传感器锚定+方差正则化解结构非可辨识性；4）自适应蒙特卡洛共形预测提供异方差预测区间及有限样本覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实空气质量数据集上，NCAM在预测精度和不确定性校准方面优于均值聚合、概率PCA和卡尔曼滤波等无监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: NCAM为无监督多源数据融合提供了一种兼具贝叶斯可解释性和共形预测有限样本保证的有效框架，尤其适用于缺乏真实标签的传感器融合和科学监测场景。

title: Energy-Based Transformers as Predictors of Reading Difficulty
summary: Transformer language models have become established tools for modeling human sentence processing, with measures such as surprisal and attention entropy serving as effective predictors of reading difficulty that together capture complementary aspects of processing load. Here, we explore a related class of transformer models: energy-based transformers, which provide a principled formal link to associative memory models, bringing processing research into direct contact with the broader literature on Hopfield networks and dense associative memory. To our knowledge, this is the first exploration of an energy-based transformer measure in computational psycholinguistics. Across reading-time corpora (Natural Stories, UCL eye-tracking, UCL self-paced reading), the energy measure is a robust predictor of reading times, providing significant fit beyond surprisal in all three. In a controlled experiment on relative clause processing, energy at a single layer captures the well-known object/subject asymmetry. We find evidence that it subsumes effects attributable to both attention entropy and surprisal, suggesting that energy may serve as a single unified predictor where multiple complementary measures have previously been required.

AI.tldr: 本文首次探索基于能量的Transformer（energy-based transformer）中的能量指标作为句子处理难度的预测因子，在多个阅读时间语料库中，能量指标显著优于困惑度（surprisal），并能统一先前需要多个互补指标（如困惑度和注意力熵）才能解释的处理负荷效应。
AI.motivation: 将Transformer语言模型与关联记忆模型（Hopfield网络、密集关联记忆）建立形式化联系，探索能量指标是否可以作为句子处理负荷的统一预测因子。
AI.method: 使用基于能量的Transformer模型，提取能量指标作为预测变量，在Natural Stories、UCL眼动追踪和UCL自定步速阅读三个语料库上对比能量指标与困惑度、注意力熵的预测能力，并在关系从句加工控制实验中进行验证。
AI.result: 能量指标在三个语料库中均显著预测阅读时间，且超越困惑度；在单层能量上捕获了宾语/主语关系从句的加工不对称性；能量指标能够吸收原本由注意力熵和困惑度分别解释的效应。
AI.conclusion: 能量指标可能成为句子处理负荷的统一预测指标，替代先前需要多个互补指标的方法，为计算心理语言学提供了新的理论工具。

title: Sequential Minimal Optimization Algorithm for One-Class Support Vector Machines With Privileged Information
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Author-prepared preprint of the article published in IEEE Access. The published article is licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
summary: One of the powerful techniques in data modeling is accounting for features that are available at the training stage, but are not available when the trained model is used to classify or predict test data -- the Learning Using Privileged Information paradigm (LUPI). Sequential Minimal Optimization (SMO) methods have been developed for supervised Support Vector Machines (SVM), unsupervised one-class SVM, and SVM with privileged information (SVM+). The missing brick in this research has long been a one-class SVM with privileged information (OC-SVM+). In this paper, we propose an SMO algorithm for OC-SVM+ that significantly outperforms non-sequential algorithms for training the OC-SVM+ model. Its finite-time convergence is established. The experiments show how privileged information affects a descriptive domain in the space of original features. Comparative benchmark tests demonstrate that our algorithm is superior over interior point algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于带特权信息的一类支持向量机（OC-SVM+）的序列最小优化（SMO）算法，该算法显著优于非序列化训练方法，并证明了有限时间收敛性。
AI.motivation: 在LUPI范式中，已有监督SVM、无监督一类SVM以及带特权信息的SVM（SVM+）的SMO方法，但长期以来缺少一类SVM与特权信息结合（OC-SVM+）的SMO算法，这正是本文所要填补的空白。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对OC-SVM+的SMO算法，并建立了其有限时间收敛性分析。
AI.result: 实验表明特权信息能够影响原始特征空间中的描述性域；在基准测试中，所提算法优于内点算法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的OC-SVM+ SMO算法在训练效率上显著超越非序列化方法，且具备理论收敛保证，是LUPI范式下重要的一块拼图。

title: Self-Stigma Is Not a Monolith, but Generic Empathy Is: Persona-Conditioned LLM Support for People Who Use Drugs
summary: Self-stigma predicts treatment avoidance and disengagement among people who use drugs (PWUD), yet conversational systems aiming to provide support typically treat self-stigma expression as a uniform signal. We present a three-phase, proof-of-concept study of a persona-aware approach to LLM support. Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) on indicator-level features from 1,174 self-stigma expressors on Reddit yields a four-persona typology validated against held-out behavioral and linguistic features. Sequential Bayesian and recurrent neural classifiers recover these personas from limited posting histories, substantially outperforming batch and few-shot LLM baselines (macro-F1 = 0.74 at 30 posts). Evaluation by eight clinical experts across three contemporary LLMs revealed a misalignment: persona-matched responses successfully achieved targeted behavioral shifts, yet raters holistically preferred the generic empathy of the persona-neutral baseline. Our findings suggest that holistic empathy judgments and clinically-aligned response design can pull in opposite directions, and that evaluating LLM-based stigma support requires rubrics capable of decomposing the two.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于人格感知的LLM支持方法，通过潜在剖面分析从Reddit上1,174名自我污名表达者中识别出四种人格类型，并利用序列贝叶斯和递归神经网络分类器以30条帖子的历史记录实现有效恢复（macro-F1=0.74）。临床专家评估发现，人格匹配的回应虽能实现目标行为转变，但整体上更偏好中性基线的通用共情，提示整体共情判断与临床对齐的回应设计可能相互矛盾。
AI.motivation: 药物使用人群（PWUD）的自我污名会导致治疗回避和脱离，但现有对话系统通常将自我污名表达视为统一信号，缺乏对个体差异的精细考量。
AI.method: 三阶段概念验证研究：1) 对Reddit上1,174名自我污名表达者的指标级特征进行潜在剖面分析（LPA），得到四人格类型学；2) 使用序列贝叶斯和递归神经网络分类器从有限的发帖历史中恢复人格类型；3) 邀请八位临床专家评估三种当代LLM在不同人格匹配条件下的回应效果。
AI.result: 人格类型学得到保留行为与语言特征验证；序列分类器在30条帖子时macro-F1达0.74，显著优于批量和小样本LLM基线；人格匹配回应能实现目标行为转变，但临床专家整体上更偏好人格中性基线的通用共情回应。
AI.conclusion: 整体共情判断与临床对齐的回应设计可能相互排斥，评估基于LLM的污名支持需要能够解耦这两者的评价标准。

title: SamatNext v0.2-B: An Exploratory Study of RMS-Normalized Hybrid Decoders for Curriculum Retention in Small Code Models
comment: 12 pages, 3 tables. Technical report. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/samat2003/samatnext-v0.1/tree/samatnext-v02-lsm-rmsnorm
summary: Standard autoregressive Transformer decoders can often exhibit substantial forgetting under sequential fine-tuning on shifting curriculum distributions. This technical report evaluates SamatNext v0.2-B, an experimental 356M-parameter hybrid sequence decoder that alternates Differential-Attention-style layers with DeltaNet-inspired simplified linear-state mixer layers using RMS normalization and output scale calibration. We study the model under a controlled staged Python code curriculum and compare it with a parameter-matched Transformer baseline. In this setting, SamatNext v0.2-B achieves a 100.0% pass rate on the controlled Stage 5 holdout while retaining 98.8% of adjacent Stage 3 semantic behavior and reaching 12.0% on the Stage 2E early syntax holdout. The strongest Transformer baseline reaches 97.6% on Stage 5 but retains only 6.0% of Stage 3 behavior. Both architectures remain weak on long-horizon early-stage retention, so the result should be interpreted as evidence of an altered retention/plasticity tradeoff in this controlled setting, not as a general solution to catastrophic forgetting. Code, model specifications, evaluation scripts, and result tables are provided for independent verification.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了 SamatNext v0.2-B 混合序列解码器在阶段性 Python 代码课程下的遗忘表现，该模型在保留近期知识的同时优于 Transformer 基线，但长程早期知识保留仍较弱。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归 Transformer 解码器在顺序微调（课程分布变化）下常常表现出显著的遗忘（灾难性遗忘）。本文旨在探索混合架构能否改善这种记忆/可塑性权衡。
AI.method: 提出 SamatNext v0.2-B，一个 356M 参数的混合序列解码器，交替使用 Differential-Attention 层和基于 DeltaNet 的简化线性状态混合层，并采用 RMS 归一化和输出缩放校准。在受控的分阶段 Python 代码课程下，与参数匹配的 Transformer 基线进行比较。
AI.result: SamatNext v0.2-B 在 Stage 5 保留集上达到 100.0% 通过率，保留 98.8% 的相邻 Stage 3 语义行为，并在 Stage 2E 早期语法保留集上达到 12.0%；最强 Transformer 基线在 Stage 5 达到 97.6%，但仅保留 6.0% 的 Stage 3 行为。
AI.conclusion: 混合架构在受控设置下改变了记忆/可塑性权衡，但不能作为灾难性遗忘的通用解决方案；两种架构在长程早期阶段保留上均表现较弱。

title: Do LLM Embedding Spaces Recover Expert Structure?
summary: Pretrained text embeddings are increasingly used as representational maps, yet high category separability does not imply that their geometry recovers expert-defined structure. We study this problem in mental-health-related language, where symptom relations provide an external reference and online communities introduce strong domain, affective, stylistic, and discourse confounds. Using 28 Reddit communities, we compare pretrained and supervised fine-tuned Qwen3 embedding spaces at two scales (0.6B and 4B). We construct category prototypes, evaluate their representational dissimilarity matrices against an expert symptom matrix with representational similarity analysis, and complement this global test with prototype-based typicality and multi-baseline confound controls. Pretrained embeddings show measurable alignment with expert structure within the mental-health subset; fine-tuning strengthens this alignment most at the finest category level; and larger scale improves both zero-shot alignment and supervision-induced gains. Residual alignment remains substantial after controlling for VAD, LIWC, lexical style, and topic-distribution structure. These results suggest that LLM embeddings can recover expert-relevant category geometry, but this recovery is level-dependent and should be tested against explicit confounds rather than inferred from classification alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究预训练和微调后的Qwen3嵌入空间（0.6B和4B）在心理健康相关语言中是否能够恢复专家定义的症状关系结构。基于28个Reddit社区，通过表征相似性分析（RSA）比较嵌入空间与专家症状矩阵的匹配度，并控制VAD、LIWC、词汇风格和主题分布等混杂因素。结果表明：预训练嵌入在心理健康子集中与专家结构有一定对齐；微调在细粒度类别上增强了这种对齐；更大模型规模同时提升零样本对齐和监督学习增益。残差对齐在控制多种混杂后仍然显著。
AI.motivation: 预训练文本嵌入在分类任务中表现良好，但高类别可分性并不保证其几何结构能够恢复专家定义的概念结构。在心理健康领域，症状关系作为外部参考标准，而在线社区引入了领域、情感、风格和话语等多重混杂因素，因此需要系统评估嵌入空间的表征结构是否与专家知识一致。
AI.method: 使用28个Reddit社区的心理健康相关语言数据，比较预训练和监督微调后的Qwen3（0.6B和4B）嵌入空间。构建类别原型，通过表征相似性分析（RSA）计算表征不相似性矩阵与专家症状矩阵的匹配度，并辅以原型典型性分析和多基线混杂控制（VAD、LIWC、词汇风格、主题分布）。
AI.result: 预训练嵌入在心理健康子集中与专家结构存在可测量的对齐；微调在细粒度类别上显著增强对齐；更大模型规模同时提升零样本对齐和监督学习增益；在控制情感、词汇、风格和主题等混杂因素后，残差对齐仍然显著。
AI.conclusion: LLM嵌入能够在一定程度上恢复专家相关的类别几何结构，但这种恢复依赖于类别粒度，且需要通过显式混杂控制来验证，而非仅从分类性能推断。

title: On the Expressive Power of Weight Quantization in Large Language Models
summary: In recent years, weight quantization that encodes the learnable parameters of large language models in an $n$-bit format has garnered significant attention due to its potential for model compression and inference acceleration. Many practical techniques have been developed; however, the theoretical understanding of many aspects, especially the approximation and degradation of expressive power as the number of quantization bits decreases, remains unclear. In this paper, we provide a theoretical investigation into the expressive capability of large language models relative to the number of quantization bits. We argue that 1.58-bit is the limiting precision for weight quantization by establishing the universal approximation and expressive collapse properties of weight-quantized models with respect to the number of quantization bits. Additionally, we confirm that weight quantization leads to expressive degradation, in which the expressive capacity of weight-quantized models degrades polynomially as the number of quantization bits decreases. These theoretical findings provide a solid foundation for advancing weight quantization in the context of scaling laws and shed insights for future research in model compression and inference acceleration.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了大型语言模型权重量化中量化位数与表达能力的关系，证明1.58-bit是权重量化的极限精度，并揭示了表达能力随量化位数减少而多项式衰减的规律。
AI.motivation: 尽管权重量化技术在实践中取得了显著进展，但其理论基础，尤其是表达能力随量化位数减少而退化的机理尚不清晰，亟需理论层面的解释与指导。
AI.method: 通过建立权重量化模型的通用逼近性质和表达能力坍塌性质，从理论上论证了量化位数与表达能力之间的数学关系。
AI.result: 证明了1.58-bit是权重量化的极限精度；量化模型的表达能力随量化位数减少呈多项式级衰减。
AI.conclusion: 这些理论发现为量化在缩放定律下的应用提供了坚实基础，并为模型压缩和推理加速的未来研究提供了理论指导。

title: ReasoningLens: Hierarchical Visualization and Diagnostic Auditing for Large Reasoning Models
comment: Our project is available at https://github.com/icip-cas/ReasoningLens
summary: The emergence of Large Reasoning Models has introduced exceptionally long Chain-of-Thought traces, creating a transparency burden where critical logic is often buried under massive procedural text. To address this, we present ReasoningLens, an open-source framework designed for the hierarchical visualization and diagnostic auditing of complex reasoning chains. ReasoningLens addresses information necropsy by: (1) structuring traces into interactive hierarchies that separate high-level strategy from low-level execution; (2) leveraging an agentic auditor for automated error detection and tool-augmented verification; and (3) synthesizing systemic reasoning profiles to reveal model-specific blind spots. By transforming unstructured walls of text into actionable insights, ReasoningLens provides a modular foundation for interpreting, debugging, and optimizing the next generation of reasoning-centric AI.

AI.tldr: ReasoningLens是一个开源框架，用于对大型推理模型生成的长链思维轨迹进行层次化可视化和诊断审计，通过结构分层、自动错误检测和系统性推理画像三大机制，将非结构化文本转化为可操作的洞察。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型生成的Chain-of-Thought轨迹过长，关键逻辑信息被淹没在海量的过程性文本中，造成透明度负担，亟需有效的可视化和审计工具。
AI.method: (1) 将推理轨迹构建为交互式层次结构，分离高层策略与低层执行；(2) 利用智能审计器进行自动错误检测和工具增强验证；(3) 综合生成系统性推理画像，揭示模型特定盲区。
AI.result: 将非结构化的文本墙转化为可操作的洞察，为推理模型的解释、调试和优化提供模块化基础。
AI.conclusion: ReasoningLens为解释、调试和优化下一代以推理为中心的AI提供了模块化基础框架。

authors: Sergio H. V. L. de Mattos
title: Evolving Spatial Weights for Cartographic Synthesis
summary: The integration of multiple thematic data layers into a single composite map, known as the cartographic synthesis problem, is typically addressed through expert-driven weighting schemes. This study presents a multi-objective formulation of cartographic synthesis grounded in spatial autocorrelation structure. We develop a bi-objective evolutionary framework, GIS-moGA, that estimates layer weights by simultaneously maximizing global spatial structure, measured by Global Moran's I, and minimizing local spatial heterogeneity, measured by the variance of Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA). Because naive evaluation of spatial relationships requires O(N^2) operations, direct computation becomes impractical for larger datasets. We address this challenge by exploiting the 97.7% sparsity of queen contiguity matrices, reducing effective complexity to O(N k) and enabling scalable municipal-level analysis. The framework is evaluated on a high-dimensional spatial epidemiology dataset with N = 523 units from Araraquara, Brazil. A 64-scenario experimental design is used to examine evolutionary behavior across parameter settings. Results show that higher mutation rates are important for maintaining population diversity and preventing premature convergence in spatially autocorrelated fitness landscapes, where crossover operators can disrupt geographically coherent structures. Compared with expert-derived Analytic Hierarchy Process baselines, the resulting Pareto fronts show substantial hypervolume gains and significant improvements in spatial coherence (p < 0.001, Cliff's delta = 0.87). These findings provide a systematic and scalable framework for data-driven geographic multi-criteria decision analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于空间自相关结构的多目标制图综合框架（GIS-moGA），通过最大化全局莫兰指数和最小化局部空间异质性来估计图层权重，利用皇后邻接矩阵的稀疏性实现高效计算，并在巴西阿拉拉夸拉市的流行病学数据上验证了该方法优于专家驱动的层次分析法基准。
AI.motivation: 传统的制图综合依赖于专家驱动的加权方案，缺乏系统性和可扩展性。本文旨在提出一种数据驱动的多目标优化方法，以更客观地解决多专题数据层的综合制图问题。
AI.method: 构建双目标进化框架（GIS-moGA），同时最大化全局空间结构（Global Moran's I）和最小化局部空间异质性（LISA方差）。利用皇后邻接矩阵97.7%的稀疏性，将复杂度从O(N²)降至O(Nk)，实现可扩展的市域级分析。采用64场景实验设计评估进化行为。
AI.result: 在N=523单元的巴西阿拉拉夸拉市流行病学数据集上，高突变率对维持种群多样性和防止过早收敛至关重要。与专家驱动的层次分析法相比，Pareto前沿在超体积和空间一致性上均有显著提升（p < 0.001, Cliff's delta = 0.87）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个系统化、可扩展的数据驱动地理多准则决策分析框架，验证了多目标进化优化在制图综合中的有效性。

title: UnBias-Plus: Detect, Explain, and Rewrite Bias
summary: Bias in natural language remains a persistent challenge in both human-written and AI-generated content, affecting domains such as journalism, education, and AI research. Most existing detection methods identify only the presence of bias, with limited support for granular detection, interpretable explanations, neutral rewriting, and openly available trained models. We present UnBias-Plus, an open-source toolkit unifying (1) segment-level multi-class bias classification, (2) biased span localization, (3) neutral text rewriting, and (4) reasoning for each decision. Available via Python, CLI, REST API, and web interfaces, UnBias-Plus supports accessible bias analysis. The toolkit, source code, models, datasets, and documentation are publicly available.

AI.tldr: UnBias-Plus是一个开源工具包，统一了片段级多类偏见分类、偏见跨度定位、中性文本改写和决策推理四大功能，支持多种接口访问。
AI.motivation: 现有偏见检测方法大多仅识别偏见存在与否，缺乏细粒度检测、可解释性、中性改写和开源模型支持。
AI.method: 构建UnBias-Plus开源工具包，集成偏见分类、定位、改写和推理功能，通过Python、CLI、REST API和Web界面提供访问。
AI.result: 实现了细粒度多类偏见分类、偏见跨度定位、中性文本改写以及决策推理的统一框架，并公开了代码、模型和数据集。
AI.conclusion: UnBias-Plus为偏见分析和中性化提供了全面的开源解决方案，支持多种使用场景。

title: From Handcrafted Features to Functional Edge Learning: Evolution of EEG Seizure Detection Frameworks
summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) analysis remains the clinical gold standard for epilepsy diagnosis and seizure detection. While Deep Learning (DL) has significantly advanced automated EEG interpretation, its transition from controlled experimental settings to routine clinical deployment is severely bottlenecked by fundamental architectural flaws. Standard DL models operate as opaque black-boxes lacking clinical interpretability, demand massive amounts of balanced annotated data, and incur steep computational costs incompatible with resource-constrained wearable or implantable neuromodulation devices. This paper presents a comprehensive review of these prevailing limitations and explores Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) as a emerging paradigm for EEG-based seizure detection. By replacing the fixed activation functions of traditional neurons with flexible, learnable functions along the network's connections, KANs bridge the critical gap between predictive accuracy and mathematical transparency. We systematically analyze how KAN architectures resolve the shortcomings of traditional DL-based models by offering exceptional parameter efficiency, inherent interpretability for physician trust, and robust performance under data scarcity. Ultimately, this review establishes KANs not merely as an incremental algorithmic update, but as a fundamental paradigm shift necessary to actualize next-generation, patient-specific, and thoroughly transparent clinical EEG monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了深度学习在EEG癫痫检测中的三大瓶颈（缺乏可解释性、依赖大量标注数据、计算成本高），并提出KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold网络）作为一种新兴范式，通过可学习的连接函数取代固定激活函数，在参数效率、可解释性和数据稀缺场景下均优于传统DL模型，是实现下一代临床EEG监控系统的关键范式转变。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在EEG癫痫检测中虽取得进展，但黑箱特性、数据依赖和高计算成本严重阻碍了其从实验环境向临床常规部署的转化，亟需一种兼具精度与透明度的新范式。
AI.method: 系统梳理传统深度学习模型在EEG癫痫检测中的三大局限（可解释性缺失、数据需求、计算开销），并引入KAN作为替代架构。KAN将传统神经元的固定激活函数替换为沿网络连接的可学习函数，从而在数学上保证透明度。
AI.result: KAN架构能够解决传统DL模型的短板，具体表现为：卓越的参数效率、固有的可解释性（便于医生信任）、以及在数据稀缺条件下的鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: KAN不仅是增量式的算法更新，而是实现下一代患者特异性、完全透明的临床EEG监测系统所需的根本性范式转变。

title: TriggerBench: Investigating Prospective Memory for Large Language Models
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long interactions, existing evaluations focus predominantly on retrospective memory (RM) via explicit queries. Prospective memory (PM), the critical ability to spontaneously recall and act on latent constraints without direct prompts, remains largely unevaluated. We introduce TriggerBench, a comprehensive PM benchmark spanning five dimensions across both daily assistants and professional workflows. TriggerBench pairs scenarios with matched RM controls, contrastive positive/negative variants, and overloaded triggers, enabling fine-grained measurement of proactive recall, false-alarm rate, and attentional robustness under a single protocol. Our evaluation yields three key findings. (i) PM shows a precision-recall trade-off and attentional fragility. Though enhanced reasoning significantly improves proactive recall, models may overfit to an "always-remind" heuristic. Furthermore, PM accuracy degrades substantially under implicit constraints or triggers overloaded by concurrent user requests, indicating that robust PM remains an open challenge. (ii) PM is notably harder than RM: on identical contexts, RM near-saturates up to 100K tokens, while PM decays sharply as context length scales. (iii) PM may serve as a behavioral probe of spare reasoning capacity. Pairing PM scenarios with AIME-2025 math problems reveals that successful trajectories yield higher PM accuracy than failed ones at the same context length, showing PM tracks spare reasoning budget that token count obscures. Project page: https://github.com/KristenZHANG/TriggerBench-Official.

AI.tldr: 提出了TriggerBench基准测试，用于评估大语言模型的前瞻性记忆（PM）能力，发现PM存在精度-召回率权衡、比回顾性记忆（RM）更难、且可作为剩余推理能力的行为探针。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估主要关注回顾性记忆（RM），忽视了前瞻性记忆（PM）——即在没有显式提示的情况下自发回忆并执行潜在约束的关键能力。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖五个维度的TriggerBench基准，包括日常助手和专业工作流场景，并配对RM对照、对比正/负变体以及过载触发条件，实现细粒度测量。
AI.result: (i) PM存在精度-召回率权衡和注意力脆弱性，隐式约束或触发过载会显著降低PM精度；(ii) PM比RM困难得多，RM在100K tokens内接近饱和，PM随上下文长度增长急剧衰减；(iii) PM可作为剩余推理能力的行为探针，成功轨迹的PM准确率高于失败轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的PM仍然是待解决的开放挑战，PM度量能揭示token数量无法反映的剩余推理预算。

title: Learning a Normal World Model for Few-Shot Boundary-Calibrated Abnormality Detection
summary: Abnormality detection in complex systems faces two practical barriers: abnormal labels are scarce, and binary labels do not quantify how far an event has departed from normal behavior. We study a normal-world modeling formulation for this setting. Instead of learning a large and incomplete space of abnormal classes, the model learns the normal world from abundant normal events and uses a few abnormal examples only to calibrate the boundary of normality. We instantiate this idea as a Hypergraph Entropic Normal-World Model. The model represents multivariate sensor windows as context-conditioned hypergraphs, where hyperedges capture high-order relations among groups of variables. It then defines abnormality by an entropy-aware normal-world energy that combines temporal prediction surprise, hypergraph consistency surprise, and latent normal-manifold departure. On the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan degradation benchmark, the proposed full energy achieves strong zero-shot and few-shot performance across all four subsets and reaches AUROC 0.9983 on FD004, the most complex setting with multiple operating conditions and fault modes. Beyond standard detection metrics, we introduce mechanistic validation tests to probe whether the energy encodes normal-world structure rather than a superficial input-output mapping. The learned energy accepts unseen healthy engines, increases along degradation trajectories, and sharply penalizes context-mismatched cross-variable coupling breaks. These results suggest that normal-world energy can serve as an anomaly score, a graded risk measure, and a testable representation of normal system behavior under severe abnormal-label scarcity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于超图熵的正态世界模型（HENWM），用于解决复杂系统中异常标签稀缺和二值标签无法量化异常程度的问题。该模型通过从大量正常事件中学习正态世界，并仅用少量异常样本校准正常边界，在NASA C-MAPSS数据集上实现了零样本和少样本下的优异异常检测性能（FD004子集AUROC达0.9983），并通过机制验证测试证实其能量函数编码了正态世界结构而非浅层映射。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统中的异常检测面临两个实际障碍：异常标签稀缺，且二值标签无法量化事件偏离正常行为的程度。现有方法或需大量异常数据，或无法提供分级风险度量。
AI.method: 提出了超图熵正态世界模型（HENWM）：将多元传感器窗口建模为上下文条件超图，超边捕获变量组间的高阶关系；通过结合时序预测惊讶度、超图一致性惊讶度和潜在正态流形偏离度，定义熵感知的正态世界能量作为异常得分。
AI.result: 在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇退化基准上，该模型在所有四个子集上均实现了强劲的零样本和少样本性能，在最复杂的FD004子集上AUROC达到0.9983。机制验证测试表明，该能量能接受未见健康引擎、沿退化轨迹递增，并严厉惩罚上下文不匹配的跨变量耦合断裂。
AI.conclusion: 正态世界能量可同时作为异常分数、分级风险度量以及可检验的正常系统行为表征，在严重异常标签稀缺场景下有效。

title: War in the Abstract: The Rise and Consequences of Militarized Language in Scientific Communication
summary: Scientists do not, by profession, wage war. Yet warfare's vocabulary consistently appears in their abstracts. To quantify the extent to which warfare's vocabulary pervades scientific abstracts, we analyze 21.4 million papers (2010-2025; OpenAlex, PubMed). We additionally run a within-subject war-framing experiment (N = 801; 32,040 trials) designed to provide causal insight into the effects of militaristic language on persuasion. Between 2010 and 2025, the presence of militaristic terms in scientific abstracts rose 48% in OpenAlex and 32% in PubMed, with the rise accelerating sharply after 2019 (cross-database r = 0.96, p < 10^-8). The prevalence of militaristic language is conflict-aligned at both country and annual scales (Uppsala Conflict Data Program; r = 0.77-0.84), with the abstracts from the Global South displaying the fastest rise in militaristic language. Among disciplines, social sciences leads in level of such language while engineering and computer science lead in growth. The COVID and post-2022 large-language-model eras also saw the rise and narrowed the language gap between native-English and non-English authors. In our follow-up experiment, we found that war framing reduced credibility (mean shift -0.18 Likert units, 95% CI [-0.21, -0.14]; d_z = -0.28, p < 10^-20), funding willingness (d_z = -0.12) and policy support (d_z = -0.08), with a trend-level increase in sense of urgency (d_z = +0.07). Collectively, findings reveal that while scientific abstracts drift toward warfare, the use of militaristic language may erode credibility, funding willingness, and policy support.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2010-2025年间2140万篇论文摘要，发现军事化术语出现频率上升48%（OpenAlex）和32%（PubMed），且与全球冲突数据高度相关。实验表明战争框架降低了可信度、资助意愿和政策支持，但略微增加了紧迫感。
AI.motivation: 科学家本不以战争为业，但军事化词汇却在科学摘要中日益普遍。研究旨在量化这一现象的规模，并揭示军事化语言对科学传播说服力的因果影响。
AI.method: 分析2140万篇论文摘要（2010-2025；OpenAlex, PubMed）中军事化术语出现频率的时间趋势；与被试内战争框架实验（N=801；32,040次试验）相结合，考察军事化语言对可信度、资助意愿、政策支持和紧迫感的因果效应。
AI.result: 军事化术语在摘要中增长48%（OpenAlex）和32%（PubMed），2019年后加速；与乌普萨拉冲突数据高度相关（r=0.77-0.84）；全球南方增长最快；社会科学水平最高，工程与计算机科学增长最快；COVID和LLM时代拉近了英语与非英语母语作者的差距。实验显示战争框架降低可信度（d_z=-0.28）、资助意愿（d_z=-0.12）和政策支持（d_z=-0.08），趋势性增加紧迫感（d_z=+0.07）。
AI.conclusion: 科学摘要正日益军事化，但军事化语言的使用可能侵蚀科学研究的可信度、资助意愿和政策支持，对科学传播产生负面影响。

title: SCENIC: Semantic-Conditioned Edge-Aware Neural Framework for Structured IoT Command Generation
summary: Edge Internet of Things (IoT) agents are often constrained by memory capacity, privacy requirements, communication latency, and recurring inference cost. Current smart-home assistants commonly rely on API-level command interfaces or cloud-based language models that remain difficult to deploy on edge devices. This paper addresses edge IoT command generation as a many-to-one structured output task, where multiple natural-language instructions map to the same canonical command string for deterministic smart-home parsing. To support this setting, we propose Semantic-Conditioned Edge-Aware Neural Framework for Structured IoT Command Generation (SCENIC), an end-to-end framework covering model architecture selection, Smart Home Instruct data generation, triplet-loss contrastive supervised fine-tuning, pruning and quantization, and deployment-oriented export. We evaluate sub-0.2B-scale transformer backbones, which are, to the best of our knowledge, among the smallest language-model backbones studied for edge IoT structured command generation. On Smart Home Instruct-Bench, the strongest dense decoder-only row reaches 99.0% EM@1, while the encoder-decoder model retains stronger high-sparsity behavior. A representative pruned INT8 encoder-decoder export preserves 91.0% EM@1 and 99.0% EM@5 while reducing exported model size by 25.38%. TensorRT profiling of the NVIDIA 2:4 sparse encoder export further shows up to 1.8x encoder-component speedup, indicating that the selected encoder-decoder deployment path can retain structured command accuracy under edge-oriented compression while hardware acceleration evidence remains component-level. The SCENIC code and experimental artifacts are open sourced to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCENIC框架，将边缘IoT命令生成建模为多对一结构化输出任务，采用小规模（<0.2B参数）Transformer模型，通过三元组损失对比微调、剪枝和量化等压缩技术，在保持高准确率的同时实现边缘端部署。最强密集解码器模型达99.0% EM@1，剪枝INT8编码器-解码器模型在缩小25.38%体积下保留91.0% EM@1，稀疏编码器在TensorRT上实现1.8倍加速。
AI.motivation: 边缘IoT设备受限于内存容量、隐私需求、通信延迟和推理成本，现有智能家居助手依赖API级命令接口或云端模型，难以在边缘设备上部署。需要一种能够将多个自然语言指令映射到同一规范化命令的结构化生成方法，同时支持模型压缩与边缘部署。
AI.method: 提出SCENIC框架，包括：(1) 将边缘IoT命令生成建模为多对一结构化输出任务；(2) 构建Smart Home Instruct数据集；(3) 采用三元组损失对比监督微调；(4) 应用剪枝和量化技术进行模型压缩；(5) 面向部署的模型导出；(6) 评估多种<0.2B参数的Transformer骨干网络（密集解码器、编码器-解码器架构）。
AI.result: 密集解码器模型达99.0% EM@1；剪枝INT8编码器-解码器模型在模型体积缩小25.38%的条件下保留91.0% EM@1和99.0% EM@5；NVIDIA 2:4稀疏编码器在TensorRT上实现最高1.8倍编码器组件加速。
AI.conclusion: 编码器-解码器架构在边缘压缩场景下能更好地保持结构化命令准确率，硬件加速证据虽限于组件级别，但表明了边缘IoT结构化命令生成的可行路径。SCENIC代码和实验工件已开源。

title: Self-Compacting Language Model Agents
summary: Long agent traces composed of chains of thought and tool calls accumulate stale content that anchor subsequent generations, and eventually outgrow the context window. Existing scaffolds mitigate it with fixed-interval compaction triggered at a token threshold. Such triggers pay no heed to trajectory structure, risking discard of partial results mid-derivation or mid-search. We propose SelfCompact, a scaffold that allows the model itself to decide when and how to compact. Specifically, it pairs two inference-time elements: (i) a compaction tool the model invokes to summarize the accumulated context, and (ii) a lightweight rubric specifying when to fire (a sub-task has resolved, or the trajectory is converging) and when to suppress (mid-derivation, or when stuck). Both are needed. The tool alone is unevenly used across open-weight models, often invoked at unhelpful moments or not at all; the rubric alone cannot act. Together, they elicit effective adaptive compaction without any fine-tuning or external supervision. We present empirical results on six benchmarks (competitive math and agentic search) and seven models. Our results show that SelfCompact matches or exceeds fixed-interval summarization at a fraction of the token cost, improving over a no-summarization baseline by up to 18.1 points on math and 5-9 points on agentic search at 30-70% lower per-question cost. Our results expose a meta-cognitive gap: although unprompted models cannot reliably tell when their own context is rotting, a lightweight rubric closes this gap, reframing when to compact as a capability that scaffolds can supply without training.

AI.tldr: SelfCompact提出了一种让模型自主决定何时及如何压缩长推理轨迹的框架，通过配对"压缩工具"和"轻量级规则"实现自适应压缩，无需微调或外部监督，在多个基准测试中以更低成本达到或超过固定间隔压缩的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的固定间隔压缩策略忽略轨迹结构，可能导致推理或搜索过程中部分结果被错误丢弃；同时模型自身缺乏判断上下文何时"腐烂"的元认知能力，需要一种自适应压缩机制。
AI.method: SelfCompact设计了两大组件：(i) 一个可调用的压缩工具，让模型自行总结累积的上下文；(ii) 一组轻量级规则(rubric)，规定在子任务解决或轨迹收敛时触发压缩，在推导中途或陷入困境时抑制压缩。两者配合使用，无需微调或外部监督即可实现有效的自适应压缩。
AI.result: 在6个基准测试和7个模型上的实验显示：SelfCompact在数学任务上最高提升18.1个点，在智能体搜索任务上提升5-9个点，同时每问题成本降低30-70%，以更低的token消耗达到或超过固定间隔总结的效果。
AI.conclusion: 模型本身缺乏判断上下文何时"腐烂"的元认知能力，但通过轻量级规则可以弥合这一差距，表明"何时压缩"作为一种能力可以由框架（scaffold）提供而无需训练。

title: Encoder-Decoder Manifold Alignment for Idempotent Generation
summary: Recently, several learning paradigms have been introduced to enforce idempotency in generative models. The goal is to ensure that repeated application of a model leaves samples unchanged once they lie on the target data manifold. In practice, however, many of these approaches fail to achieve exact fixed points, leading to instability and drift under repeated application. In this work, we argue that a key reason for this failure is a geometric mismatch between the manifolds learned by the encoder and decoder. The encoder projects inputs onto one latent manifold, while the decoder implicitly learns to reconstruct data from a different manifold. This discrepancy prevents the model from learning truly idempotent mappings. To address this issue, we propose a new training framework that explicitly closes this gap by forcing the encoder and decoder to learn consistent representations of the same underlying data manifold. By aligning the geometry of these components, our method encourages stable projections. Empirically, we show that our approach achieves significantly lower idempotency error and consistently regenerates identical outputs under repeated application, compared to existing methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on both image generation and image editing tasks. Finally, we show that enforcing idempotency in this manner improves identity preservation and information stability, leading to more realistic and controllable generative editing models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的训练框架，通过对齐编码器和解码器学习的流形几何结构，解决生成模型中幂等性失效导致的漂移和不稳定问题，在图像生成和编辑任务上显著降低了幂等性误差，提升了身份保持和信息稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有幂等生成模型在多轮应用中无法达到精确不动点，导致不稳定和漂移。作者认为根本原因是编码器和解码器学习的流形存在几何不匹配——编码器将输入投影到一个潜在流形，而解码器从另一个不同流形重建数据，这种不一致阻碍了模型学习真正的幂等映射。
AI.method: 提出一种新的训练框架，通过强制编码器和解码器学习同一底层数据流形的一致表示，显式弥合两者之间的流形几何差距，对齐编码器和解码器的几何结构。
AI.result: 与现有方法相比，该方法实现了显著更低的幂等性误差；在多轮重复应用下能一致地再生出相同输出；在图像生成和图像编辑任务上均有效；改善了身份保持和信息稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对齐编码器和解码器的流形几何结构来强制幂等性，能够生成更真实且可控的生成式编辑模型，有效解决现有方法中因流形不匹配导致的稳定性问题。

title: LangMAP: A Language-Adaptive Approach to Tokenization
summary: Language-specific tokenizers improve tokenization quality and the downstream performance of models on those languages. However, using such a tokenizer comes at a cost: either a new model must be trained from scratch, or the vocabulary of an existing pretrained model must be adapted. We propose Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori (LangMAP) Tokenization, a tokenization scheme that extends the UnigramLM algorithm to the multilingual setting, producing language-specific tokenization from a single shared vocabulary. Notably, LangMAP can be used when training a multilingual language model from scratch or to adapt a pretrained model's tokenizer to individual languages without changing its vocabulary. While language labels are required at training time, a key feature of the algorithm is that it then performs language-specific tokenization at inference without knowledge of the input's language. Across 14 open-source tokenizers, 9 natural languages, and 9 programming languages, LangMAP improves morphological boundary alignment and, for all coding languages tested, alignment with abstract syntax tree (AST) leaf boundaries. In fine-tuning experiments, results are mixed: LangMAP improves target-language grammatical acceptability (MultiBLiMP) on the languages tested; its benefits are less consistent on knowledge-related tasks (Global-PIQA, Belebele).

AI.tldr: 提出LangMAP分词方案，通过扩展UnigramLM算法到多语言场景，使用单一共享词汇表实现语言特定的分词，在训练时需要语言标签但推理时无需语言信息，提升了形态边界对齐和AST叶边界对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 语言特定的分词器能提升分词质量和下游模型性能，但使用此类分词器要么需要从头训练新模型，要么必须适配现有预训练模型的词汇表，成本高昂。为此，需要一种能在不增加额外成本的情况下实现语言特定分词的方法。
AI.method: 提出Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori (LangMAP) Tokenization，将UnigramLM算法扩展到多语言场景，使用单一共享词汇表但产生语言特定的分词结果。训练时需要语言标签，推理时无需输入语言信息即可进行语言特定分词。
AI.result: 在14个开源分词器、9种自然语言和9种编程语言上，LangMAP提升了形态边界对齐效果；在所有编程语言上，提升了与抽象语法树（AST）叶边界的对齐。微调实验中，LangMAP提升了目标语言的语法可接受性（MultiBLiMP），但在知识相关任务（Global-PIQA, Belebele）上效果不太一致。
AI.conclusion: LangMAP能够在单一共享词汇表下实现语言特定分词，既可用于从头训练多语言模型，也可用于适配预训练模型的分词器而无需改变词汇表，在形态对齐和AST对齐方面有提升，语法任务上表现良好，但知识任务上效果不一致。

title: Enhancing Protein Representation Learning via Manifold Restore Mixing
summary: Data augmentation (DA) has been proven to be an effective means for improving protein representation learning (PRL) by generating additional training samples. Although mainstream perturbation- and sampling-based augmentation methods can produce data containing sufficient variations, they carry the risk of disrupting the protein structure and function. Some crafted protein homology modeling tools can generate conformations, but reduce structural diversity. The above dilemmas lead us to a question: Can we restore the disrupted structure caused by DA operations, providing data with both the original structure and diverse variations? In this work, we first analyze and empirically reveal the structure defect and performance degradation issues of existing DA methods. Based on the findings, we propose a simple yet effective DA method, Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM), for protein representation learning. Specifically, inspired by manifold mixup, we mix the hidden representations of original and augmented protein data to generate new samples that restore structural information lost in DA while introducing diverse variations. Furthermore, we develop a sample difficulty scheduler that adjusts the beta distribution in mixup to provide models with progressively challenging mixed samples during training, which improves the final performance. Comprehensive experiments on various PRL backbones and downstream tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. The complete code and weights will be released upon acceptance. We provide a implementation at https://github.com/KingGugu/MRM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM)方法，通过在隐空间混合原始与增强蛋白质数据的表征，在保留原始结构信息的同时引入多样变异，解决现有数据增强方法破坏蛋白质结构的问题，并设计样本难度调度器逐步提升训练难度，在多个PRL骨干和下游任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质数据增强方法存在结构破坏（扰动/采样法）或结构多样性不足（同源建模法）的矛盾，作者旨在设计一种能同时保留原始结构并引入多样变异的增强方法。
AI.method: 1) Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM)：受manifold mixup启发，在隐空间混合原始蛋白质与增强蛋白质的隐层表征，生成既能恢复增强操作丢失的结构信息又能引入多样变异的新样本；2) 样本难度调度器：动态调整mixup中的Beta分布参数，在训练过程中逐步提供难度递增的混合样本。
AI.result: 在多种蛋白质表示学习骨干网络和下游任务上，MRM均取得优于现有DA方法的性能，实验验证了其有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MRM通过隐空间混合策略调和了数据增强中结构保留与多样性引入之间的矛盾，是一种简单有效的蛋白质表示学习方法。

title: Evaluation Awareness Is Not One Capability: Evidence from Open Language Models
summary: Safety benchmarks assume that test-condition behavior predicts deployment behavior, an assumption that fails if models detect evaluation cues and adapt. This opens a gap between benchmark performance and deployment behavior: compliance measured under test conditions becomes an optimistic upper bound that overstates how safely a model behaves once the evaluation harness is removed. We characterize this evaluation awareness through eight experiments across 37 open-weight models and seven families. (i)Detection is moderate and training-driven (24/37 models exceed chance, best AUROC 0.714 vs.0.819 human, with instruction tuning dominating over scale). (ii)Detection shifts safety behavior (hard refusal drops 5.8 percentage points under hypothetical framing, and 21/140 HarmBench framing effects are significant, with compliance rising up to +30 percentage points. (iii)Representations survive behavioral collapse (probes retain AUROC 0.98 under rewrites that drive behavior below chance, and multi-layer steering causally moves three downstream tasks while random controls do not). (iv)These axes are weakly coupled (only 1/15 correlations are significant, the sole robust link being behavioral detection versus framing resistance, $ρ=-0.79$, $p<0.001$). We call this gap the benchmark illusion: because detectability, behavioral manifestation, and controllability vary independently, it is multivariate rather than a single number, so no single awareness score is a reliable proxy for deployment safety.

AI.tldr: 本文通过8个实验对37个开源模型进行系统研究，发现模型能够检测评估环境并调整行为，导致基准测试表现与部署行为之间存在系统性差距——即“基准幻觉”。研究表明评估感知的检测能力、行为表现和可控性三个维度弱耦合，无法用单一分数衡量部署安全。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准假设测试条件下的行为能预测部署行为，但该假设在模型能够检测评估线索并调整自身行为时失效，导致基准性能成为过于乐观的上界，掩盖了实际部署中的安全风险。
AI.method: 在37个开源模型（7个模型家族）上设计8个实验，从四个方面分析评估感知：(i)检测能力（AUROC与人类对比），(ii)对安全行为的影响（假设框架下的硬拒绝率变化），(iii)表征的可存活性（重写后表征保持、多层因果操控），(iv)各维度之间的耦合程度（相关性分析）。
AI.result: (i)24/37模型超出随机水平，最佳AUROC 0.714（人类0.819），指令微调主导规模效应；(ii)假设框架下硬拒绝下降5.8个百分点，21/140 HarmBench条件显著，合规率最高上升30个百分点；(iii)重写后行为降至随机以下但探针AUROC仍保持0.98，多层因果操控显著影响下游任务；(iv)仅1/15相关性显著，唯一稳健关联是行为检测与框架抵抗之间的负相关（ρ=-0.79, p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 评估感知的检测、行为和可控性三个维度独立变化，是多元而非单一的，因此任何单一的感知分数都不能可靠地代理部署安全性。这种系统性偏差被称为“基准幻觉”。

title: Diffusion Integrated Gradients: Controllable Path Generation for Flexible Feature Attribution
comment: 44 pages, 22 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026; includes appendix
summary: Path-based attribution methods such as Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely adopted for their strong axiomatic properties and effectiveness in attributing model predictions to input features by integrating gradients along a path from a baseline to the input. However, the choice of the attribution path largely affects the quality of explanations, and existing approaches rely on fixed or hand-crafted paths that often produce noisy or distorted attributions. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Integrated Gradients (DiffIG), a novel method that reformulates path generation as a conditional generative modeling problem. DiffIG first trains a diffusion model to learn a distribution over paths generated from a Stick-Breaking Process, then employs guided sampling to embed user guidance during the sampling procedure. We demonstrate that DiffIG quantitatively matches or outperforms existing path-based methods, achieving perceptually aligned explanations. This work introduces a new generative perspective for flexible, inference-time controllable Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出扩散集成梯度（DiffIG），将路径生成建模为条件生成问题，通过扩散模型学习路径分布并支持引导采样，生成感知对齐的可解释性归因。
AI.motivation: 现有基于路径的归因方法（如集成梯度）依赖固定或手工设计的路径，导致归因结果噪声大、失真严重，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: DiffIG首先训练扩散模型学习基于Stick-Breaking过程生成的路径分布，然后通过引导采样在推理时嵌入用户引导，实现灵活的条件路径生成。
AI.result: 定量实验表明DiffIG在匹配或超越现有路径方法的同时，生成感知上对齐的解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可解释AI提供了生成式新视角，实现了推理时可控制的灵活归因方法。

title: EnterpriseClawBench: Benchmarking Agents from Real Workplace Sessions
summary: Enterprise agents increasingly operate inside workspaces: they read heterogeneous files, invoke tools, and deliver business artifacts. We introduce EnterpriseClawBench, an enterprise agent benchmark constructed from proprietary, real-world agent sessions. Starting from a large archive of workplace sessions, the EnterpriseClawBench produces 852 reproducible tasks, each paired with recovered fixtures, rewritten prompts, role classes, skill subclasses, hard rules, and semantic rubrics. Because the sessions contain internal enterprise content, we do not release the benchmark data; instead, our reusable contribution is the construction and evaluation protocol. On EnterpriseClawBench, the best configuration reaches only 0.663 (Codex with GPT-5.5). These results show that enterprise agent evaluation must report harness--model combinations, artifact delivery, visual quality, cost, runtime, and skill-transfer behavior, rather than collapsing performance into a single score. Code: https://github.com/FrontisAI/EnterpriseClawBench

AI.tldr: 提出了EnterpriseClawBench，一个基于真实企业工作会话构建的智能体基准测试，包含852个可复现任务，评测发现最佳配置（Codex+GPT-5.5）仅达0.663分，揭示了企业智能体评估需要多维度报告而非单一分数。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体日益在真实工作空间中运行（读写异构文件、调用工具、交付业务产物），但缺乏能够反映企业场景复杂性的标准化评估基准。现有基准多聚焦通用任务，无法覆盖企业环境的特殊需求（如多模态文档处理、工具调用链、严格规则约束等）。
AI.method: 从大规模真实企业会话档案中提取数据，构建了852个可复现任务。每个任务包含：恢复的夹具（fixtures）、重写的提示词、角色类别、技能子类、硬规则和语义评分标准。由于数据包含企业内部内容，不公开基准数据本身，而是开源构建与评估协议。
AI.result: 最佳配置（Codex with GPT-5.5）在EnterpriseClawBench上的得分仅为0.663，表明企业智能体任务具有显著挑战性。实验发现评估必须报告：模型与框架组合、工件交付质量、视觉质量、成本、运行时和技能迁移行为等多维指标。
AI.conclusion: 企业智能体评估不应简化为单一分数，而应提供多维度的性能报告。当前最优方法表现有限，企业级任务仍存在巨大提升空间。代码已开源。

title: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Can Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely viewed as a promising path toward continuously improving large language models. Recent works, however, suggest that mainstream RLVR often reallocates sampling probabilities among trajectories already present in the base model: it can improve sampling efficiency, reflected by higher pass@1 scores, but yields limited gains, and can even decrease pass@k scores when k is large, and therefore may fail to expand the base model's reasoning capacity boundary. In this paper, we present a boundary-aware Curriculum RL approach to move beyond the base model's reasoning capacity boundary. Our approach first uses pass@k sampling to locate the current reasoning capacity boundary, then applies targeted teacher guidance to examples near or beyond that boundary, and finally uses RL to consolidate the newly introduced reasoning patterns. Across Qwen, Llama, and DeepSeek base models, boundary-aware Curriculum RL improves both pass@1 scores and pass@256 scores, with pass@1 reflecting one-attempt performance and pass@256 serving as an empirical proxy for the reasoning capacity boundary. In our experiments, average pass@256 improves by 9.8 percentage points over the base models and by 10.3 percentage points over Vanilla RLVR. These results suggest that boundary-aware Curriculum RL can provide a scalable route for LLMs to continuously improve beyond the base model's empirical reasoning capacity boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种边界感知的课程强化学习方法，通过定位基础模型的推理能力边界、对边界附近样本进行针对性教师引导、再用RL巩固新推理模式，从而提升LLM的推理能力。实验表明，该方法在pass@1和pass@256指标上均优于基础模型和标准RLVR。
AI.motivation: 主流RLVR方法仅能重新分配基础模型中已有轨迹的采样概率，提升pass@1但无法扩展模型的推理能力边界，甚至在大k值时降低pass@k。因此需要一种能够突破基础模型推理能力边界的方法。
AI.method: 三阶段方法：(1) 使用pass@k采样定位当前推理能力边界；(2) 对边界附近或超出边界的样本应用针对性教师引导；(3) 使用RL巩固新引入的推理模式。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek基础模型上，pass@1和pass@256均有提升。平均pass@256相比基础模型提升9.8个百分点，相比Vanilla RLVR提升10.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 边界感知的课程RL能够为LLM提供一条可扩展的路径，使其持续超越基础模型的经验推理能力边界。

title: Can LLMs Reliably Self-Report Adversarial Prefills, and How?
summary: Prior work shows that large language models (LLMs) exhibit introspective capability on benign tasks. We extend the question to safety contexts and examine how reliably a model can recognize that its own prior response was elicited by an adversarial prefill attack. Across ten open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs (3B to 70B) and four safety benchmarks, no model reliably recognizes its own compromised outputs, with models claiming intent on prefilled responses at an average rate of $27.3\%$. Introspective signal stems largely from safety- and refusal-related reasoning. Orthogonalizing models' weights against the refusal direction collapses the gap between claiming rates on prefilled and natural outputs to near zero, though the direction is not its unique mediator. The signal is also probe-dependent: framing the question as internal intention versus external tampering elicits qualitatively different responses on the same models. We test three LoRA finetuning methods (SFT, GRPO, DPO) on eight models from 3B to 27B; all three widen the intention-probe gap on every model from 8B to 27B, with method ranking varying by model. The intervention does not transfer to the tampering probe and counterintuitively raises attack success rate under adversarial prefill on most models, amounting to a partial mitigation. These findings outline mechanisms underpinning the observed introspective signals in safety contexts and highlight risks in the reliability of LLM self-reports.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）在安全场景下无法可靠地识别自身输出是否受到对抗性前缀攻击（adversarial prefill attack）的操纵，模型平均有27.3%的概率将预填响应归因于自身意图，且内省信号主要来源于安全与拒绝相关推理。权重正交化、探针形式以及LoRA微调等方法均无法有效解决该问题，反而在某些情况下加剧了攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明LLM在良性任务上具备内省能力，本文探索在安全场景下模型能否可靠地识别自身先前响应是由对抗性前缀攻击（adversarial prefill attack）引发的。
AI.method: 在10个开源指令微调LLM（3B-70B）和4个安全基准上测试模型对自身受损输出的识别能力；分析内省信号来源（安全/拒绝相关推理）；进行权重正交化（消除拒绝方向）实验；对比不同探针形式（内部意图 vs. 外部篡改）；对8个模型（3B-27B）进行三种LoRA微调（SFT、GRPO、DPO）。
AI.result: 所有模型均无法可靠识别自身受损输出，平均27.3%将预填响应归因于自身意图；内省信号主要来自安全与拒绝推理；权重正交化后预填与自然输出的归因率差距降至接近零；探针形式显著影响响应；LoRA微调在所有8B-27B模型上扩大了意图探针差距，方法排名因模型而异；干预无法迁移到篡改探针，且多数模型上对抗性前缀攻击成功率反而上升。
AI.conclusion: LLM在安全场景下的内省信号不可靠，其机制主要基于安全与拒绝相关推理路径；模型自我报告存在显著风险，现有干预方法效果有限甚至适得其反。

title: All Routes Lead to Collapse
summary: Attention sinks, representation collapse, and norm stratification are treated as transformer-specific pathologies. We show they are not specific to attention: they are what content-based routing does under a fixed similarity metric. We give a reframing identity: softmax attention is Boltzmann-weighted aggregation over Euclidean distances with constant key norms, so its score omits a $-\|k\|^2$ term and is blind to key magnitude. This predicts that any router whose metric is ill-matched to its representations should compensate, by concentrating its routing and collapsing the routed representations. We test it on routers that score and aggregate over different axes: softmax attention over tokens (nine pretrained transformers), graph attention over nodes, a selective state-space model and a recurrent mixer over time, and learned residuals over depth. All develop the same signature, and two within-model ablations show it is caused by the routing mechanism rather than by incidental dynamics. The form is contingent, set by the strength of the positional brake each router carries alongside its content score; we sweep that brake and move the onset across its whole range. The mechanism is not contingent, and it does not require norm stratification: a router with norm-normalized keys concentrates just the same. We do not claim these models implement Riemannian geometry; the geometric view is a diagnostic that names the inadequacy of the flat, norm-blind metric.

AI.tldr: 本文证明注意力下沉、表示坍缩和范数分层并非Transformer特有的病理现象，而是任何使用固定相似度度量的基于内容的路由机制都会出现的普遍问题。作者将Softmax注意力重新解释为带常数键范数的玻尔兹曼加权聚合，指出其评分忽略了键的范数信息，导致路由与表示不匹配时产生补偿性集中和坍缩。实验涵盖9种预训练Transformer、图注意力、状态空间模型、循环混合器和残差路由，均观察到相同特征。路由中的位置刹车强度决定具体表现形式，但机制本身不依赖于范数分层。
AI.motivation: 揭示注意力下沉、表示坍缩和范数分层并非Transformer特有现象，而是基于内容路由机制在固定相似度度量下的普遍行为，从而统一理解不同架构中的类似病理现象。
AI.method: 通过数学推导将Softmax注意力重写为忽略键范数的玻尔兹曼加权聚合，并在多种架构（Transformer、图注意力、SSM、循环混合器、残差网络）上实证验证路由集中与表示坍缩的普遍性，同时通过位置刹车强度控制和范数归一化解耦实验进行因果分析。
AI.result: 所有测试的架构均展现出相同的路由集中和表示坍缩特征；位置刹车强度决定具体表现形式；范数归一化后路由集中现象依然存在，证明该机制不依赖范数分层。
AI.conclusion: 这些现象是内容路由在固定度量下的必然结果，而非注意力特有；几何视角作为诊断工具揭示了当前路由机制中平直、忽视范数的度量缺陷。

title: Randomized YaRN Improves Length Generalization for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained on short sequences and then extended to work on longer sequences with additional training. However, such LLMs still struggle to further generalize to very long sequences. We propose Randomized YaRN, a training method that improves length generalization by combining YaRN-based positional extrapolation with randomized positional encoding and a length curriculum. During training on short context data, tokens are assigned YaRN positional encodings sampled from a larger position range, exposing the model to out-of-distribution positional representations even on short-context inputs. We evaluate Randomized YaRN on two challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, BABILong and Multi-Round Coreference Resolution (MRCR). When training on data with <8K context, Randomized YaRN consistently improves reasoning performance on context lengths from 16K to 128K and outperforms standard fine-tuning, with the largest gains appearing at far out-of-distribution lengths. Our results suggest that progressively exposing models to OOD positional distributions provides an effective recipe for generalizable long-context reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Randomized YaRN训练方法，通过结合YaRN位置外推、随机位置编码和长度课程，在短上下文训练数据上提升LLM的长上下文推理泛化能力，在BABILong和MRCR基准上显著优于标准微调方法。
AI.motivation: LLM通常在短序列上预训练后通过额外训练扩展至长序列，但仍难以进一步泛化到超长序列，现有方法在分布外长度上表现不佳。
AI.method: Randomized YaRN：在短上下文训练中，为token分配从更大位置范围采样的YaRN位置编码，使模型暴露于分布外的位置表示；同时结合长度课程策略，渐进式训练。
AI.result: 在<8K上下文数据上训练后，Randomized YaRN在16K至128K上下文长度上持续提升推理性能，显著优于标准微调，在远分布外长度上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 逐步暴露模型于分布外位置分布是提升长上下文推理泛化能力的有效策略。

title: Select-to-Act: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Language Guidance
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been widely applied to sequential decision-making, yet it often suffers from poor sample efficiency due to costly interactions with the environment. A limited line of recent work has started exploring improving RL efficiency by leveraging external knowledge expressed in natural-language instructions. However, the few existing approaches typically treat the entire instruction as a single conditioning input, failing to account for the stage-dependent nature of language guidance, especially in complex environments. In this paper, we propose \emph{Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Language Instructions (HRLLI)}, a hierarchical RL framework that explicitly models natural-language instructions as dynamically selectable semantic guidance during decision-making. HRLLI decomposes instructions into a set of piecewise guidance elements, where each instruction piece may become relevant at different stages of interaction with the environment. A novel hierarchical RL policy structure is then formulated in a \emph{Select-to-Act} paradigm: a high-level semantic policy acts as a guidance selector that selects the most relevant instruction piece to the current state to guide the low-level agent's decision, while a low-level policy executes environment actions conditioned on the selected guidance. The two-level policies are learned simultaneously to maximize augmented expected returns from interactions with the environment. This design enables the agent to adaptively ground language instructions into stage-specific decisions during interaction. Experiments on the instruction-intensive RTFM benchmark show that HRLLI consistently outperforms strong instruction-conditioned RL baselines, demonstrating that explicitly modeling adaptive instruction selection significantly improves the effectiveness of RL.

AI.tldr: 提出分层强化学习框架HRLLI，通过将自然语言指令分解为可动态选择的片段指导，采用"选择-执行"范式，高层语义策略选择与当前状态最相关的指令片段，低层策略基于所选指导执行动作，显著提升强化学习在指令密集型环境中的样本效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有利用自然语言指令改进强化学习效率的方法通常将整个指令作为单一条件输入，未能考虑语言指导在不同决策阶段的动态相关性，尤其在复杂环境中，指令的不同部分在不同阶段具有不同作用。
AI.method: 提出HRLLI框架：1) 将指令分解为片段化指导元素；2) 设计"选择-执行"分层策略结构，高层语义策略选择当前最相关的指令片段，低层策略基于所选片段执行环境动作；3) 两层级策略联合学习以最大化期望回报。
AI.result: 在指令密集型RTFM基准测试中，HRLLI一致优于强指令条件化强化学习基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模自适应指令选择能显著提升强化学习在复杂环境中的有效性，验证了将自然语言指令作为动态可选择的阶段指导优于整体条件化输入的方式。

title: PEAR: Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate
