summary: Multi-agent debate improves the reliability of large language models (LLMs) through iterative peer critiques. However, fixed topologies often introduce persistent positional biases, amplify unreliable agents, and cause high sensitivity to role assignments. We introduce \textit{Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate (PEAR)}, an inference-time protocol that dynamically reconfigures communication roles and sparse topologies across consecutive debate rounds. By strategically switching agent-to-role assignments based on evolving agent states, PEAR prevents any agent from permanently occupying a privileged network position or distributes influence more evenly across the debate. We theoretically characterize PEAR as an equivariant sparse router: it preserves accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across four reasoning benchmarks and six diverse LLM backbones demonstrate PEAR significantly improves average accuracy over the strongest debate baselines. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/PEAR.

AI.tldr: PEAR是一种推理时协议，通过动态重新配置多智能体辩论中的通信角色和稀疏拓扑（基于智能体状态的轮次间排列等变自适应路由），防止位置偏见和影响力集中，在四个推理基准和六个LLM骨干上显著优于现有辩论方法。
AI.motivation: 固定拓扑结构的多智能体辩论存在持续的位置偏见、不可靠智能体被放大以及对角色分配高度敏感等问题，需要一种动态机制来缓解这些缺陷。
AI.method: 提出Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate (PEAR)，一种推理时协议，在连续辩论轮次中动态重新配置通信角色和稀疏拓扑，基于演化的智能体状态策略性地切换智能体到角色的分配，被理论化为一个等变稀疏路由器。
AI.result: 在四个推理基准和六个不同LLM骨干上的全面实证评估表明，PEAR显著提升了平均准确率，超越了最强的辩论基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PEAR通过排列等变自适应路由有效解决了固定拓扑带来的位置偏见和影响力不均问题，提升了多智能体辩论的可靠性和泛化性能。

title: Reliability-Guided Adaptive Ensembling for Robust Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate domain shift without source data, but it is highly brittle under adversarially contaminated test streams, where corrupted inputs also destabilize online updates. We study robust test-time adaptation (RTTA) in the adversarial-stream setting, which remains comparatively underexplored relative to standard TTA, and propose SAFER (Stochastic Augmentation Framework for Enhanced Robustness), a training-free reliability-guided augmentation wrapper for RTTA. SAFER preserves the wrapped TTA objective while replacing brittle single-view predictions with a reliability-guided pooled predictor. For each test sample, SAFER generates stochastic augmentations and aggregates their predictions through correlation-weighted pooling with outlier detection. We further study an adaptive-mixing extension that improves clean-performance retention by adjusting original-versus-augmentation weighting using feature disagreement signals. We evaluate on PACS, VLCS, and OfficeHome under PGD attacks at various attack rates. Across benchmarks, SAFER improves resilience of TTA methods to adversarial attacks while maintaining competitive clean performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFER，一种无需训练的、基于可靠性引导的随机增强包装器，用于增强对抗流设置下测试时自适应（TTA）方法的鲁棒性。SAFER通过生成随机增强并基于相关性加权池化与异常检测聚合预测，同时引入自适应混合扩展以保持干净性能。在PACS、VLCS和OfficeHome数据集上，SAFER在PGD攻击下显著提升了TTA方法的对抗鲁棒性，同时保持了竞争力的干净性能。
AI.motivation: 标准TTA方法在面对对抗污染的测试流时非常脆弱，受污染的输入会破坏在线更新过程。虽然对抗流的鲁棒测试时自适应（RTTA）相比标准TTA仍相对未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出SAFER，一种训练免费的可靠性引导增强包装器。具体包括：(1) 对每个测试样本生成随机增强；(2) 通过相关性加权池化（correlation-weighted pooling）和异常检测聚合增强预测；(3) 提出自适应混合扩展，利用特征分歧信号调整原始预测与增强预测的加权比例，以保持干净性能。
AI.result: 在PACS、VLCS和OfficeHome数据集上，在PGD攻击下，SAFER显著提升了TTA方法对对抗攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持了具有竞争力的干净性能。
AI.conclusion: SAFER作为一种无训练包装器，能有效增强现有TTA方法的对抗鲁棒性，无需修改原TTA目标函数，且在干净性能与鲁棒性之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Path-dependent program induction under resource constraints explains human sequence learning
summary: How do people build abstract, reusable knowledge from sequential experience under bounded cognitive resources? To answer this question, we integrate rate-distortion theory with recent advances in program induction to describe how prior knowledge shapes which future structures are cheap to encode and easy to discover. We formalize this in a hierarchical Adaptor Grammar (HAG) with distinct local (within-task) and global (across-task) libraries, governed jointly by constraints on memory and computation. In simulations, HAG achieves better rate-distortion trade-offs and stronger generalization than fixed grammars or shallow chunking methods. In an online melodic sequence-learning experiment, participants' recall errors reflected systematic simplifications and reaction times increased at inferred program boundaries. Trial-by-trial fits further showed that hierarchical libraries best explained individual differences in both recall and out-of-sample continuation choices, outperforming all alternative models. These findings cast structured learning as bounded program induction in which the order of experience shapes future abstractions a learner builds.

AI.tldr: 本文整合率-失真理论与程序归纳，提出层次化适应语法（HAG）模型，在有限认知资源下解释人们如何从序列经验中构建抽象可重用知识。实验表明HAG在率-失真权衡和泛化上优于固定语法或浅层分块方法，在线旋律学习实验中层级库模型最好地解释了个体差异。
AI.motivation: 回答在有限认知资源下，人们如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可重用的知识这一核心问题。
AI.method: 整合率-失真理论与程序归纳，提出层次化适应语法（HAG），该语法包含局部（任务内）和全局（跨任务）两个不同的知识库，并受记忆和计算约束共同调控。
AI.result: HAG在率-失真权衡和泛化上优于固定语法或浅层分块方法；在线旋律序列学习实验中，参与者回忆错误反映系统性简化，反应时间在推论的程序边界处增加；层级库模型最好地解释了个体差异。
AI.conclusion: 结构化学习可视为有界程序归纳，其中经验顺序塑造了学习者未来构建的抽象知识。

title: On the Sparsity-Storage-Accuracy Tradeoff in Parsimoniously Activated Dictionary Learning
summary: Dictionary learning has long been studied from both optimization and probabilistic perspectives. While formulations with element-wise sparsity regularization (e.g., L1-based sparse coding) admit well-established probabilistic interpretations, many structured variants that impose global constraints lack a clear and tractable generative view. In this paper, we revisit a class of practically effective yet theoretically under-explored dictionary learning methods that impose a simple global regularization on the number of activated dictionary atoms, which we term parsimoniously activated dictionary learning (PADL). We show that PADL admits an equivalent formulation as maximum a posteriori estimation under a structured generative model, with auxiliary latent variables that govern global activation patterns. This formulation allows us to derive generalization guarantees that are difficult to obtain under the original formulation. More importantly, it yields an analytical characterization of the tradeoff between sparsity, storage cost, and reconstruction accuracy, enabling data-driven estimation of optimal hyperparameters. Based on this connection, we develop an efficient and interpretable PADL algorithm that eliminates manual hyperparameter tuning, achieving improved reconstruction performance under comparable sparsity levels on visual benchmarks. We further demonstrate its practical utility in accelerating inference for vision-language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简洁激活字典学习（PADL）方法，通过全局正则化限制激活字典原子数量，并证明其等价于结构化生成模型下的最大后验估计，从而获得泛化保证并实现超参数自动调优，在视觉基准上达到更优的重建性能，并可加速视觉-语言模型推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的字典学习方法中，基于元素级稀疏正则化（如L1稀疏编码）已有成熟的概率解释，但许多施加全局约束的结构化变体缺乏清晰且可处理的生成式视角。本文旨在为那些实践有效但理论上未被充分探索的、对激活字典原子数量施加简单全局正则化的字典学习方法提供理论基础。
AI.method: 将PADL重新表述为结构化生成模型下的最大后验估计，引入控制全局激活模式的辅助潜变量；基于此推导泛化保证；给出稀疏性、存储成本与重建精度之间权衡的分析表征，实现超参数的数据驱动估计；开发无需人工调参的高效可解释PADL算法。
AI.result: 在视觉基准上，所提方法在相当稀疏性水平下实现了更优的重建性能；并在视觉-语言模型的推理加速中展示了实际效用。
AI.conclusion: PADL通过全局激活约束兼具理论与实践优势，其概率重新诠释不仅提供了泛化理论支撑，还实现了自动超参数选择，为结构化字典学习开辟了新路径。

title: In LLM Reasoning, there is Irrationality on top of Value Misalignment
summary: Significant progress has been made in aligning LLMs with target value functions. We argue that, even when an LLM has been well aligned in (post-)training, it may still fail to maximise the aligned value in reasoning. We mathematically formalise this gap as rational value risk: the utility discrepancy between a model's deployed reasoning strategy and its rational counterpart, which is defined to be the responses that maximise expected utility in the steepest direction. The estimation error of rational value risk is further decomposed into three components from finite candidates, finite prompts, and imperfect verifiers. Extensive experiments are conducted, covering models Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5, T{\"}ulu-3 families (7B-72B), GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5, and DeepSeek-V4, and benchmarks UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MathArena. The results validate that (1) rational value risk is widespread; (2) value alignment can reduce, but cannot eliminate, it; (3) the risk is highly sensitive to inference-time reasoning strategy; and (4) longer reasoning improves rationality with diminishing returns. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/LLM-Rationality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“理性价值风险”概念，形式化定义了LLM在推理中未能最大化对齐价值的差距，并通过大量实验验证该风险普遍存在、价值对齐可降低但无法消除、对推理策略高度敏感、以及长推理收益递减。
AI.motivation: 即使LLM在（后）训练中已充分对齐价值函数，其在推理阶段仍可能未能最大化对齐价值，存在理论与实际表现之间的差距，需要对此进行形式化定义与量化分析。
AI.method: 形式化定义理性价值风险为部署推理策略与理性策略（在最大梯度方向上最大化期望效用的响应）之间的效用差异；将风险估计误差分解为有限候选、有限提示和不完美验证者三个来源；在多个模型家族和基准上开展实验验证。
AI.result: (1) 理性价值风险普遍存在；(2) 价值对齐可降低但无法消除该风险；(3) 该风险对推理时策略高度敏感；(4) 更长推理可提升理性但存在边际收益递减。
AI.conclusion: LLM在推理阶段的理性价值风险是一个系统性问题，单纯依靠训练阶段的价值对齐不足以完全消除，需进一步关注推理时策略的优化。

title: Multigrid Training for Molecular Generation using Graph Neural Networks
summary: Deep learning has demonstrated significant success for modeling biochemical molecular systems, where inputs are commonly represented as graphs or 3D grids. A major challenge is that computational cost scales with resolution, making full graph/grid computation of molecular densities expensive and often unstable. We introduce a multigrid training strategy that leverages low-resolution optimization to accelerate learning at higher resolution through parameter transfer across discretizations. For graph molecular representations, we progressively transfer parameters learned from a coarse graph to a sequence of increasingly finer graphs via biased random walk upsampling. For 3D molecular generation, we voxelize the molecular structures at multiple resolutions, pretrain a coarse-resolution conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE), and initialize a fine-resolution CVAE by transferring shape compatible convolutional parameters from the coarse model. Numerical experiments on receptor-conditioned 3D Ligand generation show that multigrid training accelerates convergence and improves generalization compared to training from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多网格训练策略，通过在粗分辨率下优化并跨离散化参数迁移，加速高分辨率下的学习，应用于图分子表示和3D分子生成，实验证明其能加速收敛并提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在生化分子系统建模中计算成本随分辨率增长，全图/全网格计算分子密度昂贵且不稳定，需要高效的训练方法。
AI.method: 提出多网格训练策略：对图分子表示，通过偏置随机游走上采样渐进传递粗图参数到细图；对3D分子生成，多分辨率体素化，预训练粗分辨率条件变分自编码器（CVAE），通过迁移形状兼容的卷积参数初始化细分辨率CVAE。
AI.result: 在受体条件3D配体生成任务上，多网格训练相比从头训练加速了收敛并提高了泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 多网格训练策略能有效降低高分辨率分子建模的计算成本，加速训练并提升模型泛化性能。

title: AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents
summary: LLM agents are promising for alpha mining via combining financial priors, symbolic reasoning, executable factor generation, and feedback-driven refinement. Yet, they face a combinatorial search space, noisy non-stationary feedback, redundant discoveries, and overfitting risks from naively reusing past successes. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaMemo, a self-evolving alpha mining agent with Structured Search-Process Memory. Rather than memorizing only final factors or full trajectories, AlphaMemo records reusable evidence about which edit motifs work or fail under specific parent-factor contexts. It extracts motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory on top of a search-ledger prior, and uses asymmetric veto control to suppress high-confidence failure patterns. Experiments on CSI 500 and S\&P 500 show improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency, with ablations validating the roles of residual learning, confidence gating, AST-diff motifs, and veto memory. Code is at https://github.com/jarrettyu/AlphaMemo.

AI.tldr: AlphaMemo提出了一种基于结构化搜索过程记忆的自进化alpha挖掘智能体，通过记录可复用的编辑模式证据而非仅记忆最终因子或完整轨迹，结合置信门控残差记忆和非对称否决控制，在CSI 500和S&P 500上提升了样本外性能和固定预算发现效率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在alpha挖掘中面临组合搜索空间大、非平稳噪声反馈、冗余发现以及过度拟合等问题，现有方法仅记忆最终因子或完整轨迹，缺乏对可复用知识的结构化记录。
AI.method: AlphaMemo通过从抽象语法树差异中提取编辑模式，采用置信门控残差记忆叠加在搜索分类账先验之上，并利用非对称否决控制抑制高置信度失败模式。
AI.result: 在CSI 500和S&P 500上的实验表明，该方法提升了样本外性能和固定预算发现效率；消融实验验证了残差学习、置信门控、AST差异模式以及否决记忆各组件的作用。
AI.conclusion: 结构化搜索过程记忆比单纯记忆因子或完整轨迹更能有效指导alpha挖掘，置信门控和非对称否决控制是应对噪声和非平稳性的关键机制。

title: Bypassing Minimization Bias: A Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator for Off-Equilibrium Local Learning Coefficients
comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/yingjiacai/SIVE
summary: Singular Learning Theory leverages the Local Learning Coefficient (LLC) to quantify the geometry of neural network loss landscapes. However, mean-energy LLC estimators depend explicitly on an additive loss baseline, typically an estimate of the local minimum. During transient, off-equilibrium training phases, this minimum is unknown; substituting it with the lowest noisy mini-batch loss induces a systematic minimization bias that distorts the geometric measurement. In this paper, we propose the Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator (SIVE), a variance-based local LLC probe that structurally eliminates the unknown additive baseline through the variance operator. Combining this shift-invariant observable with an explicit correction derived from the Law of Total Variance, SIVE separates geometric loss fluctuations from mini-batch evaluation noise. Controlled experiments on analytically tractable toy models show that SIVE recovers the expected finite-temperature geometric signal in regimes where anchored mean estimators fail. Applied to deep neural networks, SIVE provides a robust, localized online diagnostic for tracking structural phase transitions throughout training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator (SIVE)，一种基于方差的局部学习系数估计器，通过方差运算消除未知加性损失基线，结合全方差定律校正项分离几何波动与评估噪声，在解析模型和深度神经网络中均能稳健追踪训练过程中的结构相变。
AI.motivation: 均值能量LLC估计器依赖未知的加性损失基线（局部最小值），在非平衡训练阶段该基线未知；使用最低噪声小批量损失替代会引入系统性最小化偏差，扭曲几何测量结果。
AI.method: SIVE通过方差算子结构性地消除未知加性基线，并结合全方差定律（Law of Total Variance）推导显式校正项，分离几何损失波动与小批量评估噪声。
AI.result: 在可解析处理的玩具模型上，SIVE在锚定均值估计器失效的设定下恢复了预期的有限温度几何信号；在深度神经网络中，SIVE提供了鲁棒的局部在线诊断工具，可追踪训练过程中的结构相变。
AI.conclusion: SIVE通过方差基的移位不变性解决了均值基LLC估计器因未知基线导致的偏差问题，为深度学习训练动态中的几何测量提供了一种鲁棒、局部且可在线的诊断方法。

title: SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed in dynamic interactive environments, creating a growing need for continual skill learning during interaction. Recent approaches address this challenge by learning reusable skills from successful trajectories. However, these skill learning methods largely assume static and safe environments, overlooking risks from adversarial interactions (e.g., prompt injections) and environmental dynamics (e.g., pop-ups). In dynamic settings, such assumptions can lead to risky skill learning and brittle execution, undermining the reliability of CUAs. This raises the question: how can CUAs learn and use skills safely in dynamic environments? To address this problem, we propose SkillHarness, a framework for safe skill harnessing in dynamic environments. SkillHarness moves beyond static skill abstractions by modeling skill learning and utilization as a safety-constrained interaction process. Specifically, we introduce the skill boundary that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories, and construct self-improving safety constraints throughout the skill lifecycle. In addition, SkillHarness introduces selective skill reuse, where tasks are guided to decompose according to context and completed through the selective activation of skill subsets. Our experiments demonstrate that SkillHarness significantly reduces the unsafe rate of learned skills by 57.1% and consistently improves execution stability under dynamic environmental changes, outperforming existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 针对动态环境中计算机使用代理（CUA）的技能学习安全问题，提出SkillHarness框架，通过技能边界界定和选择性技能重用来实现安全约束下的技能学习与复用，在实验中降低了57.1%的不安全率并提升了执行稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA技能学习方法假设环境是静态且安全的，忽略了对抗性交互（如提示注入）和环境动态变化（如弹窗）带来的风险，导致技能学习存在安全隐患，执行不够可靠。
AI.method: 提出SkillHarness框架，将技能学习与利用建模为安全约束的交互过程。核心包括：①技能边界（skill boundary），利用多源监督信号从交互轨迹中识别安全技能；②自改进的安全约束机制，贯穿技能生命周期；③选择性技能重用（selective skill reuse），根据上下文引导任务分解并通过选择性激活技能子集完成任务。
AI.result: SkillHarness将所学技能的不安全率降低了57.1%，并在动态环境变化下持续提升了执行稳定性，优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模安全约束和选择性技能复用，可以在动态环境中安全地进行技能学习与利用，为CUA的可靠部署提供了有效方案。

title: Asymptotic Signal Subspace Recovery in Softmax Attention Models
summary: Attention mechanisms have demonstrated remarkable empirical success in identifying relevant information from large collections of tokens, yet the theoretical principles underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. We study a stylized softmax-attention model in which a query vector is learned by stochastic gradient ascent from a collection of informative and nuisance tokens. Exploiting the symmetry of the model, we derive a population objective and characterize the limiting ordinary differential equation governing the learning dynamics. Using tools from stochastic approximation and dynamical systems theory, we establish a rigorous connection between the stochastic learning algorithm and its deterministic limit. Our main result shows that, under suitable high-dimensional scaling assumptions and standard step-size conditions, the learned query converges almost surely to the one-dimensional signal subspace spanned by the latent informative direction. Equivalently, the query asymptotically recovers the latent signal up to the intrinsic sign ambiguity. These results provide a rigorous theoretical foundation for understanding attention mechanisms as signal extraction procedures in high-dimensional noisy environments and offer a dynamical-systems perspective on how attention discovers relevant information in the presence of substantial noise.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机梯度上升学习查询向量的简化softmax注意力模型，在高维含噪环境下证明了查询向量几乎必然收敛到潜在信号子空间，从而为注意力机制作为信号提取过程提供了严格的理论基础。
AI.motivation: 注意力机制在实际应用中效果显著，但其选择相关信息的理论原理尚不明确。本文旨在建立注意力机制在高维含噪环境中作为信号提取过程的严格理论基础。
AI.method: 研究一个简化softmax注意力模型，其中查询向量通过随机梯度上升从信息性token和噪声token中学习。利用模型对称性推导群体目标函数，刻画学习动力学的极限常微分方程，使用随机逼近和动力系统理论建立随机学习算法与其确定性极限之间的严格联系。
AI.result: 在适当的高维缩放假设和标准步长条件下，学习到的查询向量几乎必然收敛到由潜在信息方向张成的一维信号子空间。查询向量渐近地恢复潜在信号（仅存在固有的符号歧义）。
AI.conclusion: 本文为理解注意力机制作为高维含噪环境中的信号提取过程提供了严格的理论基础，并从动力系统视角揭示了注意力如何在大量噪声中发现相关信息。

title: From Knowing to Acting: Benchmarking Self-Awareness Capability of LLM Agents
summary: The integration of external tools has transitioned LLM agents from passive responders to autonomous systems. However, current benchmarks prioritize execution success, neglecting self-awareness capability, the ability to discern whether a problem requires necessary external resources or can be solved via internal parametric knowledge. To address this, we introduce KAPRO (Knowing-Acting Quadrant PRObe), a framework that evaluates cognitive-behavioral alignment by decoupling an agent's metacognitive judgment (Knowing) from its spontaneous execution (Acting). We further construct KAware, a dataset rigorously partitioning tasks into external, internal, and hybrid subspaces to systematically probe these epistemic boundaries. Extensive experiments across diverse agent architectures show that self-awareness capability is strongly correlated with task success but degrades sharply in internal-capability settings. Moreover, open-source and instruction-following models exhibit stronger tool overuse due to shallow pattern matching, while proprietary and reasoning-oriented models demonstrate more reliable cognitive gating. Benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/AI-Santiago/KAware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KAPRO框架和KAware数据集，用于评估LLM智能体的自我意识能力（即判断问题是否需要外部工具还是仅靠内部参数知识解决），实验发现自我意识与任务成功强相关，但开源和指令遵循模型存在工具过度使用问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准过度关注执行成功率，忽视了智能体的自我意识能力——即判断问题是否需要外部资源还是可以通过内部参数知识解决的能力。
AI.method: 提出KAPRO（Knowing-Acting Quadrant PRObe）框架，将智能体的元认知判断（Knowing）与自发执行（Acting）解耦，以评估认知-行为对齐。同时构建KAware数据集，将任务严格划分为外部、内部和混合子空间，系统性地探测认知边界。
AI.result: 自我意识能力与任务成功强相关，但在内部能力设置中急剧下降；开源模型和指令遵循模型因浅层模式匹配表现出更强的工具过度使用，而专有模型和推理导向模型有更可靠的认知门控。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一套评估智能体自我意识的新框架与数据集，揭示了不同模型在工具使用上的认知偏差，为未来构建更可靠的自主智能体提供了指导。

title: QeHDC: Hyperdimensional Computing based on Quantum-enhanced binding and SuperClass Construction
summary: Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) is a robust computational framework inspired by human cognition characterized by simple and efficient operations within high-dimensional vector spaces. Quantum-enhanced Hyperdimensional Computing (QeHDC) extends classical HDC by leveraging quantum mechanical properties to enhance computational efficiency. In this paper, we propose a novel Quantum HDC framework featuring a one-pass training method, leveraging sinusoidal and quantum encoding to project classical data into quantum amplitude states efficiently. Our framework introduces an innovative reference-state-based quantum binding operation realized via quantum circuits. Furthermore, we propose a density-matrix-based superclass generation strategy employing eigenvalue decomposition to extract critical quantum state features effectively, enabling a more accurate and robust class representation. Experimental evaluations conducted on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate our approach's superior performance, robustness to noise, and computational feasibility compared to traditional classical and existing quantum-enhanced approaches. The results highlight the practical benefits and potential of Quantum HDC for quantum-enhanced classification tasks and pave the way for future advancements in quantum-inspired computational paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型量子超维计算（Quantum HDC）框架，采用单次训练方法，结合正弦与量子编码将经典数据映射到量子幅度态，创新性地引入基于参考态的量子绑定操作（通过量子电路实现）以及基于密度矩阵的超类生成策略（利用特征值分解提取关键量子态特征）。在标准基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在性能、噪声鲁棒性和计算可行性方面均优于传统经典方法和现有量子增强方法。
AI.motivation: 经典超维计算（HDC）虽然高效，但在处理复杂任务时仍存在性能瓶颈；现有量子增强HDC方法尚未充分挖掘量子力学特性来提升计算效率和分类准确性。研究者希望利用量子计算的并行性和量子态表征能力，设计一种更高效、更鲁棒且易于训练的量子HDC框架。
AI.method: (1) 采用正弦编码与量子编码将经典数据投影到量子幅度态； (2) 提出单次训练（one-pass training）方法，无需迭代优化； (3) 引入基于参考态（reference-state）的量子绑定操作，通过量子电路实现绑定运算； (4) 提出基于密度矩阵的超类生成策略，利用特征值分解提取关键量子态特征，构建更精确鲁棒的类别表征。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上，该方法的分类性能优于传统经典HDC和现有量子增强HDC方法；对噪声具有更强的鲁棒性；同时具备计算可行性，能够在当前量子硬件条件下实现。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Quantum HDC框架展示了量子计算在增强分类任务中的实际潜力，为未来量子启发的计算范式提供了新的方向，尤其在高维数据处理和噪声环境下具有明显优势。

title: DrugBench: Evaluating AI Control Protocols for Medication Harm Mitigation
summary: Large Language Models have the potential to expand and improve the access to clinical information by enabling new ways of interacting with medical knowledge in natural language. However, their deployment in medical question-answering settings is safety-critical, since misaligned outputs can lead to severe patient harm. AI control is an emerging approach that introduces external safeguards to mitigate unsafe behaviours in misaligned systems and has been shown to be effective in domains such as code generation. However, its applicability and effectiveness in medical settings have not been systematically studied. In this work, we present a pipeline for evaluating AI control protocols to mitigate medication-related harm. To this end, we introduce DrugBench, an AI control evaluation benchmark which combines 3,671 multi-turn medical conversations from HealthBench with drug information from official FDA labels, covering four categories of medication-related harm: drug interactions, contraindications, dosing constraints, and patient action restrictions. Furthermore, inspired by the medical domain, we argue that safety should account for the severity of unsafe outputs, not just their probability. Under this revised definition, we show that existing control protocols can be subverted and propose severity-based monitoring to address this limitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DrugBench——一个评估AI控制协议以减少用药相关伤害的基准，包含来自HealthBench的3,671个多轮医疗对话和FDA药品标签数据，覆盖四类用药风险；并针对现有控制协议易被规避的问题，提出了基于严重程度的监测方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医疗问答中的应用存在安全风险，错误输出可能导致患者严重伤害。AI控制方法在代码生成等领域被证明有效，但在医疗场景中的适用性和有效性缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 提出了DrugBench基准，整合了3,671个多轮医疗对话（来自HealthBench）和FDA官方药品标签信息，覆盖药物相互作用、禁忌症、剂量约束和患者行为限制四类用药风险；并提出了基于严重程度的监测方法（severity-based monitoring）来改进现有控制协议。
AI.result: 发现现有AI控制协议在医疗场景下可以被规避；引入基于严重程度的监测后能够有效解决该局限性。
AI.conclusion: 医疗领域的AI安全评估应考虑不安全输出的严重程度而不仅是概率；基于严重程度的监测可以提升控制协议在医疗场景中的有效性。

title: Enhancing LLMs for Graph Tasks via Graph-aware LoRA Generation
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) tightly couple their input-output parameters to dataset-specific feature spaces and target sets, exhibiting limited transferability across different datasets. In contrast, language models (LMs) generalize flexibly via a unified input-output interface, motivating recent attempts to adapt LMs to graph tasks. However, existing methods struggle to encode whole-graph information, leading to potential information loss and suboptimal graph understanding. In this work, we propose a novel weight-level information injection paradigm for adapting LMs to graph tasks. This paradigm injects whole-graph information by generating task-specific weight updates that interact directly with hidden representations. Instantiating this paradigm following low-rank adaptation (LoRA), we introduce GaRA, a Graph-aware LoRA generation model. GaRA constructs low-rank weight updates conditioned on the original graph structures and constrains the norm of the generated updates, thus injecting whole-graph information and avoiding the optimization bias in the weight generation. Empirical studies demonstrate that GaRA consistently outperforms baselines on zero-shot graph learning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GaRA，一种通过图感知LoRA生成模型将全图信息注入语言模型的新范式，用于图任务的零样本学习。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN在不同数据集间迁移性差，而LM虽有统一接口但难以编码全图信息，导致信息丢失和图理解次优。
AI.method: 提出权重级信息注入范式，通过生成任务特定的权重更新与隐藏表示直接交互；基于LoRA实例化为GaRA，生成基于原始图结构的低秩权重更新并约束其范数，以注入全图信息并避免优化偏差。
AI.result: 在零样本图学习任务上，GaRA一致优于基准方法。
AI.conclusion: GaRA通过图感知的权重级注入有效提升了LM对图任务的适应性，尤其在零样本场景下表现出色。

title: From Question Answering to Task Completion: A Survey on Agent System and Harness Design
summary: LLM-based agents mark a shift from passive question answering to active task completion: they perceive environments, invoke tools, maintain state, and act over extended horizons. As agent systems have evolved from prompt engineering to workflows and context engineering, harness engineering, and agent-native training with co-evolution, a central question has become increasingly important: where does the bottleneck in agent performance reside, in the foundation model, in the execution harness, or in the coupling between them? This survey examines LLM-based agents through a model-harness lens. We first clarify the functional definition of agents and the implementation view of an LLM-based agent as a foundation model coupled with an execution harness. We then analyze the limits of model-centric scaling, trace four paradigms of agent engineering, and decompose the execution harness into six coupled runtime responsibilities: observation, context, control, action, state, and verification. Using this decomposition, we map task properties and domain pressures to harness configurations, review benchmark and evaluation practices, and synthesize model-harness evidence on how runtime design affects long-horizon task completion, efficiency, and reliability. Finally, we identify open challenges in value-aware evaluation, safety, harness generalization, and model-harness co-evolution. Rather than treating agents as models with auxiliary tools, this survey argues that agent quality -- including success, efficiency, safety, and generalization -- emerges from the interaction between model capability, runtime infrastructure, task structure, and evaluation design. A collection of papers discussed in this survey is provided in https://github.com/ggjy/Awesome-Agent-Engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模型-执行框架（model-harness）视角系统审视LLM-based agent，指出代理质量（成功率、效率、安全性、泛化性）并非仅由模型能力决定，而是模型能力、执行框架、任务结构和评估设计四者交互涌现的结果。文章梳理了代理工程的四个范式，将执行框架解耦为六大运行时职责，并讨论了开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM-based agent从被动问答转向主动任务完成，代理性能的瓶颈位置（基础模型、执行框架还是二者耦合）愈发关键。现有研究多将代理视为"模型+工具"的简单组合，缺乏从系统角度对模型与执行框架交互机制的系统分析。
AI.method: 采用模型-执行框架（model-harness）视角进行分析：首先界定代理的功能定义和实现视图；分析模型中心化扩展的局限，梳理代理工程的四个范式演进；将执行框架解耦为观察、上下文、控制、动作、状态、验证六项运行时职责；基于该分解映射任务属性和领域压力到框架配置，综述基准与评估实践，综合模型-框架证据。
AI.result: 提出了执行框架的六职责分解（观察、上下文、控制、动作、状态、验证），揭示了运行时设计对长程任务完成、效率和可靠性的影响机制，明确了代理质量涌现于模型能力、运行时基础设施、任务结构和评估设计的交互。
AI.conclusion: 代理质量是模型能力、执行框架、任务结构和评估设计交互涌现的结果，而非仅由模型决定。未来需关注价值感知评估、安全性、框架泛化性以及模型-框架协同进化等开放挑战。

title: Escaping the Variance Trap: Jacobian-Free Dynamics for Root-Finding Bilevel Optimization
summary: Many central machine learning tasks, from entropy tuning in reinforcement learning to equilibrating generative adversarial networks, are fundamentally stochastic root-finding problems rather than loss minimization. Yet, they are frequently forced into a minimization framework via squared residuals, introducing a critical flaw we identify as the Variance Trap. Standard bilevel minimization algorithms require estimating hypergradients involving implicit Jacobians; in stochastic settings, these terms act as noise amplifiers, destabilizing convergence. We formalize Root-Finding Bilevel Optimization (RF-BO) as a distinct problem class that bypasses this pathology. We propose a Jacobian-free solution using Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation (TTSA) that updates directly along the root error, structurally avoiding variance amplification. We provide the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for TTSA in this setting under Markovian noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate the decisive advantage of this paradigm: compared to squared-residual and implicit-gradient baselines, our framework achieves a 2.6\% top-1 accuracy gain in SimCLR, 17$\times$ faster convergence in non-linear ODE control where baselines fail, significantly improved entropy stability in reinforcement learning, and an 11.1\% quality improvement in generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出根求解双层优化（RF-BO）框架，通过双时间尺度随机逼近（TTSA）方法直接沿根误差更新，避免平方残差导致的方差陷阱，在多个任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 许多机器学习任务本质上是随机根求解问题，但被强制转化为最小化框架（平方残差），导致"方差陷阱"——隐式雅可比矩阵在随机设置下放大噪声，破坏收敛稳定性。
AI.method: 形式化根求解双层优化（RF-BO）问题类，提出无雅可比的双时间尺度随机逼近（TTSA）方法，直接沿根误差更新，从结构上避免方差放大，并在马尔可夫噪声下给出首个非渐近收敛保证。
AI.result: SimCLR上top-1准确率提升2.6%，非线性ODE控制中加速17倍且基线方法失败，强化学习中熵稳定性显著提升，生成建模质量提升11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 根求解视角比最小化视角更适合随机根问题，TTSA方法在理论和实验上均优于平方残差和隐式梯度基线。

title: Simulated Customers Never Walk Away: Decision Fidelity of LLM User Simulators Measured Against Real Purchase Outcomes
summary: LLM-as-user-simulation has become core infrastructure for conversational AI: agent benchmarks (tau-bench), training pipelines, and a growing body of fidelity studies all rely on LLMs role-playing the human side of dialogue. Existing frameworks measure communicative fidelity -- whether simulators talk like humans -- against ground truth from paid participants role-playing assigned goals. We argue this has a structural blind spot: when the goal is assigned, the user's willingness is exogenous, so no framework can test whether simulators make decisions like real users whose motivation is endogenous, latent, and decaying. We introduce decision fidelity -- whether a simulated population reproduces the decision-state dynamics of real users facing real, consequential choices -- and measure it on a unique testbed: 2,790 production conversations between an LLM sales agent and real customers, including 793 with verified payment outcomes. Using a teacher-forced probe protocol that holds context and instrument fixed, we find a systematic, outcome-correlated failure we call the disengagement deficit: simulators reproduce eventual buyers almost exactly (depth bias +0.09) but inflate eventual non-buyers toward the purchase frame (depth bias +0.40; d=0.38, p<0.001), halving expressed resistance (25.1% to 13.5%) and nearly doubling deliberation (21.9% to 40.1%) while fabricating no purchases. The deficit replicates across model families (DeepSeek: d=0.41, p=0.002) and resists the obvious fix: instructing the simulator that it may disengage cuts marginal bias five-fold but barely moves the outcome-conditioned contrast (d=0.34, p=0.008). Real non-buyers say "not now" and stop; simulated non-buyers ask about price. Evaluating or training sales and persuasion agents against such simulators overstates funnel progress exactly where it matters most -- the customers who walk away.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“决策逼真度”（Decision Fidelity）概念，指出现有LLM用户模拟框架只衡量沟通逼真度，忽略了用户的动机是内生的、潜在的和衰减的。通过在2,790条真实销售对话（含793条有支付结果）上的测试，发现模拟器存在“脱离赤字”（Disengagement Deficit）：能准确复现最终购买者行为，但严重高估非购买者的参与度（抵抗减半、深思翻倍），且该缺陷在DeepSeek等模型中复现且无法通过简单提示修复。真实非购买者说“现在不要”并离开，模拟非购买者却询问价格。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM用户模拟框架仅关注沟通逼真度（模拟器是否像人类一样说话），但无法测试模拟器是否像真实用户一样做出决策，因为真实用户的动机是内生的、潜在的且随时间衰减的，而实验中被指派目标的用户其动机是外生的。
AI.method: 利用2,790条真实生产环境中的LLM销售代理与客户对话（含793条带验证支付结果），采用教师强制探测协议（teacher-forced probe protocol），固定上下文和工具，比较模拟器与真实用户在决策状态动态上的差异。
AI.result: 模拟器存在系统性的“脱离赤字”：对最终购买者复现准确（深度偏差+0.09），但对非购买者高估参与度（深度偏差+0.40，d=0.38，p<0.001），抵抗表达从25.1%降至13.5%，深思从21.9%升至40.1%。该缺陷在DeepSeek上复现（d=0.41，p=0.002），且简单提示修复效果有限（条件对比d=0.34，p=0.008）。
AI.conclusion: 在模拟器中评估或训练销售/说服代理会高估漏斗进展，尤其是在最关键的时刻——那些真正离开的客户。现有模拟框架存在结构性盲点，需要引入决策逼真度作为新的评估维度。

title: Distribution-Aware Robust Bilevel Optimization: Quantile-Guided Huber Updates in Two-Timescale Stochastic Approximation
summary: Bilevel optimization (BLO) is fundamental to hierarchical decision-making but suffers from critical instability under heavy-tailed stochastic noise. Existing variance-reduction techniques typically rely on myopic magnitude checks, which fail to distinguish informative geometric signals from impulsive outliers. To resolve this, we propose \textbf{RQ-TTSA} (Robust Quantile-guided TTSA), a distribution-aware framework that leverages historical gradient buffers to estimate rolling quantiles for adaptive Huber-style clipping, effectively preserving local optimization geometry while strictly bounding effective variance. Theoretically, we provide a convergence analysis for quantile-guided TTSA under nonconvex-strongly convex assumptions with infinite-variance noise ($p \in (1,2]$), deriving a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-\frac{p-1}{3p-2}})$ that recovers optimal dependence on the heavy-tailed parameter. Empirically, across six diverse tasks, spanning heterogeneous vision benchmarks, dynamic games under momentum poisoning, and offline reinforcement learning, RQ-TTSA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by eliminating divergence spikes and ensuring stable convergence. Our method demonstrates significant robustness to hyperparameter variations and incurs negligible computational overhead ($\approx 2.7\%$ increase), validating distribution-aware gradient control as a practical and necessary component for reliable bilevel learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RQ-TTSA（鲁棒分位数引导TTSA），一种面向双层优化的分布感知框架，通过历史梯度缓冲区的滚动分位数估计实现自适应Huber裁剪，在重尾噪声下保证稳定收敛。理论证明在非凸强凸假设下达到$\mathcal{O}(T^{-\frac{p-1}{3p-2}})$收敛率，实验在六项任务中优于基线，计算开销仅增加约2.7%。
AI.motivation: 双层优化在重尾随机噪声下存在严重的不稳定性问题，现有方差缩减技术依赖短视的幅度检查，无法区分有信息的几何信号与脉冲异常值。
AI.method: 提出RQ-TTSA框架，利用历史梯度缓冲区估计滚动分位数，实现自适应Huber风格裁剪，在保留局部优化几何结构的同时严格约束有效方差。
AI.result: 理论收敛率为$\mathcal{O}(T^{-\frac{p-1}{3p-2}})$，恢复了对重尾参数的最优依赖关系；在异构视觉基准、动量中毒动态博弈和离线强化学习等六项任务中优于现有基线，消除发散尖峰，计算开销仅增加约2.7%。
AI.conclusion: 分布感知的梯度控制是可靠双层学习的实用且必要的组成部分，RQ-TTSA对超参数变化具有显著鲁棒性。

title: Adaptive Recurrent Message Passing for Test Time Computing on Graphs
summary: Pre-trained foundation models have demonstrated remarkable success in many domains, enabling a unified backbone to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. However, extending this paradigm to graph learning remains challenging due to the intrinsic mismatch between graph data and fixed architectural designs. In this work, we show that this limitation can be overcome via recurrent graph models. To achieve this, we conduct a systematic theoretical analysis, rigorously deriving step dependence as a necessary and sufficient condition for an adaptively convergent recurrent process. Building on this foundation, we propose AdaR, an Adaptive Recurrent graph model, empowering flexible test-time computing on various downstream tasks without changing model parameters. To enable adaptive inference, AdaR explicitly encodes normalized step information and representation-target relations into the recurrent updates. To ensure convergence of the recurrent process, AdaR employs gradient-based supervision signals that guide representation updates throughout the recurrence. Empirical results demonstrate that AdaR consistently outperforms strong baselines in both inductive and transductive settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaR，一种自适应循环图模型，通过理论推导证明步长依赖性是自适应收敛循环过程的充要条件，使固定参数的预训练模型能够灵活适应不同下游任务，在归纳和直推式设置中均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 预训练基础模型在诸多领域取得成功，但将该范式扩展到图学习仍面临挑战，主要由于图数据与固定架构设计之间存在固有的不匹配问题。
AI.method: 1) 系统性理论分析，严格推导步长依赖性作为自适应收敛循环过程的充要条件；2) 提出AdaR模型，显式编码归一化步长信息和表示-目标关系到循环更新中；3) 采用基于梯度的监督信号引导整个循环过程中的表示更新，确保收敛性。
AI.result: AdaR在归纳和直推式设置中均一致优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过循环图模型可以克服预训练基础模型在图学习中因固定架构与图数据不匹配带来的局限性，实现无需改变模型参数即可灵活适应不同下游任务的测试时计算。

title: Building Agent Harnesses for Scientific Curation from Multimodal Sources
summary: Scientific discovery workflows often depend on structured curation from the literature. This is difficult for current agents because the key evidence is scattered across long text, dense tables, and figures, and the final records often require reasoning across multiple evidence fragments rather than copying a single span. We study scientific curation from multimodal sources and introduce Beaver, an agent harness that extracts structured information from scientific papers while preserving provenance to the supporting evidence. Beaver combines a frontier agent with multimodal evidence tooling, task scaffolding, and artifact-grounded autoresearch. These components turn curation into a staged, auditable workflow and enable an iterative evaluate--diagnose--revise loop, where persistent run artifacts expose stage-localized failures and guide harness updates. Experiments show that Beaver reaches 81.0 on Gold-Referenced Attribute Score (GRAS), an attribute-level measure of agreement with gold curated records, outperforming frontier agents by over 23 absolute points. Ablations show that task scaffolding, multimodal evidence tooling, and provenance traces each contribute meaningfully to performance, while attribute-level analysis shows the largest gains on high-value attributes that require cross-modal reasoning and normalization. These results show that, for scientific curation from papers with multimodal evidence, harness design is a central determinant of agent performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Beaver，一个用于从科学论文中提取结构化信息的智能体框架，通过多模态证据工具、任务分解和迭代优化，在科学文献 curation 任务上显著优于前沿智能体。
AI.motivation: 科学发现工作流依赖从文献中提取结构化信息，但关键证据分散在长文本、表格和图片中，现有智能体难以处理跨多个证据片段的推理，而非简单复制单个片段。
AI.method: Beaver结合前沿智能体与多模态证据工具、任务脚手架（task scaffolding）和基于工件的人工审核（artifact-grounded autoresearch），将 curation 转化为分阶段、可审计的工作流，并实现迭代的评估-诊断-修正循环。
AI.result: Beaver在GRAS指标上达到81.0，比前沿智能体高出23个绝对百分点；消融实验表明任务脚手架、多模态证据工具和溯源追踪各有贡献，跨模态推理和标准化属性上的提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 对于涉及多模态证据的科学文献 curation，智能体框架设计（harness design）是决定性能的核心因素。

title: Federated learning with heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise: a variance-reduction based algorithm
summary: Federated learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning paradigm that enables local devices to jointly train a global model while keeping data decentralized and private. We propose a variance-reduction based algorithm, VRA-FedSGD, for FL in the presence of heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise, where these noises are prevalent in large-scale machine learning over wireless networks and Internet of Things deployments. VRA-FedSGD employs a momentum variance reduction technique together with a nonlinear mapping to mitigate heavy-tailed gradient noise, and uses a variance-reduced aggregation mechanism to suppress heavy-tailed communication noise. In the mean sense, VRA-FedSGD achieves a convergence rate of {\small$\mathcal{O}\left(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)}\right)$} for nonconvex objective functions, where $p$ is the tail index of heavy-tailed noise. In the almost sure sense, VRA-FedSGD achieves a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(K^{-(1-1/(p-ε))}\right)$ for strongly convex objective functions, where $ε$ is an arbitrarily small constant. Simulated experiments on a logistic regression problem with real-world data verify the effectiveness of VRA-FedSGD.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为VRA-FedSGD的方差缩减联邦学习算法，用于处理重尾梯度噪声和通信噪声，在非凸和强凸目标下分别证明了均值和几乎必然收敛率，并通过逻辑回归实验验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在无线网络和物联网部署中面临重尾梯度噪声和通信噪声的挑战，现有算法缺乏针对这些噪声的鲁棒性保障。
AI.method: 采用动量方差缩减技术结合非线性映射来缓解重尾梯度噪声，并使用方差缩减聚合机制抑制重尾通信噪声。
AI.result: 非凸目标下均方收敛率为O(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)})；强凸目标下几乎必然收敛率为Õ(K^{-(1-1/(p-ε))})。
AI.conclusion: VRA-FedSGD能有效处理重尾噪声，理论收敛保证与实验验证均支持其有效性。

title: Answer Engineering: Local Trajectory Editing for Protocol-Constrained Decision Making in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models can produce confident but protocol-invalid answers in domains where procedural compliance is critical. This paper presents Answer Engineering, a deterministic runtime and authoring layer that applies localized rule-guided interventions to the visible reasoning trajectory during standard autoregressive generation, without retraining, modifying model weights, or performing global search. The method is evaluated on a controlled clinical benchmark for sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL), where correct management depends on protocol-consistent interpretation of symptom timing, Weber/Rinne tuning-fork findings, and otoscopic findings. In the benchmark, step-by-step reasoning shifted rather than eliminated errors: compliant outcomes for SSNHL decreased from 54.5% under unguided generation to 25.1%, while acceptance on the conductive contrast condition increased from 1.6% to 58.9%. Local trajectory editing increased SSNHL compliance to 83.5% and conductive-case adherence to 77.9%, raising balanced accuracy from 42.0% under reasoning-only generation to 80.7%. The results support a systems-level view in which protocol adherence can be improved through auditable runtime control of reasoning trajectories, while also identifying limitations caused by rule coverage, trigger reliability, and persistent diagnosis-first generation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Answer Engineering，一种无需重训练或修改模型权重的确定性运行时与编排层，通过在标准自回归生成过程中对可见推理轨迹进行局部规则引导干预。在突发性感觉神经性耳聋（SSNHL）临床基准测试中，该方法将SSNHL合规率从54.5%提升至83.5%，传导性病例依从性从1.6%提升至77.9%，平衡准确率从42.0%提升至80.7%。研究支持通过可审计的推理轨迹运行时控制来改进协议依从性，同时揭示了规则覆盖、触发可靠性和诊断优先生成动力学等局限性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在需要严格程序合规的领域（如临床医疗）中，常生成自信但违反协议的回答。现有方法（如微调、全局搜索）成本高且缺乏可审计性，亟需一种轻量级、可干预推理过程的方法来确保协议合规。
AI.method: 提出了Answer Engineering框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）编排层——在自回归解码的可见推理轨迹上应用局部规则引导干预；（2）运行时——确定性执行干预，无需重训练、修改权重或全局搜索。具体干预方式包括在推理轨迹的关键节点注入合规约束。
AI.result: 在SSNHL基准测试中：（1）未引导生成：SSNHL合规54.5%，传导性病例接受率1.6%，平衡准确率42.0%；（2）逐步推理生成：SSNHL合规降至25.1%，传导性病例接受率升至58.9%；（3）Answer Engineering：SSNHL合规升至83.5%，传导性病例依从性77.9%，平衡准确率80.7%。同时识别出规则覆盖不全、触发可靠性不足、诊断优先生成动力学等局限。
AI.conclusion: 通过可审计的运行时控制对推理轨迹进行局部编辑，能够在不改变模型参数的前提下显著提升协议依从性。然而，该方法效果受限于规则覆盖率、触发可靠性和模型固有的诊断优先生成偏好，提示需要更全面的规则工程和模型层面改进相结合。

title: Fed-CausalDiff: Decoupled Synchronization for Federated Do-Simulation and Policy Evaluation
summary: While federated learning enables collaborative modelling on decentralised data, standard methods merely fit historical observations. This purely observational approach is fundamentally insufficient for interventional inference and policy evaluation, as sequential actions dynamically alter future states. We propose \textbf{Fed-CausalDiff}, a federated causal diffusion framework for do-simulation. The architecture decomposes the evolution of the latent state into a global causal score function and a local confounding score function. This design enables \emph{decoupled synchronisation} (DSS), where clients aggregate only the shared causal mechanism while retaining site-specific confounders locally to handle heterogeneity. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Fed-CausalDiff achieves better ATE and policy-value estimation accuracy, offering a favorable trade-off between communication cost and inference fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出Fed-CausalDiff，一个联邦因果扩散框架，通过解耦全局因果与局部混淆的得分函数，实现去中心化数据上的干预推断和策略评估，在ATE和策略价值估计上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 标准联邦学习仅拟合历史观测数据，无法进行干预推断和策略评估，而序列动作会动态改变未来状态，单纯观测式方法根本不足。
AI.method: 将潜在状态演化分解为全局因果得分函数和局部混淆得分函数，设计解耦同步策略（DSS）：客户端仅聚合共享的因果机制，本地保留特定站点的混淆因子以处理异质性。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，Fed-CausalDiff在ATE和策略价值估计精度上优于基线方法，在通信成本与推断保真度之间取得了有利的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了联邦场景下的因果推断和反事实仿真问题，为去中心化数据上的策略评估提供了可行方案。

title: The Scissors Effect: When Resize-Based Input Diversity Helps or Hurts Transfer Attacks
summary: Input Diversity (DI), which applies random resizing and padding at each attack iteration, is a near-default ingredient of transfer-based adversarial attacks, widely assumed to improve transferability. We show this assumption is regime-dependent and, for robustly trained surrogates, often reversed. Varying only the surrogate, increasing the DI probability raises transfer success for standard surrogates but lowers it for robust ones: the two response curves separate like a pair of scissors, a pattern we call the Scissors Effect. The effect is strong and consistent on ImageNet, where blind DI costs the robust source 10.3% attack success on average across CNN, ViT, Swin, and ConvNeXt targets and across ten attacks spanning 2018-2024; it is smaller on CIFAR-10 unless DI is made aggressive. A controlled robustness-strength sweep that varies only the training budget shows the harm is graded rather than binary, crossing from beneficial to harmful already in the little-robustness regime. We trace it to gradient geometry: a resize/translation decomposition attributes roughly 67% of the harm to resize, and a direct source-target gradient-alignment measurement confirms the same resize operation improves alignment for standard surrogates but degrades it for robust ones. We summarize the regime with Local Gradient Consistency (LGC), a single input-space probe that separates the two surrogate types, and prove a bias-variance crossover theorem isolating where DI helps from where its resize bias dominates. A training-free rule (CG-DI) that disables diversity when LGC is high avoids the loss on robust surrogates while keeping DI's benefit on standard ones, positioning the Scissors Effect as a DI-specific manifestation of the broader robustness-transferability trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文发现输入多样性（DI）在鲁棒代理模型上会反向降低迁移攻击成功率（剪刀效应），根源在于resize操作对梯度对齐的破坏，并提出基于局部梯度一致性（LGC）的CG-DI规则来避免这一损失。
AI.motivation: 输入多样性（DI）是迁移攻击中广泛使用的默认增强手段，但其对鲁棒训练代理模型的效果尚未被系统研究；作者发现DI对标准代理有益但对鲁棒代理有害，需要揭示这一矛盾背后的机理。
AI.method: 在标准与鲁棒代理模型上对比DI概率的影响，观察到响应曲线呈剪刀状分离；通过resize/translation分解归因约67%的损害来自resize；提出局部梯度一致性（LGC）作为区分两类代理的指标；证明偏差-方差交叉定理；提出CG-DI规则（LGC高时禁用DI）。
AI.result: ImageNet上盲用DI导致鲁棒源模型的攻击成功率平均下降10.3%（跨CNN、ViT、Swin、ConvNeXt目标及十种攻击方法）；CIFAR-10上效应较弱除非DI强度大；损害随代理鲁棒性增强而单调递增。
AI.conclusion: DI的效用是regime依赖的：对标准代理有益，对鲁棒代理有害；剪刀效应是鲁棒性-迁移性权衡在DI上的具体体现；CG-DI可保留标准代理收益同时避免鲁棒代理损失。

title: ARCO: Adaptive Rubric with Co-Evolution for Multi-Step LLM-Based Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning for multi-step LLM agents often relies on scalar rewards that indicate success but cannot explain why a trajectory is good or bad. Rubric-based rewards improve interpretability through natural-language criteria, but existing methods score at the trajectory level and freeze the scorer behind a closed-source judge, leaving step-level credit assignment unresolved and the judge itself static. We propose ARCO (Adaptive Rubric CO-evolution), a rubric framework in which a same-scale model $μ$ shares a backbone with two heads: a generation head that produces per-step criteria, and a score head that predicts rubric-conditioned step-level rewards. A trajectory decomposition constraint ties the sum of step rewards to the terminal outcome, enabling credit assignment without step-level labels, while $μ$ and the policy $π$ are jointly updated on on-policy data so that the rubric content and the scoring function co-evolve at the parameter level. Across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue with two open-source backbones, ARCO improves the best EM in every setting over strong outcome-, rubric-, and process-reward baselines, and analyses show that its rubrics are step-specific, robust to design choices, and useful for diagnosing agent behavior. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/zihangtian/ARCO.

AI.tldr: ARCO提出了一种自适应规则共进化框架，通过同尺度模型的双头结构（生成头+评分头）实现步骤级别的可解释奖励分配，并在多个多跳问答数据集上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法中，标量奖励缺乏可解释性；基于规则的奖励虽提升了可解释性，但仅在轨迹级别评分，无法解决步骤级别的信用分配问题，且评判器是静态的。
AI.method: ARCO框架使用同尺度模型μ，共享主干网络并配备两个头：生成头产生每步规则，评分头预测规则条件下的步骤级奖励。通过轨迹分解约束将步骤奖励之和与终端结果对齐，实现无步骤标签的信用分配；同时μ与策略π在在线数据上联合更新，实现规则内容和评分函数的参数级共进化。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue三个数据集上，使用两种开源主干网络，ARCO在每种设置下的最佳EM指标均超越了基于结果、规则和过程奖励的强基线。
AI.conclusion: ARCO的规则具有步骤特异性，对设计选择鲁棒，并可用于诊断智能体行为。

title: Generative Robust Optimisation
summary: Classical uncertainty sets for robust optimisation impose fixed geometric shapes that cannot represent the complex dependencies present in real-world data. We propose Generative Robust Optimisation (GRO), a framework in which a deep generative model defines the uncertainty set as the image of a neural network decoder over a calibrated latent set, naturally accommodating nonlinear correlations, asymmetry, and multimodality. A five-point evaluation framework (reconstruction fidelity, distribution matching, latent regularity, robust relevance, and computational tractability) provides systematic, model-agnostic criteria for assessing any neural network-based uncertainty set. We instantiate this framework with a Wasserstein Adversarial Autoencoder employing Gaussian mixture model-guided training for latent regularity and constraint-consistency regularisation for robust relevance. Restricting the decoder to ReLU activations enables exact worst-case verification through mixed-integer programming embedding. Extensive experiments on a production planning problem across six uncertainty distributions and six generative architectures, together with a multi-period facility location study, validate the framework and demonstrate that systematic attention to all five criteria yields uncertainty sets that are simultaneously expressive, well-calibrated, and optimisation-tractable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成鲁棒优化（GRO）框架，使用深度生成模型（特别是Wasserstein对抗自编码器）定义不确定性集，并通过五维评估体系系统性地衡量神经网络不确定性集的性能，实验验证了该方法在表达性、校准性和优化可解性上的优势。
AI.motivation: 经典鲁棒优化的不确定性集采用固定几何形状，无法表示真实数据中复杂的依赖关系（如非线性相关、非对称性、多模分布）。
AI.method: 提出GRO框架，以神经网络解码器在标定潜集上的像定义不确定性集；建立五维评估框架（重构保真度、分布匹配、潜空间规则性、鲁棒相关性、计算可解性）；使用Wasserstein对抗自编码器，结合高斯混合模型引导训练和约束一致性正则化；限制解码器为ReLU激活以实现混合整数规划精确最坏情况验证。
AI.result: 在生产计划问题（六种不确定性分布、六种生成架构）和多周期设施选址问题上的实验表明，系统关注全部五个评估标准能够获得兼具表达性、良好校准性和优化可解性的不确定性集。
AI.conclusion: 生成鲁棒优化框架有效克服了经典方法的形状限制，提供了一套系统的评估与构建方法论，在复杂不确定性建模与优化可解性之间取得了有效平衡。

title: ChainWorld: Composing Long-Horizon Desktop Workloads from Atomic OSWorld Tasks
summary: Computer use agents are evaluated almost exclusively on atomic desktop tasks, but realistic desktop work requires sustaining state across multiple objectives. We study this gap with ChainWorld, which composes atomic OSWorld tasks into long horizon desktop workloads through directional compatibility search while preserving the source evaluators. The resulting workload contains 347 chains of length two to four and compares two renderings of the same task sequence. In single turn evaluation, all tasks are presented together in one prompt. In multi turn evaluation, tasks are revealed one at a time. Across four current computer use agents, maximum chain completion is 31%. Multi turn evaluation improves completion for three models, but both protocols remain challenging. The two protocols also expose different failure profiles. Single turn failures concentrate on artifact precision, while multi turn failures more often reflect session management problems such as fragmented progress and later turn disengagement.

AI.tldr: ChainWorld将原子化OSWorld任务组合成长周期桌面工作流，通过定向兼容性搜索构建347个任务链（长度2-4）。在单轮（全部任务一次性提示）和多轮（逐步揭示任务）两种评估协议下，当前最优计算机使用代理的最大链完成率仅31%。多轮协议改善了三款模型的完成率，但两种协议均具挑战性，且暴露不同失败模式：单轮失败集中在工件精度，多轮失败更多涉及会话管理问题（进度碎片化、后期任务脱离）。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用代理评估几乎完全基于原子化桌面任务，忽略现实桌面工作所需的跨多目标状态维持能力。论文旨在填补这一评估鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出ChainWorld基准，通过定向兼容性搜索将OSWorld原子任务组合为长周期桌面工作负载，保留原始评估器；设计单轮与多轮两种评估协议对比同一任务序列的不同呈现方式。
AI.result: 构建347个长度为2-4的任务链；四种当前最优代理的最大链完成率为31%；多轮评估提升三款模型完成率但整体仍具挑战；两种协议暴露不同失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 当前计算机使用代理在长周期桌面工作负载上表现严重不足，需针对性改进会话管理与工件精度能力。

title: Mitigating Measurement-Induced Training Instability in Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks for Protein Classification
summary: Hybrid Quantum Neural Network (QNN) classifiers produce logits as expectation values of quantum measurement operators. For standard Pauli measurements, these outputs are intrinsically bounded to the interval [-1,1]. When such bounded logits are used directly with the cross-entropy loss applied to softmax-normalized logits for multi-class classification, the loss function operates in a regime of weak sensitivity to logit differences. As a consequence, parameter gradients are suppressed, leading to unstable optimization in variational quantum classifiers (VQCs). In this work, we identify this effect as measurement-induced logit contraction, a previously uncharacterized source of trainability degradation in hybrid QNNs. To address this limitation, we introduce a learnable scaling parameter, termed Quantum Measurement Temperature (QMT), which rescales quantum measurement outputs prior to the loss. Unlike post-hoc calibration, QMT acts during training and compensates for the physically imposed bounds on quantum measurement outputs. This rescaling increases gradient magnitude and variance, thereby improving loss sensitivity. The proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic and does not modify the quantum ansatz, circuit depth, or measurement operators. Experiments on fluorescence microscopy images and a six-class variant of Fashion MNIST demonstrate that QMT consistently enhances logit separation, strengthens gradients, stabilizes training across random initializations, and improves classification accuracy, relative to unscaled measurement readouts. These results demonstrate that QMT enables stable and reliable training of hybrid QNNs for practical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子测量温度（QMT）机制，通过可学习的缩放参数补偿混合量子神经网络中测量诱导的logit收缩问题，增强了梯度大小和方差，从而提升分类精度和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 混合量子神经网络（QNN）中，量子测量输出的logit被固有地限制在[-1,1]区间，导致交叉熵损失对logit差异的敏感性降低，参数梯度被抑制，造成变分量子分类器优化不稳定。现有方法未关注这一由测量引起的可训练性退化问题。
AI.method: 引入量子测量温度（QMT），即在损失函数之前对量子测量输出施加一个可学习的缩放参数，以补偿物理测量输出固有的边界限制。QMT不改变量子ansatz、电路深度或测量算子，是架构无关的。
AI.result: 在荧光显微镜图像和六类Fashion MNIST数据集上，QMT增强了logit分离度、强化了梯度、稳定了跨随机初始化的训练，并提升了分类准确率。
AI.conclusion: QMT能够实现混合QNN的稳定可靠训练，为实际应用中的变分量子分类器提供了一种有效的可训练性改进方案。

title: Hallucination as Context Drift: Synchronization Protocols for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems routinely produce hallucinated outputs that cannot be explained by model deficiencies alone. A significant class of these failures arises not from model incapacity but from context drift: the divergence of internal knowledge states between concurrent agents. When agents enter a collaborative task with mismatched or stale representations of shared world state, their joint reasoning produces contradictions that manifest as hallucination. We define the Context Divergence Score (CDS), a lightweight scalar metric quantifying knowledge-state discrepancy between agent pairs across spatial, temporal, and task dimensions, and propose the Shared State Verification Protocol (SSVP), which lets agents periodically exchange compressed state summaries and flag high-divergence conditions before joint reasoning. We evaluate SSVP across two domains (multi-agent travel and software project planning) using Claude Haiku. In controlled experiments (n=30 per condition, travel; n=10, software) across 8 scenarios, naive full-broadcast synchronization increases hallucination rate by 34% above the no-sync baseline (HR: 0.658 vs. 0.492, p=0.0022, d=1.18), a contamination effect from propagating erroneous agent states. SSVP avoids this failure mode while showing modest, consistent reduction (HR: 0.463, d=0.30) and achieves significantly lower hallucination than full-broadcast (p=0.0005, d=1.47) using 58% fewer API calls. The contamination effect does not replicate in the software domain, where all conditions converge to low HR (<0.2), confirming it is specific to tasks where one erroneous shared belief cascades across evaluation dimensions. Our results reframe hallucination mitigation as a distributed systems problem and establish context synchronization as a first-class primitive in multi-agent LLM design.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文发散评分（CDS）和共享状态验证协议（SSVP），通过轻量级状态同步减少多智能体LLM系统中的幻觉。实验发现全广播同步会恶化幻觉（污染效应），而SSVP能显著降低幻觉率，并将幻觉缓解重新定义为分布式系统问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统的幻觉不能仅用模型能力不足解释，其中一类重要失败源于上下文漂移（context drift）——并发智能体之间内部知识状态的发散。当智能体以不匹配或过时的共享世界状态表征进入协作任务时，其联合推理会产生矛盾，表现为幻觉。
AI.method: 定义上下文发散评分（CDS）来量化智能体对在空间、时间和任务维度上的知识状态差异；提出共享状态验证协议（SSVP），让智能体周期性交换压缩状态摘要并在联合推理前标记高发散条件。在旅行规划和软件项目规划两个领域中使用Claude Haiku进行实验评估。
AI.result: 旅行领域（n=30/条件）：全广播同步使幻觉率比无基线高34%（HR: 0.658 vs 0.492, p=0.0022, d=1.18），产生污染效应；SSVP实现持续降低（HR: 0.463, d=0.30），比全广播显著降低幻觉率（p=0.0005, d=1.47），且减少58% API调用。软件领域污染效应未复现，所有条件HR均<0.2。
AI.conclusion: 将幻觉缓解重新定义为分布式系统问题，确立上下文同步作为多智能体LLM设计中的一等原语。污染效应仅出现在一个错误共享信念会跨评估维度级联的任务中。

title: Concept-Constrained Prompt Learning for Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation
summary: Few-shot prompt learning is an effective strategy for adapting CLIP to downstream tasks, but class-only prompt optimization can overfit base-class supervision and weaken transfer to unseen classes. We propose Concept-Constrained Prompt Learning (CCPL), a lightweight regularization framework that anchors learnable class prompts to frozen concept-level text prototypes without updating CLIP encoders. CCPL learns a set of shared context tokens, instantiates class prompts by appending class names, and constructs frozen concept prototypes from a class-level concept bank. During training, a text-space cosine consistency objective aligns learnable class-prompt embeddings with frozen concept prototypes; concept dropout provides additional regularization against over-reliance on fixed concept lists. At inference, CCPL optionally fuses class-prompt logits with concept-prototype logits using a controllable ensemble weight alpha. Our default configuration uses text-space concept regularization lambda = 0.5, concept dropout p = 0.3 and weak concept-guided fusion (alpha = 0.1), with no KL-based prediction consistency term. Experiments under identical automatically-generated fallback splits show that CCPL improves the base-to-new harmonic mean on DTD (+0.6) and EuroSAT (+2.9) compared with CoOp, while remaining near-neutral on OxfordPets (-0.1). Ablations indicate that text-space concept regularization is consistently beneficial, while the best concept-guided inference strength is dataset- and protocol-sensitive. These results suggest concept constraints are most effective when concept prototypes align naturally with dataset semantics, and identify fine-grained categories as a current boundary condition. The code is released at: https://github.com/richael-sang/concept-constrained-prompt-learning.

AI.tldr: CCPL 提出了一种轻量级正则化框架，通过将可学习的类提示锚定到冻结的概念级文本原型上，在不更新 CLIP 编码器的情况下缓解过拟合基类监督的问题，在 DTD 和 EuroSAT 上提升了基类到新类的调和平均性能。
AI.motivation: Few-shot 提示学习在适配 CLIP 到下游任务时，仅优化类提示容易过拟合基类监督，削弱向未见类的泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 学习一组共享上下文 token，拼接类名实例化类提示；2) 从类级概念库构建冻结的概念原型；3) 文本空间的余弦一致性目标对齐类提示嵌入与概念原型；4) 概念 dropout 防止过度依赖固定概念列表；5) 推理时可选的融合权重 alpha 控制类提示与概念原型 logits 的融合。
AI.result: 在自动生成的 fallback 划分下，CCPL 在 DTD 上基类到新类的调和平均提升 +0.6，EuroSAT 提升 +2.9，OxfordPets 上基本持平（-0.1）。
AI.conclusion: 概念约束在概念原型与数据集语义自然对齐时最有效，细粒度类别是当前的边界条件。

title: Stationary Robust Mean-Field Games under Model Mismatches
summary: Deploying multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in the real world is often limited by model mismatches between the training simulators and the true environment, which could be further amplified through strategic interactions and result in severe performance degradation upon deployment. Distributional robustness offers a principled response by optimizing policies against worst-case transition models drawn from an uncertainty set, but standard robust MARL frameworks become increasingly intractable as the number of agents grows. This paper develops an infinite-horizon, stationary mean-field game framework that incorporates distributional model uncertainty directly into the population-coupled dynamics. We establish a robust dynamic programming principle with a contractive Bellman operator and prove the existence of a stationary robust mean-field equilibrium via a fixed-point argument. We further develop the first concrete algorithm with convergence guarantees. We then connect the mean-field solution to a finite-population robust game whose ambiguity sets depend on the empirical distribution, showing that the mean-field equilibrium policy induces approximate equilibrium behavior as the population size increases. Under a contractive robust-dynamics regime, we further obtain explicit non-asymptotic error bounds. Numerical experiments further illustrate the qualitative and quantitative impact of robustness under multiple uncertainty models, validating our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于平均场博弈的鲁棒多智能体强化学习框架，通过将分布鲁棒性融入种群耦合动力学，解决了模型不匹配问题，并建立了收敛保证的算法和有限人口近似误差界。
AI.motivation: 现实部署中，训练模拟器与真实环境之间的模型失配会通过策略互动被放大，导致性能严重下降。标准鲁棒MARL框架随智能体数量增加而变得难以处理。
AI.method: 建立了无限时域平稳平均场博弈框架，将分布模型不确定性直接融入种群耦合动力学；提出了鲁棒动态规划原理和压缩Bellman算子；通过不动点论证证明了平稳鲁棒平均场均衡的存在性；开发了首个具有收敛保证的具体算法；建立了平均场解与有限人口鲁棒博弈之间的连接，并在压缩鲁棒动力学下给出了非渐近误差界。
AI.result: 理论证明了鲁棒动态规划原理、均衡存在性及算法收敛性；给出了有限人口近似误差的非渐近界；数值实验验证了多种不确定性模型下鲁棒性的定性和定量影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为大规模多智能体系统在模型不确定下的鲁棒策略优化提供了理论严谨且计算可处理的框架，弥合了平均场理论与实际有限人口部署之间的差距。

title: Training-free Task Classification for Multi-Task Model Merging
summary: Ever since the advent of foundation models and the pre-training-finetuning paradigm, there have been numerous efforts to merge multiple task-specific experts into a single multi-task model. Prior work largely focuses on finding a single merged model, but it often underperforms individual experts due to parameter interference. To resolve this, dynamic model merging employs routing to activate task-relevant parameters per input. However, existing routers typically require either additional training with abundant labeled datasets or assume the access to task IDs of each input at inference time. In this work, we aim to close the gap to expert performance without additional training or task-ID-access assumption. To this end, we formulate routing as training-free task classification for each test input. Using singular value decomposition (SVD)-based low-rank manifold approximations for each task, SiM scores tasks by the projection residual of the test input feature onto each task manifold and routes accordingly. The task manifolds are pre-computable offline from a pretrained backbone using a small per-task support set (e.g., 32 examples per task) prior to merging process, requiring no router training and no data during the merging process. Moreover, SiM integrates seamlessly with subspace-/mask-based merging that represents task-expert via lightweight compressed task vectors, avoiding the need to store full expert parameters. Experiments across computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks under task-unknown inference demonstrate that SiM substantially improves merged-model performance and consistently narrows the gap to individual task experts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SiM方法，通过SVD低秩流形近似构建无训练路由机制，在无需额外训练和任务ID假设条件下，基于测试输入在各任务流形上的投影残差进行路由，实现多任务模型动态合并，显著缩小与独立专家模型的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有动态模型合并方法中，路由机制要么需要额外训练和大量标注数据，要么在推理时假设已知任务ID，限制了实际应用。本文旨在无需额外训练和任务ID假设的前提下，缩小合并模型与独立专家模型之间的性能差距。
AI.method: 将路由问题转化为无训练的任务分类：利用SVD为每个任务构建低秩流形近似，每个任务使用少量支持集样本（如每任务32个样本）从预训练骨干中预计算任务流形；推理时计算测试输入特征在各任务流形上的投影残差作为相似度分数，选择残差最小的任务进行路由。SiM可与子空间/掩码类轻量压缩任务向量合并方法无缝集成。
AI.result: 在计算机视觉和自然语言处理多个基准上，SiM在任务未知的推理场景下显著提升了合并模型的性能，持续缩小了与独立任务专家模型之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: SiM通过无训练、无任务ID假设的路由策略，有效解决了多任务模型合并中的参数干扰问题，实现了接近独立专家性能的动态模型合并。

title: Measuring What Persists: Conditioning Mechanisms and a Geometric Framework for AI Agent Identity
summary:
AI agents in long-context applications drift from their specified identity. Current methods detect this only after qualitative degradation is visible. We present a geometric framework for measuring identity structure using $\sqrt{\mathrm{JSD}}$ metric spaces and magnitude homology from enriched category theory, where identity is non-geodesic structure and drift is its relaxation toward the geodesic.
  Validated on a persistent AI agent, the framework's strongest empirical finding is a two-mechanism conditioning structure: cross-condition distances reveal an identity-vacuum cluster where the identity specification fills a behavioral void, and a safety-basin cluster where it displaces from post-training attractors. An equilateral probe baseline confirms that the identity specification creates measurable behavioral richness (55 unique response patterns vs. 1 for the base model) at maximum probe separation. A first-order perturbation theory for equilateral configurations predicts magnitude changes from perimeter changes alone, with shape perturbations first-order cancelled by the $S_n$ symmetry; the formula is self-consistent at the observed perturbation amplitudes.
  A drift experiment measuring magnitude decrease under context pressure was subsequently found to reflect repetitive-padding artifacts rather than genuine context-length drift; diverse padding produces no measurable deformation through 150K tokens. The magnitude homology framework's full diagnostic promise -- detecting anisotropic contraction and structural collapse via homological simplification -- is architecturally grounded in the perturbation theory and selection rules but remains empirically unconfirmed.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于√JSD度量空间和丰富范畴论中 magnitude homology 的几何框架来测量AI智能体的身份结构，发现身份规范在行为真空中填充（身份真空簇）或从训练后吸引子中位移（安全盆地簇），但漂移实验表明观察到的度量下降主要是重复填充伪影而非真实上下文漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅在定性退化明显后才能检测到AI智能体在长上下文应用中的身份漂移，缺乏早期、定量的检测手段。
AI.method: 使用√JSD度量空间构建几何框架，利用丰富范畴论中的magnitude homology测量身份结构（非测地结构），定义漂移为该结构向测地线的松弛过程。采用等边探针基线进行扰动理论分析，并设计漂移实验验证框架有效性。
AI.result: 发现双重机制：身份真空簇（身份规范填充行为真空）和安全盆地簇（身份规范位移训练后吸引子）；等边探针基线显示55种独特响应模式（基线模型仅1种）；漂移实验中度量下降实际反映重复填充伪影而非真实漂移；通过150K tokens的多样化填充未产生可测量变形。
AI.conclusion: magnitude homology框架的诊断潜力（检测各向异性收缩和结构坍缩）在理论上基于扰动理论和选择规则得到支撑，但尚未得到实证验证。

title: On the Position Bias of On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) improves the learning efficiency of standard reinforcement learning through dense, token-level supervision from teachers. In the standard KL objective of OPD, token-level losses are uniformly averaged, implying equal weights for all tokens. However, we discover that not all tokens are created equal: as student rollouts grow longer, they deviate further from the teacher's distribution, leading to degraded supervision quality at later positions. As a result, OPD using only the first 30% of tokens can perform comparably to using all tokens, whereas OPD using only the last 30% of tokens barely learns anything. In this work, we provide a principled understanding of this issue through the lens of constrained optimization. Based on these insights, we derive Importance-Weighted On-Policy Distillation (IW-OPD), in which the weight assigned to each token depends on the accumulated discrepancy between the student's and teacher's distributions, naturally upweighting earlier tokens and downweighting later ones with larger deviations. We show that IW-OPD converges significantly faster than OPD, with better learning efficiency, and achieves better final performance than standard OPD in both same-size and cross-scale settings, improving performance up to 6.9 points on AIME-2025.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于重要性加权的在策略蒸馏方法（IW-OPD），通过根据学生与教师分布间的累积差异动态调整各token的权重，解决了标准在策略蒸馏中长序列后段token监督质量退化的问题，在AIME-2025上取得最高6.9分的提升。
AI.motivation: 标准在策略蒸馏（OPD）对所有token的KL散度损失进行均匀平均，但研究发现随着学生模型 rollout 长度增加，后段token与学生分布偏离教师分布更远，监督质量退化。仅使用前30% token即可达到与使用全部token相当的性能，而仅使用后30% token则几乎无法学习。
AI.method: 通过约束优化的视角对OPD中token权重问题进行理论分析，推导出重要性加权的在策略蒸馏（IW-OPD），其中每个token的权重取决于学生与教师分布之间的累积差异，自然地对早期token赋予更高权重、对后期偏差大的token赋予更低权重。
AI.result: IW-OPD相比标准OPD收敛速度显著更快，学习效率更高，在同等规模和跨尺度设置下均取得更好的最终性能，在AIME-2025上最高提升6.9分。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态加权策略，在策略蒸馏可以更有效地利用token级监督信号，缓解长序列中后段监督退化问题，从而提升学习效率和最终性能。

title: ForEx: A Formal Verification Framework for Explainable Reasoning in Logical Fallacy Detection and Annotation
comment: 2026 IEEE 27th International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration for Data Science
summary: Current evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) on logical fallacy detection focus on predicted labels, but do not establish whether those labels are supported by the reasoning the models provide. We propose ForEx (Formal Verification for Explainable Reasoning), a framework that translates LLM-generated explanations into Lean4 and verifies whether the translated rationale is derivable under encoded premises, not the logical validity of the original natural language argument. To distinguish prediction outcomes from the formal status of the supporting reasoning, we introduce the LLM Argument Verification Matrix, which separates label consistency from formal verification status. Experiments on LOGIC-Climate show that over 90% of LLM outputs can be translated into formal reasoning chains that pass verification, while agreement with human annotations remains around 20%. These results expose a systematic gap between formal derivability and label agreement, a distinction invisible to prediction-based metrics. ForEx moves LLM evaluation beyond label correctness toward machine-checkable analysis of formalized reasoning chains.

AI.tldr: 提出ForEx框架，将LLM在逻辑谬误检测中的解释翻译为Lean4代码进行形式化验证，发现90%以上的推理链可通过形式验证，但与人类标注的一致性仅约20%，揭示了形式可推导性与标签一致性之间的系统性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM逻辑谬误检测评估仅关注预测标签的正确性，未验证模型提供的推理理由是否真正支持其结论，缺乏对推理过程的形式化验证机制。
AI.method: 提出ForEx框架，将LLM生成的解释翻译为Lean4形式化语言，在编码前提条件下验证翻译后的推理链是否可推导；并引入LLM参数验证矩阵，区分标签一致性与形式验证状态两个维度。
AI.result: 在LOGIC-Climate数据集上，超过90%的LLM输出可翻译为通过形式验证的推理链，但与人类标注的一致性仅约20%，表明形式可推导性与标签一致性之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: ForEx将LLM评估从标签正确性扩展到机器可检验的形式化推理链分析，揭示了预测指标无法捕捉到的系统性偏差。

title: Federated Learning for Global Carbon Emission Forecasting: A Hybrid Time-Series Approach with Statistical and Neural Models
comment: Approximately 22 pages, 5 figures, 15 tables. Submitted for journal publication
summary: Climate change, primarily driven by carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions, requires accurate forecasting tools to support effective mitigation policies and sustainable development strategies. Existing forecasting approaches typically rely on centralized data collection, which is often restricted by privacy regulations and the distributed nature of emission data across countries and industrial sectors. This paper proposes a novel federated hybrid forecasting framework that integrates ARIMA-based trend modeling, GARCH-based volatility modeling, LSTM-Attention temporal representation learning, and XGBoost prediction within a privacy-preserving federated learning environment. The proposed framework enables collaborative learning among distributed clients without requiring the exchange of raw data. Experimental evaluation across 14 clients demonstrates strong forecasting performance, achieving client R2 values between 0.50 and 0.97 with an average of 0.73, RMSE values ranging from 0.06 to 2.35 with an average of 1.21, and MAPE values between 1.5% and 11.3% with an average of 6.5%. The results indicate that the proposed framework provides an accurate, scalable, and regulation-compliant solution for collaborative carbon-emission forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种联邦混合预测框架，将ARIMA、GARCH、LSTM-Attention和XGBoost集成在隐私保护的联邦学习环境中，用于分布式碳排放预测。在14个客户端上实验，平均R²为0.73，RMSE为1.21，MAPE为6.5%，实现了准确、可扩展且合规的协同预测。
AI.motivation: 现有碳排放预测方法依赖集中式数据收集，但排放数据具有分布式特性且受隐私法规限制，亟需一种既能保护数据隐私又能实现协同学习的预测框架。
AI.method: 提出联邦混合预测框架，融合ARIMA（趋势建模）、GARCH（波动性建模）、LSTM-Attention（时序表征学习）和XGBoost（预测）四种模型，并在联邦学习环境下实现分布式客户端协同训练，无需交换原始数据。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种准确、可扩展且符合法规的协同碳排放预测解决方案，有效解决了数据隐私与分布式数据共享之间的矛盾。

title: Scalable Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Policies via Adjoint Matching
summary: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for representing complex action distributions in reinforcement learning (RL). However, their application to online RL remains limited by the challenge of scalable training in the absence of ground-truth data, where standard optimization techniques such as score matching are not directly applicable. In this work, we introduce a highly efficient algorithm for optimizing diffusion policies by leveraging recent advances in stochastic optimal control. Our approach is based on adjoint matching, which enables simulation-free training and circumvents the need for explicit likelihood estimation or costly backpropagation through the diffusion process. Furthermore, we propose several extensions that improve the robustness and stability of the method in practical settings. Empirical results demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive performance while significantly reducing computational overhead, making diffusion policies more viable for online RL scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于伴随匹配的高效扩散策略优化算法，通过模拟自由训练避免了显式似然估计和昂贵反向传播，显著降低计算开销，使扩散策略在在线强化学习中更具可行性。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略在强化学习中表现优异，但其应用于在线RL时面临挑战：缺乏真实数据情况下，标准优化技术（如分数匹配）无法直接适用，导致可扩展训练困难。
AI.method: 利用随机最优控制的最新进展，提出伴随匹配（adjoint matching）方法，实现模拟自由训练（simulation-free training），无需显式似然估计或通过扩散过程进行昂贵的反向传播。
AI.result: 该方法在显著降低计算开销的同时达到了具有竞争力的性能，提升了扩散策略在在线RL场景中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 伴随匹配为扩散策略在在线强化学习中的高效优化提供了可行方案，未来可进一步扩展其鲁棒性和稳定性。

title: Learning the ARTS of Search for Automated Discovery
summary: Scientific discovery can be formulated as an iterative search process over the space of hypotheses and experiments. Contemporary methods navigate this space using heuristics such as MCTS. These algorithms conflate the merit of a hypothesis with the quality of its experimental execution. A promising hypothesis with preliminary execution is therefore ranked below a modest hypothesis whose execution is refined. Moreover, prior methods prune the search logs as the search progresses because the accumulated history outgrows the context window. We propose Agentic Reasoning for Tree Search (ARTS), where we deploy a reasoning language model to navigate this space. The model inspects prior execution logs, diagnoses whether earlier failures arose from faulty implementations or bad hypotheses, and selects the hypothesis to build on next. To mitigate challenges with context length, ARTS uses test-time training to instill the knowledge of search tree in the model weights. Across 22 tasks from MLGym and MLEBench, we show that ARTS outperforms leading algorithms, with over 15.3% relative improvement in the normalized score. With test-time training we show that a Qwen3-4B agent can match performance with closed-source frontier models like Gemini-3 Pro and GPT o3-reasoning with upto 5x lower inference cost. We further observe that on partially observable RL tasks, the test-time trained Qwen3-4B scientist surpasses ARTS with the o3 scientist by rediscovering the human-best recurrent-memory solution that heuristic methods prune away.

AI.tldr: 提出ARTS框架，利用推理语言模型在假设与实验空间中进行树搜索，通过测试时训练将搜索树知识编码到模型权重中，在22个ML任务上超越现有方法，且4B小模型通过测试时训练可媲美闭源大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MCTS等方法将假设的优劣与实验执行质量混淆，导致有前景但初步执行的假设被低估；同时搜索日志累积超长，传统方法只能剪枝丢弃历史信息。
AI.method: 提出ARTS框架，使用推理语言模型（如Qwen3-4B）进行树搜索：模型检查历史执行日志，诊断失败源于实现错误还是假设本身缺陷，据此选择下一步构建方向；采用测试时训练（test-time training）将搜索树知识注入模型权重，缓解上下文窗口限制。
AI.result: 在MLGym和MLEBench的22个任务上，ARTS相较领先算法在归一化分数上提升超过15.3%；Qwen3-4B模型经测试时训练后，推理成本降低5倍且性能可媲美Gemini-3 Pro和GPT o3-reasoning；在部分可观测RL任务中，测试时训练的4B模型超越o3科学家，重新发现了人类最优的循环记忆解决方案。
AI.conclusion: ARTS通过将推理语言模型与测试时训练结合，有效解决了科学发现搜索中假设评估偏斜和历史信息丢失的问题，小模型通过测试时训练可达到甚至超越大模型的表现，验证了在搜索过程中动态学习的重要性。

title: A Markov Chain Approach to Preference Alignment
summary: We propose Markov Chain from Human Feedback (MCHF), an elementary approach for aligning generative models from pairwise human preferences. Unlike Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), which reduces comparisons to a scalar reward, and Nash Learning from Human Feedback (NLHF), which preserves pairwise utilities through a KL-regularized minimax optimization, MCHF uses pairwise preferences directly to define a transition mechanism over model outputs. Given a pairwise utility $U(x,y)$, which quantifies human preference for $y$ over $x$, and a reference probability distribution $μ_{\mathsf{ref}}$, we define a Markov kernel $\mathsf{P}(x, dy)\propto \exp(U(x,y))μ_{\mathsf{ref}}(dy)$, and take the Markov chain starting from $μ_{\mathsf{ref}}$ as an iterative alignment procedure. We show that MCHF converges geometrically fast to the stationary distribution, with a convergence rate governed by the seminorm $\|U\|_\oplus=\inf_{g,f\in L^\infty(μ_{\mathsf{ref}})}\|U-g\oplus f\|_\infty$, which quantifies the non-transitive structure of the pairwise utility. We further show that a mirror-descent algorithm for NLHF satisfies an analogous structure-adaptive convergence guarantee. Finally, through a perturbation analysis, we prove that when $\|U\|_\oplus$ is small, MCHF and NLHF agree up to first order around an RLHF solution, which yields a unified view of reward-based, game-theoretic, and Markovian approaches to alignment. In particular, for two natural algorithms that converge to the MCHF/NLHF equilibria, we show that the first step of MCHF and NLHF recovers the RLHF solution based on the column-sum reward $\hat{f}(y)=\int μ_{\mathsf{ref}}(dx) U(x, y)$, and starting from the second iteration, both algorithms incorporate the same linear functional of the residual $U-(-\hat f)\oplus \hat f$, which captures the non-transitive structure of the pairwise utility $U$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCHF方法，直接从成对人类偏好定义马尔可夫核来对齐生成模型，证明其几何收敛速度由成对效用的非传递结构决定，并通过扰动分析揭示了MCHF、NLHF与RLHF之间的统一关系。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法（如RLHF将偏好简化为标量奖励，NLHF通过KL正则化minimax优化保留成对效用）各有局限，缺乏一种直接利用成对偏好进行对齐的马尔可夫视角方法。
AI.method: 定义基于成对效用U(x,y)的马尔可夫核P(x,dy)∝exp(U(x,y))μ_ref(dy)，以参考分布μ_ref为初始分布进行马尔可夫链迭代对齐。通过半范数||U||_⊕量化效用的非传递结构，分析收敛性；通过扰动分析比较MCHF与NLHF、RLHF的关系。
AI.result: MCHF几何快速收敛至平稳分布，收敛率由||U||_⊕控制；NLHF的镜像下降算法具有类似的结构自适应收敛保证；当||U||_⊕很小时，MCHF和NLHF在RLHF解附近一阶一致；MCHF/NLHF的第一步恢复基于列和奖励的RLHF解，第二步开始两者引入相同线性泛函捕获非传递结构。
AI.conclusion: MCHF提供了基于奖励、博弈论和马尔可夫方法的统一对齐视角，为理解不同对齐范式的关系提供了理论框架。

title: CFAgentBench: A Reproducible Environment and Benchmark for Autonomous Construction-Finance Agents
comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Benchmark, environment spec, and app contract released. First open-weight three-model sweep (k=5) on a 40-task oracle-validated executable suite; frontier-model leaderboard committed in the roadmap
summary: We introduce CFAgentBench, a reproducible, self-hostable environment and benchmark for autonomous construction-finance agents: a CFO/controller-class agent operating across the real software stack a US construction finance team runs - ERP, project management, email, documents, pay applications, payroll, certified payroll, lien waivers, and bank/treasury portals. It contains 1,014 machine-gradeable task specifications across 8 domains and 77 families, every family grounded in a real source; a self-validated subset of 40 tasks (54 with a project-management extension) is compiled into oracle-validated executable evaluators, the runnable suite reported here. Following WebArena, the benchmark runs on an executable environment rather than static traces: 35 mock applications (31 reconciled to one company book, plus 4 PM platforms) over 9 archetypes, each implementing a uniform self-hostable app contract, so every task is graded by functional correctness - a state diff plus forbidden-side-effect checks plus required-output regexes - with an LLM judge used only for reply quality, never as reward.
