A distinguishing principle is a money-movement guard: 278 instances embed a payment, payroll, e-signature, or e-filing step where the correct behavior is to stop and stage for human approval, and executing even the correct transaction fails the task. The public split (n=711) is sized for a 95% Wilson half-width of +/-4.1%; a private, contamination-protected split (n=303) is reserved for remote scoring. In a first three-model open-weight sweep (k=5), the strongest agent reaches pass^1 = 0.67 but only pass^5 = 0.38 - losing 43% of its successes when required to repeat them under temperature-0 decoding. The within-model pass^1 to pass^5 collapse and sharp per-domain heterogeneity are clear evidence that single-attempt accuracy overstates deployable construction-finance competence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CFAgentBench——一个面向建筑金融自主代理的可复现、可自托管的评估环境与基准测试。它包含1,014个机器可评分的任务规范，覆盖8个领域和77个任务族，基于35个模拟应用构建可执行环境，采用功能性正确性评分。核心原则是资金流动防护：278个任务实例包含支付、薪资、电子签名或电子归档步骤，正确行为是停止并等待人工批准。最强模型pass@1=0.67但pass@5=0.38，表明单次准确率高估了可部署的建筑金融能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AI Agent基准测试多基于静态轨迹或模拟环境，缺乏针对建筑金融这一专业领域的可执行、可复现的评估基准。建筑金融涉及ERP、项目管理、支付申请、认证薪资、留置权豁免、银行门户等多个复杂系统的交互，且资金流动场景对安全性要求极高，需要一个能够真实评估代理在资金操作中正确行为（包括停止并等待人工批准）的基准。
AI.method: 构建了35个模拟应用（31个与同一公司账簿对齐，4个为PM平台），覆盖9种原型，每个实现统一的自托管应用接口。包含1,014个任务规范，其中40个任务（PM扩展后54个）编译为可执行评估器。任务评分基于功能正确性：状态差异检查+禁止副作用检查+必需输出正则，仅回复质量使用LLM评判器。278个任务嵌入资金流动防护机制。数据集分为公开集（711个）和私有保护集（303个）。
AI.result: 在k=5的评估中，最强开放权重模型pass@1达到0.67，但pass@5降至0.38，即重复执行时损失43%的成功率。模型内部pass@1到pass@5的显著下降以及领域间的剧烈异质性表明，单次准确率严重高估了实际可部署的建筑金融能力。
AI.conclusion: CFAgentBench提供了一个高度真实、可复现的建筑金融自主代理评估环境。实验结果表明，当前最强模型在建筑金融任务中表现不稳定，单次成功率远不能代表可部署的可靠性，特别是在涉及资金流动的安全关键场景中表现欠佳，亟需进一步提升。

title: Foundation Models for Epileptogenic Zone Identification in Drug-Resistant Epilepsy
comment: Keywords: drug-resistant epilepsy, epileptogenic zone, stereo-electroencephalography, signal foundation models, language foundation models
summary: Accurate identification of the epileptogenic zone (EZ) is essential for seizure freedom after resective surgery in drug-resistant epilepsy, yet seizure freedom rates remain below 50%. We developed EpiiSLM, a dual foundation model system for EZ identification with stereo-electroencephalography (sEEG), by training a signal foundation model on 104,990 minutes of sEEG recordings from the Montreal Neurological Institute & Hospital, while leveraging all recordings regardless of surgical outcome and anchoring EZ biomarker extraction on non-epileptic signals. A language foundation model then integrates sEEG-derived outputs with multimodal clinical information to produce interpretable predictions. Under leave-one-patient-out evaluation, EpiiSLM achieved 0.978 contact-level positive predictive value (PPV), outperforming the seizure onset zone(SOZ)-as-EZ baseline by 15.1% (p < 0.05), and 100% region-level accuracy; on an external dataset, EpiiSLM achieved 0.857 contact-level PPV. EpiiSLM requires only one night of interictal sleep data, suggesting potential to reduce invasive sEEG monitoring duration and improve surgical outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EpiiSLM双基础模型系统，用于药物难治性癫痫的致痫区(EZ)识别。该系统通过信号基础模型处理立体脑电图(sEEG)数据，语言基础模型整合多模态临床信息，在留一法交叉验证中达到0.978的触点级阳性预测值，优于传统发作起始区(SOZ)基线15.1%，仅需一晚非快速眼动睡眠数据即可实现高效EZ定位。
AI.motivation: 药物难治性癫痫患者接受切除手术后癫痫无发作率仍低于50%，主要原因在于致痫区(EZ)识别不准确。现有方法依赖发作期记录和主观专家判断，亟需更客观、高效、准确的EZ定位方法。
AI.method: 提出EpiiSLM双基础模型系统：(1)信号基础模型在104,990分钟sEEG数据上预训练，利用全部记录(无论手术结局)并锚定非癫痫信号提取EZ生物标志物；(2)语言基础模型整合sEEG输出与多模态临床信息，生成可解释预测。仅需一晚发作间期睡眠数据。
AI.result: 内部留一法验证：触点级PPV达0.978，比SOZ基线高15.1%(p<0.05)，区域级准确率100%。外部数据集验证：触点级PPV为0.857。
AI.conclusion: EpiiSLM通过双基础模型架构显著提升了EZ识别精度，有望减少侵入性sEEG监测时长并改善手术预后。

title: Nous: A Predictive World Model for Long-Term Agent Memory
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Preprint; ablations, LongMemEval evaluation, and a controlled comparison against concurrent work (BeliefMem) planned for a future revision
summary: We present Nous, a novel agent memory architecture grounded in the principle that knowledge is prediction, not storage. Rather than persisting facts as database records, vector embeddings, or knowledge-graph triples, Nous maintains a predictive world model: a collection of categorical probability distributions, called dimensions, one per entity-attribute pair observed in conversation. Each incoming observation is scored by its information-theoretic surprise S = -log2 P(obs | D), and the distribution is updated via a closed-form Bayesian posterior. The primary stored artifact is the delta, a record of the shift from prior to posterior belief, rather than the fact itself. Forgetting emerges naturally as entropy decay toward the uniform distribution, and identity resolution is handled through mutual information between entity dimension sets. Evaluated on the LoCoMo long-term conversational memory benchmark across ten conversations (1,540 questions) using GPT-4o-mini as backbone, Nous achieves F1 of 63.50 (single-hop), 55.32 (multi-hop), 58.57 (temporal), and 62.50 (open-domain). Against A-MEM's self-reported GPT-4o-mini numbers, Nous shows substantial gains in three of four categories, though we note that independent citations of A-MEM's results disagree with each other on category assignment, a reproducibility issue we discuss openly rather than resolve unilaterally. We additionally compare against BeliefMem, a concurrently developed system built on the same core premise of belief-based rather than deterministic memory; on the same benchmark and backbone, Nous's self-reported numbers exceed BeliefMem's self-reported numbers on all four categories, though we flag several uncontrolled differences between the two evaluation pipelines that prevent this from being a fully controlled comparison. Nous requires no external vector database or graph engine.

AI.tldr: Nous提出了一种基于"知识即预测"原则的新型智能体记忆架构，通过维护预测性世界模型（即实体-属性对的分类概率分布）替代传统数据库、向量嵌入或知识图谱存储。信息通过贝叶斯后验更新，存储的是信念变化的"增量"而非事实本身，遗忘通过熵衰减自然发生。在LoCoMo基准上使用GPT-4o-mini作为骨干模型，Nous在四个评估维度上取得了有竞争力的F1分数（63.50/55.32/58.57/62.50），且无需外部向量数据库或图引擎。
AI.motivation: 传统智能体记忆系统将知识视为静态存储（数据库记录、向量嵌入或知识图谱三元组），这种方式缺乏对信息不确定性的建模，也无法自然地处理遗忘和身份消歧。作者希望构建一种更接近认知科学原理的记忆架构，将记忆视为对世界的概率预测而非事实的仓库。
AI.method: 核心创新包括：(1) 维护预测性世界模型——每个实体-属性对对应一个分类概率分布（维度）；(2) 每个观测通过信息论惊讶度S = -log2 P(obs|D)评分，并通过封闭式贝叶斯后验更新分布；(3) 存储"增量"（先验到后验信念的偏移）而非事实本身；(4) 遗忘通过熵向均匀分布的自然衰减实现；(5) 身份消歧通过实体维度集之间的互信息处理。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准的10个对话（1,540个问题）上，使用GPT-4o-mini作为骨干，Nous在单跳（63.50 F1）、多跳（55.32）、时序（58.57）和开放域（62.50）四个类别上取得了结果。相比A-MEM的GPT-4o-mini结果，Nous在3/4类别上有显著提升；相比同前提的BeliefMem，Nous在所有四个类别上均超越其自报结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于信念而非确定性存储的记忆架构是可行的，且无需外部向量数据库或图引擎即可达到有竞争力的性能。同时论文坦诚讨论了A-MEM结果复现中的不一致问题以及自身与BeliefMem比较中存在的未控制变量，体现了对可重复性问题的开放态度。

title: LSTM Variants for Chaotic Dynamical Systems: An Empirical Study on the Lorenz Attractor
summary: Forecasting chaotic dynamical systems such as the Lorenz attractor is notoriously difficult: small numerical errors are amplified exponentially over long autoregressive rollouts. We study seven recurrent and convolutional architectures for the AI-DEEDS 2026 Chaotic Systems Challenge: a vanilla LSTM, an LSTM with additive attention, a Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), a BiLSTM trained with the Huber loss, a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), a CNN front-end followed by an LSTM, and a CNN front-end followed by a BiLSTM. All models share the same pre-processing, sequence length, and rollout procedure, isolating the contribution of each design choice. The challenge scores predictions on a 0-100 scale where higher is better. We obtain leaderboard scores between 45.72 and 58.81, with the BiLSTM trained with Huber loss being the strongest configuration. Two findings stand out: (i) adding additive attention to the unidirectional baseline degraded performance by over ten points, and (ii) prepending a CNN front-end to either an LSTM or a BiLSTM did not help and slightly hurt the score. Per-pair RMSE measurements confirm that the BiLSTM family generalizes better in the harder pairs (6-7), while the LSTM + Attention model collapses there (RMSE up to 8.94 on pair 6). We discuss why bidirectional context and a robust loss help in chaotic regimes while attention and CNN front-ends fail in this setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了七种循环和卷积架构在混沌系统（Lorenz吸引子）预测任务上的表现，发现使用Huber损失的BiLSTM表现最佳（得分58.81），而注意力机制和CNN前端在该任务中反而会降低性能。
AI.motivation: 混沌动力系统（如Lorenz吸引子）的长期自回归预测中，微小数值误差会指数级放大，导致预测极其困难。研究者希望系统性地比较不同深度学习架构在该挑战性任务中的表现。
AI.method: 在相同预处理、序列长度和滚动预测流程下，比较七种架构：vanilla LSTM、LSTM + 加性注意力、BiLSTM、Huber损失训练的BiLSTM、TCN、CNN + LSTM、CNN + BiLSTM。评估采用0-100评分（越高越好）和逐对RMSE。
AI.result: 排行榜得分在45.72至58.81之间，Huber损失训练的BiLSTM最强。加性注意力使性能下降超过10分；CNN前端对LSTM或BiLSTM均无增益甚至略微降低分数。在困难配对（6-7）上BiLSTM系列泛化更优，而LSTM+Attention模型在该配对RMSE高达8.94。
AI.conclusion: 双向上下文和鲁棒损失函数在混沌预测中有帮助，而注意力机制和CNN前端在该场景中失效。

title: Can Reasoning Models Detect Changes to their Chains of Thought?
summary: There are many reasons one may want to edit a model's chain of thought (CoT) -- e.g., to prefill it with reasoning from a stronger model or to remove steps that may yield unsafe outputs. The success of these interventions plausibly depends on a model's inability to notice them, as the model may alter its behavior if it suspects tampering. In this work, we study whether recent reasoning models are able to detect such interventions on their CoTs under a variety of conditions: both during reasoning and after it, and when prefilled both with their own CoTs and with those of other models. Broadly, we find that (i) models exhibit only very modest detection accuracy; (ii) models struggle to identify *how* their CoT was modified; and (iii) models are about as good at detecting changes to their own CoTs as to those of other models.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了推理模型是否能够检测到对其思维链（CoT）的干预（如预填充更强模型的推理或移除不安全步骤），发现在多种条件下模型检测准确率很低，难以识别CoT被修改的方式，且对自身和其他模型CoT的检测能力相近。
AI.motivation: 编辑模型思维链（CoT）有多种用途（如预填充更强模型推理、移除不安全输出步骤），但这些干预成功与否可能取决于模型是否无法察觉篡改，因为模型若怀疑被篡改可能会改变自身行为。因此，需要研究推理模型能否检测到CoT干预。
AI.method: 在多种条件下（推理过程中和推理完成后，预填充自身CoT和其他模型CoT）系统性地测试近期推理模型是否能够检测到CoT干预。
AI.result: (i) 模型检测准确率非常有限；(ii) 模型难以识别CoT被修改的具体方式；(iii) 模型检测自身CoT变化的能力与检测其他模型CoT变化的能力相当。
AI.conclusion: 当前推理模型对思维链干预的检测能力很弱，这对CoT编辑的安全性影响有重要启示。

title: Clipping the Price of Adaptivity at the Tail
summary: Adaptive stochastic convex optimization (SCO) methods face a fundamental ``price of adaptivity'' barrier: under the standard set of assumptions, they cannot efficiently adapt to large uncertainty in both the initial distance to optimality and the Lipschitz constant. We circumvent this barrier by requiring a small amount of additional structure common to many learning problems. Specifically, we assume that the objective decomposes into a model and a loss function, enabling us to intervene by modifying the model's output before it passes to the loss function. Under this assumption, we design a method that clips the learned model output in tail events where it deviates too much from the output of a fixed reference model. Our method matches the optimal bounds for known-parameter SCO up to logarithmic factors in the uncertainty in the distance and Lipschitz parameters, thus efficiently adapting to large uncertainty in both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在自适应随机凸优化（SCO）中绕过"适应性代价"障碍的方法，通过利用目标函数分解为模型和损失函数的额外结构，对模型输出进行裁剪，使其在距离和Lipschitz常数存在较大不确定性时仍能达到近乎最优的收敛界。
AI.motivation: 自适应SCO方法存在一个根本性的"适应性代价"障碍：在标准假设下，它们无法同时高效地适应初始距离和Lipschitz常数的大幅不确定性。
AI.method: 假设目标函数可分解为模型和损失函数两部分，从而允许在模型输出传递给损失函数之前进行干预。具体方法是在尾部事件中对模型输出进行裁剪——当学习模型输出与固定参考模型输出偏差过大时进行截断处理。
AI.result: 该方法在距离和Lipschitz参数存在较大不确定性时，达到了已知参数SCO最优界（仅相差对数因子），从而高效地适应了二者的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入模型-损失函数分解这一额外结构，可以有效绕过自适应SCO中的"适应性代价"障碍。

title: SCRUB-FL: Sanitizing and Cleansing Representations via Unlearning of Backdoors
summary: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data, making it a promising paradigm for privacy-sensitive applications. However, its decentralized nature makes it inherently vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where malicious clients embed hidden triggers into local training data to manipulate model predictions. Existing defenses mainly operate during before and during aggregation cannot fully eliminate backdoor behaviors that persist in the converged global model. Moreover, the effectiveness of post-training sanitization is often limited by the server's lack of knowledge of trigger patterns or poisoned clients after convergence, resulting in residual backdoor behaviors or accuracy degradation due to neuron entanglement. To address this limitation, we propose SCRUB-FL (Sanitizing and Cleansing Representations via Unlearning of Backdoors), a two-phase solution for post-training backdoor removal in FL. During training, clients identify suspicious samples using spectral analysis and activation clustering, then train lightweight Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) models to capture trigger-related distributions. The generator parameters are aggregated server-side to construct a global representation of suspicious patterns without exposing raw data. After convergence, the server synthesizes trigger-approximating samples and applies machine unlearning to erase the trigger-target association by redistributing predictions toward a uniform distribution. Experimental evaluations on CIFAR-10 and GTSRB across three attack types and up to 40% malicious participation demonstrate that SCRUB-FL reduces the backdoor attack success rate to as low as 3.88% while maintaining over 91% normal task accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art defenses without requiring prior trigger knowledge or a large clean proxy dataset at the server.

AI.tldr: 提出SCRUB-FL，一个两阶段的后训练后门移除框架，在联邦学习训练阶段通过光谱分析和激活聚类检测可疑样本并训练WGAN-GP模型捕获触发分布，在收敛后通过机器遗忘合成近似触发器样本并擦除触发-目标关联，在CIFAR-10和GTSRB上实现攻击成功率最低至3.88%同时保持91%以上正常准确率。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习的去中心化特性使其易受后门攻击，现有防御主要在聚合前或聚合中进行，无法完全消除已收敛全局模型中的后门行为；后训练清理方法受限于服务器缺乏触发模式或被毒化客户端的知识，且由于神经元纠缠导致残留后门行为或精度下降。
AI.method: 两阶段解决方案：1) 训练阶段：客户端使用光谱分析和激活聚类检测可疑样本，训练轻量级WGAN-GP模型捕获与触发相关的分布，服务器端聚合生成器参数构建全局可疑模式表示而不暴露原始数据；2) 收敛后：服务器合成近似触发器样本，应用机器遗忘通过将预测向均匀分布重新分配来擦除触发-目标关联。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和GTSRB上，针对三种攻击类型和多达40%的恶意参与率，SCRUB-FL将后门攻击成功率降至最低3.88%，同时保持91%以上的正常任务准确率，优于现有最先进防御方法，且无需先验触发知识或服务器端大型干净代理数据集。
AI.conclusion: SCRUB-FL通过结合训练阶段的异常检测与后训练阶段的机器遗忘，有效解决了联邦学习中的后门攻击问题，无需已知触发模式或大量干净数据，在低攻击成功率和保持主任务性能之间取得了优异平衡。

title: PlanBench-XL: Evaluating Long-Horizon Planning of LLM Tool-Use Agents in Large-Scale Tool Ecosystems
summary: LLM agents increasingly operate in large tool ecosystems, where real-world tasks require discovering relevant tools, inferring implicit sub-goals, and adapting to dynamic environments over long horizons. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate planning under retrieval-limited tool visibility. To address this gap, we introduce PlanBench-XL, an interactive benchmark of 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools that tests whether agents can iteratively retrieve usable tools, invoke them to uncover intermediate evidence for subsequent calls toward the final goal. PlanBench-XL further features an optional blocking mechanism that simulates real-world unpredictability through missing, failing, or distracting tool functions, forcing agents to detect disrupted paths and adapt at runtime. Experiments on ten leading LLMs show that massive-tool planning remains challenging: while GPT-5.4 achieves 51.90% accuracy in block-free settings, it collapses to 11.36% under the most severe blocking condition. Further analysis shows that agents are especially vulnerable when failures lack explicit error signals or when recovery requires longer alternative tool-use paths. These results establish PlanBench-XL as a testbed for diagnosing agentic planning failures and highlight the need for robust adaptive planning in long-horizon tasks with large, imperfect tool environments.

AI.tldr: PlanBench-XL是一个包含327个零售任务和1665个工具的交互式基准测试，用于评估LLM智能体在检索受限和工具失效环境下的规划能力。实验表明，即使GPT-5.4在无阻塞条件下也仅达51.90%准确率，在严重阻塞条件下骤降至11.36%，揭示了大规模工具规划中自适应规划的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试很少评估LLM智能体在工具可见性受限条件下的规划能力，而现实任务需要在大型工具生态系统中发现相关工具、推断隐式子目标并适应动态环境。
AI.method: 构建包含327个零售任务和1665个工具的交互式基准PlanBench-XL，并引入可选的阻塞机制（工具缺失、失效、干扰）模拟现实不可预测性，在10个领先LLM上进行实验评估。
AI.result: GPT-5.4在无阻塞条件下准确率51.90%，最严重阻塞条件下骤降至11.36%；智能体在缺乏显式错误信号或需要更长替代工具路径时尤其脆弱。
AI.conclusion: PlanBench-XL可作为诊断智能体规划失败的有效测试平台，凸显了在大型、不完美工具环境下长周期任务中鲁棒自适应规划的必要性。

title: Subspace-Constrained Federated Learning with Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Federated low-rank adaptation methods are attractive for fine-tuning large models under communication and privacy constraints, but heterogeneous client data can induce geometric misalignment between local low-rank updates. We study whether this subspace misalignment leads to destructive aggregation and slower convergence in LoRA-based federated learning. We propose a subspace-regularized federated LoRA objective that encourages local client updates to remain close to a shared global reference subspace. We present a complete empirical evaluation on two pretrained models, RoBERTa-large and SmolLM-360M, over HellaSwag in a non-IID 10-client federated setting, across 3 random seeds (42, 43, 44), yielding 24 total experimental runs (4 methods x 3 seeds x 2 models). On RoBERTa-large, Subspace-Reg achieves the strongest mean best accuracy (0.454 +/- 0.023), mean final accuracy (0.429 +/- 0.011), and lowest final loss (1.363) across all three seeds, outperforming FedAvg, SVD redistribution, and FedSVD baselines by a large margin. On SmolLM-360M, FedAvg leads on accuracy, revealing that accuracy gains are model-dependent. Crucially, Subspace-Reg achieves near-perfect basis overlap, approximately 0.9999, on both models and across all seeds, versus 0.958 to 0.991 for all baselines, providing robust support for the geometric alignment hypothesis. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sadia-sigma-lab/Subspace-Constrained-Federated-learning-with-Lora.

AI.tldr: 本文提出子空间正则化的联邦LoRA方法（Subspace-Reg），通过在联邦微调中约束客户端低秩更新保持与全局参考子空间对齐，解决了异构数据导致的子空间几何失配和聚合退化问题。在RoBERTa-large和SmolLM-360M上的实验表明，该方法在RoBERTa-large上显著优于FedAvg等基线，且实现了近完美的基重叠（~0.9999），有力支撑了几何对齐假说。
AI.motivation: 联邦LoRA方法在通信和隐私约束下具有吸引力，但异构客户端数据会导致局部低秩更新之间的几何失配，这种子空间失配可能引发破坏性聚合和收敛变慢。现有方法缺乏对这一问题的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出子空间正则化的联邦LoRA目标函数，通过正则化项鼓励客户端局部更新保持在共享的全局参考子空间附近，从而缓解子空间对齐问题。
AI.result: 在RoBERTa-large上，Subspace-Reg取得最佳平均准确率（0.454±0.023）、最终平均准确率（0.429±0.011）和最低最终损失（1.363），大幅超越FedAvg、SVD redistribution和FedSVD基线。在SmolLM-360M上，FedAvg在准确率上领先，表明性能增益具有模型依赖性。Subspace-Reg在两个模型上均实现约0.9999的近完美基重叠，而基线仅为0.958-0.991。
AI.conclusion: 子空间正则化方法能有效解决联邦LoRA中的几何对齐问题，显著提升模型性能，但效果存在模型依赖性。近完美的基重叠结果强有力地支持了几何对齐假说——即保持子空间对齐是联邦LoRA有效聚合的关键。

title: VADAOrchestra: Neurosymbolic Orchestration of Adaptive Reasoning Workflows
summary: Decision-making in real-world settings rarely follows a fixed script. Instead, it unfolds as a dynamic reasoning process in which the appropriate course of action evolves as new context and data become available. Traditional Business Process Management systems provide rigor, determinism, and auditability, yet they generally struggle to adapt their execution at runtime. Conversely, agentic systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs) bring flexibility to decision-making, but they are inherently opaque, often unreliable, and suffer from significant scalability constraints when operating over large datasets. To combine these complementary paradigms, we introduce VADAOrchestra, a neurosymbolic framework that models complex workflows as evolving reasoning processes. The framework adopts a hybrid approach: given a user query and a collection of data sources, an LLM-based orchestrator incrementally plans and adapts the workflow. This is encoded as a logic program in a fragment of Datalog+/- where predicates correspond to tool invocations and rules represent both predefined domain dependencies and logic constructs synthesized on demand to manipulate intermediate results. All logical inference tasks are then executed by a state-of-the-art Datalog+/- symbolic engine. This approach provides a verifiable reasoning trace, supporting the auditability and reproducibility of the entire process. Furthermore, by decoupling high-level orchestration from symbolic inference, it addresses scalability concerns, enabling complex reasoning over large datasets through targeted data querying. We evaluate VADAOrchestra on real-world financial use cases, demonstrating faithfulness, scalability, and explainability compared to standard agentic architectures.

AI.tldr: VADAOrchestra是一个神经符号框架，结合了传统BPM的严谨性和LLM的灵活性，通过Datalog+/-逻辑程序对工作流进行增量规划，实现可审计、可扩展且忠实于金融场景的决策推理。
AI.motivation: 传统BPM系统在运行时难以适应动态变化，而基于LLM的智能体系统虽然灵活但缺乏可解释性且在大数据上存在可扩展性问题。两种范式互补但各自有缺陷，需要一种结合两者优势的方法。
AI.method: 提出VADAOrchestra框架，采用混合架构：LLM编排器根据用户查询和数据源增量规划工作流，将其编码为Datalog+/-逻辑程序，其中谓词对应工具调用，规则表示领域依赖和动态合成的逻辑构造，所有推理任务由符号引擎执行。
AI.result: 在真实金融用例上评估，相比标准智能体架构，VADAOrchestra在忠实性(faithfulness)、可扩展性(scalability)和可解释性(explainability)方面均表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦高层编排与符号推理，该方法提供了可验证的推理轨迹，支持审计和可复现性，同时通过目标数据查询解决了大规模数据上的复杂推理问题。

title: GRADE: Graph Representation of LLM Agent Dependency and Execution
summary: Can one graph represent every kind of LLM agent's run? A trace records what each step did, never what it relied on, the state it read, and the results it reused. GRADE recovers that missing layer: it models any run as one graph over its step nodes with two edge layers, execution edges (what ran in what order) read from the trace for free, and dependency edges (what each step relied on) rarely logged, so each is graded by how it is known, observed, declared, or inferred. One representation, and each layer earns its place. Across six corpora of LLM agents spanning tool use, coding, and the web, the dependency layer can predict failure where run size is weak and, under leave-one-corpus-out transfer, stays above chance on every held-out class while run size fails. Meanwhile, the execution layer localizes the faulting step in a failed multi-agent run. This work also provides a more in-depth analysis of why generic graph neural networks may misread the dependency layer, unlike our feature-based alternative. The same graph representation opens further uses, carrying from failure diagnosis in a single run to efficiency and robustness optimization at scale.

AI.tldr: GRADE提出将LLM Agent的任意运行过程建模为具有执行边和依赖边两层边的统一图表示，其中依赖边通过四种可信度分级（已知、观察、声明、推断）来补全日志中缺失的依赖信息。在六个语料库上，依赖层能预测运行规模无法预测的失败，执行层能定位多Agent运行中的故障步骤。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent追踪记录仅记录每一步执行了什么，但缺失了每一步依赖了什么状态、重用了哪些结果这一关键信息层，导致运行分析不完整。
AI.method: 将任意运行建模为单图结构，包含步骤节点和两层边：执行边（执行顺序，从追踪日志免费获取）和依赖边（数据依赖关系，按四种可信度分级：已知、观察、声明、推断）。
AI.result: 在六个涵盖工具使用、编码和Web交互的LLM Agent语料库上：(1) 依赖层能预测运行规模无法预测的失败；(2) 留一法跨语料库迁移时，依赖层在每个保留类上均高于随机水平，而运行规模失败；(3) 执行层能定位多Agent运行中的故障步骤。
AI.conclusion: 统一图表示GRADE可用于从单次运行的故障诊断到大规模效率与鲁棒性优化等多种场景，同时揭示了通用图神经网络可能在依赖层上失效的原因。

title: MacAgentBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World macOS Desktop
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) have advanced rapidly in desktop automation, and a growing number of users deploy CUAs such as OpenClaw on Mac Mini for always-on automation. However, existing benchmarks, including those for macOS, evaluate agents without framework augmentation and rely on binary evaluation. As a result, they fail to capture both the framework capabilities leveraged by modern CUAs and the partial progress on long-horizon, multi-application tasks. We present MacAgentBench, a comprehensive macOS agent benchmark comprising 676 tasks across 25 applications, with nearly 60% involving both GUI and CLI interaction. The benchmark adopts deterministic rule-based evaluation and introduces fine-grained multi-checkpoint scoring with capability annotations for multi-application tasks. Experiments across three frameworks and 16 models show that the best configuration, Claude Opus 4.6 on OpenClaw, attains 73.7% Pass@1, while this advantage is primarily driven by the skill library rather than by framework design. Fine-grained metrics further reveal that models with similar Pass@1 can differ substantially in sub-goal completion. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/JetAstra/MacAgentBench.

AI.tldr: MacAgentBench是一个包含676个任务、覆盖25个macOS应用的智能体基准测试，采用细粒度多检查点评分和规则评估。实验表明，在OpenClaw上使用Claude Opus 4.6达到73.7% Pass@1，优势主要来自技能库而非框架设计。
AI.motivation: 现有macOS基准测试未评估框架增强能力，且依赖二元评估，无法捕捉现代CUA利用的框架能力以及长周期多应用任务中的部分进展。
AI.method: 构建MacAgentBench，包含676个任务和25个应用（近60%涉及GUI和CLI交互），采用确定性规则评估和细粒度多检查点评分，并引入能力标注用于多应用任务。
AI.result: 最佳配置（Claude Opus 4.6 on OpenClaw）达到73.7% Pass@1；优势主要来自技能库而非框架设计；细粒度指标显示Pass@1相似的模型在子目标完成度上存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: MacAgentBench能更全面评估CUA在macOS上的表现，揭示Pass@1之外的性能差异，并为未来研究提供基准和见解。

title: Error Highways: Scaling Predictive Coding to Very Deep Networks
summary: Predictive coding networks (PCNs) offer a biologically-plausible, local-learning alternative to back-propagation of errors (backprop). Nevertheless, they have remained largely confined to shallow architectures and evaluated on simple machine intelligence benchmarks. A central obstacle to scaling PCNs is that the learning signal decays rapidly as it propagates away from the clamped boundaries, leaving interior layers effectively unchanged. To directly counter this problem, we propose highway error propagation (HEP), a scheme that augments the free energy function underlying predictive coding (PC) by altering its neural structure with feedback matrices $V_{L\to i}$ that couple selected hidden states directly to the clamped output error. Since this coupling is linear in the hidden state, the highway pathway delivers a correction at every inference step whose magnitude is independent of depth, in contrast to vanilla PC where the output error reaches the $i$-th hidden layer with attenuation that decays exponentially in depth. This bypasses the Jacobian chain while preserving the local PC synaptic update rule. On MNIST and Fashion-MNIST, we show that HEP effectively trains MLPs of up to 128 layers with accuracy that is robust with respect to depth.

AI.tldr: 针对预测编码网络在深层架构中学习信号快速衰减的问题，提出高速公路误差传播（HEP）方案，通过在线性耦合隐藏状态与输出误差的反馈矩阵，使误差修正幅度不受深度影响，在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上成功训练了高达128层的MLP。
AI.motivation: 预测编码网络虽具有生物合理性和局部学习优势，但难以扩展到深层架构，因为学习信号在远离边界层时迅速衰减，导致内部层几乎无法更新。
AI.method: 提出HEP方案，通过引入反馈矩阵$V_{L\to i}$将选定隐藏状态直接线性耦合到输出误差，修改预测编码的自由能函数，使每个推理步的修正幅度与深度无关，绕过雅可比链的同时保持局部突触更新规则。
AI.result: 在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上，HEP成功训练了多达128层的MLP，且准确率对深度具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: HEP有效解决了预测编码网络中的误差衰减问题，使其能够扩展到深层架构，为构建更具生物合理性的深度学习方法提供了可行路径。

title: One-Step Flow Matching for Generative Modeling of Path-Dependent Physical Fields
summary: Physical simulations for intricate geometries with path-dependent constitutive models face difficulties due to the enormous computational cost they require. Recently, the emergence of generative AI models, which succeed in image and video synthesis tasks, has provided a promise to further improve simulations. Although U-Net-based denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) have been adopted for elastic stress field generation, they typically require hundreds of sampling steps, and applications of generative models to path-dependent, e.g. plastic, stress fields remain very limited. In this work, we propose a novel flow matching (FM) model based on a transformer backbone for high-resolution path-dependent stress field generation with stochastic loading-unloading paths and geometry. The proposed model operates within the latent space of a variational autoencoder (VAE) and formulates the simulation of plastic fields as a video synthesis task, directly generating the stress fields across all time steps. Meanwhile, we design a non-Gaussian source distribution for flow matching, such that crossings among conditional transport paths are reduced during training. This enables our model to generate satisfactory samples in one step without relying on distillation. In addition, we introduce token-level loading embeddings and two auxiliary networks to further enhance the model performance in path-dependent simulation. The results demonstrate that, even with a limited training dataset, our model can accurately generate high-resolution path-dependent fields. It is much more computationally efficient than finite element analysis, providing a speedup of 6 to 7 times over FEM on CPUs and approximately two orders of magnitude speedup on consumer-grade GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer骨干网络的流匹配（Flow Matching）模型，在变分自编码器（VAE）的隐空间中运行，将塑性应力场模拟建模为视频合成任务，通过非高斯源分布实现单步高质量生成，在路径依赖应力场生成上比有限元分析快6-7倍（CPU）或约两个数量级（GPU）。
AI.motivation: 复杂几何与路径依赖本构模型的物理模拟计算成本极高，现有U-Net扩散模型需数百步采样，且生成式模型在路径依赖（如塑性）应力场中的应用非常有限。
AI.method: 提出基于Transformer骨干的流匹配（FM）模型，在VAE隐空间中将塑性场模拟建模为视频合成任务；设计非高斯源分布以减少条件传输路径交叉，实现单步高质量生成；引入token级加载嵌入和两个辅助网络提升路径依赖模拟性能。
AI.result: 即便在有限训练数据集下，模型能准确生成高分辨率路径依赖应力场；计算效率远优于有限元分析：CPU上快6-7倍，消费级GPU上约快两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的流匹配模型在路径依赖应力场生成上兼具高精度和高效率，为物理模拟提供了有前景的替代方案。

title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; includes Supplementary Information. Code: https://github.com/VISTA-Stanford/vista-architect (tag v0.1.0-preprint, commit 8837d44)
summary:
We introduce VISTA Architect, a database-oriented AI architecture for integrating large language models (LLMs) with longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). At ingestion, it transforms complex clinical documentation into a persistent, provenance-linked knowledge graph, eliminating repeated reprocessing of raw records at query time. The architecture has two layers: a source-faithful MEDS Graph preserving granular EHR structure with full provenance, and a clinically abstracted Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) that uses graph-guided LLM extraction to synthesize a concise timeline of deduplicated, temporally coherent clinical events. This addresses key limitations of direct long-context prompting and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which often miss temporal relationships and incur high cost and latency from repeated raw-text processing. By precomputing clinical synthesis once, downstream queries access an organized patient state and traverse to source documentation only when detailed verification is needed.
  We demonstrate the system in multidisciplinary thoracic oncology tumor boards at Stanford Medicine, where precise reconstruction of patient histories is critical. Across 1,180 patients, VISTA Architect achieved 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10) on 15 tumor board-salient variables (17,700 evaluations; 95% CI 96.1-96.7%), surpassing a matched BM25 RAG baseline and recent benchmarks for LLM-based clinical extraction. An agentic interface reduced preparation for a 30-patient held-out cohort to about 2.2 minutes without sacrificing accuracy. While configured here for thoracic oncology, the modular design adapts to other specialties through customizable event definitions, episode structures, and agentic tools; validation beyond thoracic oncology remains future work.

AI.tldr: VISTA Architect是一种面向数据库的AI架构，通过将LLM与纵向电子健康记录集成，构建持久化的溯源知识图谱和临床时间线，在斯坦福医学中心多学科胸科肿瘤委员会中，对1,180名患者的17,700项评估实现了96.4%的准确率，并将30名患者的准备工作缩短至约2.2分钟。
AI.motivation: 解决直接长上下文提示和RAG在临床应用中忽略时间关系、反复处理原始文本导致高成本和高延迟等关键局限性，需要一种能高效组织患者历史信息、保留时间关系且避免重复计算的方法。
AI.method: 提出两层架构：1) MEDS Graph层，保留原始EHR的细粒度结构和完整溯源；2) Timeline Object Architecture (TOA)层，利用图引导的LLM提取合成去重且时间连贯的临床事件时间线。通过预处理方式一次性计算临床摘要，下游查询可快速访问组织好的患者状态，仅在需要详细验证时才回溯源文档。
AI.result: 在斯坦福医学中心胸科肿瘤委员会场景中，对1,180名患者的15个肿瘤委员会相关变量进行17,700次评估，达到96.4%准确率（平均9.75/10，95% CI 96.1-96.7%），优于BM25 RAG基线和近期LLM临床提取基准。智能体接口将30名患者的准备时间降至约2.2分钟且不牺牲准确性。
AI.conclusion: VISTA Architect通过数据库导向的预计算架构有效解决了LLM在临床EHR应用中的效率和时序问题，模块化设计可适应其他专科，但超出胸科肿瘤学的验证仍有待未来研究。

title: Factored Gossip DiLoCo: Reducing Blocking Communication in DiLoCo
summary: To make large-scale distributed training practical outside high-bandwidth datacenters, we must reduce blocking, high-volume synchronization. While DiLoCo communicates infrequently, its outer synchronization remains bandwidth-heavy and brittle to stragglers and transient failures. We relax exact synchronization to approximate synchronization via mixing/gossip, which degrades gracefully under delays and communication failures. This allows us to factorize DiLoCo synchronization into a non-blocking mixing step that overlaps computation with no staleness, and a blocking mixing step that tightens worker agreement, yielding a tunable trade-off between compute utilization and optimization stability. On up to billion-parameter language models in low-bandwidth settings, our framework substantially improves compute utilization compared to DiLoCo, with training progress ranging from comparable to closely matching it, and is more robust to failures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将DiLoCo的精确同步松弛为近似同步（混合/ gossip）的框架，通过分解为非阻塞混合步骤（无延迟重叠计算）和阻塞混合步骤（收紧工作节点一致性），在低带宽环境下实现了比DiLoCo更高的计算利用率、可比的训练进度以及更强的故障鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 为了在非高带宽数据中心实现大规模分布式训练，必须减少阻塞式、高流量的同步操作。DiLoCo虽然通信频率低，但其外部同步仍然带宽密集且对掉队者和瞬时故障脆弱。
AI.method: 将精确同步松弛为近似同步（混合/gossip），使其在延迟和通信故障下优雅降级。将DiLoCo同步分解为：(1) 非阻塞混合步骤，与计算重叠且无陈旧性；(2) 阻塞混合步骤，收紧工作节点一致性，从而在计算利用率和优化稳定性之间实现可调权衡。
AI.result: 在多达十亿参数的语言模型上、低带宽设置下，与DiLoCo相比，该框架显著提高了计算利用率，训练进度从可比到紧密匹配，且对故障更加鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 近似同步（混合/gossip）结合分解式同步设计，能够有效缓解大规模分布式训练中的带宽瓶颈和故障脆弱性问题，在实用化低带宽分布式训练方面具有显著优势。

title: Beyond Penalizing Mistakes: Stabilizing Efficiency Training in Large Reasoning Models via Adaptive Correct-Only Rewards
summary: Training large language models to reason efficiently is a critical challenge. While integrating length-penalizing rewards into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) aims to reduce verbosity, it frequently triggers reward collapse, severely degrading reasoning capabilities. Through a systematic evaluation of various reward configurations, we identify the root mechanism: GRPO's group normalization creates divergent advantages when incorrect answers receive continuous length penalties. Consequently, methods penalizing the length of incorrect answers are structurally prone to collapse under sustained optimization. Furthermore, restricting penalties exclusively to correct answers avoids this primary failure, but leaves the model susceptible to a stochastic collapse driven by response over-compression. To robustly prevent both failure modes, we propose ACOER (Adaptive Correct-Only Efficiency Reward). ACOER eliminates the structural penalty loop by isolating brevity bonuses to correct completions and prevents stochastic compression via dynamic budget normalization and control-loop penalty adjustments. Evaluated across diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ACOER improves overall accuracy compared to the base model while reducing token generation by over 60%, establishing a fundamentally stable approach for efficiency-aware optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文发现GRPO中长度惩罚会导致奖励坍塌，提出ACOER方法通过仅对正确回答给予简洁奖励并结合动态预算归一化，在数学推理任务上减少60%以上token生成的同时提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 训练大语言模型高效推理时，在GRPO中加入长度惩罚虽旨在减少冗长，但常引发奖励坍塌，严重损害推理能力，亟需解决这一不稳定问题。
AI.method: 提出ACOER（自适应仅正确效率奖励）：1）将简洁奖励仅作用于正确完成，消除结构性惩罚循环；2）通过动态预算归一化和控制环路惩罚调整，防止随机坍塌。
AI.result: 在多种数学推理基准上，ACOER相比基模型提升准确率，同时减少超过60%的token生成。
AI.conclusion: ACOER建立了稳定的效率感知优化方法，证明仅对正确回答施加长度奖励并配合动态调节机制可同时避免两种坍塌模式。

title: Noise is Signal: Density-Based Outliers as Leading Indicators of Occupational Emergence in Labor Market Text
summary: Standard NLP pipelines for occupational clustering discard the 10-15% of job postings that density-based methods assign to noise. We argue this is an error: in rapidly evolving domains, low posting density signals novelty, not incoherence. We formalize this as the Emergence-Density Inversion (EDI) hypothesis and test it longitudinally on 84,988 job postings across eight quarters (Q4 2022-Q3 2024). EDI is partially confirmed: high-EOS outlier groups transition to stable clusters in 1.4 +/- 0.6 quarters vs. 4.1 +/- 1.2 for low-EOS groups (p < 0.001), though the signal fails in approximately 19% of cases, which we characterize as a failure analysis. We extend the Emerging Occupation Score (EOS) with Temporal Velocity and Cross-Platform Convergence, improving 2-quarter cluster-formation prediction from F1 = 0.61 to 0.74, outperforming Isolation Forest, LOF, GLOSH, and BERTrend baselines. A retrospective study on three now-established roles (MLOps Engineer, DevOps/SRE, Data Engineer) confirms EOS signalled 2-3 quarters before cluster formation, providing held-out validation. A held-out annotator panel (kappa = 0.74) rates EOS > 0.75 as coherent emerging occupations with 77% precision. Prompt Engineer, AI Safety Researcher, Foundation Model Engineer, and Agent Systems Engineer, all absent from O*NET, are top-4 in Q3 2024 and form stable clusters by Q1 2025.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Emergence-Density Inversion (EDI)假说，认为密度聚类中被视为噪声的低密度职位发布实际上标志着新兴职业。基于84,988条招聘数据，发现高新兴职业得分(EOS)的离群点平均1.4个季度内形成稳定聚类，而低EOS组需4.1个季度。通过引入时间速度和跨平台收敛性改进EOS，聚类形成预测F1从0.61提升至0.74，并成功识别出Prompt Engineer等O*NET未收录的新兴职业。
AI.motivation: 传统NLP职业聚类管线将10-15%被密度聚类算法标记为噪声的职位发布直接丢弃，但作者认为在快速演变的领域中，低发布密度并非无意义噪声，而是代表了新兴职业的信号。这一假设挑战了现有处理惯例，旨在从噪声中提前识别出尚未被标准职业分类体系收录的新兴角色。
AI.method: 形式化提出EDI假说；在横跨8个季度（2022Q4-2024Q3）的84,988条招聘数据上纵向验证；扩展EOS指标，引入Temporal Velocity和Cross-Platform Convergence两个新维度；使用逻辑回归进行聚类形成预测，并与Isolation Forest、LOF、GLOSH、BERTrend等基线对比；通过回顾性研究（MLOps Engineer等三个已确立角色）和留出标注者小组（kappa=0.74）进行验证。
AI.result: 高EOS离群组形成稳定聚类的速度为1.4±0.6个季度，低EOS组为4.1±1.2个季度（p<0.001），EDI部分成立但约19%案例失败。改进后的EOS将2个季度聚类形成预测F1从0.61提升至0.74，超越所有基线。回顾性验证确认EOS比聚类形成早2-3个季度发出信号。标注者小组对EOS>0.75的判断精度为77%。Prompt Engineer等四个角色在2024Q3排名前四并于2025Q1形成稳定聚类。
AI.conclusion: 低密度噪声可有效转化为新兴职业的早期预警信号，EDI假说为动态劳动力市场监测提供了可操作的方法论框架，能够提前2-3个季度发现标准分类体系（如O*NET）尚未收录的新兴职业角色。

title: GroundEval: A Deterministic Replacement for LLM-as-Judge in Stateful Agent Evaluation
summary:
Before letting an agent operate over real context, can you prove it used the right evidence? GroundEval turns that question into a deterministic test of what the agent searched, fetched, cited, and was permitted to access. In one case study, two frontier LLM judges scored a plausible agent response above 0.85. But the trace told a different story: the agent had never retrieved the artifact its answer depended on, yielding a GroundEval score of 0.000.
  We introduce GroundEval, a judge-free framework for evaluating agents against grounded, time-bounded, and access-controlled evidence. GroundEval uses a domain configuration to generate questions, lets the agent choose how to answer, and then scores both the final answer and the recorded trajectory that produced it. The benchmark targets three failures that LLM-as-judge evaluation struggles to detect: whether an agent checked before claiming absence, reasoned only from evidence available to the actor at the relevant time, and used the correct causal mechanism rather than a plausible one. These correspond to three tracks: Silence, Perspective, and Counterfactual. GroundEval exposes when plausible answers rest on invalid evidence paths, and produces structured per-question diagnostics that pair tool activity with the agent's turn-level narration, making each score inspectable rather than merely reported. What our case studies turned up is that this gap isn't some rare corner case. It's exactly the blind spot that final-answer and judge-based scoring were never built to catch.

AI.tldr: GroundEval是一个无评判者的评估框架，通过记录和分析智能体的搜索、获取、引用和访问轨迹，检测其最终答案是否基于真实证据，而非仅凭合理性。案例显示，两个前沿LLM评判者给一个看似合理的答案打分0.85以上，但GroundEval发现智能体从未检索关键证据，得分为0.000。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-judge评估方法无法检测智能体是否真正使用了正确的证据，容易将基于不合理证据路径的合理答案误判为正确。
AI.method: GroundEval通过域配置生成问题，记录智能体执行轨迹，从三个维度（Silence、Perspective、Counterfactual）评估答案是否基于真实、时间受限且受访问控制的证据，并生成结构化逐问题诊断。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，两个前沿LLM评判者对智能体的错误答案给出0.85以上高分，而GroundEval正确识别其证据路径无效，得分为0.000。这种差距并非罕见边缘案例，而是最终答案和评判者评分方法的固有盲区。
AI.conclusion: GroundEval能够暴露基于无效证据路径的合理答案，提供可检查的评分而非仅报告数值，填补了现有评估方法的盲区。

title: Statistical Matching via Schrödinger Bridge beyond Conditional Independence
summary: Statistical matching combines partially overlapping datasets that share covariates $X$ but observe the target $Y$ and auxiliary variables $Z$ separately. Classical approaches typically invoke the conditional independence assumption (CIA), which makes the problem identifiable but fundamentally implies that the imported auxiliary variable provides no additional predictive power for $Y$ once $X$ is known. To capture this latent $Y$--$Z$ dependence, we propose a novel dependency-aware Schrödinger bridge for predictive statistical matching. Our approach couples the two separated databases by tilting the conservative CIA baseline with a transportation-based compatibility cost, recovering an informative joint distribution. The resulting statistical learning framework yields full probabilistic posterior rules for bidirectional imputation. Theoretically, we establish a sufficient condition under which the learned bridge strictly improves over the CIA baseline, alongside an exact joint recovery guarantee in the Gaussian setting under an appropriate cost. Across synthetic benchmarks and real-world datasets (CelebA and Adult), we demonstrate that our dependency-aware completion consistently improves downstream predictive utility, proving especially beneficial in settings like data recoding where the underlying population exhibits strong $Y$--$Z$ dependence.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种依赖感知的薛定谔桥方法用于统计匹配，通过倾斜条件独立假设基线并引入基于运输的兼容性成本，恢复联合分布，实现双向插补，在理论和实验上均证明优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 传统统计匹配方法依赖于条件独立假设(CIA)，该假设认为一旦已知共享协变量X，辅助变量Z对目标变量Y没有额外预测能力，这忽略了潜在的Y-Z依赖关系，导致信息损失。
AI.method: 提出依赖感知的薛定谔桥方法：通过倾斜保守的CIA基线，引入基于运输的兼容性成本来耦合两个分离数据库，恢复信息丰富的联合分布，形成完整概率后验规则用于双向插补。
AI.result: 在合成基准和真实数据集(CelebA和Adult)上，依赖感知补全一致性地改善了下游预测效用，在Y-Z依赖较强的数据重编码等场景中尤其有益。
AI.conclusion: 建立了学习桥严格优于CIA基线的充分条件，在高斯设置下给出精确联合恢复保证；实验验证了方法在捕捉Y-Z依赖关系方面的有效性。

title: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents depend on context management: systems compress, summarize, and evict old tokens so tasks can continue beyond finite windows. That is safe only when dropped information is no longer needed or has been internalized. Plans are the stress case: they are written early, used for many steps, and first to be evicted. We introduce replay pairing, a diagnostic that runs the same trajectory with and without the plan in history and measures hidden-state cosine distance. On Llama-3.1-70B, plan signal spikes to 0.453 one step after the plan, then falls 4.1x in a single action-observation step; HotpotQA falls 12.4x. This is evidence that standard LLM agents do not carry plans forward as persistent state, and instead depend on the plan remaining in context. A layer-L32 probe detects this decay as a diagnostic, not as proof that it reads plan content itself. Reasoning models add a measurement confound: their `<think>` traces re-derive plan content, so standard stripping leaves plan evidence in the stripped condition. We name this the reasoning-trace confound and fix it with strict stripping, which removes prior `<think>` blocks from the stripped run only. It recovers +163% of the step+1 signal in-sample and +153% held out, while not meaningfully changing non-reasoning Llama (+4.8%). On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, a Llama-trained probe transfers at AUROC 0.748 (p=6e-4), while R1-specific probes reach 1.000, suggesting R1 encodes plan signal in a different hidden-state direction. Finally, a compression stress test shows the practical cost: naive plan eviction cuts ALFWorld success by 34.7pp, while probe-gated re-surfacing does not recover it. The contribution is a measurement and stress-test framework showing that agent-critical information can be context-resident rather than persistent. Context management is load bearing, but plan protection alone is not enough.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了长程智能体在有限上下文窗口中的计划信息持久性问题，发现标准LLM智能体并未将计划存储为持久隐藏状态，而是依赖于计划留在上下文窗口中。作者提出了回放配对（replay pairing）诊断方法，揭示了计划信号在上下文中快速衰减的现象，并发现了推理模型中的“推理痕迹混淆”问题。实验表明，计划被上下文管理机制丢弃会导致ALFWorld任务成功率下降34.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体依赖上下文管理（压缩、摘要、驱逐旧token）来在有限窗口内继续任务。计划（plan）是最先被驱逐的早期内容，但若计划信息未被模型内化为持久状态，驱逐会导致任务失败。现有工作未系统量化计划信息是否被模型内化为持久隐藏状态，也未评估上下文管理对计划信息的影响。
AI.method: 1）提出回放配对（replay pairing）诊断方法：在同一轨迹上对比有/无计划在历史中的隐藏状态余弦距离；2）在Llama-3.1-70B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B上进行测量；3）发现推理模型存在“推理痕迹混淆”（reasoning-trace confound），提出严格剥离（strict stripping）方法去除前序<think>块；4）设计压缩压力测试，评估计划驱逐的实际影响。
AI.result: 1）Llama-3.1-70B上，计划信号在下一步后立即达到峰值0.453，随后一个行动-观察步骤衰减4.1倍（HotpotQA衰减12.4倍）；2）严格剥离在推理模型上恢复163%（样本内）和153%（样本外）的信号，对非推理模型影响仅+4.8%；3）Llama训练的探针迁移到DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B的AUROC为0.748（p=6e-4），R1专用探针达到1.000；4）计划驱逐导致ALFWorld成功率下降34.7个百分点，探针门控的重新浮现无法恢复。
AI.conclusion: 标准LLM智能体并未将计划存储为持久隐藏状态，而是依赖计划保留在上下文中。上下文管理机制承担了关键负载，但仅仅保护计划不被驱逐不足以解决信息持久性问题。本文提供了一个测量和压力测试框架，揭示了智能体关键信息可能仅存在于上下文中而非持久化。

title: GeoRouteNet: Geometry-Enhanced Non-Autoregressive Neural Solver for the Traveling Salesman Problem
summary: The traveling salesman problem (TSP) is a canonical NP-hard combinatorial optimization benchmark that tests the representational capacity and generalization of neural solvers. While non-autoregressive (NAR) approaches offer parallel inference, they often lack sufficient geometric inductive bias and stable training signals, leading to degraded performance under cross-scale and cross-distribution shifts. We propose GeoRouteNet, a geometry-enhanced NAR neural solver for Euclidean TSP. On the model side, GeoRouteNet incorporates centered node features, learnable radial distance basis functions, distance-aware graph attention with explicit edge messaging, LayerNorm-SwiGLU feed-forward blocks, and cross-layer attentive residual mixing. On the training side, we design multi-candidate self-comparison reinforcement learning (MCS-RL), which samples multiple candidate tours per instance, constructs adaptive baselines from greedy and peer candidates, and adds winner-candidate guidance with annealed entropy regularization. On 10,000 random TSP50 instances, GeoRouteNet achieves a 0.32% optimality gap under Beam-1000 decoding. On TSP100, the gap is 1.26%. On 27 stratified TSPLIB EUC_2D instances, the overall gap drops from 17.12% (NAR4TSP reproduction) to 3.60%, while batch inference throughput substantially exceeds that of Concorde and LKH3. Ablation studies confirm that geometric structure enhancement and multi-candidate training are complementary: structure improvements dominate cross-distribution gains, while MCS-RL further stabilizes solution quality when paired with a strong geometric encoder.

AI.tldr: GeoRouteNet是一种几何增强的非自回归神经求解器，用于欧几里得旅行商问题。它通过中心化节点特征、可学习径向距离基函数、距离感知图注意力等结构改进，以及多候选自比较强化学习训练策略，在TSP50上达到0.32%最优性差距，TSP100上为1.26%，且在TSPLIB实例上将差距从17.12%降至3.60%，同时推理吞吐量显著超过Concorde和LKH3。
AI.motivation: 现有非自回归神经求解器在求解TSP时缺乏充分的几何归纳偏置和稳定训练信号，导致在跨尺度、跨分布场景下性能退化严重。
AI.method: 模型层面：中心化节点特征、可学习径向距离基函数(RBF)、距离感知图注意力与显式边消息传递、LayerNorm-SwiGLU前馈块、跨层注意力残差混合。训练层面：多候选自比较强化学习(MCS-RL)，每个实例采样多条候选路径，基于贪心和同伴候选构建自适应基线，加入优胜者候选引导和退火熵正则化。
AI.result: TSP50：0.32%最优性差距(Beam-1000解码)；TSP100：1.26%最优性差距；27个TSPLIB EUC_2D实例：差距从17.12%降至3.60%；推理吞吐量远超Concorde和LKH3。
AI.conclusion: 几何结构增强与多候选训练相互补充：结构改进主导跨分布泛化增益，MCS-RL在强几何编码器基础上进一步稳定解质量。

title: Understanding Parallel Samplers in Masked Diffusion via Random Walks on Graphs
summary:
In this paper, we propose using random walks on graphs as a verifiable sandbox to study different parallel sampling strategies in masked diffusion models (MDMs). We train an MDM on random walk samples from a fixed graph. The graph or the transition kernel is never shown to the model explicitly and plays the role of latent structure in the sequences, albeit one that is controllable and can be used for quantitative evaluation. Thus, this framework enjoys a Sudoku-like validity check: verifying that an output is a valid walk and estimating the Markov kernel from the walks to measure distribution fidelity.
  Using simple graphs, we theoretically prove that parallel unmasking via widely used scores like lowest entropy is not uniformly better than a random parallel sampler; the performance critically depends on the structure of the underlying graph. We develop a new bisection sampler for random walks, which takes logarithmic steps in the sequence length and is provably exact under perfect training. Experiments on various graph walk tasks show that different parallel samplers are better for different graphs even in practice. Our initial experiments on a pretrained OpenWebText MDM show that the bisection-style samplers improve speed-quality tradeoffs even for language generation. Together, these results position graph random walks as a mechanistic benchmark for diagnosing and designing parallel samplers for masked diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用图上的随机游走作为可验证的沙箱，研究掩码扩散模型中的不同并行采样策略，并开发了一种新的二分采样器，理论上证明其在完美训练下是精确的，实验表明不同图结构适合不同的并行采样器。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型中的并行采样策略缺乏可控的定量评估基准，现有方法如最低熵并行去掩码的性能依赖于潜在结构但难以分析，需要一个可验证的框架来系统研究不同采样策略的优劣。
AI.method: 使用固定图上的随机游走作为可控潜在结构训练MDM，通过图论理论证明不同并行采样器的性能差异；开发了在序列长度上呈对数步数的二分采样器，并证明其在完美训练下是精确的。
AI.result: 理论证明最低熵等广泛使用的并行去掩码策略并不统一优于随机并行采样器，性能依赖于底层图结构；实验表明不同图需要不同的最优并行采样器；在OpenWebText MDM上的实验表明二分风格采样器能改善语言生成的速度-质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 图随机游走可作为掩码扩散模型并行采样器的机械论基准，用于诊断和设计更好的并行采样策略。

title: Explainable AI for Mental Health Prediction in Drug-Affected Populations with Dragonfly Algorithm and GAN Oversampling
comment: Accepted for presenting at the 16th International Conference on Advanced Computer Information Technologies (ACIT 2026). To appear in IEEE conference proceedings
summary: Mental illnesses among drug users are an increasing international issue, particularly in regions where early detection cannot be easily undertaken. The current literature tends to ignore the use of AI-based mental health analysis in drug users, and low quality of the class imbalance treatment, low interpretability, and optimal hyperparameter optimization can lower predictive quality and clinical utility. This study present a detailed, explainable machine learning (ML) model of multiclass mental health prediction, using a multidimensional data set of drug-affected persons. We combine hybrid PCA-Information Gain (PCA-IG) feature selection, Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based oversampling, and Dragonfly Algorithm (DA)-optimized XGBoost to address some of the limitations of existing methods. The suggested framework is effective to work with high-dimensional categorical data, address the issue of class imbalance, and improve predictive performance due to intelligent hyperparameter tuning. The experimental findings show that the XGBoost model optimized using the DA, in combination with GAN-based oversampling, has an accuracy of 94.17% and a weighted F1-score of 93.80%, which is better than the traditional and baseline models. The behavioral, lifestyle, and health factors, particularly sleep quality, physical health, and emotional regulation, are strongly predictive of mental health, with demographic factors having little impact, as seen through feature analysis. SHAP-based explainable AI provides easy-to-understand, instance-level information, enhancing interpretability and trust in models to be used in clinical settings. The results indicate that this framework has the potential to generate valid mental health forecasting tools, which would facilitate early intervention and enhance the treatment of drug-influenced people.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合PCA-IG特征选择、GAN过采样和蜻蜓算法优化XGBoost的可解释机器学习框架，用于药物使用者的多类心理健康预测，准确率达94.17%，并通过SHAP提供了实例级可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏针对药物使用者的AI心理健康分析，且存在类别不平衡处理质量低、可解释性差和超参数优化不足等问题，限制了预测质量和临床实用性。
AI.method: 采用混合PCA-信息增益(PCA-IG)进行特征选择，生成对抗网络(GAN)进行过采样以处理类别不平衡，蜻蜓算法(DA)优化XGBoost超参数，最后结合SHAP进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: DA优化的XGBoost结合GAN过采样实现了94.17%的准确率和93.80%的加权F1分数。特征分析表明睡眠质量、身体健康和情绪调节是强预测因素，而人口学因素影响较小。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有生成有效的心理健康预测工具的潜力，能够促进早期干预并改善对药物影响人群的治疗，且SHAP提供的可解释性增强了模型在临床环境中的信任度。

title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grained and still treats agent exploration as isolated, linear trajectories. This oversimplified perspective ignores the inherent graph structure of state transitions, leading to high-variance state-value estimation and myopic, localized credit assignment. To overcome these critical bottlenecks, we propose Group-Graph Policy Optimization (G2PO), a novel group-based RL algorithm tailored for multi-turn agentic tasks. G2PO explicitly transforms linear interaction trajectories into a global state-transition graph. By aggregating identical observations across different trajectories, we introduce group-aggregation state-value estimation that reduces sampling variance and trajectory-dependent bias. Furthermore, we redefine agent actions as transitions between state nodes and propose an edge-centric advantage estimation strategy. By globally standardizing Temporal Difference (TD) errors across the entire graph, G2PO explicitly identifies and prioritizes critical transitions that drive absolute task progress. Extensive experiments on representative long-horizon benchmarks-WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld-demonstrate that G2PO substantially outperforms state-of-the-art prompt-based and RL baselines, achieving remarkable success rate improvements of up to 22.2% over GRPO.

AI.tldr: G2PO是一种新的基于组的强化学习算法，通过将线性交互轨迹转换为全局状态转移图，利用组聚合状态价值估计和边中心化优势估计，解决了长程智能体RL中的奖励稀疏与延迟问题，在WebShop、ALFWorld和AppWorld基准上相比GRPO实现了高达22.2%的成功率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于步骤的智能体RL框架虽然比轨迹级训练更细粒度，但信用分配仍然粗糙，将智能体探索视为孤立的线性轨迹，忽略了状态转移的固有图结构，导致高方差状态价值估计和短视的局部信用分配，无法有效处理长程任务中的奖励稀疏与延迟问题。
AI.method: 提出G2PO框架：(1) 将线性交互轨迹显式转换为全局状态转移图；(2) 通过聚合不同轨迹中相同的观测，提出组聚合状态价值估计，降低采样方差和轨迹依赖偏差；(3) 将智能体动作重新定义为状态节点间的边，提出边中心化优势估计策略，通过全局标准化TD误差来识别和优先处理推动绝对任务进展的关键转移。
AI.result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和AppWorld三个代表性长程基准上，G2PO显著优于现有基于提示和RL的基线方法，相比GRPO实现了最高22.2%的成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: G2PO通过图结构化的状态建模和边级别的信用分配，克服了传统线性轨迹范式的奖励稀疏与延迟瓶颈，为长程智能体RL提供了一种更有效的细粒度训练方法。

title: Towards Robust Personalized Federated Learning: Vulnerability Assessment and Defense Co-Design
summary: The proliferation of IoT devices has fueled distributed edge systems to collect vast amounts of sensitive data, creating fertile ground for on-device machine learning applications. While federated learning (FL) mitigates privacy concerns by exchanging model parameters instead of raw data, we identify a critical blind spot in current research. We examine the most commonly used personalized federated learning (PFL) methods, which allow clients to maintain private, personalized models to address data heterogeneity across clients. Through systematic analysis, we reveal that PFL methods exhibit heightened vulnerability to transfer-based adversarial attacks compared to centralized learning paradigms. Wherein, malicious clients can exploit local model knowledge to craft adversarial examples that can compromise peer clients' personalized models. We establish this vulnerability through both theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation across multiple benchmark datasets, demonstrating significant accuracy drops across various PFL methods. To address this challenge, we propose a defense framework combining stochastic input noise, input-scaled trace regularization, and parameter sensitivity maximization to improve FL's robustness. Our findings establish the first systematic study of adversarial threats in PFL systems, providing both diagnostic tools and practical countermeasures.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了个性化联邦学习(PFL)在迁移攻击下的脆弱性，发现PFL方法比集中式学习更易受攻击，并提出了一种结合随机输入噪声、输入缩放迹正则化和参数灵敏度最大化的防御框架。
AI.motivation: 当前研究忽略了PFL方法在迁移攻击下的安全性问题，作者发现PFL中恶意客户端可利用本地模型知识构造对抗样本攻击其他客户端的个性化模型，这一盲点亟需系统性研究。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和多基准数据集上的实证评估，系统性地检验了多种主流PFL方法对基于迁移的对抗攻击的脆弱性；提出包含随机输入噪声、输入缩放迹正则化和参数灵敏度最大化的防御框架。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上观察到各种PFL方法的准确率显著下降，验证了PFL比集中式学习更易受迁移攻击；提出的防御框架有效提升了FL的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次系统性地揭示了PFL系统中的对抗性威胁，并为诊断和防御此类攻击提供了实用工具和策略。

title: Cognitive Digital Twins: Ethical Risks and Governance for AI Systems That Model the Mind
summary: As AI systems become increasingly persistent and personalized, they make possible a class of technologies that we call cognitive digital twins (CDTs): dynamic computational representations of a specific person's cognition, updated from behavioral, contextual, or physiological data in order to model, predict, or simulate that person's cognition, or to act as that person's communicative or decision-making proxy. CDTs combine cognitive inference with longitudinal representation, simulation, and proxy action in ways that existing governance strategies for personal assistants, autonomous agents, recommender systems, and automated decision systems only partially address. This paper makes four contributions. First, we define CDTs and distinguish them from adjacent systems. Second, we introduce a 5A governance framework organized around authority, autonomy, access and control, accountability, and availability. Third, we identify CDT-specific risks, from misrepresentation and epistemic authority shifts to shadow twins, simulated participation, proxy action, and proxy-power asymmetries. Fourth, we analyze governance gaps and propose requirements for high-risk CDTs that strengthen consent, purpose limitation, validity, traceability, contestation, independent review, and model retirement. Existing frameworks primarily regulate data processing, automated decisions, or autonomous actions; CDTs also require governance at the level of cognitive representation itself, before any final decision or external action occurs. We argue that CDTs require governance not only because they can act for people, but because they can become infrastructures through which cognition is represented, simulated, classified, and operationalized.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了认知数字孪生（CDT）技术——一种动态计算表征个体认知的系统，并提出针对CDT的5A治理框架（权威、自主性、访问与控制、问责制、可用性），分析其特有风险（如误表征、认知权威转移、影子孪生等），指出现有治理策略的不足，并提出高风险CDT的治理要求。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统日益持久化和个性化，出现了认知数字孪生（CDT）这类新技术，但现有治理策略（针对个人助理、自主代理、推荐系统、自动决策系统等）只能部分覆盖CDT带来的挑战，亟需专门的治理框架。
AI.method: 1) 定义CDT并区分其与相邻系统；2) 提出5A治理框架；3) 识别CDT特有风险；4) 分析治理缺口并提出高风险CDT的治理要求。
AI.result: 发现现有框架主要监管数据处理、自动决策或自主行动，而CDT还需要在认知表征层面进行治理，即在最终决策或外部行动发生之前进行监管。
AI.conclusion: CDT需要治理不仅因为它们可以代理人的行动，更因为它们可能成为表征、模拟、分类和操作认知的基础设施。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Learning for Enzyme-Substrate Interaction Prediction Under Low-Homology Shift
summary: Enzyme substrate interaction (ESI) prediction is a fundamental computational task for biocatalyst discovery and reaction screening in large biochemical spaces. In practical settings, ESI prediction is challenged by sparse positive supervision and low-homology distribution shift, where test enzymes share limited sequence identity with those observed during training. To address these challenges, we propose RAMMESI, a retrieval-augmented multimodal framework for robust ESI prediction. RAMMESI learns explicit pairwise enzyme-substrate representations through directional cross-modal interaction modeling and adaptive fusion. To enhance robustness, RAMMESI retrieves neighboring enzymes at inference time, recombines them with the query substrate, and aggregates the resulting pairwise predictions as contextual evidence. To improve learning under sparse positive supervision, we further adopt an imbalance-aware weighted-BCE objective. Experiments on two ESI benchmarks under sequence-identity-aware splits demonstrate that RAMMESI achieves consistently strong performance, with particular advantages in more challenging low-identity regimes. In addition, the retrieval module improves multiple ESI backbones in a plug-and-play manner, suggesting that retrieval provides a general mechanism for improving robustness under homology shift.

AI.tldr: RAMMESI是一种检索增强的多模态框架，通过方向性跨模态交互建模、自适应融合和推理时邻居酶检索，结合不平衡加权BCE损失，有效解决酶-底物相互作用预测中的稀疏正监督和低同源性分布偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 酶-底物相互作用(ESI)预测面临两大挑战：稀疏的正监督信号（正样本稀少）和低同源性分布偏移（测试酶与训练酶的序列一致性低），现有方法在这些实际场景下表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出RAMMESI框架：(1) 方向性跨模态交互建模与自适应融合学习显式的成对酶-底物表示；(2) 推理时检索邻近酶，与查询底物重组并聚合预测结果作为上下文证据；(3) 采用不平衡感知加权BCE损失改善稀疏正监督下的学习。
AI.result: 在基于序列一致性划分的两个ESI基准上，RAMMESI持续取得强劲性能，在更具挑战性的低同源性场景下优势尤为明显。检索模块还能以即插即用方式提升多个ESI骨干模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 检索提供了一种提升同源性偏移下鲁棒性的通用机制，RAMMESI框架能有效应对实际ESI预测中的核心挑战。

title: Self-Evolution for Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents via Divergence-Point Preference Learning
summary: Multi-turn tool-using agents must coordinate long-horizon tool sequences while tracking dialogue state and policy constraints. Existing approaches often separate inference-time orchestration from parameter-level learning, leaving tool selection weakly structured and preference updates vulnerable to train--deployment prompt mismatch. For within-benchmark self-improvement, ToolGraph combines schema-derived topology, transition weights estimated from successful rollouts, and history-aware controls for write prerequisites and repeated-search loops. We then construct 161 preference pairs by locating divergence points via state-based matching and prefix-based alignment, filtered through action-correctness annotations, and train DPO under the same ToolGraph context used at inference. Across 375 tau2-bench tasks, ToolGraph raises the weighted average reward from 0.304 to 0.338 (+11.2% relative), while ToolGraph+DPO reaches 0.355 (+16.8% over the baseline), with the DPO gain concentrated in airline and retail. Fine-grained diagnostics further show that roughly half of telecom trajectories exhaust the step budget before action execution and that chosen reward positivity is the most useful checkpoint signal across our 16 evaluated DPO configurations.

AI.tldr: ToolGraph结合图结构推理与DPO偏好优化，在375个tau2-bench任务上将加权平均奖励从0.304提升至0.355（+16.8%），其中DPO增益主要集中在航空和零售领域。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用代理在长序列协调、对话状态跟踪和策略约束方面存在结构松散问题，且推理时的工具选择与参数级学习分离，导致偏好更新易受训练-部署提示不匹配影响。
AI.method: 提出ToolGraph方法：(1) 基于schema构建拓扑图并估计过渡权重；(2) 加入历史感知控制（写前置条件、重复搜索循环）；(3) 通过状态匹配和前缀对齐定位分歧点构建161个偏好对；(4) 在ToolGraph上下文中训练DPO。
AI.result: 在375个tau2-bench任务中，ToolGraph将加权平均奖励从0.304提升至0.338（+11.2%），ToolGraph+DPO达到0.355（+16.8%）。DPO增益集中在航空和零售领域。约半数电信轨迹在动作执行前耗尽了步骤预算。
AI.conclusion: 图结构引导的推理与偏好优化能够有效提升多轮工具使用代理的性能，选择奖励正向性是最有效的检查点信号。

title: BranchShine: Compact Raw-Audio-to-IPA Transcription with a RoPE E-Branchformer Encoder
summary: Speech-to-IPA transcription is useful when the desired output is pronunciation rather than orthographic text, but competitive multilingual systems are often large and evaluation is sensitive to normalization choices. This paper presents BranchShine, a 33M-parameter raw-audio CTC recognizer with a lightweight convolutional front end and a 19-block RoPE E-Branchformer encoder. We find that BranchShine provides a compact and competitive operating point for IPA transcription under matched normalization and scoring. On a 16,660-utterance multilingual test set covering 41 language labels, BranchShine obtains 9.19% whitespace-insensitive IPA character error rate, compared with 9.78% for the 575.00M-parameter PhoneticXEUS baseline. A secondary child speech reading analysis shows a complementary operating profile: BranchShine is more conservative on incorrect readings, while Whisper-Medium is stronger on exact acceptance of correct readings. Overall, the results indicate that a compact raw-audio-to-IPA model can approach much larger baselines on character-level IPA transcription.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BranchShine，一个33M参数的原始音频到IPA音标的CTC识别模型，在41种语言的测试集上以9.19%的字符错误率接近了575M参数的PhoneticXEUS基线（9.78%），证明了紧凑模型在大规模IPA转写任务上的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 语音到IPA音标转写在需要发音而非正交文本输出的场景中有用，但竞争性的多语言系统往往规模庞大，且评估对归一化选择敏感，因此需要探索紧凑且有效的解决方案。
AI.method: BranchShine采用33M参数，包含轻量级卷积前端和19块RoPE E-Branchformer编码器，基于CTC损失函数进行原始音频到IPA音标的直接识别。
AI.result: 在覆盖41种语言标签的16,660条多语言测试集上，BranchShine获得9.19%的忽略空格的IPA字符错误率，而575M参数的PhoneticXEUS基线为9.78%。儿童口语阅读分析显示BranchShine在错误阅读上更保守，Whisper-Medium在正确阅读的精确接受上更强。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的原始音频到IPA音标模型可以在字符级IPA转写任务上接近更大规模基线的表现。

title: Managing Procedural Memory in LLM Agents: Control, Adaptation, and Evaluation
summary: Procedural memory is increasingly used to improve LLM agents on recurring workplace tasks, yet its ability to produce reusable skills remains poorly understood. We introduce AFTER, a benchmark of 382 realistic enterprise tasks spanning six professional roles and 22 procedural skills, designed to evaluate how skills transfer across tasks, roles, and model backbones. The benchmark includes controlled evaluation settings for local improvement, cross-task transfer, cross-role transfer, and cross-model generalization. Experiments show that procedural memory delivers consistent gains in industrial workflows: a single refinement round improves aggregate performance by 3.7-6.7 points, while skills evolved from diverse multi-model execution traces achieve 73.1% cross-model test accuracy, outperforming all single-model trace sources. We further find that some skills generalize broadly across tasks and models, whereas others become specialized to role-specific workflows and lose effectiveness under transfer. These results provide practical guidance for building, evaluating, and deploying procedural memory systems in production agent platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AFTER基准，包含382个企业任务和22个程序性技能，用于评估程序性记忆在LLM代理中的技能迁移能力。实验表明，程序性记忆能带来3.7-6.7分的性能提升，多模型演化技能达到73.1%的跨模型测试准确率，且部分技能可广泛泛化，部分则专化于特定角色。
AI.motivation: 程序性记忆在提升LLM代理完成重复性工作任务的方面越来越被广泛使用，但其产生可复用技能的能力尚不清楚，缺乏系统的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建AFTER基准，包含382个真实企业任务、6个专业角色和22个程序性技能；设计了局部改进、跨任务迁移、跨角色迁移和跨模型泛化四种评估设置。
AI.result: 单轮改进带来3.7-6.7分聚合性能提升；多模型执行轨迹演化的技能达到73.1%跨模型测试准确率，优于所有单模型轨迹来源；部分技能可广泛泛化，部分技能专化于特定角色工作流。
AI.conclusion: 为在代理平台上构建、评估和部署程序性记忆系统提供了实用指导。

title: CLIP-guided Diffusion Model for Backdoor Generation in Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition
summary: Sensors are critical components of modern intelligent devices. The proliferation of the Internet of Things (IoT) and wearable mobile devices has enabled the integration of such sensors to monitor the environment and enable users to take predictive actions. Human activity recognition (HAR) is a popular application in which Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU)-based sensors, such as accelerometers and gyroscopes, are used to provide insights into health, training, and medical diagnosis. However, the accuracy of such a model is hindered by the lack of data. The diffusion model-based technique has proven successful in generating synthetic data for training HAR models. In this paper, we propose a backdoor training technique, IMU-DM-CLIP, that leverages a diffusion model to enable trigger-based attacks on HAR models. Our empirical analysis shows that the attack is successful even with a very small backdoor injection rate of 10\% and 10\% of the data guided for the diffusion model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IMU-DM-CLIP，一种利用扩散模型在人类活动识别（HAR）系统中植入后门攻击的方法，仅需10%的后门注入率和10%的数据引导即可成功实施攻击。
AI.motivation: HAR模型在智能设备中广泛应用，但面临数据不足的问题。扩散模型虽能生成合成数据提升模型精度，但本文指出该技术存在安全漏洞，可被恶意利用进行后门攻击。
AI.method: 提出IMU-DM-CLIP方法，结合扩散模型与CLIP架构，设计基于触发器的后门攻击技术，通过少量（10%）被篡改数据注入后门。
AI.result: 实验表明，在仅10%的后门注入率和10%的数据引导率下，攻击仍能成功实施，证明该后门攻击具有高效性和隐蔽性。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型在HAR数据增强中的应用存在安全隐患，需警惕针对IMU传感器的后门攻击威胁。

title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
summary: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that samples two cheap no-think drafts, accepts direct answering when the drafts agree, and predicts a thinking budget from draft entropy when they disagree. Across the main comparisons, DART preserves or improves always-thinking accuracy in most settings while reducing thinking-token use. On math reasoning, accuracy improves by up to $+$9.0 points on Olympiad-level problems while thinking tokens drop 15-69%. On code reasoning under execution-based equivalence, accuracy improves by up to +22.5 points while thinking tokens drop 51-63%. The Stage~1 signal extends across model scales (0.6B-32B), model families, and API-only hosted settings, with no labeled data and no gradient updates required.

AI.tldr: DART是一种无需训练的路由框架，通过采样两个廉价的无思考草稿，在草稿一致时直接回答，在草稿不一致时根据草稿熵预测思考预算，从而在保持或提升准确性的同时大幅减少思考令牌使用量。
AI.motivation: 现有混合推理模型的路由器需要标注训练数据或预先固定思考预算，忽视了模型自身的答案级证据，无法在简单问题和困难问题之间灵活分配计算资源。
AI.method: DART框架采样两个廉价的无思考草稿（no-think drafts），当草稿一致时直接接受答案；当草稿不一致时，利用草稿熵（draft entropy）来动态预测需要的思考预算，然后调用模型的思考模式。
AI.result: 在数学推理中，奥林匹克级别问题准确率提升高达+9.0分，思考令牌减少15-69%；在代码推理中（基于执行等价评估），准确率提升高达+22.5分，思考令牌减少51-63%。该方法在0.6B-32B模型规模、不同模型家族及仅API托管环境下均有效。
AI.conclusion: DART作为一个无需训练、无需梯度更新的路由框架，能够有效平衡混合推理模型的准确性和计算效率，在多种场景下优于现有方法。

title: RLM-Cascade: Response-Level Speculative Decoding for Cost-Efficient LLM API Serving
summary: We present RLM-Cascade, a proxy-layer system that applies speculative decoding at the response level to reduce LLM API costs without requiring model architecture access or a shared vocabulary. A fast, inexpensive draft model generates a candidate response; a capable verify model accepts, enhances, or is bypassed entirely depending on a lightweight complexity router. On a real-world agentic coding workload (Claude Code), RLM-Cascade achieves a draft-use rate of 88.8% across 125 production requests, reducing API cost by 45.8% relative to a direct Opus baseline. Counter-intuitively, the proxy also reduces end-to-end latency: median response time is 2,026 ms versus 3,698 ms for Native Opus -- a 1.83X speedup at p50 -- because the SKIPPED path (DeepSeek only, no Opus call) dominates the workload distribution. Quality matches or exceeds the Opus baseline: 100% pass rate on a 20-task Code/Math/Instruct benchmark versus 95% for Native Opus. We further describe a rule-based complexity router that selects the SKIPPED path for simple agentic turns and a hybrid tool-call strategy that bypasses the speculative pipeline for schema-critical tool-selection turns. RLM-Cascade is deployed in production as an enterprise AI infrastructure component and published as open source with a live metrics dashboard and Prometheus endpoint.

AI.tldr: RLM-Cascade是一个代理层系统，通过在响应级别应用推测解码，在无需模型架构访问或共享词汇表的情况下，将LLM API成本降低45.8%，同时实现1.83倍的速度提升。该系统使用快速廉价的草稿模型生成候选响应，由轻量级复杂度路由器决定是否由验证模型接受、增强或完全绕过。在真实编码工作负载中，草稿使用率达88.8%，质量超越基线（100% vs 95%）。
AI.motivation: 降低LLM API调用成本而不牺牲质量或延迟，同时无需访问底层模型架构或共享词汇表，使系统在现有商业API上即可部署。
AI.method: 提出RLM-Cascade代理层系统，采用响应级推测解码：快速草稿模型（DeepSeek）生成候选响应，轻量级复杂度路由器决定三路径——SKIPPED（直接使用草稿）、ACCEPTED（草稿作为提示给验证模型增强）、BYPASSED（完全跳过推测管线直接调用验证模型）。同时引入混合工具调用策略，对模式关键的工具选择轮次绕过推测管线。
AI.result: 在Claude Code生产工作负载上，125个请求中草稿使用率88.8%，API成本降低45.8%；中位延迟从3,698ms降至2,026ms（1.83倍加速），SKIPPED路径主导分布；20任务基准测试中通过率100% vs Native Opus的95%。
AI.conclusion: RLM-Cascade证明了在无需模型架构访问的前提下，通过响应级推测解码和轻量级路由机制可以同时实现成本降低、延迟优化和质量提升。该系统已部署为生产级企业AI基础设施组件，并开源。

title: Capable but Careless: Do Computer-Use Agents Follow Contextual Integrity?
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) now act on a user's behalf across personal applications such as email, calendars, and to-do lists. This cross-application access is useful, but it also creates a privacy risk that has been largely overlooked: when an agent works in one context, it can pull in information from another that is inappropriate in that context. Hence, we introduce AgentCIBench, an evaluation harness that turns this risk into executable, deterministically scored scenarios. We target three common failure modes in CUAs: visual co-location, where the agent pulls in prohibited items that sit next to the task target in the UI; task-ambiguity overshare, where the agent dumps dense personal state in response to an under-specified prompt; and recipient misalignment, where the agent sends content to an addressee for whom it is inappropriate. We evaluate 15 frontier agents and find a surprisingly high failure rate: 11 of 15 leak on more than 50% of scenarios, with an average leakage of 67.9%, and the same failures persist when agents act end-to-end in the environment to complete the task. We release AgentCIBench to encourage the development of safer computer-use agents and position contextual disclosure testing as a pre-deployment safety check.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentCIBench基准，针对计算机使用代理在跨应用操作时无意泄露上下文信息的三大失败模式（视觉共位泄露、任务模糊过度分享、接收者错配）进行评估，发现15个前沿代理中有11个在超50%场景下泄露信息，平均泄露率67.9%。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用代理在跨应用操作时存在被忽视的隐私风险：代理在一个上下文中工作时，可能从另一个上下文拉入不适当的信息。
AI.method: 设计了AgentCIBench评估框架，将隐私风险转化为可执行、可确定性评分的情景，针对视觉共位泄露、任务模糊过度分享、接收者错配三种失败模式，对15个前沿代理进行测试。
AI.result: 15个代理中11个在超过50%的情景中泄露信息，平均泄露率达67.9%，且端到端任务执行中同样存在该问题。
AI.conclusion: 当前计算机使用代理存在严重的上下文信息披露问题，需要将上下文披露测试作为部署前的安全检查，推动开发更安全的代理。

title: The Unseen Hand: Manipulating Model Fairness and SHAP with Targeted Identity Re-Association Attacks
summary: As machine learning models grow more influential and opaque, algorithmic fairness and explainability are critical for ensuring accountability. However, we demonstrate that these auditing mechanisms are themselves vulnerable to subtle manipulation, camouflaging the influence of protected features. While prior work on data-agnostic attacks has exposed this vulnerability, they leave behind detectable artifacts that compromise their stealth. We introduce Targeted Identity Re-Association (TIRA) attacks, a novel family of attacks that iteratively and probabilistically manipulate a model's outputs without requiring access to the model's internals or feature representations. We formalize two algorithms: Probabilistic Micro-Shuffling (PMiS), which applies localized adjacent swaps, and Probabilistic Rank-Shift Micro-Perturbation (PRSMP), which introduces small, randomized rank shifts. We empirically demonstrate that TIRA attacks are highly effective at pushing fairness metrics towards ideal values. Crucially, TIRA attacks successfully confound SHAP-based explanations, leaving effectively zero residual attribution for protected features, a major improvement over prior work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIRA攻击系列（包括PMiS和PRSMP算法），通过迭代概率性操作模型输出，在不访问模型内部结构的情况下，有效操控公平性指标并混淆SHAP解释，使受保护特征的归因贡献几乎为零，比先前方法更具隐蔽性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型日益强大且不透明，算法公平性和可解释性成为确保问责制的关键；然而已有审计机制本身易受操纵，先前数据无关攻击虽暴露了此漏洞但留下可检测痕迹，缺乏隐蔽性。
AI.method: 提出TIRA攻击系列，包含两种算法：PMiS（概率性微混洗，执行局部相邻交换）和PRSMP（概率性排名偏移微扰动，引入小型随机排名偏移）。两者均以迭代概率方式操纵模型输出，无需访问模型内部结构或特征表示。
AI.result: TIRA攻击能高效地将公平性指标推向理想值；更重要的是，成功混淆SHAP解释，使受保护特征的残差归因几乎为零，显著优于先前工作。
AI.conclusion: 公平性与可解释性审计机制存在被隐蔽操纵的风险，TIRA攻击展示了这种脆弱性，提示需开发更鲁棒的审计方法。

title: Memory Contagion: Cross-Temporal Propagation of Evaluator Bias via Agent Memory
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on memory systems to maintain long-term coherence. Recent work shows that agent memories degrade during continuous consolidation. However, existing research assumes memories are derived from unbiased experiences. In this work, we identify and formalize a novel phenomenon: Memory Contagion -- the cross-temporal propagation of evaluator bias through agent memory. We show that when agents are trained or guided by biased evaluators, their experiences become biased; when these trajectories are stored and consolidated into memory, the bias propagates to future agents retrieving from the same memory store, even when consolidation is perfect (oracle). Across two bias types (length preference, authority bias) and four experimental phases, we demonstrate: (1) Memory Contagion occurs even with perfect consolidation (oracle condition), proving that biased input is a sufficient cause of contagion; (2) Consolidation has opposite effects depending on bias type -- robustly attenuating length bias while preliminarily amplifying authority bias (single-run estimate), suggesting a bias-type-dependent interaction; (3) No observed safe threshold: bias propagation is detected at contamination rates as low as p=0.2. Our findings expose a critical vulnerability in current agent memory designs and provide formal tools for measuring cross-temporal bias propagation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现并形式化了LLM智能体记忆系统中的"记忆传染"现象：有偏评估者的偏见会通过记忆存储和整合跨时间传播，即使记忆整合是完美的，偏见仍会从有偏经验传播到后续智能体。研究在两种偏见类型（长度偏好、权威偏见）和四个实验阶段中证实了该现象，并发现不同偏见类型下记忆整合效果相反，且不存在安全阈值（污染率低至p=0.2仍可检测到偏见传播）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设智能体记忆来源于无偏经验，但实际中智能体常由有偏评估者训练或指导，导致经验本身带有偏见。作者旨在发现并形式化这种偏见通过记忆系统跨时间传播的机制，揭示当前智能体记忆设计的脆弱性。
AI.method: 形式化定义了"记忆传染"现象，设计了两类偏见（长度偏好、权威偏见）和四个实验阶段，通过控制污染率（p从0.2开始）和整合质量（包括完美的oracle整合条件）进行系统实验。
AI.result: (1)即使完美整合（oracle条件）下记忆传染仍然发生；(2)整合对不同偏见类型效果相反——稳健抑制长度偏见，但初步放大权威偏见；(3)不存在安全阈值，污染率低至p=0.2即可检测到偏见传播。
AI.conclusion: 记忆传染暴露了当前智能体记忆设计的严重缺陷，需要开发能够检测和缓解跨时间偏见传播的形式化工具与机制。

title: When AUC 0.998 Is Not Enough: A Candidate Evaluation Protocol for Hidden-State Probes of Indirect Prompt Injection in Multimodal Computer-Use Agents
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Camera-ready version for EvalMG '26, The 2nd Workshop on Evaluation for Multimodal Generation, co-located with SIGIR 2026
summary: Hidden-state probing -- a linear classifier on a frozen vision-language model's internal activations -- has emerged as an attractive evaluation tool for flagging indirect prompt injection (IPI) in multimodal computer-use agents before the agent emits a corrupted action. We argue, on a single-backbone cautionary case study (Qwen2.5-VL-7B on Mind2Web, teacher-forced replay), that a high probing AUC on a clean-vs-attack split is not, on its own, evidence of malicious-content detection. Two post-hoc diagnostics -- a paired-construction scalar baseline on text-side injections, and same-step nuisance-matched visual controls on the overlay surface -- do not license an unqualified malicious-content interpretation of the headline while leaving room for partly-semantic readings. We package the diagnostics as a candidate control set with reporting heuristics for what a high clean-vs-attack AUC does and does not license. Labels are injection-surface-present, not attack success; generalisation beyond this backbone and benchmark is a conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过单骨干案例研究（Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 Mind2Web 上）论证，隐状态探测（在冻结的视觉语言模型内部激活上训练线性分类器）在干净-攻击二分类上取得的高 AUC 本身并不能作为检测恶意内容的证据。作者提出两项事后诊断（文本侧注入的配对构造标量基线、覆盖表面的同步骤干扰匹配视觉控制），并给出了报告启发式，说明高 AUC 在何种条件下成立或不成立。
AI.motivation: 当前将隐状态探测作为检测多模态计算机使用智能体中间接提示注入（IPI）的评价工具日益流行，但作者怀疑高探测 AUC 是否真正意味着检测到了恶意内容，而非表面特征。因此需要提出诊断方法检验探测器的真实语义理解能力。
AI.method: 采用单骨干案例研究方法，使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 模型在 Mind2Web 数据集上进行教师强制回放。提出两项事后诊断：(1) 文本侧注入的配对构造标量基线；(2) 覆盖表面的同步骤干扰匹配视觉控制。标签定义为注入表面是否出现，而非攻击是否成功。
AI.result: 高 AUC 不能无条件解释为恶意内容检测；两项诊断表明仍有部分语义解读空间，但不支持纯粹的恶意内容检测结论。AUC 高仅意味着探测到注入表面的存在，而非攻击成功与否。
AI.conclusion: 隐状态探测的高 AUC 应审慎解释，需配合诊断控制集使用；超出当前骨干和基准的泛化能力仅为推测。作者将诊断方法打包为候选控制集并附报告启发式。

title: VeriEvol: Scaling Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning via Verifiable Evol-Instruct
summary: Scaling reinforcement learning for visual mathematical reasoning requires more than generating harder questions: as data volume grows, the reward labels themselves must remain reliable. Yet existing data pipelines scale supervision while trusting the labeller, and policy-side methods assume the underlying answers are already correct. We instead treat scaling as a verifiable data-construction problem and decouple two axes before any policy update: prompt difficulty, expanded by route-specific evolution operators, and answer reliability, enforced by offline hypothesis-test falsification. We instantiate this as VeriEvol, an iterative framework with two extensible components: a type-aware evolution module that rewrites low-difficulty image-question seeds into harder, image-grounded prompts; and HTV-Agent, a verifier that accepts an answer only after multi-source counter-evidence has failed to refute it. The resulting verified data scales in volume, extends by adding evolution routes or verifier channels, and plugs directly into existing GRPO-style RL recipes. On a five-benchmark visual-math suite, scaling evolved SFT data from 10K to 250K samples raises the mean accuracy from 35.42 to 54.73; then, with backbone, SFT initialization, and GRPO recipe held fixed, VeriEvol adds a cumulative +3.88 over an un-evolved RL baseline, of which +1.82 comes from evolved prompts and +2.06 from the HTV-Agent verifier.
